verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tabernacle of the congregation, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse dans le désert de Sinaï, dans la tente d''assignation, le premier jour du second mois, la seconde année après leur sortie du pays d''Egypte. Il dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በሲና ምድረ በዳ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ፥ በሁለተኛው ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን፥ ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በሁለተኛው ዓመት እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take ye the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, after their families, by the house of their fathers, with the number of their names, every male by their polls;
verses.fr: Faites le dénombrement de toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant par tête les noms de tous les mâles,
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ድምር፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ በየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ወንዱን በየራሱ፥ ውሰዱ።

verses.en: From twenty years old and upward, all that are able to go forth to war in Israel: thou and Aaron shall number them by their armies.
verses.fr: depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux d''Israël en état de porter les armes; vous en ferez le dénombrement selon leurs divisions, toi et Aaron.
verses.am: ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን፥ ከእስራኤል ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡትን ሁሉ፥ አንተና አሮን በየሠራዊቶቻቸው ቍጠሩአቸው።

verses.en: And with you there shall be a man of every tribe; every one head of the house of his fathers.
verses.fr: Il y aura avec vous un homme par tribu, chef de la maison de ses pères.
verses.am: ከየነገዱም አንድ ሰው የአባቶቹ ቤት አለቃ ከእናንተ ጋር ይሁን።

verses.en: And these are the names of the men that shall stand with you: of the tribe of Reuben; Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des hommes qui se tiendront avec vous. Pour Ruben: Elitsur, fils de Schedéur;
verses.am: ከእናንተም ጋር የሚቆሙት ሰዎች ስሞቻቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከሮቤል የሰዲዮር ልጅ

verses.en: Of Simeon; Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.fr: pour Siméon: Schelumiel, fils de Tsurischaddaï;
verses.am: ኤሊሱር፥ ከስምዖን የሱሪሰዳይ ልጅ ሰለሚኤል፥

verses.en: Of Judah; Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.fr: pour Juda: Nachschon, fils d''Amminadab;
verses.am: ከይሁዳ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን፥

verses.en: Of Issachar; Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.fr: pour Issacar: Nethaneel, fils de Tsuar;
verses.am: ከይሳኮር የሶገር ልጅ ናትናኤል፥

verses.en: Of Zebulun; Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.fr: pour Zabulon: Eliab, fils de Hélon;
verses.am: ከአሴር የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል፥

verses.en: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim; Elishama the son of Ammihud: of Manasseh; Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.fr: pour les fils de Joseph, -pour Ephraïm: Elischama, fils d''Ammihud; -pour Manassé: Gamliel, fils de Pedahtsur;
verses.am: ከአሴር የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል፥

verses.en: Of Benjamin; Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.fr: pour Benjamin: Abidan, fils de Guideoni;
verses.am: ከአሴር የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል፥

verses.en: Of Dan; Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.fr: pour Dan: Ahiézer, fils d''Ammischaddaï;
verses.am: ከጋድ የራጉኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ፥

verses.en: Of Asher; Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.fr: pour Aser: Paguiel, fils d''Ocran;
verses.am: ከንፍታሌም የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ።

verses.en: Of Gad; Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.fr: pour Gad: Eliasaph, fils de Déuel;
verses.am: ከማኅበሩ የተመረጡ የእስራኤል አእላፍ ታላላቆች፥ የአባቶቻቸው ነገድ አለቆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Of Naphtali; Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.fr: pour Nephthali: Ahira, fils d''Enan.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም እነዚህን በስማቸው የተጠሩትን ሰዎች ወሰዱአቸው፤

verses.en: These were the renowned of the congregation, princes of the tribes of their fathers, heads of thousands in Israel.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux qui furent convoqués à l''assemblée, princes des tribus de leurs pères, chefs des milliers d''Israël.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ማኅበሩን ሁሉ ሰበሰቡአቸው፤ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን በየራሱ በየወገኑም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች በየስማቸው ቍጥር ትውልዳቸውን ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron took these men which are expressed by their names:
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron prirent ces hommes, qui avaient été désignés par leurs noms,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ በሲና ምድረ በዳ ቈጠራቸው።

verses.en: And they assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month, and they declared their pedigrees after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, by their polls.
verses.fr: et ils convoquèrent toute l''assemblée, le premier jour du second mois. On les enregistra selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant par tête les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus.
verses.am: የእስራኤል በኵር የሮቤል ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ በየራሳቸው፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: As the Lord commanded Moses, so he numbered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.fr: Moïse en fit le dénombrement dans le désert de Sinaï, comme l''Eternel le lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: ከሮቤል ነገድ የተቈጠሩ አርባ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the children of Reuben, Israel's eldest son, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Ruben, premier-né d''Israël, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant par tête les noms de tous les mâles, depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የስምዖን ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የተቈጠሩ፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ በየራሳቸው፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለው ወንድ ሁሉ፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Reuben, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Ruben dont on fit le dénombrement furent quarante-six mille cinq cents.
verses.am: ከስምዖን ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ዘጠኝ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Simeon, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, those that were numbered of them, according to the number of the names, by their polls, every male from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Siméon, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères; on en fit le dénombrement, en comptant par tête les noms de tous les mâles depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የጋድ ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Siméon dont on fit le dénombrement furent cinquante-neuf mille trois cents.
verses.am: ከጋድ ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አርባ አምስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Gad, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Gad, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Gad, were forty and five thousand six hundred and fifty.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Gad dont on fit le dénombrement furent quarante-cinq mille six cent cinquante.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ነገድ የተቈጠሩት ሰባ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Judah, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Juda, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የይሳኮር ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Judah, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Juda dont on fit le dénombrement furent soixante-quatorze mille six cents.
verses.am: ከይሳኮር ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አምሳ አራት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Issachar, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils d''Issacar, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የዛብሎን ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu d''Issacar dont on fit le dénombrement furent cinquante-quatre mille quatre cents.
verses.am: ከዛብሎን ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሰባት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Zebulun, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Zabulon, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ልጆች፥ የኤፍሬም ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Zabulon dont on fit le dénombrement furent cinquante-sept mille quatre cents.
verses.am: ከኤፍሬም ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አርባ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Joseph, namely, of the children of Ephraim, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra, d''entre les fils de Joseph, les fils d''Ephraïm, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የምናሴ ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu d''Ephraïm dont on fit le dénombrement furent quarante mille cinq cents.
verses.am: ከምናሴ ነገድ የተቈጠሩት ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Manasseh, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Manassé, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የብንያም ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Manassé dont on fit le dénombrement furent trente-deux mille deux cents.
verses.am: ከብንያም ነገድ የተቈጠሩት ሠላሳ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Benjamin, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Benjamin, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የዳን ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Benjamin dont on fit le dénombrement furent trente-cinq mille quatre cents.
verses.am: ከዳን ነገድ የተቈጠሩት ስድሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Dan, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Dan, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የአሴር ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Dan, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Dan dont on fit le dénombrement furent soixante-deux mille sept cents.
verses.am: ከአሴር ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አርባ አንድ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Asher, by their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils d''Aser, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የንፍታሌም ልጆች በየትውልዳቸው፥ በየወገናቸው፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ እንደየስማቸው ቍጥር፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Asher, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu d''Aser dont on fit le dénombrement furent quarante et un mille cinq cents.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌም ነገድ የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Naphtali, throughout their generations, after their families, by the house of their fathers, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war;
verses.fr: On enregistra les fils de Nephthali, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, en comptant les noms depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux en état de porter les armes:
verses.am: የተቈጠሩት፥ ሙሴና አሮን አሥራ ሁለቱም የእስራኤል አለቆች የቈጠሩአቸው፥ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ እያንዳንዱ የአባቶቹ ቤት አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, even of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: les hommes de la tribu de Nephthali dont on fit le dénombrement furent cinquante-trois mille quatre cents.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ፥ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት፥ ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡት ሁሉ፥

verses.en: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux dont le dénombrement fut fait par Moïse et Aaron, et par les douze hommes, princes d''Israël; il y avait un homme pour chacune des maisons de leurs pères.
verses.am: የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ ስድስት መቶ ሦስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
verses.fr: Tous ceux des enfants d''Israël dont on fit le dénombrement, selon les maisons de leurs pères, depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, tous ceux d''Israël en état de porter les armes,
verses.am: ሌዋውያን ግን በየአባቶቻቸው ነገድ ከእነርሱ ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.en: Even all they that were numbered were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.fr: tous ceux dont on fit le dénombrement furent six cent trois mille cinq cent cinquante.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው። የሌዊን ነገድ አትቍጠረው፥

verses.en: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not numbered among them.
verses.fr: Les Lévites, selon la tribu de leurs pères, ne firent point partie de ce dénombrement.
verses.am: ቍጥራቸውንም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አታድርግ፤

verses.en: For the Lord had spoken unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምስክሩ ማደሪያና በዕቃዎች ሁሉ ለእርሱም በሚሆነው ነገር ሁሉ ላይ ሌዋውያንን አቁማቸው። ማደሪያውንና ዕቃዎችን ሁሉ ይሸከሙ፥ ያገልግሉትም፥ በማደሪያውም ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ።

verses.en: Only thou shalt not number the tribe of Levi, neither take the sum of them among the children of Israel:
verses.fr: Tu ne feras point le dénombrement de la tribu de Lévi, et tu n''en compteras point les têtes au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ማደሪያውም ሲነሣ ሌዋውያን ይንቀሉት፤ ማደሪያውም በሰፈረ ጊዜ ሌዋውያን ይትከሉት፤ ሌላ ሰው ግን ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.en: But thou shalt appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of testimony, and over all the vessels thereof, and over all things that belong to it: they shall bear the tabernacle, and all the vessels thereof; and they shall minister unto it, and shall encamp round about the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Remets aux soins des Lévites le tabernacle du témoignage, tous ses ustensiles et tout ce qui lui appartient. Ils porteront le tabernacle et tous ses ustensiles, ils en feront le service, et ils camperont autour du tabernacle.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እያንዳንዱ በየሰፈሩ፥ በየዓላማውም፥ በየጭፍራውም ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.en: And when the tabernacle setteth forward, the Levites shall take it down: and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.fr: Quand le tabernacle partira, les Lévites le démonteront; quand le tabernacle campera, les Lévites le dresseront; et l''étranger qui en approchera sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይወርድ ሌዋውያን በምስክሩ ማደሪያ ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ፤ ሌዋውያንም የምስክሩን ማደሪያ ይጠብቁ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, throughout their hosts.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël camperont chacun dans son camp, chacun près de sa bannière, selon leurs divisions.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: But the Levites shall pitch round about the tabernacle of testimony, that there be no wrath upon the congregation of the children of Israel: and the Levites shall keep the charge of the tabernacle of testimony.
verses.fr: Mais les Lévites camperont autour du tabernacle du témoignage, afin que ma colère n''éclate point sur l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël; et les Lévites auront la garde du tabernacle du témoignage.
verses.am: ፤ ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይወርድ ሌዋውያን በምስክሩ ማደሪያ ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ፤ ሌዋውያንም የምስክሩን ማደሪያ ይጠብቁ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did they.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël se conformèrent à tous les ordres que l''Eternel avait donnés à Moïse; ils firent ainsi.
verses.am: ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴና ለአሮን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረ።

verses.en: Every man of the children of Israel shall pitch by his own standard, with the ensign of their father's house: far off about the tabernacle of the congregation shall they pitch.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël camperont chacun près de sa bannière, sous les enseignes de la maison de ses pères; ils camperont vis-à-vis et tout autour de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች እያንዳንዱ በየዓላማው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ምልክት ይስፈሩ፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን አፋዛዥ ዙሪያ ይስፈሩ።

verses.en: And on the east side toward the rising of the sun shall they of the standard of the camp of Judah pitch throughout their armies: and Nahshon the son of Amminadab shall be captain of the children of Judah.
verses.fr: A l''orient, le camp de Juda, avec sa bannière, et avec ses corps d''armée. Là camperont le prince des fils de Juda, Nachschon, fils d''Amminadab,
verses.am: በምሥራቅ በኩል ወደ ፀሐይ መውጫ የሚሰፍሩት እንደ ሠራዊቶቻቸው የይሁዳ ሰፈር ዓላማ ሰዎች ይሆናሉ፤ የይሁዳ ልጆችም አለቃ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and fourteen thousand and six hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de soixante-quatorze mille six cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ሰባ አራት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And those that do pitch next unto him shall be the tribe of Issachar: and Nethaneel the son of Zuar shall be captain of the children of Issachar.
verses.fr: A ses côtés camperont la tribu d''Issacar, le prince des fils d''Issacar, Nethaneel, fils de Tsuar,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የሚሰፍሩ የይሳኮር ነገድ ይሆናሉ፤ የይሳኮርም ልጆች አለቃ የሶገር ልጅ ናትናኤል ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de cinquante-quatre mille quatre cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement;
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ አራት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then the tribe of Zebulun: and Eliab the son of Helon shall be captain of the children of Zebulun.
verses.fr: puis la tribu de Zabulon, le prince des fils de Zabulon, Eliab, fils de Hélon,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የዛብሎን ነገድ ነበረ፤ የዛብሎንም ልጆች አለቃ የኬሎን ልጅ ኤልያብ ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were fifty and seven thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de cinquante-sept mille quatre cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ ሰባት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
verses.fr: Total pour le camp de Juda, d''après le dénombrement: cent quatre-vingt six mille quatre cents hommes, selon leurs corps d''armée. Ils seront les premiers dans la marche.
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው መቶ ሰማንያ ስድስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ። እነዚህም አስቀድመው ይጓዛሉ።

verses.en: On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their armies: and the captain of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.fr: Au midi, le camp de Ruben, avec sa bannière, et avec ses corps d''armée. Là camperont le prince des fils de Ruben, Elitsur, fils de Schedéur,
verses.am: በደቡብ በኩል በየሠራዊቶቻቸው የሮቤል ሰፈር ዓላማ ይሆናል፤ የሮቤልም ልጆች አለቃ የሰዲዮር ልጅ ኤሊሱር ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered thereof, were forty and six thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de quarante-six mille cinq cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And those which pitch by him shall be the tribe of Simeon: and the captain of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.fr: A ses côtés camperont la tribu de Siméon, le prince des fils de Siméon, Schelumiel, fils de Tsurischaddaï,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የሚሰፍሩ የስምዖን ነገድ ናቸው፤ የስምዖንም ልጆች አለቃ የሱሪሰዳይ ልጅ ሰለሚኤል ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and nine thousand and three hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de cinquante-neuf mille trois cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement;
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ ዘጠኝ ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then the tribe of Gad: and the captain of the sons of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.
verses.fr: puis la tribu de Gad, le prince des fils de Gad, Eliasaph, fils de Déuel,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የጋድ ነገድ ነበረ፤ የጋድም ልጆች አለቃ የራጉኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and five thousand and six hundred and fifty.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de quarante-cinq mille six cent cinquante hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ አምስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: All that were numbered in the camp of Reuben were an hundred thousand and fifty and one thousand and four hundred and fifty, throughout their armies. And they shall set forth in the second rank.
verses.fr: Total pour le camp de Ruben, d''après le dénombrement: cent cinquante et un mille quatre cent cinquante hommes, selon leurs corps d''armée. Ils seront les seconds dans la marche.
verses.am: ከሮቤል ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው መቶ አምሳ አንድ ሺህ አራት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ። እነርሱም ቀጥለው ይጓዛሉ።

verses.en: Then the tabernacle of the congregation shall set forward with the camp of the Levites in the midst of the camp: as they encamp, so shall they set forward, every man in his place by their standards.
verses.fr: Ensuite partira la tente d''assignation, avec le camp des Lévites placé au milieu des autres camps: Ils suivront dans la marche l''ordre dans lequel ils auront campé, chacun dans son rang, selon sa bannière.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ የመገናኛው ድንኳን በሰፈሮቹም መካከል የሌዋውያን ሰፈር ይጓዛል፤ እንደ ሰፈራቸው ሰው ሁሉ በየስፍራው በየዓላማውም ይጓዛሉ።

verses.en: On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their armies: and the captain of the sons of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.fr: A l''occident, le camp d''Ephraïm, avec sa bannière, et avec ses corps d''armée. Là camperont le prince des fils d''Ephraïm, Elischama, fils d''Ammihud,
verses.am: በምዕራብ በኩል እንደ ሠራዊቶቻቸው የኤፍሬም ሰፈር ዓላማ ይሆናል፤ የኤፍሬም ልጆች አለቃ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ኤሊሳማ ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de quarante mille cinq cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And by him shall be the tribe of Manasseh: and the captain of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.fr: A ses côtés camperont la tribu de Manassé, le prince des fils de Manassé, Gamliel, fils de Pedahtsur,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የምናሴ ነገድ ይሆናል፤ የምናሴም ልጆች አለቃ የፍዳሱር ልጅ ገማልኤል ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de trente-deux mille deux cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement;
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then the tribe of Benjamin: and the captain of the sons of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.fr: puis la tribu de Benjamin, le prince des fils de Benjamin, Abidan, fils de Guideoni,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የብንያም ነገድ ይሆናል፤ ይብንያምም ልጆች አለቃ የጋዴዮን ልጅ አቢዳን ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were thirty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de trente-cinq mille quatre cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ሠላሳ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: All that were numbered of the camp of Ephraim were an hundred thousand and eight thousand and an hundred, throughout their armies. And they shall go forward in the third rank.
verses.fr: Total pour le camp d''Ephraïm, d''après le dénombrement: cent huit mille et cent hommes, selon leurs corps d''armée. Ils seront les troisièmes dans la marche.
verses.am: ከኤፍሬም ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው መቶ ስምንት ሺህ አንድ መቶ ነበሩ። እነርሱም ሦስተኛ ሆነው ይጓዛሉ።

verses.en: The standard of the camp of Dan shall be on the north side by their armies: and the captain of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.fr: Au nord, le camp de Dan, avec sa bannière, et avec ses corps d''armée. Là camperont le prince des fils de Dan, Ahiézer, fils d''Ammischaddaï,
verses.am: በሰሜን በኩል እንደ ሠራዊቶቻቸው የዳን ሰፈር ዓላማ ይሆናል፤ የዳንም ልጆች አለቃ የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዘር ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were threescore and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de soixante-deux mille sept cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ስድሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.fr: A ses côtés camperont la tribu d''Aser, le prince des fils d''Aser, Paguiel, fils d''Ocran,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የሚሰፍሩ የአሴር ነገድ ይሆናሉ፤ የአሴርም ልጆች አለቃ የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were forty and one thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de quarante et un mille cinq cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement;
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አርባ አንድ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Then the tribe of Naphtali: and the captain of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.fr: puis la tribu de Nephthali, le prince des fils de Nephthali, Ahira, fils d''Enan,
verses.am: በእነርሱም አጠገብ የንፍታሌም ነገድ ይሆናል፤ የንፍታሌምም ልጆች አለቃ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ ነበረ።

verses.en: And his host, and those that were numbered of them, were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: et son corps d''armée composé de cinquante-trois mille quatre cents hommes, d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ሠራዊቱም፥ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: All they that were numbered in the camp of Dan were an hundred thousand and fifty and seven thousand and six hundred. They shall go hindmost with their standards.
verses.fr: Total pour le camp de Dan, d''après le dénombrement: cent cinquante-sept mille six cents hommes. Ils seront les derniers dans la marche, selon leur bannière.
verses.am: ከዳን ሰፈር የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ መቶ አምሳ ሰባት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ። እነርሱም በየዓላሞቻቸው በመጨረሻ ይጓዛሉ።

verses.en: These are those which were numbered of the children of Israel by the house of their fathers: all those that were numbered of the camps throughout their hosts were six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux des enfants d''Israël dont on fit le dénombrement, selon les maisons de leurs pères. Tous ceux dont on fit le dénombrement, et qui formèrent les camps, selon leurs corps d''armée, furent six cent trois mille cinq cent cinquante.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የተቈጠሩ እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከየሰፈሩ በየሠራዊቶቻቸው የተቈጠሩ ሁሉ ስድስት መቶ ሦስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: But the Levites were not numbered among the children of Israel; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Les Lévites, suivant l''ordre que l''Eternel avait donné à Moïse, ne firent point partie du dénombrement au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሌዋውያን ግን እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did according to all that the Lord commanded Moses: so they pitched by their standards, and so they set forward, every one after their families, according to the house of their fathers.
verses.fr: Et les enfants d''Israël se conformèrent à tous les ordres que l''Eternel avait donnés à Moïse. C''est ainsi qu''ils campaient, selon leurs bannières; et c''est ainsi qu''ils se mettaient en marche, chacun selon sa famille, selon la maison de ses pères.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሁሉ እንዲሁ በዓላሞቻቸው አጠገብ ሰፈሩ፥ እንዲሁም በየወገኖቻቸው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ተጓዙ።

verses.en: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
verses.fr: Voici la postérité d''Aaron et de Moïse, au temps où l''Eternel parla à Moïse, sur la montagne de Sinaï.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሲና ተራራ ላይ ሙሴን በተናገረበት ቀን የአሮንና የሙሴ ትውልድ ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des fils d''Aaron: Nadab, le premier-né, Abihu, Eléazar et Ithamar.
verses.am: የአሮን ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው፤ በኵሩ ናዳብ፥ አብዩድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር።

verses.en: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest's office.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les noms des fils d''Aaron, qui reçurent l''onction comme sacrificateurs, et qui furent consacrés pour l''exercice du sacerdoce.
verses.am: የተቀቡ ካህናት በክህነትም ያገለግሉ ዘንድ የቀደሳቸው የአሮን ልጆች ስም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest's office in the sight of Aaron their father.
verses.fr: Nadab et Abihu moururent devant l''Eternel, lorsqu''ils apportèrent devant l''Eternel du feu étranger, dans le désert de Sinaï; ils n''avaient point de fils. Eléazar et Ithamar exercèrent le sacerdoce, en présence d''Aaron, leur père.
verses.am: ናዳብና አብዩድ በሲና ምድረ በዳ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ልዩ እሳት ባቀረቡ ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሞቱ፤ ልጆችም አልነበሩአቸውም። አልዓዛርና ኢታምር በአባታቸው በአሮን ፊት በክህነት ያገለግሉ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
verses.fr: Fais approcher la tribu de Lévi, et tu la placeras devant le sacrificateur Aaron, pour qu''elle soit à son service.
verses.am: የሌዊን ነገድ አቅርበህ ያገለግሉት ዘንድ በካህኑ በአሮን ፊት አቁማቸው።

verses.en: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Ils auront le soin de ce qui est remis à sa garde et à la garde de toute l''assemblée, devant la tente d''assignation: ils feront le service du tabernacle.
verses.am: የማደሪያውንም ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ፥ እርሱንና ማኅበሩን ሁሉ ለማገልገል የሚያስፈልገውን ነገር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ይጠብቁ።

verses.en: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Ils auront le soin de tous les ustensiles de la tente d''assignation, et de ce qui est remis à la garde des enfants d''Israël: ils feront le service du tabernacle.
verses.am: የማደሪያውንም ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ፥ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይጠብቁ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ለማገልገል የሚያስፈልገውንም ነገር ይጠብቁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Tu donneras les Lévites à Aaron et à ses fils; ils lui seront entièrement donnés, de la part des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንንም ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ትሰጣለህ፤ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ለእርሱ ፈጽመው ተሰጡ።

verses.en: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest's office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.fr: Tu établiras Aaron et ses fils pour qu''ils observent les fonctions de leur sacerdoce; et l''étranger qui approchera sera puni de mort.
verses.am: አሮንንና ልጆቹን አቁማቸው፥ ክህነታቸውንም ይጠብቁ፤ ሌላ ሰውም ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
verses.fr: Voici, j''ai pris les Lévites du milieu des enfants d''Israël, à la place de tous les premiers-nés, des premiers-nés des enfants d''Israël; et les Lévites m''appartiendront.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እኔ በእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ማኅፀን በሚከፍተው በበኵሩ ሁሉ ፋንታ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወስጄአለሁ፤

verses.en: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Car tout premier-né m''appartient; le jour où j''ai frappé tous les premiers-nés dans le pays d''Egypte, je me suis consacré tous les premiers-nés en Israël, tant des hommes que des animaux: ils m''appartiendront. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በኵር ሁሉ ለእኔ ነውና ሌዋውያን ለእኔ ይሁኑ፤ በግብፅ ምድር በኵርን ሁሉ በመታሁ ቀን፥ ከእስራኤል ዘንድ በኵርን ሁሉ፥ ሰውንና እንስሳን፥ ለእኔ ለይቼአለሁ፤ ለእኔ ይሁኑ። እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, dans le désert de Sinaï, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በሲና ምድረ በዳ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
verses.fr: Fais le dénombrement des enfants de Lévi, selon les maisons de leurs pères, selon leurs familles; tu feras le dénombrement de tous les mâles, depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus.
verses.am: የሌዊን ልጆች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች በየወገናቸውም ቍጠር፤ ወንዱን ሁሉ ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን ቍጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.
verses.fr: Moïse en fit le dénombrement sur l''ordre de l''Eternel, en se conformant à l''ordre qui lui fut donné.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዳዘዘው ቈጠራቸው።

verses.en: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
verses.fr: Ce sont ici les fils de Lévi, d''après leurs noms: Guerschon, Kehath et Merari. -
verses.am: የሌዊ ልጆች በየስማቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ጌድሶን፥ ቀዓት፥ ሜራሪ።

verses.en: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des fils de Guerschon, selon leurs familles: Libni et Schimeï.
verses.am: የጌድሶንም ልጆች ስሞች በየወገናቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ሎቤኒ፥ ሰሜኢ።

verses.en: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Kehath, selon leurs familles: Amram, Jitsehar, Hébron et Uziel;
verses.am: የቀዓትም ልጆች በየወገናቸው እንበረም፥ ይስዓር፥ ኬብሮን፥ ዑዝኤል።

verses.en: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
verses.fr: et les fils de Merari, selon leurs familles: Machli et Muschi. Ce sont là les familles de Lévi, selon les maisons de leurs pères.
verses.am: የሜራሪም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ሞሖሊ፥ ሙሲ። የሌዋውያን ወገኖች በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
verses.fr: De Guerschon descendent la famille de Libni et la famille de Schimeï, formant les familles des Guerschonites.
verses.am: ለጌድሶን የሎቤናውያን ወገን የሰሜአውያንም ወገን ነበሩት፤ የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: Ceux dont on fit le dénombrement, en comptant tous les mâles depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus, furent sept mille cinq cents.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩት የወንዶች ሁሉ ቍጥር ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የተቈጠሩት ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.fr: Les familles des Guerschonites campaient derrière le tabernacle à l''occident.
verses.am: የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች ከማደሪያው በኋላ በምዕራብ ብኩል ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
verses.fr: Le chef de la maison paternelle des Guerschonites était Eliasaph, fils de Laël.
verses.am: የጌድሶናውያንም አባቶች ቤት አለቃ የዳኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.fr: Pour ce qui concerne la tente d''assignation, on remit aux soins des fils de Guerschon le tabernacle et la tente, la couverture, le rideau qui est à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation;
verses.am: ጌድሶናውያንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን የሚጠብቁት ማደሪያው፥ ድንኳኑም፥ መደረቢያውም፥ የመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥

verses.en: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
verses.fr: les toiles du parvis et le rideau de l''entrée du parvis, tout autour du tabernacle et de l''autel, et tous les cordages pour le service du tabernacle.
verses.am: በማደሪያውና በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ያለው የአደባባዩ መጋረጆች፥ የአደባባዩም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥ ለማገልገሉም ያሉት ገመዶች ሁሉ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
verses.fr: De Kehath descendent la famille des Amramites, la famille des Jitseharites, la famille des Hébronites et la famille des Uziélites, formant les familles des Kehathites.
verses.am: ከቀዓትም የእንበረማውያን ወገን፥ የይስዓራውያንም ወገን፥ የኬብሮናውያንም ወገን፥ የዑዝኤላውያንም ወገን ነበሩ፤ የቀዓታውያን ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.fr: En comptant tous les mâles depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus, il y en eut huit mille six cents, qui furent chargés des soins du sanctuaire.
verses.am: ወንዶች ሁሉ እንደ ቍጥራቸው ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ስምንት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ፤ መቅደሱንም ይጠብቁ ነበር።

verses.en: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.fr: Les familles des fils de Kehath campaient au côté méridional du tabernacle.
verses.am: የቀዓት ልጆች ወገኖች በማደሪያው አጠገብ በደቡብ በኩል ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
verses.fr: Le chef de la maison paternelle des familles des Kehathites était Elitsaphan, fils d''Uziel.
verses.am: የቀዓታውያንም ወገኖች አባቶች ቤት አለቃ የዑዝኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፈን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
verses.fr: On remit à leurs soins l''arche, la table, le chandelier, les autels, les ustensiles du sanctuaire, avec lesquels on fait le service, le voile et tout ce qui en dépend.
verses.am: ታቦቱንም፥ ገበታውንም፥ መቅረዙንም፥ መሠዊያዎቹንም፥ የሚያገለግሉበትንም የመቅደሱን ዕቃ፥ መጋረጃውንም፥ ማገልገያውንም ሁሉ ይጠብቃሉ።

verses.en: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.fr: Le chef des chefs des Lévites était Eléazar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron; il avait la surveillance de ceux qui étaient chargés des soins du sanctuaire.
verses.am: የሌዋውያንም አለቆች አለቃ የካህኑ የአሮን ልጅ አልዓዛር ይሆናል፤ እርሱም መቅደሱን በሚጠብቁት ላይ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
verses.fr: De Merari descendent la famille de Machli et la famille de Muschi, formant les familles des Merarites.
verses.am: ከሜራሪ የሞሖላውያን ወገን የሙሳያውያንም ወገን ነበሩ፤ የሜራሪ ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
verses.fr: Ceux dont on fit le dénombrement, en comptant tous les mâles depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus, furent six mille deux cents.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ወንዶች ሁሉ እንደ ቍጥራቸው ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የተቈጠሩት ስድስት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.fr: Le chef de la maison paternelle des familles de Merari était Tsuriel, fils d''Abihaïl. Ils campaient du côté septentrional du tabernacle.
verses.am: የሜራሪም ወገኖች አባቶች ቤት አለቃ የአቢካኢል ልጅ ሱሪኤል ነበረ፤ በማደሪያው አጠገብ በሰሜን በኩል ይሰፍራሉ።

verses.en: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
verses.fr: On remit à la garde et aux soins des fils de Merari les planches du tabernacle, ses barres, ses colonnes et leurs bases, tous ses ustensiles et tout ce qui en dépend;
verses.am: የሜራሪም ልጆች የሚጠብቁት የማደሪያው ሳንቆች፥ መወርወሪያዎችም፥ ተራዳዎችም፥ እግሮቹም፥ ዕቃውም ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
verses.fr: les colonnes du parvis tout autour, leurs bases, leurs pieux et leurs cordages.
verses.am: ማገልገያውም ሁሉ፥ በዙሪያውም የሚቆሙ የአደባባይ ምሰሶች፥ እግሮቹም፥ ካስማዎቹም፥ አውታሮቹም ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.fr: Moïse, Aaron et ses fils campaient devant le tabernacle, à l''orient, devant la tente d''assignation, au levant; ils avaient la garde et le soin du sanctuaire, remis à la garde des enfants d''Israël; et l''étranger qui s''approchera sera puni de mort.
verses.am: በማደሪያውም ፊት በምሥራቅ በኩል በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት በስተ ፀሐይ መውጫ የሚሰፍሩት ሙሴና አሮን ልጆቹም ይሆናሉ፥ መቅደሱንም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ይጠብቃሉ፤ ልዩም ሰው ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.en: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
verses.fr: Tous les Lévites dont Moïse et Aaron firent le dénombrement sur l''ordre de l''Eternel, selon leurs familles, tous les mâles depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus, furent vingt-deux mille.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ ከሌዋውያን ወንዶች ሁሉ ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ በየወገናቸው የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Fais le dénombrement de tous les premiers-nés mâles parmi les enfants d''Israël, depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus, et compte les d''après leurs noms.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ወንዱን በኵር ሁሉ ቍጠር፤ ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉትን የስማቸውን ቍጥር ውሰድ፤

verses.en: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Tu prendras les Lévites pour moi, l''Eternel, à la place de tous les premiers-nés des enfants d''Israël, et le bétail des Lévites à la place de tous les premiers-nés du bétail des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንንም በእስራኤል ልጆች በኵር ሁሉ ፋንታ፥ የሌዋውያንንም እንስሶች በእስራኤል ልጆች እንስሶች በኵር ሁሉ ፋንታ ለእኔ ለእግዚአብሔር ውሰድ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Moïse fit le dénombrement de tous les premiers-nés parmi les enfants d''Israël, selon l''ordre que l''Eternel lui avait donné.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው የእስራኤልን ልጆች በኵር ሁሉ ቈጠረ።

verses.en: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
verses.fr: Tous les premiers-nés mâles, dont on fit le dénombrement, en comptant les noms, depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus, furent vingt-deux mille deux cent soixante-treize.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩ ወንዶች በኵሮች ሁሉ የበስማቸው ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ሰባ ሦስት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Prends les Lévites à la place de tous les premiers-nés des enfants d''Israël, et le bétail des Lévites à la place de leur bétail; et les Lévites m''appartiendront. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንን በእስራኤል ልጆች በኵር ሁሉ ፋንታ፥ የሌዋውያንንም እንስሶች በእንስሶቻቸው ፋንታ ውሰድ፤ ሌዋውያንም ለእኔ ይሁኑ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
verses.fr: Pour le rachat des deux cent soixante-treize qui dépassent le nombre des Lévites, parmi les premiers-nés des enfants d''Israël,
verses.am: በሌዋውያን ላይ ከእስራኤል ልጆች በኵር ስለ ተረፉት ስለ ሁለት መቶ ሰባ ሦስት ቤዛ፥ በየራሱ አምስት ሰቅል ውሰድ፤

verses.en: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
verses.fr: tu prendras cinq sicles par tête; tu les prendras selon le sicle du sanctuaire, qui est de vingt guéras.
verses.am: እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ትወስዳለህ፤ ሰቅሉም ሀያ አቦሊ ነው።

verses.en: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
verses.fr: Tu donneras l''argent à Aaron et à ses fils, pour le rachat de ceux qui dépassent le nombre des Lévites.
verses.am: ስለ ተረፉትም የመቤዣውን ገንዘብ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ስጥ።

verses.en: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
verses.fr: Moïse prit l''argent pour le rachat de ceux qui dépassaient le nombre des rachetés par les Lévites;
verses.am: ሙሴም በሌዋውያን ከተቤዡት በላይ ከተረፉት ዘንድ የመቤዣውን ገንዘብ ወሰደ።

verses.en: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.fr: il prit l''argent des premiers-nés des enfants d''Israël: mille trois cent soixante-cinq sicles, selon le sicle du sanctuaire.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች በኵሮች ገንዘቡን ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ስድሳ አምስት ሰቅል እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Et Moïse donna l''argent du rachat à Aaron et à ses fils, sur l''ordre de l''Eternel, en se conformant à l''ordre que l''Eternel avait donné à Moïse.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ቃል፥ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው፥ ሙሴ የመቤዣውን ገንዘብ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ሰጠ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Take the sum of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, after their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.fr: Compte les fils de Kehath parmi les enfants de Lévi, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères,
verses.am: ከሌዊ ልጆች መካከል በየወገናቸው በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች የቀዓትን ልጆች ድምር ውሰድ፤

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all that enter into the host, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus jusqu''à l''âge de cinquante ans, tous ceux qui sont propres à exercer quelque fonction dans la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የሚገቡበትን ሁሉ ትደምራለህ።

verses.en: This shall be the service of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation, about the most holy things:
verses.fr: Voici les fonctions des fils de Kehath, dans la tente d''assignation: elles concernent le lieu très saint.
verses.am: በመገናኛው ድንኳን በንዋየ ቅድሳቱ ዘንድ የቀዓት ልጆች ሥራ ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: And when the camp setteth forward, Aaron shall come, and his sons, and they shall take down the covering vail, and cover the ark of testimony with it:
verses.fr: Au départ du camp, Aaron et ses fils viendront démonter le voile, et ils en couvriront l''arche du témoignage;
verses.am: ከሰፈሩ በተነሡ ጊዜ አሮንና ልጆቹ ገብተው የሚሸፍነውን መጋረጃ ያውርዱ፥ የምስክሩንም ታቦት ይጠቅልሉበት፤

verses.en: And shall put thereon the covering of badgers' skins, and shall spread over it a cloth wholly of blue, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.fr: ils mettront dessus une couverture de peaux de dauphins, et ils étendront par-dessus un drap entièrement d''étoffe bleue; puis ils placeront les barres de l''arche.
verses.am: በላዩም የአቆስጣውን ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ያድርጉበት፥ ከእርሱም በላይ ሁለንተናው ሰማያዊ የሆነ መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.en: And upon the table of shewbread they shall spread a cloth of blue, and put thereon the dishes, and the spoons, and the bowls, and covers to cover withal: and the continual bread shall be thereon:
verses.fr: Ils étendront un drap bleu sur la table des pains de proposition, et ils mettront dessus les plats, les coupes, les tasses et les calices pour les libations; le pain y sera toujours;
verses.am: በገጽ ኅብስት ገበታ ላይ ሰማያዊውን መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፤ በእርሱም ላይ ወጭቶቹን፥ ጭልፋዎቹንም፥ ጽዋዎቹንም፥ ለማፍሰስም መቅጃዎቹን ያድርጉ፤ ሁልጊዜም የሚኖር እንጀራ በእርሱ ላይ ይሁን።

verses.en: And they shall spread upon them a cloth of scarlet, and cover the same with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put in the staves thereof.
verses.fr: ils étendront sur ces choses un drap de cramoisi, et ils l''envelopperont d''une couverture de peaux de dauphins; puis ils placeront les barres de la table.
verses.am: በእነርሱም ላይ ቀይ መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉ፥ በአቆስጣውም ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይሸፍኑት፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.en: And they shall take a cloth of blue, and cover the candlestick of the light, and his lamps, and his tongs, and his snuffdishes, and all the oil vessels thereof, wherewith they minister unto it:
verses.fr: Ils prendront un drap bleu, et ils couvriront le chandelier, ses lampes, ses mouchettes, ses vases à cendre et tous ses vases à huile, destinés à son service;
verses.am: ሰማያዊውንም መጐናጸፊያ ይውሰዱ፥ የሚያበራውንም መቅረዝ፥ ቀንዲሎቹንም፥ መኰስተሪያዎቹንም፥ የኩስታሪ ማድረጊያዎቹንም፥ እርሱንም ለማገልገል የዘይቱን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ ይሸፍኑ፤

verses.en: And they shall put it and all the vessels thereof within a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put it upon a bar.
verses.fr: ils le mettront, avec tous ses ustensiles, dans une couverture de peaux de dauphins; puis ils le placeront sur le brancard.
verses.am: እርሱንና ዕቃዎቹን ሁሉ በአቆስጣ ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ውስጥ ያድርጉ፥ በመሸከሚያውም ላይ ያድርጉት።

verses.en: And upon the golden altar they shall spread a cloth of blue, and cover it with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put to the staves thereof:
verses.fr: Ils étendront un drap bleu sur l''autel d''or, et ils l''envelopperont d''une couverture de peaux de dauphins; puis ils placeront les barres de l''autel.
verses.am: በወርቁም መሠዊያ ላይ ሰማያዊውን መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፥ በአቆስጣም ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይሸፍኑት፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.en: And they shall take all the instruments of ministry, wherewith they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a cloth of blue, and cover them with a covering of badgers' skins, and shall put them on a bar:
verses.fr: Ils prendront tous les ustensiles dont on se sert pour le service dans le sanctuaire, et ils les mettront dans un drap bleu, et ils les envelopperont d''une couverture de peaux de dauphins; puis ils les placeront sur le brancard.
verses.am: በመቅደስም ውስጥ የሚያገልግሉበትን የማገልገያውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይውሰዱ፥ በሰማያዊውም መጐናጸፊያ ውስጥ ያስቀምጡት፥ በአቆስጣም ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይሸፍኑት፥ በመሸከሚያውም ላይ ያድርጉት።

verses.en: And they shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth thereon:
verses.fr: Ils ôteront les cendres de l''autel, et ils étendront sur l''autel un drap de pourpre;
verses.am: አመዱንም ከመሠዊያው ላይ ያስወግዱ፥ ሐምራዊውንም መጐናጸፊያ ይዘርጉበት፤

verses.en: And they shall put upon it all the vessels thereof, wherewith they minister about it, even the censers, the fleshhooks, and the shovels, and the basons, all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread upon it a covering of badgers' skins, and put to the staves of it.
verses.fr: ils mettront dessus tous les ustensiles destinés à son service, les brasiers, les fourchettes, les pelles, les bassins, tous les ustensiles de l''autel, et ils étendront par-dessus une couverture de peaux de dauphins; puis ils placeront les barres de l''autel.
verses.am: የሚያገለግሉበትን ዕቃውን ሁሉም ማንደጃዎቹን ሜንጦቹንም መጫሪያዎቹንም ድስቶቹንም፥ የመሠዊያውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ያስቀምጡበት፤ በእርሱም የአቆስጣን ቁርበት መሸፈኛ ይዘርጉ፥ መሎጊያዎቹንም ያግቡ።

verses.en: And when Aaron and his sons have made an end of covering the sanctuary, and all the vessels of the sanctuary, as the camp is to set forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to bear it: but they shall not touch any holy thing, lest they die. These things are the burden of the sons of Kohath in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Après qu''Aaron et ses fils auront achevé de couvrir le sanctuaire et tous les ustensiles du sanctuaire, les fils de Kehath viendront, au départ du camp, pour les porter; mais ils ne toucheront point les choses saintes, de peur qu''ils ne meurent. Telles sont les fonctions de porteurs, imposées aux fils de Kehath dans la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ከሰፈሩም ሲነሡ፥ አሮንና ልጆቹ መቅደሱንና የመቅደሱን ዕቃ ሁሉ ከሸፈኑ በኋላ፥ በዚያን ጊዜ የቀዓት ልጆች ሊሸከሙት ይመጣሉ፤ እንዳይሞቱ ግን ንዋየ ቅድሳቱን አይንኩ። በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ የቀዓት ልጆች ሸክም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And to the office of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest pertaineth the oil for the light, and the sweet incense, and the daily meat offering, and the anointing oil, and the oversight of all the tabernacle, and of all that therein is, in the sanctuary, and in the vessels thereof.
verses.fr: Eléazar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron, aura sous sa surveillance l''huile du chandelier, le parfum odoriférant, l''offrande perpétuelle et l''huile d''onction; il aura sous sa surveillance tout le tabernacle et tout ce qu''il contient, le sanctuaire et ses ustensiles.
verses.am: የካህኑም የአሮን ልጅ አልዓዛር በመብራቱ ዘይት በጣፋጩም ዕጣን ላይ፥ ሁልጊዜም በሚቀርበው በእህሉ ቍርባንና በቅባቱ ዘይት ላይ ይሾም፤ ማደሪያውን ሁሉ፥ በእርሱም ውስጥ ያለውን ሁሉ፥ መቅደሱንና ዕቃውን ይጠብቃል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Cut ye not off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites:
verses.fr: N''exposez point la race des familles des Kehathites à être retranchée du milieu des Lévites.
verses.am: የቀዓትን ወገኖች ነገድ ከሌዋውያን መካከል አታጥፉአቸው፤

verses.en: But thus do unto them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach unto the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in, and appoint them every one to his service and to his burden:
verses.fr: Faites ceci pour eux, afin qu''ils vivent et qu''ils ne meurent point, quand ils s''approcheront du lieu très saint: Aaron et ses fils viendront, et ils placeront chacun d''eux à son service et à sa charge.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ወደ ቅድስተ ቅዱሳን በቀረቡ ጊዜ በሕይወት ይኖሩ ዘንድ እንጂ እንዳይሞቱ እንዲሁ አድርጉላቸው፤ አሮንና ልጆቹ ይግቡ፥ ለሰውም ሁሉ ሥራውንና ሸክሙን ይዘዙ፤

verses.en: But they shall not go in to see when the holy things are covered, lest they die.
verses.fr: Ils n''entreront point pour voir envelopper les choses saintes, de peur qu''ils ne meurent.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እንዳይሞቱ ንዋየ ቅድሳቱን ለድንገት እንኳ ለማየት አይግቡ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take also the sum of the sons of Gershon, throughout the houses of their fathers, by their families;
verses.fr: Compte aussi les fils de Guerschon, selon les maisons de leurs pères, selon leurs familles;
verses.am: የጌድሶንን ልጆች ድምር ደግሞ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች በየወገኖቻቸውም ውሰድ።

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward until fifty years old shalt thou number them; all that enter in to perform the service, to do the work in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: tu feras le dénombrement, depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus jusqu''à l''âge de cinquante ans, de tous ceux qui sont propres à exercer quelque fonction dans la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የሚገቡትን ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ቍጠራቸው።

verses.en: This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, to serve, and for burdens:
verses.fr: Voici les fonctions des familles des Guerschonites, le service qu''ils devront faire et ce qu''ils devront porter.
verses.am: የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች ሥራ በማገልገልና በመሸከም ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: And they shall bear the curtains of the tabernacle, and the tabernacle of the congregation, his covering, and the covering of the badgers' skins that is above upon it, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.fr: Ils porteront les tapis du tabernacle et la tente d''assignation, sa couverture et la couverture de peaux de dauphins qui se met par-dessus, le rideau qui est à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation;
verses.am: የማደሪያውን መጋረጆች፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን፥ መደረቢያውን፥ በላዩም ያለውን የአቆስጣውን ቁርበት መደረቢያ፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥

verses.en: And the hangings of the court, and the hanging for the door of the gate of the court, which is by the tabernacle and by the altar round about, and their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and all that is made for them: so shall they serve.
verses.fr: les toiles du parvis et le rideau de l''entrée de la porte du parvis, tout autour du tabernacle et de l''autel, leurs cordages et tous les ustensiles qui en dépendent. Et ils feront tout le service qui s''y rapporte.
verses.am: በማደሪያውና በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ያለውን የአደባባዩን መጋረጃ፥ የአደባባዩንም ደጃፍ መጋረጃ፥ አውታሮቻቸውንም፥ ለማገልገልም የሚሠሩበትን ዕቃ ሁሉ ይሸከሙ፤ በዚህ ያገልግሉ።

verses.en: At the appointment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burdens, and in all their service: and ye shall appoint unto them in charge all their burdens.
verses.fr: Dans leurs fonctions, les fils des Guerschonites seront sous les ordres d''Aaron et de ses fils, pour tout ce qu''ils porteront et pour tout le service qu''ils devront faire; vous remettrez à leurs soins tout ce qu''ils ont à porter.
verses.am: የጌድሶናውያን አገልግሎት ሁሉ፥ ሸክማቸውም ሁሉ፥ ሥራቸውም ሁሉ በአሮንና በልጆቹ ትእዛዝ ይሁን፤ የሚደርስባቸውንም ሸክም ሁሉ ትነግሩአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation: and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.fr: Telles sont les fonctions des familles des fils des Guerschonites dans la tente d''assignation, et ce qu''ils ont à garder sous la direction d''Ithamar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron.
verses.am: የጌድሶናውያን ወገኖች አገልግሎት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ ይህ ነው፤ ከካህኑ ከአሮን ልጅ ከኢታምር እጅ በታች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: As for the sons of Merari, thou shalt number them after their families, by the house of their fathers;
verses.fr: Tu feras le dénombrement des fils de Merari, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères;
verses.am: የሜራሪንም ልጆች በየወገናቸው በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ቍጠራቸው።

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old shalt thou number them, every one that entereth into the service, to do the work of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: tu feras le dénombrement, depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus jusqu''à l''âge de cinquante ans, de tous ceux qui sont propres à exercer quelque fonction dans la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ሥራ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የሚገቡትን ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ቍጠራቸው።

verses.en: And this is the charge of their burden, according to all their service in the tabernacle of the congregation; the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and sockets thereof,
verses.fr: Voici ce qui est remis à leurs soins et ce qu''ils ont à porter, pour toutes leurs fonctions dans la tente d''assignation: les planches du tabernacle, ses barres, ses colonnes, ses bases,
verses.am: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ ባለው አገልግሎታቸው ሁሉ፥ የማደሪያው ሳንቆች፥ መወርወሪያዎቹም፥ ተራዳዎቹም፥ እግሮቹም፥

verses.en: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service: and by name ye shall reckon the instruments of the charge of their burden.
verses.fr: les colonnes du parvis formant l''enceinte, leurs bases, leurs pieux, leurs cordages, tous les ustensiles qui en dépendent et tout ce qui est destiné à leur service. Vous désignerez par leurs noms les objets qui sont remis à leurs soins et qu''ils ont à porter.
verses.am: በዙሪያውም የሚቆሙት የአደባባዩ ምሰሶች፥ እግሮቹም፥ ካስማዎቹም፥ አውታሮቹም፥ ዕቃዎቹና ማገልገያዎቹ ሸክማቸው ነው፤ የሚጠብቁትንም የሸክማቸውን ዕቃ ሁሉ በስማቸው ቍጠሩ።

verses.en: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service, in the tabernacle of the congregation, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.fr: Telles sont les fonctions des familles des fils de Merari, toutes leurs fonctions dans la tente d''assignation, sous la direction d''Ithamar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron.
verses.am: የሜራሪ ልጆች ወገኖች አገልግሎት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዘንድ ከካህኑ ክአሮን ልጅ ከኢታምር እጅ በታች በየአገልግሎታቸው ሁሉ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron and the chief of the congregation numbered the sons of the Kohathites after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.fr: Moïse, Aaron et les princes de l''assemblée firent le dénombrement des fils des Kehathites, selon leurs familles et selon les maisons de leurs pères,
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም የሕቡም አለቆች የቀዓትን ልጆች በየወገናቸው በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ቈጠሩአቸው።

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.fr: de tous ceux qui, depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus jusqu''à l''âge de cinquante ans, étaient propres à exercer quelque fonction dans la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ወደ አገግሎት የገቡትን ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉትን ቈጠሩአቸው፤

verses.en: And those that were numbered of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.fr: Ceux dont ils firent le dénombrement, selon leurs familles, furent deux mille sept cent cinquante.
verses.am: በየወገናቸውም ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩት ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: These were they that were numbered of the families of the Kohathites, all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, which Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux des familles des Kehathites dont on fit le dénombrement, tous ceux qui exerçaient des fonctions dans la tente d''assignation; Moïse et Aaron en firent le dénombrement sur l''ordre de l''Eternel par Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ያገለገሉት ሁሉ፥ ከቀዓታውያን ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And those that were numbered of the sons of Gershon, throughout their families, and by the house of their fathers,
verses.fr: Les fils de Guerschon dont on fit le dénombrement, selon leurs familles et selon les maisons de leurs pères,
verses.am: በየወገናቸውም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች የተቈጠሩት የጌድሶን ልጆች፥

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.fr: depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus jusqu''à l''âge de cinquante ans, tous ceux qui étaient propres à exercer quelque fonction dans la tente d''assignation,
verses.am: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ለአገልግሎት የገቡት፥ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉት፥

verses.en: Even those that were numbered of them, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers, were two thousand and six hundred and thirty.
verses.fr: ceux dont on fit le dénombrement, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères, furent deux mille six cent trente.
verses.am: በየወገናቸውም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች የተቈጠሩት ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ሠላሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: These are they that were numbered of the families of the sons of Gershon, of all that might do service in the tabernacle of the congregation, whom Moses and Aaron did number according to the commandment of the Lord.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux des familles des fils de Guerschon dont on fit le dénombrement, tous ceux qui exerçaient des fonctions dans la tente d''assignation; Moïse et Aaron en firent le dénombrement sur l''ordre de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ያገለገሉት ሁሉ፥ ከጌድሶን ልጆች ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, throughout their families, by the house of their fathers,
verses.fr: Ceux des familles des fils de Merari dont on fit le dénombrement, selon leurs familles, selon les maisons de leurs pères,
verses.am: በየወገናቸውም በየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች ከሜራሪ ልጆች ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that entereth into the service, for the work in the tabernacle of the congregation,
verses.fr: depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus jusqu''à l''âge de cinquante ans, tous ceux qui étaient propres à exercer quelque fonction dans la tente d''assignation,
verses.am: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ወደ አገልግሎት የገቡት ሁሉ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉት፥

verses.en: Even those that were numbered of them after their families, were three thousand and two hundred.
verses.fr: ceux dont on fit le dénombrement, selon leurs familles, furent trois mille deux cents.
verses.am: በየወገናቸው የተቈጠሩት ሦስት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: These be those that were numbered of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron numbered according to the word of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux des familles des fils de Merari dont on fit le dénombrement; Moïse et Aaron en firent le dénombrement sur l''ordre de l''Eternel par Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ፥ ከሜራሪ ልጆች ወገኖች የተቈጠሩት፥ ሙሴና አሮን የቈጠሩአቸው፥ እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: All those that were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron and the chief of Israel numbered, after their families, and after the house of their fathers,
verses.fr: Tous ceux des Lévites dont Moïse, Aaron et les princes d''Israël firent le dénombrement, selon leurs familles et selon les maisons de leurs pères,
verses.am: በየወገናቸውና በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች ከሌዋውያን የተቈጠሩት ሁሉ፥ ሙሴና አሮን የእስራኤልም አለቆች የቈጠሩአቸው፥

verses.en: From thirty years old and upward even unto fifty years old, every one that came to do the service of the ministry, and the service of the burden in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: depuis l''âge de trente ans et au-dessus jusqu''à l''âge de cinquante ans, tous ceux qui étaient propres à exercer quelque fonction et à servir de porteurs dans la tente d''assignation,
verses.am: በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ሥራውን ለመሥራትና ዕቃውን ለመሸከም የገቡት ሁሉ፥ ከሠላሳ ዓመት ጀምሮ እስከ አምሳ ዓመት ድረስ ያሉት፥

verses.en: Even those that were numbered of them, were eight thousand and five hundred and fourscore,
verses.fr: tous ceux dont on fit le dénombrement furent huit mille cinq cent quatre-vingts.
verses.am: ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩት ስምንት ሺህ እምስት መቶ ሰማንያ ነበሩ።

verses.en: According to the commandment of the Lord they were numbered by the hand of Moses, every one according to his service, and according to his burden: thus were they numbered of him, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: On en fit le dénombrement sur l''ordre de l''Eternel par Moïse, en indiquant à chacun le service qu''il devait faire et ce qu''il devait porter; on en fit le dénombrement selon l''ordre que l''Eternel avait donné à Moïse.
verses.am: እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ እያንዳንዳቸው በየአገልግሎታቸውና በየሸክማቸው በሙሴ እጅ ተቈጠሩ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ እንዲሁ በእርሱ ተቈጠሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, that they put out of the camp every leper, and every one that hath an issue, and whosoever is defiled by the dead:
verses.fr: Ordonne aux enfants d''Israël de renvoyer du camp tout lépreux, et quiconque a une gonorrhée ou est souillé par un mort.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ለምጻሙን ሁሉ፥ ፈሳሽ ነገርም ያለበትን ሁሉ፥ በሬሳም የረከሰውን ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ እንዲያወጡ እዘዛቸው፤

verses.en: Both male and female shall ye put out, without the camp shall ye put them; that they defile not their camps, in the midst whereof I dwell.
verses.fr: Hommes ou femmes, vous les renverrez, vous les renverrez hors du camp, afin qu''ils ne souillent pas le camp au milieu duquel j''ai ma demeure.
verses.am: ወንዱንና ሴቱን አውጡ፤ እኔ በመካከሉ የማድርበትን ሰፈራቸውን እንዳያረክሱ ከሰፈሩ አውጡአቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Israel did so, and put them out without the camp: as the Lord spake unto Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent ainsi, et ils les renvoyèrent hors du camp; comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse, ainsi firent les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ፥ ከሰፈሩ አወጡአቸው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንደ ተናገረው፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲሁ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, When a man or woman shall commit any sin that men commit, to do a trespass against the Lord, and that person be guilty;
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël: Lorsqu''un homme ou une femme péchera contre son prochain en commettant une infidélité à l''égard de l''Eternel, et qu''il se rendra ainsi coupable,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው። ወንድ ወይም ሴት የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ይተላለፍ ዘንድ ሰው የሚሠራውን ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ በዚያም ሰው ላይ በደል ቢሆን፥ በሠራው ኃጢአት ይናዘዝ፤

verses.en: Then they shall confess their sin which they have done: and he shall recompense his trespass with the principal thereof, and add unto it the fifth part thereof, and give it unto him against whom he hath trespassed.
verses.fr: il confessera son péché, et il restituera dans son entier l''objet mal acquis, en y ajoutant un cinquième; il le remettra à celui envers qui il s''est rendu coupable.
verses.am: የወሰደውንም በሙሉ ይመልስ አምስተኛውንም ይጨምርበት፥ ለበደለውም ሰው ይስጠው።

verses.en: But if the man have no kinsman to recompense the trespass unto, let the trespass be recompensed unto the Lord, even to the priest; beside the ram of the atonement, whereby an atonement shall be made for him.
verses.fr: S''il n''y a personne qui ait droit à la restitution de l''objet mal acquis, cet objet revient à l''Eternel, au sacrificateur, outre le bélier expiatoire avec lequel on fera l''expiation pour le coupable.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ይመልስለት ዘንድ ሰውዮው ዘመድ ባይኖረው፥ ስለ በደል ለእግዚአብሔር የሚመልሰው ነገር ለካህኑ ይሁን፥ ይህም ስለ እርሱ ማስተሰረያ ከሚደረግበት አውራ በግ በላይ ይጨመር።

verses.en: And every offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they bring unto the priest, shall be his.
verses.fr: Toute offrande de choses consacrées par les enfants d''Israël appartiendra au sacrificateur à qui elles seront présentées.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ለካህኑ የሚያቀርቡት የተቀደሰ የማንሣት ቍርባን ሁሉ ለእርሱ ይሁን።

verses.en: And every man's hallowed things shall be his: whatsoever any man giveth the priest, it shall be his.
verses.fr: Les choses qu''on aura consacrées lui appartiendront, ce qu''on lui aura remis lui appartiendra.
verses.am: የተቀደሰ የሰው ነገር ሁሉ፥ ሰውም ለካህኑ የሚሰጠው ሁሉ ለእርሱ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man's wife go aside, and commit a trespass against him,
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et tu leur diras: Si une femme se détourne de son mari, et lui devient infidèle;
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው። የማንኛውም ሰው ሚስት ከእርሱ ፈቀቅ ብትል፥ በእርሱም ላይ ብትበድል፥

verses.en: And a man lie with her carnally, and it be hid from the eyes of her husband, and be kept close, and she be defiled, and there be no witness against her, neither she be taken with the manner;
verses.fr: si un autre a commerce avec elle, et que la chose soit cachée aux yeux de son mari; si elle s''est souillée en secret, sans qu''il y ait de témoin contre elle, et sans qu''elle ait été prise sur le fait; -
verses.am: ከሌላም ሰው ጋር ብትተኛ፥ ከባልዋም ዓይን ቢሸሸግ፥ እርስዋም ተሰውራ ብትረክስ፥ ምስክርም ባይኖርባት፥ በምንዝርም ባትገኝ፥

verses.en: And the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be defiled: or if the spirit of jealousy come upon him, and he be jealous of his wife, and she be not defiled:
verses.fr: et si le mari est saisi d''un esprit de jalousie et a des soupçons sur sa femme, qui s''est souillée, ou bien s''il est saisi d''un esprit de jalousie et a des soupçons sur sa femme, qui ne s''est point souillée; -
verses.am: በባልዋም ላይ የቅንዓት መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፥ እርስዋም ስትረክስ ስለ ሚስቱ ቢቀና፤ ወይም እርስዋ ሳትረክስ የቅንዓት መንፈስ ቢመጣበት፥ ስለ ሚስቱም ቢቀና፤

verses.en: Then shall the man bring his wife unto the priest, and he shall bring her offering for her, the tenth part of an ephah of barley meal; he shall pour no oil upon it, nor put frankincense thereon; for it is an offering of jealousy, an offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to remembrance.
verses.fr: cet homme amènera sa femme au sacrificateur, et apportera en offrande pour elle un dixième d''épha de farine d''orge; il n''y répandra point d''huile, et n''y mettra point d''encens, car c''est une offrande de jalousie, une offrande de souvenir, qui rappelle une iniquité.
verses.am: ያ ሰው ሚስቱን ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣት፥ የኢፍ መስፈሪያም አሥረኛ እጅ ገብስ ዱቄት ቍርባን ስለ እርስዋ ያምጣ፤ የቅንዓት ቍርባን ነውና፥ ኃጢአትንም የሚያሳስብ የመታሰቢያ ቍርባን ነውና ዘይት አያፍስስበት፥ ዕጣንም አይጨምርበት።

verses.en: And the priest shall bring her near, and set her before the Lord:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur la fera approcher, et la fera tenir debout devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ያቀርባታል በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ያቆማታል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and of the dust that is in the floor of the tabernacle the priest shall take, and put it into the water:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra de l''eau sainte dans un vase de terre; il prendra de la poussière sur le sol du tabernacle, et la mettra dans l''eau.
verses.am: ካህኑም የተቀደሰ ውኃ በሸክላ ዕቃ ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም በማደሪያው ውስጥ ካለው ትቢያ ወስዶ በውኃ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall set the woman before the Lord, and uncover the woman's head, and put the offering of memorial in her hands, which is the jealousy offering: and the priest shall have in his hand the bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur fera tenir la femme debout devant l''Eternel; il découvrira la tête de la femme, et lui posera sur les mains l''offrande de souvenir, l''offrande de jalousie; le sacrificateur aura dans sa main les eaux amères qui apportent la malédiction.
verses.am: ካህኑም ሴቲቱን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቆማታል፥ የሴቲቱንም ራስ ይገልጣል፥ በእጅዋም ለመታሰቢያ የሚሆነውን የእህል ቍርባን፥ ለቅንዓት ቍርባን፥ ያኖራል፤ በካህኑም እጅ እርግማንን የሚያመጣው መራራ ውኃ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the priest shall charge her by an oath, and say unto the woman, If no man have lain with thee, and if thou hast not gone aside to uncleanness with another instead of thy husband, be thou free from this bitter water that causeth the curse:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur fera jurer la femme, et lui dira: Si aucun homme n''a couché avec toi, et si, étant sous la puissance de ton mari, tu ne t''en es point détournée pour te souiller, ces eaux amères qui apportent la malédiction ne te seront point funestes.
verses.am: ካህኑም ያምላታል፥ ሴቲቱንም እንዲህ ይላታል። ሌላ ወንድ አልተኛሽ፥ ባልሽንም አልተውሽ፥ ራስሽንም አላረከስሽ እንደ ሆነ፥ እርግማንን ከሚያመጣ ከዚህ መራራ ውኃ ንጹሕ ሁኚ፤

verses.en: But if thou hast gone aside to another instead of thy husband, and if thou be defiled, and some man have lain with thee beside thine husband:
verses.fr: Mais si, étant sous la puissance de ton mari, tu t''en es détournée et que tu te sois souillée, et si un autre homme que ton mari a couché avec toi, -
verses.am: ነገር ግን ባልሽን ትተሽ ረክሰሽ እንደ ሆነ፥ ከባልሽም ሌላ ከወንድ ጋር ተኝተሽ እንደሆነ፤

verses.en: Then the priest shall charge the woman with an oath of cursing, and the priest shall say unto the woman, The Lord make thee a curse and an oath among thy people, when the Lord doth make thy thigh to rot, and thy belly to swell;
verses.fr: et le sacrificateur fera jurer la femme avec un serment d''imprécation, et lui dira: -Que l''Eternel te livre à la malédiction et à l''exécration au milieu de ton peuple, en faisant dessécher ta cuisse et enfler ton ventre,
verses.am: ካህኑም ሴቲቱን በመርገም መሐላ ያምላታል፥ ካህኑም ሴቲቱን። እግዚአብሔር ጭንሽን እያሰለሰለ ሆድሽንም እየነፋ፥ እግዚአብሔር ለመርገምና ለመሐላ በሕዝብሽ መካከል ያድርግሽ፤

verses.en: And this water that causeth the curse shall go into thy bowels, to make thy belly to swell, and thy thigh to rot: And the woman shall say, Amen, amen.
verses.fr: et que ces eaux qui apportent la malédiction entrent dans tes entrailles pour te faire enfler le ventre et dessécher la cuisse! Et la femme dira: Amen! Amen!
verses.am: እርግማንንም የሚያመጣ ይህ ውኃ ወደ ሆድሽ ይግባ፥ ሆድሽንም ይንፋው፥ ጭንሽንም ያበስብሰው ይላታል፤ ሴቲቱም። አሜን አሜን ትላለች።

verses.en: And the priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall blot them out with the bitter water:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur écrira ces imprécations dans un livre, puis les effacera avec les eaux amères.
