verses.am: ካህኑም እነዚህን መርገሞች በሰሌዳ ይጽፈዋል፥ በመራራውም ውኃ ይደመስሰዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall cause the woman to drink the bitter water that causeth the curse: and the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter.
verses.fr: Et il fera boire à la femme les eaux amères qui apportent la malédiction, et les eaux qui apportent la malédiction entreront en elle pour produire l''amertume.
verses.am: እርግማን የሚያመጣውንም መራራ ውኃ ለሴቲቱ ይጠጣታል፤ የእርግማኑም ውኃ በገባባት ጊዜ መራራ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then the priest shall take the jealousy offering out of the woman's hand, and shall wave the offering before the Lord, and offer it upon the altar:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra des mains de la femme l''offrande de jalousie, il agitera l''offrande de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel, et il l''offrira sur l''autel;
verses.am: ካህኑም የቅንዓቱን የእህል ቍርባን ከሴቲቱ እጅ ይወስዳል፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዘዋል፥ ወደ መሠዊያውም ያመጣዋል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall take an handful of the offering, even the memorial thereof, and burn it upon the altar, and afterward shall cause the woman to drink the water.
verses.fr: le sacrificateur prendra une poignée de cette offrande comme souvenir, et il la brûlera sur l''autel. C''est après cela qu''il fera boire les eaux à la femme.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን አንድ እፍኝ ሙሉ ለመታሰቢያው ወስዶ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ለሴቲቱ ውኃውን ያጠጣታል።

verses.en: And when he hath made her to drink the water, then it shall come to pass, that, if she be defiled, and have done trespass against her husband, that the water that causeth the curse shall enter into her, and become bitter, and her belly shall swell, and her thigh shall rot: and the woman shall be a curse among her people.
verses.fr: Quand il aura fait boire les eaux, il arrivera, si elle s''est souillée et a été infidèle à son mari, que les eaux qui apportent la malédiction entreront en elle pour produire l''amertume; son ventre s''enflera, sa cuisse se desséchera, et cette femme sera en malédiction au milieu de son peuple.
verses.am: ውኃውን ካጠጣት በኋላ እንዲህ ይሆናል፤ ረክሳና በባልዋ ላይ አመንዝራ እንደ ሆነች፥ እርግማንን የሚያመጣው ውኃ ገብቶ መራራ ይሆንባታል፥ ሆድዋም ይነፋል፥ ጭንዋም ይሰለስላል፤ ሴቲቱም በሕዝብዋ መካከል ለመርገም ትሆናለች።

verses.en: And if the woman be not defiled, but be clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive seed.
verses.fr: Mais si la femme ne s''est point souillée et qu''elle soit pure, elle sera reconnue innocente et aura des enfants.
verses.am: ያልረከሰች ያለ ነውርም እንደ ሆነች፥ ንጹሕ ትሆናለች፥ ልጆችንም ታረግዛለች።

verses.en: This is the law of jealousies, when a wife goeth aside to another instead of her husband, and is defiled;
verses.fr: Telle est la loi sur la jalousie, pour le cas où une femme sous la puissance de son mari se détourne et se souille,
verses.am: ሰውዮውም ከኃጢአት ንጹሕ ይሆናል፥ ሴቲቱም ኃጢአትዋን ትሸከማለች።

verses.en: Or when the spirit of jealousy cometh upon him, and he be jealous over his wife, and shall set the woman before the Lord, and the priest shall execute upon her all this law.
verses.fr: et pour le cas où un mari saisi d''un esprit de jalousie a des soupçons sur sa femme: le sacrificateur la fera tenir debout devant l''Eternel, et lui appliquera cette loi dans son entier.
verses.am: ሰውዮውም ከኃጢአት ንጹሕ ይሆናል፥ ሴቲቱም ኃጢአትዋን ትሸከማለች።

verses.en: Then shall the man be guiltless from iniquity, and this woman shall bear her iniquity.
verses.fr: Le mari sera exempt de faute, mais la femme portera la peine de son iniquité.
verses.am: ፤ ሰውዮውም ከኃጢአት ንጹሕ ይሆናል፥ ሴቲቱም ኃጢአትዋን ትሸከማለች።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When either man or woman shall separate themselves to vow a vow of a Nazarite, to separate themselves unto the Lord:
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et tu leur diras: Lorsqu''un homme ou une femme se séparera des autres en faisant voeu de naziréat, pour se consacrer à l''Eternel,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው። ሰው ወይም ሴት ለእግዚአብሔር ራሱን የተለየ ያደርግ ዘንድ የናዝራዊነት ስእለት ቢሳል፥

verses.en: He shall separate himself from wine and strong drink, and shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of strong drink, neither shall he drink any liquor of grapes, nor eat moist grapes, or dried.
verses.fr: il s''abstiendra de vin et de boisson enivrante; il ne boira ni vinaigre fait avec du vin, ni vinaigre fait avec une boisson enivrante; il ne boira d''aucune liqueur tirée des raisins, et il ne mangera point de raisins frais ni de raisins secs.
verses.am: ከወይን ጠጅና ከሚያሰክር መጠጥ ራሱን የተለየ ያድርግ፤ ከወይን ወይም ከሌላ ነገር የሚገኘውን ሆምጣጤ አይጠጣ፥ የወይንም ጭማቂ አይጠጣ፤ የወይን እሸት ወይም ዘቢብ አይብላ።

verses.en: All the days of his separation shall he eat nothing that is made of the vine tree, from the kernels even to the husk.
verses.fr: Pendant tout le temps de son naziréat, il ne mangera rien de ce qui provient de la vigne, depuis les pépins jusqu''à la peau du raisin.
verses.am: ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ከወይን የሆነውን ነገር ሁሉ ከውስጡ ፍሬ ጀምሮ እስከ ገፈፎው ድረስ አይብላ።

verses.en: All the days of the vow of his separation there shall no razor come upon his head: until the days be fulfilled, in the which he separateth himself unto the Lord, he shall be holy, and shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow.
verses.fr: Pendant tout le temps de son naziréat, le rasoir ne passera point sur sa tête; jusqu''à l''accomplissement des jours pour lesquels il s''est consacré à l''Eternel, il sera saint, il laissera croître librement ses cheveux.
verses.am: ራሱን ለመለየት ስእለት ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ በራሱ ላይ ምላጭ አይደርስም፤ ለእግዚአብሔር የተለየበት ወራት እስኪፈጸም ድረስ የተቀደሰ ይሆናል፥ የራሱንም ጠጕር ያሳድጋል።

verses.en: All the days that he separateth himself unto the Lord he shall come at no dead body.
verses.fr: Pendant tout le temps qu''il a voué à l''Eternel, il ne s''approchera point d''une personne morte;
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ወደ ሬሳ አይቅረብ።

verses.en: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die: because the consecration of his God is upon his head.
verses.fr: il ne se souillera point à la mort de son père, de sa mère, de son frère ou de sa soeur, car il porte sur sa tête la consécration de son Dieu.
verses.am: ለአምላኩ ያደረገው እስለት በራሱ ላይ ነውና አባቱ ወይም እናቱ ወይም ወንድሙ ወይም እኅቱ ሲሞቱ ሰውነቱን አያርክስባቸው።

verses.en: All the days of his separation he is holy unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Pendant tout le temps de son naziréat, il sera consacré à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ራሱን የተለየ ባደረገበት ወራት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰ ነው።

verses.en: And if any man die very suddenly by him, and he hath defiled the head of his consecration; then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing, on the seventh day shall he shave it.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un meurt subitement près de lui, et que sa tête consacrée devienne ainsi souillée, il se rasera la tête le jour de sa purification, il se la rasera le septième jour.
verses.am: ሰውም በአጠገቡ ድንገት ቢሞት የተለየውንም ራሱን ቢያረክስ፥ እርሱ በሚነጻበት ቀን ራሱን ይላጭ፤ በሰባተኛው ቀን ይላጨው።

verses.en: And on the eighth day he shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons, to the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, il apportera au sacrificateur deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣ፤

verses.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make an atonement for him, for that he sinned by the dead, and shall hallow his head that same day.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur sacrifiera l''un comme victime expiatoire, et l''autre comme holocauste, et il fera pour lui l''expiation de son péché à l''occasion du mort. Le naziréen sanctifiera ainsi sa tête ce jour-là
verses.am: ካህኑም አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁለተኛውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል፤ በሬሳም የተነሣ ኃጢአት ሠርቶአልና ያስተሰርይለታል፥ በዚያም ቀን ራሱን ይቀድሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall consecrate unto the Lord the days of his separation, and shall bring a lamb of the first year for a trespass offering: but the days that were before shall be lost, because his separation was defiled.
verses.fr: Il consacrera de nouveau à l''Eternel les jours de son naziréat, et il offrira un agneau d''un an en sacrifice de culpabilité; les jours précédents ne seront point comptés, parce que son naziréat a été souillé.
verses.am: ራሱን የተለየ ያደረገበትን ወራትም ለእግዚአብሔር ይቀድሳል፥ የአንድ ዓመትም ተባት ጠቦት ለበደል መሥዋዕት ያምጣ፤ ናዝራዊነቱ ግን ረክሶአልና ያለፈው ወራት ሁሉ ከንቱ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And this is the law of the Nazarite, when the days of his separation are fulfilled: he shall be brought unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.fr: Voici la loi du naziréen. Le jour où il aura accompli le temps de son naziréat, on le fera venir à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: የመለየቱ ወራት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ የናዝራዊው ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ይቅረብ፤

verses.en: And he shall offer his offering unto the Lord, one he lamb of the first year without blemish for a burnt offering, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish for a sin offering, and one ram without blemish for peace offerings,
verses.fr: Il présentera son offrande à l''Eternel: un agneau d''un an et sans défaut pour l''holocauste, une brebis d''un an et sans défaut pour le sacrifice d''expiation, et un bélier sans défaut pour le sacrifice d''actions de grâces;
verses.am: ቍርባኑንም ለእግዚአብሔር ያቅርብ፤ ነውር የሌለበት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦት ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ነውርም የሌለባትን የአንድ ዓመት እንስት ጠቦት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ነውርም የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት፥

verses.en: And a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, and wafers of unleavened bread anointed with oil, and their meat offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.fr: une corbeille de pains sans levain, de gâteaux de fleur de farine pétris à l''huile, et de galettes sans levain arrosées d''huile, avec l''offrande et la libation ordinaires.
verses.am: አንድ ሌማትም ቂጣ እንጀራ፥ በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመልካም ዱቄትም የተሠሩ እንጐቻዎች፥ በዘይትም የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ፥ የእህሉንም ቍርባን፥ የመጠጡንም ቍርባን ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And the priest shall bring them before the Lord, and shall offer his sin offering, and his burnt offering:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur présentera ces choses devant l''Eternel, et il offrira sa victime expiatoire et son holocauste;
verses.am: ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርባቸዋል፥ የኃጢአቱንም መሥዋዕት የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ያሳርግለታል።

verses.en: And he shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, with the basket of unleavened bread: the priest shall offer also his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: il offrira le bélier en sacrifice d''actions de grâces à l''Eternel, outre la corbeille de pains sans levain, avec l''offrande et la libation.
verses.am: አውራውንም በግ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከሌማቱ ቂጣ እንጀራ ጋር ወደ እግዚአብሔር ያቀርባል፤ ካህኑም ደግሞ የእህሉን ቍርባንና የመጠጡን ቍርባን ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And the Nazarite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it in the fire which is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.fr: Le naziréen rasera, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, sa tête consacrée; il prendra les cheveux de sa tête consacrée, et il les mettra sur le feu qui est sous le sacrifice d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: ናዝራዊውም የተለየውን የራሱን ጠጕር በመገናኛው ድንኳን አጠገብ ይላጫል፥ የመለየቱንም ራስ ጠጕር ወስዶ ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በታች ወዳለው እሳት ይጥለዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take the sodden shoulder of the ram, and one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them upon the hands of the Nazarite, after the hair of his separation is shaven:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra l''épaule cuite du bélier, un gâteau sans levain de la corbeille, et une galette sans levain; et il les posera sur les mains du naziréen, après qu''il aura rasé sa tête consacrée.
verses.am: ካህኑም የተቀቀለውን የአውራውን በግ ወርች፥ ከሌማቱም አንድ ቂጣ እንጐቻ አንድም ስስ ቂጣ ይወስዳል፥ የተለየውንም የራስ ጠጕር ከተላጨ በኋላ በናዝራዊው እጆች ላይ ያኖራቸዋል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord: this is holy for the priest, with the wave breast and heave shoulder: and after that the Nazarite may drink wine.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur les agitera de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel: c''est une chose sainte, qui appartient au sacrificateur, avec la poitrine agitée et l''épaule offerte par élévation. Ensuite, le naziréen pourra boire du vin.
verses.am: ካህኑም እነዚህን ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዛቸዋል፤ ይህም ከሚወዘወዘው ፍርምባና ከሚነሣው ወርች ጋር ለካህኑ የተቀደሰ ነው። ከዚያም በኋላ ናዝራዊው ወይን ይጠጣ ዘንድ ይችላል።

verses.en: This is the law of the Nazarite who hath vowed, and of his offering unto the Lord for his separation, beside that that his hand shall get: according to the vow which he vowed, so he must do after the law of his separation.
verses.fr: Telle est la loi pour celui qui fait voeu de naziréat; telle est son offrande à l''Eternel pour son naziréat, outre ce que lui permettront ses ressources. Il accomplira ce qui est ordonné pour le voeu qu''il a fait, selon la loi de son naziréat.
verses.am: ስእለቱን የተሳለው የናዝራዊ፥ እጁም ከሚያገኘው ሌላ ስለ ናዝራዊነቱ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበው የቍርባኑ ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ስእለቱን እንደ ተሳለ እንደ ናዝራዊነቱ ሕግ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron and unto his sons, saying, On this wise ye shall bless the children of Israel, saying unto them,
verses.fr: Parle à Aaron et à ses fils, et dis: Vous bénirez ainsi les enfants d''Israël, vous leur direz:
verses.am: ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ንገራቸው። የእስራኤልን ልጆች ስትባርኩአቸው እንዲህ በሉአቸው።

verses.en: The Lord bless thee, and keep thee:
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel te bénisse, et qu''il te garde!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይባርክህ፥ ይጠብቅህም፤

verses.en: The Lord make his face shine upon thee, and be gracious unto thee:
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel fasse luire sa face sur toi, et qu''il t''accorde sa grâce!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፊቱን ያብራልህ፥ ይራራልህም፤

verses.en: The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee, and give thee peace.
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel tourne sa face vers toi, et qu''il te donne la paix!
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ፊቱን ወደ አንተ ያንሣ፥ ሰላምንም ይስጥህ።

verses.en: And they shall put my name upon the children of Israel, and I will bless them.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''ils mettront mon nom sur les enfants d''Israël, et je les bénirai.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ስሜን በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ያደርጋሉ፤ እኔም እባርካቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the day that Moses had fully set up the tabernacle, and had anointed it, and sanctified it, and all the instruments thereof, both the altar and all the vessels thereof, and had anointed them, and sanctified them;
verses.fr: Lorsque Moïse eut achevé de dresser le tabernacle, il l''oignit et le sanctifia avec tous ses ustensiles, de même que l''autel avec tous ses ustensiles; il les oignit et les sanctifia.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሙሴ ማደሪያውን ፈጽሞ ከተከለ በኋላ፥ እርሱንና ዕቃውን ሁሉ ከቀባና ከቀደሰ በኋላ፥ መሠዊያውንና ዕቃውንም ሁሉ ከቀባና ከቀደሰ በኋላ፤

verses.en: That the princes of Israel, heads of the house of their fathers, who were the princes of the tribes, and were over them that were numbered, offered:
verses.fr: Alors les princes d''Israël, chefs des maisons de leurs pères, présentèrent leur offrande: c''étaient les princes des tribus, ceux qui avaient présidé au dénombrement.
verses.am: የእስራኤል አለቆች፥ የአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች አለቆች ቍርባናቸውን አቀረቡ፤ እነዚህም ከተቈጠሩት በላይ የተሾሙ የነገዶች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they brought their offering before the Lord, six covered wagons, and twelve oxen; a wagon for two of the princes, and for each one an ox: and they brought them before the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Ils amenèrent leur offrande devant l''Eternel: six chars en forme de litières et douze boeufs, soit un char pour deux princes et un boeuf pour chaque prince; et ils les offrirent devant le tabernacle.
verses.am: መባቸውንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረቡ፥ የተከደኑ ስድስት ሰረገሎች አሥራ ሁለትም በሬዎች፤ በየሁለቱም አለቆች አንድ ሰረገላ አቀረቡ፥ ሁሉም እያንዳንዱ አንድ በሬ በማደሪያው ፊት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take it of them, that they may be to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; and thou shalt give them unto the Levites, to every man according to his service.
verses.fr: Prends d''eux ces choses, afin de les employer pour le service de la tente d''assignation; tu les donneras aux Lévites, à chacun selon ses fonctions.
verses.am: ለመገናኛው ድንኳን ማገልገል ይሆን ዘንድ ከእነርሱ ተቀብለህ ለሌዋውያን ለእያንዳንዱ እንደ አገልግሎታቸው ስጣቸው።

verses.en: And Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them unto the Levites.
verses.fr: Moïse prit les chars et les boeufs, et il les remit aux Lévites.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሰረገሎችንና በሬዎችን ተቀብሎ ለሌዋውያን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: Two wagons and four oxen he gave unto the sons of Gershon, according to their service:
verses.fr: Il donna deux chars et quatre boeufs aux fils de Guerschon, selon leurs fonctions;
verses.am: ለጌድሶን ልጆች እንደ አገልግሎታቸው ሁለት ሰረገሎችንና አራት በሬዎችን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And four wagons and eight oxen he gave unto the sons of Merari, according unto their service, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.
verses.fr: il donna quatre chars et huit boeufs aux fils de Merari, selon leurs fonctions, sous la conduite d''Ithamar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron.
verses.am: ከካህኑም ከአሮን ልጅ ከኢታምር እጅ በታች ላሉት ለሜራሪ ልጆች እንደ አገልግሎታቸው አራት ሰረገሎችንና ስምንት በሬዎችን ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: But unto the sons of Kohath he gave none: because the service of the sanctuary belonging unto them was that they should bear upon their shoulders.
verses.fr: Mais il n''en donna point aux fils de Kehath, parce que, selon leurs fonctions, ils devaient porter les choses saintes sur les épaules.
verses.am: ለቀዓት ልጆች ግን መቅደሱን ማገልገል የእነርሱ ነውና፥ በትከሻቸውም ይሸከሙት ነበርና ምንም አልሰጣቸውም።

verses.en: And the princes offered for dedicating of the altar in the day that it was anointed, even the princes offered their offering before the altar.
verses.fr: Les princes présentèrent leur offrande pour la dédicace de l''autel, le jour où on l''oignit; les princes présentèrent leur offrande devant l''autel.
verses.am: መሠዊያውም በተቀባ ቀን አለቆቹ መሠዊያውን ለመቀደስ ቍርባንን አቀረቡ፤ አለቆችም መባቸውን በመሠዊያው ፊት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedicating of the altar.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Les princes viendront un à un, et à des jours différents, présenter leur offrande pour la dédicace de l''autel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። አለቆቹ መሠዊያውን ለመቀደስ መባቸውን እያንዳንዱ በቀን በቀኑ ያቅርቡ አለው።

verses.en: And he that offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah:
verses.fr: Celui qui présenta son offrande le premier jour fut Nachschon, fils d''Amminadab, de la tribu de Juda.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያውም ቀን መባውን ያቀረበ ከይሁዳ ነገድ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን ነበረ።

verses.en: And his offering was one silver charger, the weight thereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them were full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.fr: Il offrit: un plat d''argent du poids de cent trente sicles, un bassin d''argent de soixante-dix sicles, selon le sicle du sanctuaire, tous deux pleins de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, pour l''offrande;
verses.am: መባውም ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት የተሞሉ፥ ሚዛኑ እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የብር ወጭት፥ ሚዛኑም ሰባ ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የብር ድስት፤

verses.en: One spoon of ten shekels of gold, full of incense:
verses.fr: une coupe d''or de dix sicles, pleine de parfum;
verses.am: ዕጣንም የተሞላ ሚዛኑ አሥር ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የወርቅ ጭልፋ፤

verses.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.fr: un jeune taureau, un bélier, un agneau d''un an, pour l''holocauste;

verses.fr: Le douzième jour, le prince des fils de Nephthali, Ahira, fils d''Enan,
verses.am: በአሥራ ሁለተኛውም ቀን የንፍታሌም ልጆች አለቃ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ፤

verses.en: His offering was one silver charger, the weight whereof was an hundred and thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary; both of them full of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering:
verses.fr: offrit: un plat d''argent du poids de cent trente sicles, un bassin d''argent de soixante-dix sicles selon le sicle du sanctuaire, tous deux pleins de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, pour l''offrande;
verses.am: መባውም ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት የተሞሉ፥ ሚዛኑ እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን መቶ ሠላሳ ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የብር ወጭት፥ ሚዛኑም ሰባ ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የብር ድስት፤

verses.en: One golden spoon of ten shekels, full of incense:
verses.fr: une coupe d''or de dix sicles, pleine de parfum;
verses.am: ዕጣንም የተሞላ ሚዛኑ አሥር ሰቅል የሆነ አንድ የወርቅ ጭልፋ፤

verses.en: One young bullock, one ram, one lamb of the first year, for a burnt offering:
verses.fr: un jeune taureau, un bélier, un agneau d''un an, pour l''holocauste;
verses.am: ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥

verses.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering:
verses.fr: un bouc, pour le sacrifice d''expiation;
verses.am: አንድ የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦት፤ ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፤

verses.en: And for a sacrifice of peace offerings, two oxen, five rams, five he goats, five lambs of the first year: this was the offering of Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.fr: et, pour le sacrifice d''actions de grâces, deux boeufs, cinq béliers, cinq boucs, cinq agneaux d''un an. Telle fut l''offrande d''Ahira, fils d''Enan.
verses.am: ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ሁለት በሬዎች፥ አምስት አውራ በጎች፥ አምስት አውራ ፍየሎች፥ አምስት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበረ፤ የዔናን ልጅ የአኪሬ መባ ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: This was the dedication of the altar, in the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve chargers of silver, twelve silver bowls, twelve spoons of gold:
verses.fr: Tels furent les dons des princes d''Israël pour la dédicace de l''autel, le jour où on l''oignit. Douze plats d''argent, douze bassins d''argent, douze coupes d''or;
verses.am: መሠዊያው በተቀባ ቀን የእስራኤል አለቆች ለመቀደሻው ያቀረቡት ቍርባን ይህ ነበረ፤ አሥራ ሁለት የብር ወጭቶች፥ አሥራ ሁለት የብር ድስቶች፥ አሥራ ሁለት የወርቅ ጭልፋዎች፤

verses.en: Each charger of silver weighing an hundred and thirty shekels, each bowl seventy: all the silver vessels weighed two thousand and four hundred shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
verses.fr: chaque plat d''argent pesait cent trente sicles, et chaque bassin soixante-dix, ce qui fit pour l''argent de ces ustensiles un total de deux mille quatre cents sicles, selon le sicle du sanctuaire;
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም የብር ወጭት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰቅል፥ እያንዳንዱም ድስት ሰባ ሰቅል ነበረ፤ የዚህም ዕቃ ሁሉ ብር በመቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ሁለት ሺህ አራት መቶ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.en: The golden spoons were twelve, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, after the shekel of the sanctuary: all the gold of the spoons was an hundred and twenty shekels.
verses.fr: les douze coupes d''or pleines de parfum, à dix sicles la coupe, selon le sicle du sanctuaire, firent pour l''or des coupes un total de cent vingt sicles.
verses.am: ዕጣንም የተሞሉ አሥራ ሁለቱ የወርቅ ጭልፋዎች፥ እያንዳንዱ በመቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን አሥር አሥር ሰቅል ነበረ፤ የጭልፋዎቹ ወርቅ ሁሉ መቶ ሀያ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.en: All the oxen for the burnt offering were twelve bullocks, the rams twelve, the lambs of the first year twelve, with their meat offering: and the kids of the goats for sin offering twelve.
verses.fr: Total des animaux pour l''holocauste: douze taureaux, douze béliers, douze agneaux d''un an, avec les offrandes ordinaires. Douze boucs, pour le sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ከብት ሁሉ ከእህሉ ቍርባን ጋር አሥራ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ አሥራ ሁለትም አውራ በጎች፥ አሥራ ሁለትም የአንድ ዓመት ተባት ጠቦቶች ነበሩ፤ የኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየሎች አሥራ ሁለት ነበሩ።

verses.en: And all the oxen for the sacrifice of the peace offerings were twenty and four bullocks, the rams sixty, the he goats sixty, the lambs of the first year sixty. This was the dedication of the altar, after that it was anointed.
verses.fr: Total des animaux pour le sacrifice d''actions de grâces: vingt-quatre boeufs, soixante béliers, soixante boucs, soixante agneaux d''un an. Tels furent les dons pour la dédicace de l''autel, après qu''on l''eut oint.
verses.am: የደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት ከብት ሁሉ ሀያ አራት በሬዎች፥ ስድሳም አውራ በጎች፥ ስድሳም አውራ ፍየሎች፥ ስድሳም የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ነበሩ። መሠዊያው ከተቀባ በኋላ ለመቀደሻው የቀረበ ቍርባን ይህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when Moses was gone into the tabernacle of the congregation to speak with him, then he heard the voice of one speaking unto him from off the mercy seat that was upon the ark of testimony, from between the two cherubims: and he spake unto him.
verses.fr: Lorsque Moïse entrait dans la tente d''assignation pour parler avec l''Eternel, il entendait la voix qui lui parlait du haut du propitiatoire placé sur l''arche du témoignage, entre les deux chérubins. Et il parlait avec l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን እርሱን ለመነጋገር በገባ ጊዜ በምስክሩ ታቦት ላይ ካለው ከስርየት መክደኛ በላይ ከኪሩቤልም መካከል ድምፁ ሲናገረው ይሰማ ነበር፤ እርሱም ይናገረው ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron and say unto him, When thou lightest the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light over against the candlestick.
verses.fr: Parle à Aaron, et tu lui diras: Lorsque tu placeras les lampes sur le chandelier, les sept lampes devront éclairer en face.
verses.am: መብራቶቹን ስትለኵስ ሰባቱ መብራቶች በመቅረዙ ፊት ያበራሉ ብለህ ለአሮን ንገረው።

verses.en: And Aaron did so; he lighted the lamps thereof over against the candlestick, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Aaron fit ainsi; il plaça les lampes sur le devant du chandelier, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: አሮንም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ በመቅረዙ ፊት መብራቶቹን ለኰሰ።

verses.en: And this work of the candlestick was of beaten gold, unto the shaft thereof, unto the flowers thereof, was beaten work: according unto the pattern which the Lord had shewed Moses, so he made the candlestick.
verses.fr: Le chandelier était d''or battu; jusqu''à son pied, jusqu''à ses fleurs, il était d''or battu; Moïse avait fait le chandelier d''après le modèle que l''Eternel lui avait montré.
verses.am: መቅረዙም እንዲህ ሆኖ ተሠርቶ ነበር፤ ከተቀጠቀጠ ወርቅ ተሠራ፤ እስከ አገዳውና እስከ አበቦቹ ድረስ ከተቀጠቀጠ ሥራ ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳሳየው ምሳሌ መቅረዙን እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
verses.fr: Prends les Lévites du milieu des enfants d''Israël, et purifie-les.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ሌዋውያንን ወስደህ አንጻቸው።

verses.en: And thus shalt thou do unto them, to cleanse them: Sprinkle water of purifying upon them, and let them shave all their flesh, and let them wash their clothes, and so make themselves clean.
verses.fr: Voici comment tu les purifieras. Fais sur eux une aspersion d''eau expiatoire; qu''ils fassent passer le rasoir sur tout leur corps, qu''ils lavent leurs vêtements, et qu''ils se purifient.
verses.am: ታነጻቸው ዘንድ እንዲህ ታደርግላቸዋለህ፤ ኃጢአትን የሚያነጻውን ውኃ እርጫቸው፥ በገላቸውም ሁሉ ምላጭ ያሳልፉ፥ ልብሳቸውንም ይጠቡ፥ ይታጠቡም።

verses.en: Then let them take a young bullock with his meat offering, even fine flour mingled with oil, and another young bullock shalt thou take for a sin offering.
verses.fr: Ils prendront ensuite un jeune taureau, avec l''offrande ordinaire de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile; et tu prendras un autre jeune taureau pour le sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: ወይፈንን፥ ለእህሉም ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄትን ይውሰዱ፥ ሌላውንም ወይፈን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ውሰድ።

verses.en: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt gather the whole assembly of the children of Israel together:
verses.fr: Tu feras approcher les Lévites devant la tente d''assignation, et tu convoqueras toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት አቅርብ፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ሰብስብ።

verses.en: And thou shalt bring the Levites before the Lord: and the children of Israel shall put their hands upon the Levites:
verses.fr: Tu feras approcher les Lévites devant l''Eternel; et les enfants d''Israël poseront leurs mains sur les Lévites.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርባቸው፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች በሌዋውያን ላይ እጃቸውን ይጫኑባቸው።

verses.en: And Aaron shall offer the Levites before the Lord for an offering of the children of Israel, that they may execute the service of the Lord.
verses.fr: Aaron fera tourner de côté et d''autre les Lévites devant l''Eternel, comme une offrande de la part des enfants d''Israël; et ils seront consacrés au service de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሮንም ሌዋውያን እግዚአብሔርን ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ስጦታ አድርጎ፥ ሌዋውያንን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bullocks: and thou shalt offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, unto the Lord, to make an atonement for the Levites.
verses.fr: Les Lévites poseront leurs mains sur la tête des taureaux; et tu offriras l''un en sacrifice d''expiation, et l''autre en holocauste, afin de faire l''expiation pour les Lévites.
verses.am: ሌዋውያኑም በወይፈኖቹ ራሶች ላይ እጆቻቸውን ይጫኑ፤ ለሌዋውያንም ስለ ማስተስረያ አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሁለተኛውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርብ።

verses.en: And thou shalt set the Levites before Aaron, and before his sons, and offer them for an offering unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu feras tenir les Lévites debout devant Aaron et devant ses fils, et tu les feras tourner de côté et d''autre comme une offrande à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንንም በአሮንና በልጆቹ ፊት አቁማቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ስጦታ አድርገህ አቅርባቸው።

verses.en: Thus shalt thou separate the Levites from among the children of Israel: and the Levites shall be mine.
verses.fr: Tu sépareras les Lévites du milieu des enfants d''Israël; et les Lévites m''appartiendront.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለይ፤ ሌዋውያንም ለእኔ ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And after that shall the Levites go in to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation: and thou shalt cleanse them, and offer them for an offering.
verses.fr: Après cela, les Lévites viendront faire le service dans la tente d''assignation. C''est ainsi que tu les purifieras, et que tu les feras tourner de côté et d''autre comme une offrande.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ሌዋውያን የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ይገባሉ፤ ታነጻቸውማለህ፥ ስጦታም አድርገህ ታቀርባቸዋለህ።

verses.en: For they are wholly given unto me from among the children of Israel; instead of such as open every womb, even instead of the firstborn of all the children of Israel, have I taken them unto me.
verses.fr: Car ils me sont entièrement donnés du milieu des enfants d''Israël: je les ai pris pour moi à la place des premiers-nés, de tous les premiers-nés des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ፈጽሞ ለእኔ ተሰጥተዋልና፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች በኵራት ሁሉ፥ ማኅፀን በሚከፍት ሁሉ ፋንታ ለእኔ ወስጄአቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: For all the firstborn of the children of Israel are mine, both man and beast: on the day that I smote every firstborn in the land of Egypt I sanctified them for myself.
verses.fr: Car tout premier-né des enfants d''Israël m''appartient, tant des hommes que des animaux; le jour où j''ai frappé tous les premiers-nés dans le pays d''Egypte, je me les suis consacrés.
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድር ያለውን በኵር ሁሉ በገደልሁበት ቀን የእስራኤልን ልጆች በኵራት ሁሉ፥ ሰው ወይም እንስሳ፥ ለእኔ ቀድሼአቸዋለሁና የእኔ ናቸው።

verses.en: And I have taken the Levites for all the firstborn of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Et j''ai pris les Lévites à la place de tous les premiers-nés des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በእስራኤልም ልጆች በኵራት ሁሉ ፋንታ ሌዋውያንን ወስጄአለሁ።

verses.en: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the tabernacle of the congregation, and to make an atonement for the children of Israel: that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come nigh unto the sanctuary.
verses.fr: J''ai donné les Lévites entièrement à Aaron et à ses fils, du milieu des enfants d''Israël, pour qu''ils fassent le service des enfants d''Israël dans la tente d''assignation, pour qu''ils fassent l''expiation pour les enfants d''Israël, et pour que les enfants d''Israël ne soient frappés d''aucune plaie, en s''approchant du sanctuaire.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ወደ መቅደሱ በቀረቡ ጊዜ መቅሠፍት እንዳያገኛቸው፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ያስተሰርዩላቸው ዘንድ፥ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አገልግሎት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ይሠሩ ዘንድ ሌዋውያንን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ስጦታ አድርጌ ሰጥቼአቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: And Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, did to the Levites according unto all that the Lord commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did the children of Israel unto them.
verses.fr: Moïse, Aaron et toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, firent à l''égard des Lévites tout ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné à Moïse touchant les Lévites; ainsi firent à leur égard les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮን የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲሁ በሌዋውያን ላይ አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ስለ ሌዋውያን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉላቸው።

verses.en: And the Levites were purified, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them as an offering before the Lord; and Aaron made an atonement for them to cleanse them.
verses.fr: Les Lévites se purifièrent, et lavèrent leurs vêtements; Aaron les fit tourner de côté et d''autre comme une offrande devant l''Eternel, et il fit l''expiation pour eux, afin de les purifier.
verses.am: ሌዋውያንም ከኃጢአት ተጣጠቡ፥ ልብሳቸውንም አጠቡ፤ አሮንም ስጦታ አድርጎ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረባቸው፥ አሮንም ያነጻቸው ዘንድ አስተሰረየላቸው።

verses.en: And after that went the Levites in to do their service in the tabernacle of the congregation before Aaron, and before his sons: as the Lord had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so did they unto them.
verses.fr: Après cela, les Lévites vinrent faire leur service dans la tente d''assignation, en présence d''Aaron et de ses fils, selon ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné à Moïse touchant les Lévites; ainsi fut-il fait à leur égard.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ሌዋውያን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በአሮንና በልጆቹ ፊት አገልግሎታቸውን ይሠሩ ዘንድ ገቡ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ስለ ሌዋውያን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረጉላቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: This is it that belongeth unto the Levites: from twenty and five years old and upward they shall go in to wait upon the service of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.fr: Voici ce qui concerne les Lévites. Depuis l''âge de vingt-cinq ans et au-dessus, tout Lévite entrera au service de la tente d''assignation pour y exercer une fonction.
verses.am: የሌዋውያን ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ከሀያ አምስት ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ሥራ ያገለግሉ ዘንድ ይገባሉ።

verses.en: And from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting upon the service thereof, and shall serve no more:
verses.fr: Depuis l''âge de cinquante ans, il sortira de fonction, et ne servira plus.
verses.am: ዕድሜአቸውም አምሳ ዓመት ሲሞላ የአገልግሎታቸውን ሥራ ይተዋሉ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ አይሠሩም፤

verses.en: But shall minister with their brethren in the tabernacle of the congregation, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shalt thou do unto the Levites touching their charge.
verses.fr: Il aidera ses frères dans la tente d''assignation, pour garder ce qui est remis à leurs soins; mais il ne fera plus de service. Tu agiras ainsi à l''égard des Lévites pour ce qui concerne leurs fonctions.
verses.am: የተሰጣቸውን ይጠብቁ ዘንድ ወንድሞቻቸውን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ያገለግላሉ፤ የድንኳኑን አገልግሎት አይሠሩም። እንዲሁ ስለ ሥራቸው በሌዋውያን ላይ ታደርጋለህ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they were come out of the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, dans le désert de Sinaï, le premier mois de la seconde année après leur sortie du pays d''Egypte. Il dit:
verses.am: ከግብፅ ምድር በወጡ በሁለተኛው ዓመት በመጀመሪያው ወር በሲና ምድረ በዳ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Let the children of Israel also keep the passover at his appointed season.
verses.fr: Que les enfants d''Israël célèbrent la Pâque au temps fixé.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች በጊዜው ፋሲካውን ያድርጉ፤

verses.en: In the fourteenth day of this month, at even, ye shall keep it in his appointed season: according to all the rites of it, and according to all the ceremonies thereof, shall ye keep it.
verses.fr: Vous la célébrerez au temps fixé, le quatorzième jour de ce mois, entre les deux soirs; vous la célébrerez selon toutes les lois et toutes les ordonnances qui s''y rapportent.
verses.am: በዚህ ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ በጊዜው አድርጉት፤ እንደ ሥርዓቱ ሁሉ እንደ ፍርዱም ሁሉ አድርጉት።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, that they should keep the passover.
verses.fr: Moïse parla aux enfants d''Israël, afin qu''ils célébrassent la Pâque.
verses.am: ሙሴም ፋሲካን ያደርጉ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And they kept the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month at even in the wilderness of Sinai: according to all that the Lord commanded Moses, so did the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Et ils célébrèrent la Pâque le quatorzième jour du premier mois, entre les deux soirs, dans le désert de Sinaï; les enfants d''Israël se conformèrent à tous les ordres que l''Eternel avait donnés à Moïse.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያውም ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ በሲና ምድረ በዳ ፋሲካን አደረጉ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች አደረጉ።

verses.en: And there were certain men, who were defiled by the dead body of a man, that they could not keep the passover on that day: and they came before Moses and before Aaron on that day:
verses.fr: Il y eut des hommes qui, se trouvant impurs à cause d''un mort, ne pouvaient pas célébrer la Pâque ce jour-là. Ils se présentèrent le même jour devant Moïse et Aaron;
verses.am: በሞተ ሰው ሬሳ የረከሱ ሰዎችም ነበሩ፥ ስለዚህም በዚያ ቀን ፋሲካን ያደርጉ ዘንድ አልቻሉም። በዚያም ቀን ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ቀረቡ።

verses.en: And those men said unto him, We are defiled by the dead body of a man: wherefore are we kept back, that we may not offer an offering of the Lord in his appointed season among the children of Israel?
verses.fr: et ces hommes dirent à Moïse: Nous sommes impurs à cause d''un mort; pourquoi serions-nous privés de présenter au temps fixé l''offrande de l''Eternel au milieu des enfants d''Israël?
verses.am: እነዚያም ሰዎች። በሞተ ሰው ሬሳ ረክሰናል፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል በጊዜው ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር እንዳናቀርብ ስለ ምን እንከለከላለን? አሉት።

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, Stand still, and I will hear what the Lord will command concerning you.
verses.fr: Moïse leur dit: Attendez que je sache ce que l''Eternel vous ordonne.
verses.am: ሙሴም። እግዚአብሔር ስለ እናንተ የሚያዝዘውን እስክሰማ ድረስ ቈዩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If any man of you or of your posterity shall be unclean by reason of a dead body, or be in a journey afar off, yet he shall keep the passover unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Si quelqu''un d''entre vous ou de vos descendants est impur à cause d''un mort, ou est en voyage dans le lointain, il célébrera la Pâque en l''honneur de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ከእናንተ ወይም ከትውልዶቻችሁ ዘንድ ሰው በሬሳ ቢረክስ፥ ወይም ሩቅ መንገድ ቢሄድ፥ እርሱ ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካን ያድርግ።

verses.en: The fourteenth day of the second month at even they shall keep it, and eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
verses.fr: C''est au second mois qu''ils la célébreront, le quatorzième jour, entre les deux soirs; ils la mangeront avec des pains sans levain et des herbes amères.
verses.am: በሁለተኛው ወር በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን በመሸ ጊዜ ያድርጉት፤ ከቂጣ እንጀራና ከመራራ ቅጠል ጋር ይብሉት።

verses.en: They shall leave none of it unto the morning, nor break any bone of it: according to all the ordinances of the passover they shall keep it.
verses.fr: Ils n''en laisseront rien jusqu''au matin, et ils n''en briseront aucun os. Ils la célébreront selon toutes les ordonnances de la Pâque.
verses.am: ከእርሱም እስከ ነገ ምንም አያስቀሩ፥ ከእርሱም አጥንትን አይስበሩ፤ እንደ ፋሲካ ሥርዓት ሁሉ ያድርጉት።

verses.en: But the man that is clean, and is not in a journey, and forbeareth to keep the passover, even the same soul shall be cut off from among his people: because he brought not the offering of the Lord in his appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.fr: Si celui qui est pur et qui n''est pas en voyage s''abstient de célébrer la Pâque, celui-là sera retranché de son peuple; parce qu''il n''a pas présenté l''offrande de l''Eternel au temps fixé, cet homme-là portera la peine de son péché.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው በመንገድም ላይ ያልሆነ ፋሲካን ባያደርግ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ዘንድ ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ የእግዚአብሔርን ቍርባን በጊዜው አላቀረበምና ያ ሰው ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And if a stranger shall sojourn among you, and will keep the passover unto the Lord; according to the ordinance of the passover, and according to the manner thereof, so shall he do: ye shall have one ordinance, both for the stranger, and for him that was born in the land.
verses.fr: Si un étranger en séjour chez vous célèbre la Pâque de l''Eternel, il se conformera aux lois et aux ordonnances de la Pâque. Il y aura une même loi parmi vous, pour l''étranger comme pour l''indigène.
verses.am: በመካከላችሁም መጻተኛ ቢኖር፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካን ያደርግ ዘንድ ቢወድድ፥ እንደ ፋሲካ ሥርዓት እንደ ፍርዱም እንዲሁ ያድርግ፤ ለመጻተኛና ለአገር ልጅ አንድ ሥርዓት ይሁንላችሁ።

verses.en: And on the day that the tabernacle was reared up the cloud covered the tabernacle, namely, the tent of the testimony: and at even there was upon the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until the morning.
verses.fr: Le jour où le tabernacle fut dressé, la nuée couvrit le tabernacle, la tente d''assignation; et, depuis le soir jusqu''au matin, elle eut sur le tabernacle l''apparence d''un feu.
verses.am: ማደሪያውም በተተከለ ቀን ደመናው የምስክሩን ድንኳን ሸፈነው፤ ከማታም ጀምሮ እስከ ጥዋት ድረስ በማደሪያው ላይ እንደ እሳት ይመስል ነበር።

verses.en: So it was alway: the cloud covered it by day, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.fr: Il en fut continuellement ainsi: la nuée couvrait le tabernacle, et elle avait de nuit l''apparence d''un feu.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ሁልጊዜ ነበረ፤ በቀን ደመና በሌሊትም የእሳት አምሳል ይሸፍነው ነበር።

verses.en: And when the cloud was taken up from the tabernacle, then after that the children of Israel journeyed: and in the place where the cloud abode, there the children of Israel pitched their tents.
verses.fr: Quand la nuée s''élevait de dessus la tente, les enfants d''Israël partaient; et les enfants d''Israël campaient dans le lieu où s''arrêtait la nuée.
verses.am: ደመናውም ከድንኳኑ ላይ በተነሣ ጊዜ በዚያን ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች ይጓዙ ነበር፤ ደመናውም በቆመበት ስፍራ በዚያ የእስራኤል ልጆች ይሰፍሩ ነበር።

verses.en: At the commandment of the Lord the children of Israel journeyed, and at the commandment of the Lord they pitched: as long as the cloud abode upon the tabernacle they rested in their tents.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël partaient sur l''ordre de l''Eternel, et ils campaient sur l''ordre de l''Eternel; ils campaient aussi longtemps que la nuée restait sur le tabernacle.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ የእስራኤል ልጆች ይጓዙ ነበር፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ይሰፍሩ ነበር። ደመናው በማደሪያው ላይ በተቀመጠበት ዘመን ሁሉ በሰፈራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር።

verses.en: And when the cloud tarried long upon the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of the Lord, and journeyed not.
verses.fr: Quand la nuée restait longtemps sur le tabernacle, les enfants d''Israël obéissaient au commandement de l''Eternel, et ne partaient point.
verses.am: ደመናውም በማደሪያው ላይ ብዙ ቀን በተቀመጠ ጊዜ የእስራኤል ልጆች የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ይጠብቁ ነበር፥ አይጓዙምም ነበር።

verses.en: And so it was, when the cloud was a few days upon the tabernacle; according to the commandment of the Lord they abode in their tents, and according to the commandment of the Lord they journeyed.
verses.fr: Quand la nuée restait peu de jours sur le tabernacle, ils campaient sur l''ordre de l''Eternel, et ils partaient sur l''ordre de l''Eternel.
verses.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜ ደመናው ጥቂት ቀን በማደሪያው ላይ ይሆን ነበር፤ በዚያን ጊዜ እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ በሰፈራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር፤ እንደ እግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ይጓዙ ነበር።

verses.en: And so it was, when the cloud abode from even unto the morning, and that the cloud was taken up in the morning, then they journeyed: whether it was by day or by night that the cloud was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.fr: Si la nuée s''arrêtait du soir au matin, et s''élevait le matin, ils partaient. Si la nuée s''élevait après un jour et une nuit, ils partaient.
verses.am: አንዳንድ ጊዜም ደመናው ከማታ ጀምሮ እስከ ጥዋት ድረስ ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ በጥዋትም ደመናው በተነሣ ጊዜ ይጓዙ ነበር፤ በቀንም በሌሊትም ቢሆን፥ ደመናው በተነሣ ጊዜ ይጓዙ ነበር።

verses.en: Or whether it were two days, or a month, or a year, that the cloud tarried upon the tabernacle, remaining thereon, the children of Israel abode in their tents, and journeyed not: but when it was taken up, they journeyed.
verses.fr: Si la nuée s''arrêtait sur le tabernacle deux jours, ou un mois, ou une année, les enfants d''Israël restaient campés, et ne partaient point; et quand elle s''élevait, ils partaient.
verses.am: ደመናውም ሁለት ቀን ወይም አንድ ወር ወይም አንድ ዓመት ቆይቶ በማደሪያው ላይ ቢቀመጥ የእስራኤል ልጆች በሰፈራቸው ይቀመጡ ነበር፥ አይጓዙምም ነበር፤ ነገር ግን በተነሣ ጊዜ ይጓዙ ነበር።

verses.en: At the commandment of the Lord they rested in the tents, and at the commandment of the Lord they journeyed: they kept the charge of the Lord, at the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Ils campaient sur l''ordre de l''Eternel, et ils partaient sur l''ordre de l''Eternel; ils obéissaient au commandement de l''Eternel, sur l''ordre de l''Eternel par Moïse.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ይሰፍሩ ነበር፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ትእዛዝ ይጓዙ ነበር፥ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ይጠብቁ ነበር።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Make thee two trumpets of silver; of a whole piece shalt thou make them: that thou mayest use them for the calling of the assembly, and for the journeying of the camps.
verses.fr: Fais-toi deux trompettes d''argent; tu les feras d''argent battu. Elles te serviront pour la convocation de l''assemblée et pour le départ des camps.
verses.am: ሁለት የብር መለከቶች አጠፍጥፈህ ለአንተ አድርግ፤ ማኅበሩን ለመጥራት ከሰፈራቸውም ለማስጓዝ ይሁኑልህ።

verses.en: And when they shall blow with them, all the assembly shall assemble themselves to thee at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Quand on en sonnera, toute l''assemblée se réunira auprès de toi, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ሁለቱም መለከቶች በተነፉ ጊዜ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ወደ አንተ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ይሰብሰቡ።

verses.en: And if they blow but with one trumpet, then the princes, which are heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves unto thee.
verses.fr: Si l''on ne sonne que d''une trompette, les princes, les chefs des milliers d''Israël, se réuniront auprès de toi.
verses.am: አንድ መለከት ሲነፋ ታላላቆቹ የእስራኤል አእላፍ አለቆች ወደ አንተ ይሰብሰቡ።

verses.en: When ye blow an alarm, then the camps that lie on the east parts shall go forward.
verses.fr: Quand vous sonnerez avec éclat, ceux qui campent à l''orient partiront;
verses.am: መለከትንም ከፍ ባለ ድምፅ ስትነፉ በምሥራቅ በኩል የሰፈሩት ይጓዙ።

verses.en: When ye blow an alarm the second time, then the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
verses.fr: quand vous sonnerez avec éclat pour la seconde fois, ceux qui campent au midi partiront: on sonnera avec éclat pour leur départ.
verses.am: ሁለተኛውንም ከፍ ባለ ድምፅ ስትነፉ በደቡብ በኩል የሰፈሩት ይጓዙ፤ ለማስጓዝ መለከትን ይነፋሉ።

verses.en: But when the congregation is to be gathered together, ye shall blow, but ye shall not sound an alarm.
verses.fr: Vous sonnerez aussi pour convoquer l''assemblée, mais vous ne sonnerez pas avec éclat.
verses.am: ጉባኤውም በሚሰበሰብበት ጊዜ ንፉ፥ ነገር ግን ድምፁን ከፍ አታድርጉት።

verses.en: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow with the trumpets; and they shall be to you for an ordinance for ever throughout your generations.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Aaron, les sacrificateurs, sonneront des trompettes. Ce sera une loi perpétuelle pour vous et pour vos descendants.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ መለከቶቹን ይንፉ፤ እነርሱም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And if ye go to war in your land against the enemy that oppresseth you, then ye shall blow an alarm with the trumpets; and ye shall be remembered before the Lord your God, and ye shall be saved from your enemies.
verses.fr: Lorsque, dans votre pays, vous irez à la guerre contre l''ennemi qui vous combattra, vous sonnerez des trompettes avec éclat, et vous serez présents au souvenir de l''Eternel, votre Dieu, et vous serez délivrés de vos ennemis.
verses.am: በሚገፋችሁም ጠላት ላይ በምድራችሁ ወደ ሰልፍ ስትወጡ ከፍ ባለ ድምፅ መለከቶቹን ንፉ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም በአምላካችሁ ፊት ትታሰባላችሁ፥ ከጠላቶቻችሁም ትድናላችሁ።

verses.en: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Dans vos jours de joie, dans vos fêtes, et à vos nouvelles lunes, vous sonnerez des trompettes, en offrant vos holocaustes et vos sacrifices d''actions de grâces, et elles vous mettront en souvenir devant votre Dieu. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ደግሞ በደስታችሁ ቀን፥ በበዓላታችሁም ዘመን፥ በወርም መባቻ፥ በሚቃጠል መሥዋዕታችሁና በደኅንነት መሥዋዕታችሁ ላይ መለከቶቹን ንፉ፤ እነርሱም በአምላካችሁ ፊት ለመታሰቢያ ይሆኑላችኋል፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the twentieth day of the second month, in the second year, that the cloud was taken up from off the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.fr: Le vingtième jour du second mois de la seconde année, la nuée s''éleva de dessus le tabernacle du témoignage.
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር ከወሩም በሀያኛው ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ደመናው ከምስክሩ ማደሪያ ላይ ተነሣ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel took their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.fr: Et les enfants d''Israël partirent du désert de Sinaï, selon l''ordre fixé pour leur marche. La nuée s''arrêta dans le désert de Paran.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከሲና ምድረ በዳ በየጕዞአቸው ተጓዙ፤ ደመናውም በፋራን ምድረ በዳ ቆመ።

verses.en: And they first took their journey according to the commandment of the Lord by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Ils firent ce premier départ sur l''ordre de l''Eternel par Moïse.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያም እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ እንዳዘዘ ተጓዙ።

verses.en: In the first place went the standard of the camp of the children of Judah according to their armies: and over his host was Nahshon the son of Amminadab.
verses.fr: La bannière du camp des fils de Juda partit la première, avec ses corps d''armée. Le corps d''armée de Juda était commandé par Nachschon, fils d''Amminadab;
verses.am: በመጀመሪያም የይሁዳ ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የአሚናዳብ ልጅ ነአሶን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Issachar was Nethaneel the son of Zuar.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils d''Issacar, par Nethaneel, fils de Tsuar;
verses.am: በይሳኮርም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የሶገር ልጅ ናትናኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Zebulun was Eliab the son of Helon.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils de Zabulon, par Eliab, fils de Hélon.
verses.am: በዛብሎንም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የኬሎን ልጅ ኤልያብ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set forward, bearing the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Le tabernacle fut démonté; et les fils de Guerschon et les fils de Merari partirent, portant le tabernacle.
verses.am: ማደሪያውም ተነቀለ፤ ማደሪያውንም የተሸከሙ የጌድሶን ልጆችና የሜራሪ ልጆች ተጓዙ።

verses.en: And the standard of the camp of Reuben set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elizur the son of Shedeur.
verses.fr: La bannière du camp de Ruben partit, avec ses corps d''armée. Le corps d''armée de Ruben était commandé par Elitsur, fils de Schedéur;
verses.am: የሮቤልም ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የሰዲዮር ልጅ ኤሊሱር አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Simeon was Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils de Siméon, par Schelumiel, fils de Tsurischaddaï;
verses.am: በስምዖንም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የሱሪሰዳይ ልጅ ሰለሚኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Gad was Eliasaph the son of Deuel.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils de Gad, par Eliasaph, fils de Déuel.
verses.am: በጋድም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የራጉኤል ልጅ ኤሊሳፍ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary: and the other did set up the tabernacle against they came.
verses.fr: Les Kehathites partirent, portant le sanctuaire; et l''on dressait le tabernacle en attendant leur arrivée.
verses.am: ቀዓታውያንም መቅደሱን ተሸክመው ተጓዙ፤ እነዚህም እስኪመጡ ድረስ እነዚያ ማደሪያውን ተከሉ።

verses.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies: and over his host was Elishama the son of Ammihud.
verses.fr: La bannière du camp des fils d''Ephraïm partit, avec ses corps d''armée. Le corps d''armée d''Ephraïm était commandé par Elischama, fils d''Ammihud;
verses.am: የኤፍሬምም ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ኤሊሳማ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Manasseh was Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils de Manassé, par Gamliel, fils de Pedahtsur;
verses.am: በምናሴም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የፍዳሱር ልጅ ገማልኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Benjamin was Abidan the son of Gideoni.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils de Benjamin, par Abidan, fils de Guideoni.
verses.am: በብንያምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የጋዴዮን ልጅ አቢዳን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the standard of the camp of the children of Dan set forward, which was the rereward of all the camps throughout their hosts: and over his host was Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.
verses.fr: La bannière du camp des fils de Dan partit, avec ses corps d''armée: elle formait l''arrière-garde de tous les camps. Le corps d''armée de Dan était commandé par Ahiézer, fils d''Ammischaddaï;
verses.am: ከሰፈሮቹ ሁሉ በኋላ የሆነ የዳን ልጆች ሰፈር ዓላማ በየሠራዊታቸው ተጓዘ፤ በሠራዊቱም ላይ የአሚሳዳይ ልጅ አኪዔዘር አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Asher was Pagiel the son of Ocran.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils d''Aser, par Paguiel, fils d''Ocran;
verses.am: በአሴርም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የኤክራን ልጅ ፋግኤል አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And over the host of the tribe of the children of Naphtali was Ahira the son of Enan.
verses.fr: le corps d''armée de la tribu des fils de Nephthali, par Ahira, fils d''Enan.
verses.am: በንፍታሌምም ልጆች ነገድ ሠራዊት ላይ የዔናን ልጅ አኪሬ አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: Thus were the journeyings of the children of Israel according to their armies, when they set forward.
verses.fr: Tel fut l''ordre d''après lequel les enfants d''Israël se mirent en marche selon leurs corps d''armée; et c''est ainsi qu''ils partirent.
verses.am: እንዲሁ የእስራኤል ልጆች ጕዞ በየሠራዊታቸው ነበረ፤ እነርሱም ተጓዙ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the Lord said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the Lord hath spoken good concerning Israel.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Hobab, fils de Réuel, le Madianite, beau-père de Moïse: Nous partons pour le lieu dont l''Eternel a dit: Je vous le donnerai. Viens avec nous, et nous te ferons du bien, car l''Eternel a promis de faire du bien à Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም የሚስቱን አባት የምድያማዊውን የራጉኤልን ልጅ ኦባብን። እግዚአብሔር። ለእናንተ እሰጠዋለሁ ወዳለው ስፍራ እንሄዳለን፤ እግዚአብሔር ስለ እስራኤል መልካምን ነገር ተናግሮአልና አንተ ከእኛ ጋር ና፥ መልካምን እናደርግልሃለን አለው።

verses.en: And he said unto him, I will not go; but I will depart to mine own land, and to my kindred.
verses.fr: Hobab lui répondit: Je n''irai point; mais j''irai dans mon pays et dans ma patrie.
verses.am: እርሱም። አልሄድም፥ ነገር ግን ወደ አገሬና ወደ ዘመዶቼ እሄዳለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.
verses.fr: Et Moïse dit: Ne nous quitte pas, je te prie; puisque tu connais les lieux où nous campons dans le désert, tu nous serviras de guide.
verses.am: እርሱም። እባክህ፥ በምድረ በዳ የምንሰፍርበትን አንተ ታውቃለህና፥ እንደ ዓይኖቻችንም ትሆንልናለህና አትተወን፤

verses.en: And it shall be, if thou go with us, yea, it shall be, that what goodness the Lord shall do unto us, the same will we do unto thee.
verses.fr: Et si tu viens avec nous, nous te ferons jouir du bien que l''Eternel nous fera.
verses.am: ከእኛም ጋር ብትሄድ እግዚአብሔር ከሚያደርግልን መልካም ነገር ሁሉ እኛ ለአንተ እናደርጋለን አለ።

verses.en: And they departed from the mount of the Lord three days' journey: and the ark of the covenant of the Lord went before them in the three days' journey, to search out a resting place for them.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de la montagne de l''Eternel, et marchèrent trois jours; l''arche de l''alliance de l''Eternel partit devant eux, et fit une marche de trois jours, pour leur chercher un lieu de repos.
verses.am: ከእግዚአብሔርም ተራራ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ያህል ተጓዙ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም የኪዳኑ ታቦት የሚያድርበትን ስፍራ ይፈልግላቸው ዘንድ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ቀደማቸው።

verses.en: And the cloud of the Lord was upon them by day, when they went out of the camp.
verses.fr: La nuée de l''Eternel était au-dessus d''eux pendant le jour, lorsqu''ils partaient du camp.
verses.am: ከሰፈራቸውም በተጓዙ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ደመና ቀን ቀን በላያቸው ነበረ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the ark set forward, that Moses said, Rise up, Lord, and let thine enemies be scattered; and let them that hate thee flee before thee.
verses.fr: Quand l''arche partait, Moïse disait: Lève-toi, Eternel! et que tes ennemis soient dispersés! que ceux qui te haïssent fuient devant ta face!
verses.am: ሙሴም ታቦቱ በተጓዘ ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ተነሣ፥ ጠላቶችህም ይበተኑ፥ የሚጠሉህም ከፊትህ ይሽሹ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: And when it rested, he said, Return, O Lord, unto the many thousands of Israel.
verses.fr: Et quand on la posait, il disait: Reviens, Eternel, aux myriades des milliers d''Israël!
verses.am: ባረፈም ጊዜ። አቤቱ፥ ወደ እስራኤል እልፍ አእላፋት ተመለስ ይል ነበር።

verses.en: And when the people complained, it displeased the Lord: and the Lord heard it; and his anger was kindled; and the fire of the Lord burnt among them, and consumed them that were in the uttermost parts of the camp.
verses.fr: Le peuple murmura et cela déplut aux oreilles de l''Eternel. Lorsque l''Eternel l''entendit, sa colère s''enflamma; le feu de l''Eternel s''alluma parmi eux, et dévora l''extrémité du camp.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ክፉ ሆነው በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አጕረመረሙ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሰምቶ ተቈጣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት በመካከላቸው ነደደች፥ የሰፈሩንም ዳር በላች።

verses.en: And the people cried unto Moses; and when Moses prayed unto the Lord, the fire was quenched.
verses.fr: Le peuple cria à Moïse. Moïse pria l''Eternel, et le feu s''arrêta.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወደ ሙሴ ጮኹ፤ ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸለየ፥ እሳቲቱም ጠፋች።

verses.en: And he called the name of the place Taberah: because the fire of the Lord burnt among them.
verses.fr: On donna à ce lieu le nom de Tabeéra, parce que le feu de l''Eternel s''était allumé parmi eux.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም እሳት በመካከላቸው ስለነደደች የዚያን ስፍራ ስም ተቤራ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: And the mixt multitude that was among them fell a lusting: and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, Who shall give us flesh to eat?
verses.fr: Le ramassis de gens qui se trouvaient au milieu d''Israël fut saisi de convoitise; et même les enfants d''Israël recommencèrent à pleurer et dirent: Qui nous donnera de la viande à manger?
verses.am: በመካከላቸውም የነበሩ ልዩ ልዩ ሕዝብ እጅግ ጐመጁ፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ደግሞ ያለቅሱ ነበር። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ማን ይሰጠናል?

verses.en: We remember the fish, which we did eat in Egypt freely; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlick:
verses.fr: Nous nous souvenons des poissons que nous mangions en Egypte, et qui ne nous coûtaient rien, des concombres, des melons, des poireaux, des oignons et des aulx.
verses.am: በግብፅ ያለ ዋጋ እንበላው የነበረውን ዓሣ፥ ዱባውንም፥ በጢኹንም፥ ኩራቱንም፥ ቀዩንም ሽንኩርት፥ ነጩንም ሽንኩርት እናስባለን፤

verses.en: But now our soul is dried away: there is nothing at all, beside this manna, before our eyes.
verses.fr: Maintenant, notre âme est desséchée: plus rien! Nos yeux ne voient que de la manne.
verses.am: አሁን ግን ሰውነታችን ደረቀች፤ ዓይናችንም ከዚህ መና በቀር ምንም አታይም አሉ።

verses.en: And the manna was as coriander seed, and the colour thereof as the colour of bdellium.
verses.fr: La manne ressemblait à de la graine de coriandre, et avait l''apparence du bdellium.
verses.am: መናውም እንደ ድንብላል ዘር ነበረ፥ መልኩም ሙጫ ይመስል ነበር።

verses.en: And the people went about, and gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in a mortar, and baked it in pans, and made cakes of it: and the taste of it was as the taste of fresh oil.
verses.fr: Le peuple se dispersait pour la ramasser; il la broyait avec des meules, ou la pilait dans un mortier; il la cuisait au pot, et en faisait des gâteaux. Elle avait le goût d''un gâteau à l''huile.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም እየዞሩ ይለቅሙ ነበር፥ በወፍጮም ይፈጩት፥ ወይም በሙቀጫ ይወቅጡት፥ በምንቸትም ይቀቅሉት ነበር፥ እንጐቻም ያደርጉት ነበር፤ ጣዕሙም በዘይት እንደ ተለወሰ እንጐቻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And when the dew fell upon the camp in the night, the manna fell upon it.
verses.fr: Quand la rosée descendait la nuit sur le camp, la manne y descendait aussi.
verses.am: ሌሊትም ጠል በሰፈሩ ላይ በወረደ ጊዜ መናው በላዩ ይወርድ ነበር።

verses.en: Then Moses heard the people weep throughout their families, every man in the door of his tent: and the anger of the Lord was kindled greatly; Moses also was displeased.
verses.fr: Moïse entendit le peuple qui pleurait, chacun dans sa famille et à l''entrée de sa tente. La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma fortement. Moïse fut attristé,
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡ በወገኖቻቸው፥ ሰው ሁሉ በድንኳኑ ደጃፍ፥ ሲያለቅሱ ሰማ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ እጅግ ነደደ፤ ሙሴም ተቈጣ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, Wherefore hast thou afflicted thy servant? and wherefore have I not found favour in thy sight, that thou layest the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.fr: et il dit à l''Eternel: Pourquoi affliges-tu ton serviteur, et pourquoi n''ai-je pas trouvé grâce à tes yeux, que tu aies mis sur moi la charge de tout ce peuple?
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ለምን በባሪያህ ላይ ክፉ አደረግህ? ለምንስ በፊትህ ሞገስ አላገኘሁም? ለምንስ የዚህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ ሸክም በእኔ ላይ አደረግህ?

verses.en: Have I conceived all this people? have I begotten them, that thou shouldest say unto me, Carry them in thy bosom, as a nursing father beareth the sucking child, unto the land which thou swarest unto their fathers?
verses.fr: Est-ce moi qui ai conçu ce peuple? est-ce moi qui l''ai enfanté, pour que tu me dises: Porte-le sur ton sein, comme le nourricier porte un enfant, jusqu''au pays que tu as juré à ses pères de lui donner?
verses.am: አንተ ለአባቶቻቸው ወደ ማልህላቸው ምድር አደርሳቸው ዘንድ። ሞግዚት የሚጠባውን ልጅ እንድታቀፍ በብብትህ እቀፋቸው የምትለኝ፥ በውኑ ይህን ሕዝብ ሁሉ እኔ ፀነስሁትን? ወለድሁትንስ?

verses.en: Whence should I have flesh to give unto all this people? for they weep unto me, saying, Give us flesh, that we may eat.
verses.fr: Où prendrai-je de la viande pour donner à tout ce peuple? Car ils pleurent auprès de moi, en disant: Donne-nous de la viande à manger!
verses.am: በፊቴ ያለቅሳሉና። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ስጠን ይላሉና ለዚህ ሕዝብ ሁሉ የምሰጠው ሥጋ ከወዴት እወስዳለሁ?

verses.en: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.fr: Je ne puis pas, à moi seul, porter tout ce peuple, car il est trop pesant pour moi.
verses.am: እጅግ ከብዶኛልና ይህን ሁሉ ሕዝብ ልሸከም አልችልም።

verses.en: And if thou deal thus with me, kill me, I pray thee, out of hand, if I have found favour in thy sight; and let me not see my wretchedness.
verses.fr: Plutôt que de me traiter ainsi, tue-moi, je te prie, si j''ai trouvé grâce à tes yeux, et que je ne voie pas mon malheur.
verses.am: እንዲህስ ከምታደርግብኝ፥ በፊትህ ሞገስ አግኝቼ እንደ ሆነ፥ በእኔ ላይ የሚሆነውን መከራ እንዳላይ፥ እባክህ፥ ፈጽሞ ግደለኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Gather unto me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom thou knowest to be the elders of the people, and officers over them; and bring them unto the tabernacle of the congregation, that they may stand there with thee.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Assemble auprès de moi soixante-dix hommes des anciens d''Israël, de ceux que tu connais comme anciens du peuple et ayant autorité sur lui; amène-les à la tente d''assignation, et qu''ils s''y présentent avec toi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች፥ በሕዝቡ ላይ ሽማግሌዎችና አለቆች ይሆኑ ዘንድ የምታውቃቸውን፥ ሰባ ሰዎች ሰብስብልኝ፥ ወደ መገናኛውም ድንኳን አምጣቸው፥ በዚያም ከአንተ ጋር አቁማቸው።

verses.en: And I will come down and talk with thee there: and I will take of the spirit which is upon thee, and will put it upon them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with thee, that thou bear it not thyself alone.
verses.fr: Je descendrai, et là je te parlerai; je prendrai de l''esprit qui est sur toi, et je le mettrai sur eux, afin qu''ils portent avec toi la charge du peuple, et que tu ne la portes pas à toi seul.
verses.am: እኔም እወርዳለሁ፥ በዚያም እነጋገርሃለሁ፥ በአንተ ካለውም መንፈስ ወስጄ በእነርሱ ላይ አደርገዋለሁ፤ አንተም ብቻ እንዳትሸከም የሕዝቡን ሸክም ከአንተ ጋር ይሸከማሉ።

verses.en: And say thou unto the people, Sanctify yourselves against to morrow, and ye shall eat flesh: for ye have wept in the ears of the Lord, saying, Who shall give us flesh to eat? for it was well with us in Egypt: therefore the Lord will give you flesh, and ye shall eat.
verses.fr: Tu diras au peuple: Sanctifiez-vous pour demain, et vous mangerez de la viande, puisque vous avez pleuré aux oreilles de l''Eternel, en disant: Qui nous fera manger de la viande? car nous étions bien en Egypte. L''Eternel vous donnera de la viande, et vous en mangerez.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም በላቸው። የምንበላውን ሥጋ ማን ይሰጠናል? በግብፅ ደኅና ነበረልን እያላችሁ ያለቀሳችሁት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጆሮ ደርሶአልና ለነገ ተቀደሱ፥ ሥጋንም ትበላላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሥጋን ይሰጣችኋል፥ ትበሉማላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall not eat one day, nor two days, nor five days, neither ten days, nor twenty days;
verses.fr: Vous en mangerez non pas un jour, ni deux jours, ni cinq jours, ni dix jours, ni vingt jours,
verses.am: አንድ ቀን ወይም ሁለት ቀን ወይም አምስት ቀን ወይም አሥር ቀን ወይም ሀያ ቀን አትበሉም፤

verses.en: But even a whole month, until it come out at your nostrils, and it be loathsome unto you: because that ye have despised the Lord which is among you, and have wept before him, saying, Why came we forth out of Egypt?
verses.fr: mais un mois entier, jusqu''à ce qu''elle vous sorte par les narines et que vous en ayez du dégoût, parce que vous avez rejeté l''Eternel qui est au milieu de vous, et parce que vous avez pleuré devant lui, en disant: Pourquoi donc sommes-nous sortis d''Egypte?
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመካከላችሁ ያለውን እግዚአብሔርን ንቃችኋልና፥ በፊቱም። ለምን ከግብፅ ወጣን? ብላችሁ አልቅሳችኋልና በአፍንጫችሁ እስኪወጣ እስኪሰለቻችሁም ድረስ ወር ሙሉ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And Moses said, The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand footmen; and thou hast said, I will give them flesh, that they may eat a whole month.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Six cent mille hommes de pied forment le peuple au milieu duquel je suis, et tu dis: Je leur donnerai de la viande, et ils en mangeront un mois entier!
verses.am: ሙሴም። እኔ በመካከላቸው ያለሁ ሕዝብ ስድስት መቶ ሺህ እግረኛ ናቸው፤ አንተም። ወር ሙሉ የሚበሉትን ሥጋ እኔ እሰጣቸዋለሁ አልህ።

verses.en: Shall the flocks and the herds be slain for them, to suffice them? or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to suffice them?
verses.fr: Egorgera-t-on pour eux des brebis et des boeufs, en sorte qu''ils en aient assez? ou rassemblera-t-on pour eux tous les poissons de la mer, en sorte qu''ils en aient assez?
verses.am: እነርሱን የሚያጠግብ የበሬና የበግ መንጋ ይታረድን? ወይስ የባሕርን ዓሣ ሁሉ ያጠግባቸው ዘንድ ይሰበሰብላቸዋልን? አለ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Is the Lord'S hand waxed short? thou shalt see now whether my word shall come to pass unto thee or not.
verses.fr: L''Eternel répondit à Moïse: La main de l''Eternel serait-elle trop courte? Tu verras maintenant si ce que je t''ai dit arrivera ou non.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። በውኑ የእግዚአብሔር እጅ አጭር ሆነ? አሁን ቃሌ ይፈጸም ወይስ አይፈጸም እንደ ሆነ አንተ ታያለህ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses went out, and told the people the words of the Lord, and gathered the seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them round about the tabernacle.
verses.fr: Moïse sortit, et rapporta au peuple les paroles de l''Eternel. Il assembla soixante-dix hommes des anciens du peuple, et les plaça autour de la tente.
verses.am: ሙሴም ወጣ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቃሎች ለሕዝቡ ነገረ፤ ከሕዝቡ ሽማግሌዎችም ሰባውን ሰዎች ሰብስቦ በድንኳኑ ዙሪያ አቆማቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord came down in a cloud, and spake unto him, and took of the spirit that was upon him, and gave it unto the seventy elders: and it came to pass, that, when the spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, and did not cease.
verses.fr: L''Eternel descendit dans la nuée, et parla à Moïse; il prit de l''esprit qui était sur lui, et le mit sur les soixante-dix anciens. Et dès que l''esprit reposa sur eux, ils prophétisèrent; mais ils ne continuèrent pas.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በደመናው ወረደ፥ ተናገረውም፥ በእርሱም ላይ ከነበረው መንፈስ ወስዶ በሰባው ሽማግሌዎች ላይ አደረገ፤ መንፈሱም በላያቸው ባደረ ጊዜ ትንቢት ተናገሩ፤ ከዚያ በኋል ግን አልተናገሩም።

verses.en: But there remained two of the men in the camp, the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad: and the spirit rested upon them; and they were of them that were written, but went not out unto the tabernacle: and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.fr: Il y eut deux hommes, l''un appelé Eldad, et l''autre Médad, qui étaient restés dans le camp, et sur lesquels l''esprit reposa; car ils étaient parmi les inscrits, quoiqu''ils ne fussent point allés à la tente; et ils prophétisèrent dans le camp.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም ሁለት ሰዎች በሰፈር ቀርተው ነበር፥ የአንዱም ስም ኤልዳድ የሁለተኛውም ሞዳድ ነበረ፤ መንፈስም ወረደባቸው፤ እነርሱም ከተጻፉት ጋር ነበሩ ወደ ድንኳኑ ግን አልወጡም ነበር፤ በሰፈሩም ውስጥ ሳሉ ትንቢት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
verses.fr: Un jeune garçon courut l''annoncer à Moïse, et dit: Eldad et Médad prophétisent dans le camp.
verses.am: አንድ ጐበዝ ሰው እየሮጠ መጥቶ። ኤልዳድና ሞዳድ በሰፈር ትንቢት ይናገራሉ ብሎ ለሙሴ ነገረው።

verses.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his young men, answered and said, My lord Moses, forbid them.
verses.fr: Et Josué, fils de Nun, serviteur de Moïse depuis sa jeunesse, prit la parole et dit: Moïse, mon seigneur, empêche-les!
verses.am: ከልጅነቱ ጀምሮ የሙሴ አገልጋይ የነበረው የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ። ጌታዬ ሙሴ ሆይ፥ ከልክላቸው አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto him, Enviest thou for my sake? would God that all the Lord'S people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit upon them!
verses.fr: Moïse lui répondit: Es-tu jaloux pour moi? Puisse tout le peuple de l''Eternel être composé de prophètes; et veuille l''Eternel mettre son esprit sur eux!
verses.am: ሙሴም። የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ሁሉ ነቢያት ቢሆኑ፥ እግዚአብሔርም በእነርሱ ላይ መንፈሱን ቢያወርድ፤ አንተ ስለእኔ ትቀናለህን? አለው።

verses.en: And Moses gat him into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.fr: Et Moïse se retira au camp, lui et les anciens d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከእስራኤል ሽማግሌዎች ጋር ወደ ሰፈር ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And there went forth a wind from the Lord, and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, as it were a day's journey on this side, and as it were a day's journey on the other side, round about the camp, and as it were two cubits high upon the face of the earth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel fit souffler de la mer un vent, qui amena des cailles, et les répandit sur le camp, environ une journée de chemin d''un côté et environ une journée de chemin de l''autre côté, autour du camp. Il y en avait près de deux coudées au-dessus de la surface de la terre.
verses.am: ነፋስም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፥ ከባሕርም ድርጭቶችን አመጣ፥ የአንድ ቀንም መንገድ ያህል በዚህ፥ የአንድ ቀንም መንገድ ያህል በዚያ በሰፈሩ ላይ በተናቸው፤ በዚያም በሰፈሩ ዙሪያ ከፍታው ከምድር ወደ ላይ ሁለት ክንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the people stood up all that day, and all that night, and all the next day, and they gathered the quails: he that gathered least gathered ten homers: and they spread them all abroad for themselves round about the camp.
verses.fr: Pendant tout ce jour et toute la nuit, et pendant toute la journée du lendemain, le peuple se leva et ramassa les cailles; celui qui en avait ramassé le moins en avait dix homers. Ils les étendirent pour eux autour du camp.
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን ሁሉ በሌሊትም ሁሉ በነጋውም ሁሉ ሕዝቡ ተነሥተው ድርጭትን ሰበሰቡ፤ ከሁሉ ጥቂት የሰበሰበ አሥር የቆሮስ መስፈሪያ የሚያህል ሰበሰበ፤ በሰፈሩም ዙሪያ ሁሉ አሰጡት።

verses.en: And while the flesh was yet between their teeth, ere it was chewed, the wrath of the Lord was kindled against the people, and the Lord smote the people with a very great plague.
verses.fr: Comme la chair était encore entre leurs dents sans être mâchée, la colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre le peuple, et l''Eternel frappa le peuple d''une très grande plaie.
verses.am: ሥጋውም ገና በጥርሳቸው መካከል ሳለ ሳያኝኩትም፥ የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ ነደደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቡን በታላቅ መቅሠፍት እጅግ መታ።

verses.en: And he called the name of that place Kibrothhattaavah: because there they buried the people that lusted.
verses.fr: On donna à ce lieu le nom de Kibroth-Hattaava, parce qu''on y enterra le peuple que la convoitise avait saisi.
verses.am: የጐመጁ ሕዝብ በዚያ ተቀብረዋልና የዚያ ስፍራ ስም የምኞት መቃብር ተብሎ ተጠራ።

verses.en: And the people journeyed from Kibrothhattaavah unto Hazeroth; and abode at Hazeroth.
verses.fr: De Kibroth-Hattaava le peuple partit pour Hatséroth, et il s''arrêta à Hatséroth.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ከምኞት መቃብር ወደ ሐጼሮት ተጓዙ በሐጼሮትም ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And Miriam and Aaron spake against Moses because of the Ethiopian woman whom he had married: for he had married an Ethiopian woman.
verses.fr: Marie et Aaron parlèrent contre Moïse au sujet de la femme éthiopienne qu''il avait prise, car il avait pris une femme éthiopienne.
verses.am: ሙሴም ኢትዮጵያይቱን አግብቶአልና ባገባት በኢትዮጵያይቱ ምክንያት ማርያምና አሮን በእርሱ ላይ ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And they said, Hath the Lord indeed spoken only by Moses? hath he not spoken also by us? And the Lord heard it.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: Est-ce seulement par Moïse que l''Eternel parle? N''est-ce pas aussi par nous qu''il parle? Et l''Eternel l''entendit.
verses.am: እነርሱም። በውኑ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ ብቻ ተናግሮአልን? በእኛስ ደግሞ የተናገረ አይደለምን? አሉ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሰማ።

verses.en: (Now the man Moses was very meek, above all the men which were upon the face of the earth.)
verses.fr: Or, Moïse était un homme fort patient, plus qu''aucun homme sur la face de la terre.
verses.am: ሙሴም በምድር ላይ ካሉት ሰዎች ሁሉ ይልቅ እጅግ ትሑት ሰው ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake suddenly unto Moses, and unto Aaron, and unto Miriam, Come out ye three unto the tabernacle of the congregation. And they three came out.
verses.fr: Soudain l''Eternel dit à Moïse, à Aaron et à Marie: Allez, vous trois, à la tente d''assignation. Et ils y allèrent tous les trois.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ወዲያው ሙሴንና አሮንን ማርያምንም። ሦስታችሁ ወደ መገኛኛው ድንኳን ውጡ ብሎ ተናገረ፤ ሦስቱም ወጡ።

verses.en: And the Lord came down in the pillar of the cloud, and stood in the door of the tabernacle, and called Aaron and Miriam: and they both came forth.
verses.fr: L''Eternel descendit dans la colonne de nuée, et il se tint à l''entrée de la tente. Il appela Aaron et Marie, qui s''avancèrent tous les deux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በደመና ዓምድ ወረደ፥ በድንኳኑም ደጃፍ ቆመ፤ አሮንንና ማርያምን ጠራ፥ ሁለቱም ወጡ።

verses.en: And he said, Hear now my words: If there be a prophet among you, I the Lord will make myself known unto him in a vision, and will speak unto him in a dream.
verses.fr: Et il dit: Ecoutez bien mes paroles! Lorsqu''il y aura parmi vous un prophète, c''est dans une vision que moi, l''Eternel, je me révélerai à lui, c''est dans un songe que je lui parlerai.
verses.am: እርሱም። ቃሌን ስሙ፤ በመካከላችሁ ነቢይ ቢኖር፥ እኔ እግዚአብሔር በራእይ እገለጥለታለሁ፥ ወይም በሕልም እናገረዋለሁ።

verses.en: My servant Moses is not so, who is faithful in all mine house.
verses.fr: Il n''en est pas ainsi de mon serviteur Moïse. Il est fidèle dans toute ma maison.
verses.am: ባሪያዬ ሙሴ ግን እንዲህ አይደለም፤ እርሱ በቤቴ ሁሉ የታመነ ነው።

verses.en: With him will I speak mouth to mouth, even apparently, and not in dark speeches; and the similitude of the Lord shall he behold: wherefore then were ye not afraid to speak against my servant Moses?
verses.fr: Je lui parle bouche à bouche, je me révèle à lui sans énigmes, et il voit une représentation de l''Eternel. Pourquoi donc n''avez-vous pas craint de parler contre mon serviteur, contre Moïse?
verses.am: እኔ አፍ ለአፍ በግልጥ እናገረዋለሁ፥ በምሳሌ አይደለም፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም መልክ ያያል፤ በባሪያዬ በሙሴ ላይ ትናገሩ ዘንድ ስለ ምን አልፈራችሁም? አለ።

verses.en: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against them; and he departed.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre eux. Et il s''en alla.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ተቈጥቶባቸው ሄደ።

verses.en: And the cloud departed from off the tabernacle; and, behold, Miriam became leprous, white as snow: and Aaron looked upon Miriam, and, behold, she was leprous.
verses.fr: La nuée se retira de dessus la tente. Et voici, Marie était frappée d''une lèpre, blanche comme la neige. Aaron se tourna vers Marie; et voici, elle avait la lèpre.
verses.am: ደመናውም ከድንኳኑ ተነሣ፤ እነሆም፥ ማርያም ለምጻም ሆነች፥ እንደ አመዳይም ነጭ ሆነች፤ አሮንም ማርያምን ተመለከተ፥ እነሆም፥ ለምጻም ሆና ነበር።

verses.en: And Aaron said unto Moses, Alas, my lord, I beseech thee, lay not the sin upon us, wherein we have done foolishly, and wherein we have sinned.
verses.fr: Alors Aaron dit à Moïse: De grâce, mon seigneur, ne nous fais pas porter la peine du péché que nous avons commis en insensés, et dont nous nous sommes rendus coupables!
verses.am: አሮንም ሙሴን። ጌታዬ ሆይ፥ ስንፍና አድርገናልና፥ በድለንማልና እባክህ፥ ኃጢአት አታድርግብን።

verses.en: Let her not be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he cometh out of his mother's womb.
verses.fr: Oh! qu''elle ne soit pas comme l''enfant mort-né, dont la chair est à moitié consumée quand il sort du sein de sa mère!
verses.am: ከእናቱ ሆድ በወጣ ጊዜ ግማሽ ሥጋው ተበልቶ እንደ ሞተ እርስዋ አትሁን።

verses.en: And Moses cried unto the Lord, saying, Heal her now, O God, I beseech thee.
verses.fr: Moïse cria à l''Eternel, en disant: O Dieu, je te prie, guéris-la!
verses.am: ሙሴም ወደ እግዚአብሔር እየጮኸ። አቤቱ፥ እባክህ፥ አድናት አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, If her father had but spit in her face, should she not be ashamed seven days? let her be shut out from the camp seven days, and after that let her be received in again.
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Si son père lui avait craché au visage, ne serait-elle pas pendant sept jours un objet de honte? Qu''elle soit enfermée sept jours en dehors du camp; après quoi, elle y sera reçue.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። አባትዋ ምራቁን በፊትዋ ቢተፋባት ስንኳ ሰባት ቀን ታፍር ዘንድ ይገባት ነበር፤ ሰባት ቀን ከሰፈር ውጭ ተዘግታ ትቀመጥ፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ትመለስ አለው።

verses.en: And Miriam was shut out from the camp seven days: and the people journeyed not till Miriam was brought in again.
verses.fr: Marie fut enfermée sept jours en dehors du camp; et le peuple ne partit point, jusqu''à ce que Marie y fût rentrée.
verses.am: ማርያምም ከሰፈር ውጭ ሰባት ቀን ተዘግታ ተቀመጠች፤ ማርያምም እስክትመለስ ድረስ ሕዝቡ አልተጓዙም።

verses.en: And afterward the people removed from Hazeroth, and pitched in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.fr: Après cela, le peuple partit de Hatséroth, et il campa dans le désert de Paran.
verses.am: ከዚያም በኋላ ሕዝቡ ከሐጼሮት ተጓዙ፥ በፋራንም ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Send thou men, that they may search the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel: of every tribe of their fathers shall ye send a man, every one a ruler among them.
verses.fr: Envoie des hommes pour explorer le pays de Canaan, que je donne aux enfants d''Israël. Tu enverras un homme de chacune des tribus de leurs pères; tous seront des principaux d''entre eux.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች የምሰጣትን የከንዓንን ምድር ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሰዎችን ላክ፤ ከአባቶች ነገድ ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ በመካከላቸው አለቃ የሆነ አንድ ሰው ትልካላችሁ።

verses.en: And Moses by the commandment of the Lord sent them from the wilderness of Paran: all those men were heads of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Moïse les envoya du désert de Paran, d''après l''ordre de l''Eternel; tous ces hommes étaient chefs des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደ እግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ከፋራን ምድረ በዳ ላካቸው፤ እነርሱም ሁሉ የእስራኤል ልጆች አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And these were their names: of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.
verses.fr: Voici leurs noms. Pour la tribu de Ruben: Schammua, fils de Zaccur;
verses.am: ስማቸውም ይህ ነበረ፤ ከሮቤል ነገድ የዘኩር ልጅ ሰሙኤል፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Siméon: Schaphath, fils de Hori;
verses.am: ከስምዖን ነገድ የሱሬ ልጅ ሰፈጥ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Juda: Caleb, fils de Jephunné;
verses.am: ከይሁዳ ነገድ የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.
verses.fr: pour la tribu d''Issacar: Jigual, fils de Joseph;
verses.am: ከይሳኮር ነገድ የዮሴፍ ልጅ ይግአል፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Oshea the son of Nun.
verses.fr: pour la tribu d''Ephraïm: Hosée, fils de Nun;
verses.am: ከኤፍሬም ነገድ የነዌ ልጅ አውሴ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Benjamin: Palthi, fils de Raphu;
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ነገድ እርሱም የምናሴ ነገድ የሱሲ ልጅ ጋዲ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Zabulon: Gaddiel, fils de Sodi;
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ነገድ እርሱም የምናሴ ነገድ የሱሲ ልጅ ጋዲ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Joseph, namely, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.
