verses.fr: pour la tribu de Joseph, la tribu de Manassé: Gaddi, fils de Susi;
verses.am: ከዳን ነገድ የገማሊ ልጅ ዓሚኤል፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Dan: Ammiel, fils de Guemalli;
verses.am: ከአሴር ነገድ የሚካኤል ልጅ ሰቱር፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.
verses.fr: pour la tribu d''Aser: Sethur, fils de Micaël;
verses.am: ከንፍታሌም ነገድ የያቢ ልጅ ናቢ፤

verses.en: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Nephthali: Nachbi, fils de Vophsi;
verses.am: ከጋድ ነገድ የማኪ ልጅ ጉዲኤል።

verses.en: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Gad: Guéuel, fils de Maki.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ሙሴ የላካቸው ሰዎች ስም ይህ ነው። ሙሴም የነዌን ልጅ አውሴን ኢያሱ ብሎ ጠራው።

verses.en: These are the names of the men which Moses sent to spy out the land. And Moses called Oshea the son of Nun Jehoshua.
verses.fr: Tels sont les noms des hommes que Moïse envoya pour explorer le pays. Moïse donna à Hosée, fils de Nun, le nom de Josué.
verses.am: ሙሴም የከነዓንን ምድር ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ላካቸው፥ አላቸውም። ከዚህ በደቡብ በኩል ውጡ፥ ወደ ተራሮችም ሂዱ፤

verses.en: And Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said unto them, Get you up this way southward, and go up into the mountain:
verses.fr: Moïse les envoya pour explorer le pays de Canaan. Il leur dit: Montez ici, par le midi; et vous monterez sur la montagne.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም እንዴት እንደ ሆነች፥ በእርስዋም የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ብርቱዎች ወይም ደካሞች፥

verses.en: And see the land, what it is, and the people that dwelleth therein, whether they be strong or weak, few or many;
verses.fr: Vous verrez le pays, ce qu''il est, et le peuple qui l''habite, s''il est fort ou faible, s''il est en petit ou en grand nombre;
verses.am: ጥቂቶች ወይም ብዙዎች እንደ ሆኑ፥ የሚኖሩባትም ምድር መልካም ወይም ክፉ፥ የሚኖሩባቸውም ከተሞች ሰፈሮች ወይም አምቦች እንደ ሆኑ፥

verses.en: And what the land is that they dwell in, whether it be good or bad; and what cities they be that they dwell in, whether in tents, or in strong holds;
verses.fr: ce qu''est le pays où il habite, s''il est bon ou mauvais; ce que sont les villes où il habite, si elles sont ouvertes ou fortifiées;
verses.am: ምድሪቱም ወፍራም ወይም ስስ ዛፍ ያለባት ወይም የሌለባት እንደ ሆነች እዩ፤ ከምድሪቱ ፍሬ አምጡ፤ አይዞአችሁ። በዚያን ጊዜም ወይኑ አስቀድሞ ፍሬ የሚያፈራበት ወራት ነበረ።

verses.en: And what the land is, whether it be fat or lean, whether there be wood therein, or not. And be ye of good courage, and bring of the fruit of the land. Now the time was the time of the firstripe grapes.
verses.fr: ce qu''est le terrain, s''il est gras ou maigre, s''il y a des arbres ou s''il n''y en a point. Ayez bon courage, et prenez des fruits du pays. C''était le temps des premiers raisins.
verses.am: ወጡም ምድሪቱንም ከጺን ምድረ በዳ በሐማት ዳር እስካለችው እስከ ረአብ ድረስ ሰለሉ።

verses.en: So they went up, and searched the land from the wilderness of Zin unto Rehob, as men come to Hamath.
verses.fr: Ils montèrent, et ils explorèrent le pays, depuis le désert de Tsin jusqu''à Rehob, sur le chemin de Hamath.
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል ውጡ፥ ወደ ኬብሮንም ደረሱ፤ በዚያም የዔናቅ ልጆች አኪመን፥ ሴሲ፥ ተላሚ ነበሩ። ኬብሮንም በግብፅ ካለችው ከጣኔዎስ በፊት ሰባት ዓመት ተሠርታ ነበር።

verses.en: And they ascended by the south, and came unto Hebron; where Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)
verses.fr: Ils montèrent, par le midi, et ils allèrent jusqu''à Hébron, où étaient Ahiman, Schéschaï et Talmaï, enfants d''Anak. Hébron avait été bâtie sept ans avant Tsoan en Egypte.
verses.am: ወደ ኤሽኮልም ሸለቆ መጡ፥ ከዚያም ከወይኑ አንድ ዘለላ የነበረበትን አረግ ቈረጡ፥ ሁለቱም ሰዎች በመሎጊያ ተሸከሙት፤ ደግሞም ከሮማኑ ከበለሱም አመጡ።

verses.en: And they came unto the brook of Eshcol, and cut down from thence a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bare it between two upon a staff; and they brought of the pomegranates, and of the figs.
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent jusqu''à la vallée d''Eschcol, où ils coupèrent une branche de vigne avec une grappe de raisin, qu''ils portèrent à deux au moyen d''une perche; ils prirent aussi des grenades et des figues.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከዚያ ስለ ቈረጡት ዘለላ የዚያን ስፍራ ስም የኤሽኮል ሸለቆ ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.en: The place was called the brook Eshcol, because of the cluster of grapes which the children of Israel cut down from thence.
verses.fr: On donna à ce lieu le nom de vallée d''Eschcol, à cause de la grappe que les enfants d''Israël y coupèrent.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ሰልለው ከአርባ ቀን በኋላ ተመለሱ።

verses.en: And they returned from searching of the land after forty days.
verses.fr: Ils furent de retour de l''exploration du pays au bout de quarante jours.
verses.am: በፋራን ምድረ በዳና በቃዴስ ወዳሉት ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ወደ እስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ሄደው ደረሱ፤ ወሬውንም ለእነርሱና ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ነገሩአቸው፥ የምድሪቱንም ፍሬ አሳዩአቸው።

verses.en: And they went and came to Moses, and to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word unto them, and unto all the congregation, and shewed them the fruit of the land.
verses.fr: A leur arrivée, ils se rendirent auprès de Moïse et d''Aaron, et de toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, à Kadès dans le désert de Paran. Ils leur firent un rapport, ainsi qu''à toute l''assemblée, et ils leur montrèrent les fruits du pays.
verses.am: እንዲህም ብለው ነገሩት። ወደ ላክኸን ምድር ደረስን፥ እርስዋም ወተትና ማር ታፈስሳለች፥ ፍሬዋም ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And they told him, and said, We came unto the land whither thou sentest us, and surely it floweth with milk and honey; and this is the fruit of it.
verses.fr: Voici ce qu''ils racontèrent à Moïse: Nous sommes allés dans le pays où tu nous as envoyés. A la vérité, c''est un pays où coulent le lait et le miel, et en voici les fruits.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በምድሪቱ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ኃያላን ናቸው። ከተሞቻቸውም የተመሸጉ እጅግም የጸኑ ናቸው፤ ደግሞም በዚያ የዔናቅን ልጆች አየን።

verses.en: Nevertheless the people be strong that dwell in the land, and the cities are walled, and very great: and moreover we saw the children of Anak there.
verses.fr: Mais le peuple qui habite ce pays est puissant, les villes sont fortifiées, très grandes; nous y avons vu des enfants d''Anak.
verses.am: በደቡብም ምድር አማሌቅ ተቀምጦአል፤ በተራሮቹም ኬጢያዊና ኢያቡሳዊ አሞራዊም ተቀምጠዋል፤ ከነዓናዊም በባሕር ዳርና በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ ተቀምጦአል።

verses.en: The Amalekites dwell in the land of the south: and the Hittites, and the Jebusites, and the Amorites, dwell in the mountains: and the Canaanites dwell by the sea, and by the coast of Jordan.
verses.fr: Les Amalécites habitent la contrée du midi; les Héthiens, les Jébusiens et les Amoréens habitent la montagne; et les Cananéens habitent près de la mer et le long du Jourdain.
verses.am: ካሌብም ሕዝቡን በሙሴ ፊት ዝም አሰኘና። ማሸነፍ እንችላለንንና እንውጣ፥ እንውረሰው አለ።

verses.en: And Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, Let us go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it.
verses.fr: Caleb fit taire le peuple, qui murmurait contre Moïse. Il dit: Montons, emparons-nous du pays, nous y serons vainqueurs!
verses.am: ከእርሱ ጋር የወጡ ሰዎች ግን። በኃይል ከእኛ ይበረታሉና በዚህ ሕዝብ ላይ መውጣት አንችልም አሉ።

verses.en: But the men that went up with him said, We be not able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.
verses.fr: Mais les hommes qui y étaient allés avec lui dirent: Nous ne pouvons pas monter contre ce peuple, car il est plus fort que nous.
verses.am: ስለ ሰለሉአትም ምድር ክፉ ወሬ ለእስራኤል ልጆች እያወሩ። እኛ ዞረን የሰለልናት ምድር የሚኖሩባትን ሰዎች የምትበላ ምድር ናት፤ በእርስዋም ዘንድ ያየናቸው ሰዎች ሁሉ ረጃጅም ሰዎች ናቸው።

verses.en: And they brought up an evil report of the land which they had searched unto the children of Israel, saying, The land, through which we have gone to search it, is a land that eateth up the inhabitants thereof; and all the people that we saw in it are men of a great stature.
verses.fr: Et ils décrièrent devant les enfants d''Israël le pays qu''ils avaient exploré. Ils dirent: Le pays que nous avons parcouru, pour l''explorer, est un pays qui dévore ses habitants; tous ceux que nous y avons vus sont des hommes d''une haute taille;
verses.am: በዚያም ከኔፊሊም ወገን የሆኑትን ኔፊሊም፥ የዔናቅን ልጆች፥ አየን፤ እኛም በዓይናችን ግምት እንደ አንበጣዎች ነበርን፥ ደግሞም እኛ በዓይናቸው ዘንድ እንዲሁ ነበርን አሉ።

verses.en: And there we saw the giants, the sons of Anak, which come of the giants: and we were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.
verses.fr: et nous y avons vu les géants, enfants d''Anak, de la race des géants: nous étions à nos yeux et aux leurs comme des sauterelles.
verses.am: ፤ በዚያም ከኔፊሊም ወገን የሆኑትን ኔፊሊም፥ የዔናቅን ልጆች፥ አየን፤ እኛም በዓይናችን ግምት እንደ አንበጣዎች ነበርን፥ ደግሞም እኛ በዓይናቸው ዘንድ እንዲሁ ነበርን አሉ።

verses.en: And all the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée éleva la voix et poussa des cris, et le peuple pleura pendant la nuit.
verses.am: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ድምፃቸውን አንሥተው ጮኹ፤ ሕዝቡም በዚያ ሌሊት አለቀሱ።

verses.en: And all the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron: and the whole congregation said unto them, Would God that we had died in the land of Egypt! or would God we had died in this wilderness!
verses.fr: Tous les enfants d''Israël murmurèrent contre Moïse et Aaron, et toute l''assemblée leur dit: Que ne sommes-nous morts dans le pays d''Egypte, ou que ne sommes-nous morts dans ce désert!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አጕረመረሙ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ። በግብፅ ምድር ሳለን ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ! ወይም በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ!

verses.en: And wherefore hath the Lord brought us unto this land, to fall by the sword, that our wives and our children should be a prey? were it not better for us to return into Egypt?
verses.fr: Pourquoi l''Eternel nous fait-il aller dans ce pays, où nous tomberons par l''épée, où nos femmes et nos petits enfants deviendront une proie? Ne vaut-il pas mieux pour nous retourner en Egypte?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሰይፍ እንሞት ዘንድ ወደዚች ምድር ለምን ያገባናል? ሴቶቻችንና ልጆቻችን ምርኮ ይሆናሉ፤ ወደ ግብፅ መመለስ አይሻለንምን? አሉአቸው።

verses.en: And they said one to another, Let us make a captain, and let us return into Egypt.
verses.fr: Et ils se dirent l''un à l''autre: Nommons un chef, et retournons en Egypte.
verses.am: እርስ በርሳቸውም። ኑ፥ አለቃ ሾመን ወደ ግብፅ እንመለስ ተባባሉ።

verses.en: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron tombèrent sur leur visage, en présence de toute l''assemblée réunie des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም በእስራኤል ልጆች ጉባኤ ፊት በግምባራቸው ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of them that searched the land, rent their clothes:
verses.fr: Et, parmi ceux qui avaient exploré le pays, Josué, fils de Nun, et Caleb, fils de Jephunné, déchirèrent leurs vêtements,
verses.am: ምድርን ከሰለሉት ጋር የነበሩት የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱና የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ ልብሳቸውን ቀደዱ፤

verses.en: And they spake unto all the company of the children of Israel, saying, The land, which we passed through to search it, is an exceeding good land.
verses.fr: et parlèrent ainsi à toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël: Le pays que nous avons parcouru, pour l''explorer, est un pays très bon, excellent.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። ዞረን የሰለልናት ምድር እጅግ መልካም ናት።

verses.en: If the Lord delight in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it us; a land which floweth with milk and honey.
verses.fr: Si l''Eternel nous est favorable, il nous mènera dans ce pays, et nous le donnera: c''est un pays où coulent le lait et le miel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርስ ከወደደን ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስሰው ወደዚች ምድር ያገባናል እርስዋንም ይሰጠናል።

verses.en: Only rebel not ye against the Lord, neither fear ye the people of the land; for they are bread for us: their defence is departed from them, and the Lord is with us: fear them not.
verses.fr: Seulement, ne soyez point rebelles contre l''Eternel, et ne craignez point les gens de ce pays, car ils nous serviront de pâture, ils n''ont plus d''ombrage pour les couvrir, l''Eternel est avec nous, ne les craignez point!
verses.am: ነገር ግን በእግዚአብሔር ላይ አታምፁ፤ እንደ እንጀራ ይሆኑልናልና የምድሪቱን ሰዎች አትፍሩ፤ ጥላቸው ከላያቸው ተገፍፎአል፥ እግዚአብሔርም ከእኛ ጋር ነው፤ አትፍሩአቸው ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: But all the congregation bade stone them with stones. And the glory of the Lord appeared in the tabernacle of the congregation before all the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée parlait de les lapider, lorsque la gloire de l''Eternel apparut sur la tente d''assignation, devant tous les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ግን በድንጋይ ይወግሩአቸው ዘንድ ተማከሩ። የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, How long will this people provoke me? and how long will it be ere they believe me, for all the signs which I have shewed among them?
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Jusqu''à quand ce peuple me méprisera-t-il? Jusqu''à quand ne croira-t-il pas en moi, malgré tous les prodiges que j''ai faits au milieu de lui?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ይህ ሕዝብ እስከ መቼ ይንቀኛል? በፊቱስ ባደረግሁት ተአምራት ሁሉ እስከ መቼ አያምንብኝም?

verses.en: I will smite them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of thee a greater nation and mightier than they.
verses.fr: Je le frapperai par la peste, et je le détruirai; mais je ferai de toi une nation plus grande et plus puissante que lui.
verses.am: ከርስታቸው አጠፋቸው ዘንድ በቸነፈር እመታቸዋለሁ፤ አንተም ከእነርሱ ለሚበዛና ለሚጠነክር ሕዝብ አደርግሃለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the Lord, Then the Egyptians shall hear it, (for thou broughtest up this people in thy might from among them;)
verses.fr: Moïse dit à l''Eternel: Les Egyptiens l''apprendront, eux du milieu desquels tu as fait monter ce peuple par ta puissance,
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን አለው። ግብፃውያን ይሰማሉ፤ ይህን ሕዝብ ከመካከላቸው በኃይልህ አውጥተኸዋልና፤

verses.en: And they will tell it to the inhabitants of this land: for they have heard that thou Lord art among this people, that thou Lord art seen face to face, and that thy cloud standeth over them, and that thou goest before them, by day time in a pillar of a cloud, and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.fr: et ils le diront aux habitants de ce pays. Ils savaient que toi, l''Eternel, tu es au milieu de ce peuple; que tu apparais visiblement, toi, l''Eternel; que ta nuée se tient sur lui; que tu marches devant lui le jour dans une colonne de nuée, et la nuit dans une colonne de feu.
verses.am: ለዚችም ምድር ሰዎች ይናገራሉ። አንተ እግዚአብሔር በዚህ ሕዝብ መካከል እንደ ሆንህ ሰምተዋል፤ አንተም፥ አቤቱ፥ ፊት ለፊት ተገልጠሃል፥ ደመናህም በላያቸው ቆሞአል፥ በቀንም በደመና ዓምድ፥ በሌሊትም በእሳት ዓምድ በፊታቸው ትሄዳለህ።

verses.en: Now if thou shalt kill all this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of thee will speak, saying,
verses.fr: Si tu fais mourir ce peuple comme un seul homme, les nations qui ont entendu parler de toi diront:
verses.am: ይህን ሕዝብ እንደ አንድ ሰው ብትገድል ዝናህን የሰሙ አሕዛብ።

verses.en: Because the Lord was not able to bring this people into the land which he sware unto them, therefore he hath slain them in the wilderness.
verses.fr: L''Eternel n''avait pas le pouvoir de mener ce peuple dans le pays qu''il avait juré de lui donner: c''est pour cela qu''il l''a égorgé dans le désert.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሕዝብ ወደ ማለላቸው ምድር ያገባቸው ዘንድ አልቻለምና በምድረ በዳ ገደላቸው ብለው ይናገራሉ።

verses.en: And now, I beseech thee, let the power of my lord be great, according as thou hast spoken, saying,
verses.fr: Maintenant, que la puissance du Seigneur se montre dans sa grandeur, comme tu l''as déclaré en disant:
verses.am: ይህን ሕዝብ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ይቅር እንዳልሃቸው፥ እባክህ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህ ብዛት የዚህን ሕዝብ ኃጢአት ይቅር በል።

verses.en: The Lord is longsuffering, and of great mercy, forgiving iniquity and transgression, and by no means clearing the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation.
verses.fr: L''Eternel est lent à la colère et riche en bonté, il pardonne l''iniquité et la rébellion; mais il ne tient point le coupable pour innocent, et il punit l''iniquité des pères sur les enfants jusqu''à la troisième et la quatrième génération.
verses.am: ይህን ሕዝብ ከግብፅ ምድር ካወጣህ ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ይቅር እንዳልሃቸው፥ እባክህ፥ እንደ ምሕረትህ ብዛት የዚህን ሕዝብ ኃጢአት ይቅር በል።

verses.en: Pardon, I beseech thee, the iniquity of this people according unto the greatness of thy mercy, and as thou hast forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.
verses.fr: Pardonne l''iniquité de ce peuple, selon la grandeur de ta miséricorde, comme tu as pardonné à ce peuple depuis l''Egypte jusqu''ici.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አለ። እንደ ቃልህ ይቅር አልሁ፤

verses.en: And the Lord said, I have pardoned according to thy word:
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit: Je pardonne, comme tu l''as demandé.
verses.am: ነገር ግን እኔ ሕያው ነኛ በእውነት የእግዚአብሔር ክብር ምድርን ሁሉ ይሞላል።

verses.en: But as truly as I live, all the earth shall be filled with the glory of the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais, je suis vivant! et la gloire de l''Eternel remplira toute la terre.
verses.am: በግብፅ ምድርና በምድረ በዳ ያደረግሁትን ተአምራቴንና ክብሬን ያዩ እነዚህ ሰዎች ሁሉ አሥር ጊዜ ስለ ተፈታተኑኝ፥

verses.en: Because all those men which have seen my glory, and my miracles, which I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, and have tempted me now these ten times, and have not hearkened to my voice;
verses.fr: Tous ceux qui ont vu ma gloire, et les prodiges que j''ai faits en Egypte et dans le désert, qui m''ont tenté déjà dix fois, et qui n''ont point écouté ma voix,
verses.am: ነገሬንም ስላልሰሙ፥ በእውነት ለአባቶቻቸው የማልሁላቸውን ምድር አያዩም፤ ከእነርሱም የናቀኝ ሰው ሁሉ አያያትም፤

verses.en: Surely they shall not see the land which I sware unto their fathers, neither shall any of them that provoked me see it:
verses.fr: tous ceux-là ne verront point le pays que j''ai juré à leurs pères de leur donner, tous ceux qui m''ont méprisé ne le verront point.
verses.am: ባሪያዬ ካሌብ ግን ሌላ መንፈስ ከእርሱ ጋር ስለ ሆነ ፈጽሞም ስለተከተለኝ እርሱ ወደ ገባባት ምድር አገባዋለሁ፤ ዘሩም ይወርሳታል።

verses.en: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and hath followed me fully, him will I bring into the land whereinto he went; and his seed shall possess it.
verses.fr: Et parce que mon serviteur Caleb a été animé d''un autre esprit, et qu''il a pleinement suivi ma voie, je le ferai entrer dans le pays où il est allé, et ses descendants le posséderont.
verses.am: አማሌቅና ከነዓናዊውም በሸለቆው ውስጥ ተቀምጦአል፤ በነጋው ተመልሳችሁ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ሂዱ።

verses.en: (Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites dwelt in the valley.) Tomorrow turn you, and get you into the wilderness by the way of the Red sea.
verses.fr: Les Amalécites et les Cananéens habitent la vallée: demain, tournez-vous, et partez pour le désert, dans la direction de la mer Rouge.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: የሚያጕረመርምብኝን ይህን ክፉ ሕዝብ እስከ መቼ እታገሠዋለሁ? በእኔ ላይ የሚያጕረመርሙትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማጕረምረም ሰማሁ።

verses.en: How long shall I bear with this evil congregation, which murmur against me? I have heard the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against me.
verses.fr: Jusqu''à quand laisserai-je cette méchante assemblée murmurer contre moi? J''ai entendu les murmures des enfants d''Israël qui murmuraient contre moi.
verses.am: እንዲህ በላቸው። እኔ ሕያው ነኝና በጆሮዬ እንደ ተናገራችሁት እንዲሁ በእውነት አደርግባችኋለሁ፥ ይላል እግዚአብሔር፤

verses.en: Say unto them, As truly as I live, saith the Lord, as ye have spoken in mine ears, so will I do to you:
verses.fr: Dis-leur: Je suis vivant! dit l''Eternel, je vous ferai ainsi que vous avez parlé à mes oreilles.
verses.am: በድኖቻችሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ይወድቃሉ፤ የተቆጠራችሁ ሁሉ፥ እንደቁጥራችሁ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ የሆነ ሁሉ፥ እናንተ ያጕረመረማችሁብኝ፥

verses.en: Your carcases shall fall in this wilderness; and all that were numbered of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward which have murmured against me.
verses.fr: Vos cadavres tomberont dans ce désert. Vous tous, dont on a fait le dénombrement, en vous comptant depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, et qui avez murmuré contre moi,
verses.am: ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብና ከነዌ ልጅ ከኢያሱ በቀር በእርስዋ አስቀምጣችሁ ዘንድ እጄን ዘርግቼ ወደ ማልሁላችሁ ምድር በእውነት እናንተ አትገቡም።

verses.en: Doubtless ye shall not come into the land, concerning which I sware to make you dwell therein, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.fr: vous n''entrerez point dans le pays que j''avais juré de vous faire habiter, excepté Caleb, fils de Jephunné, et Josué, fils de Nun.
verses.am: ምርኮኛ ይሆናሉ ያላችኋቸውን ልጆቻችሁን እነርሱን አገባቸዋለሁ፥ እናንተም የናቃችኋትን ምድር ያውቃሉ።

verses.en: But your little ones, which ye said should be a prey, them will I bring in, and they shall know the land which ye have despised.
verses.fr: Et vos petits enfants, dont vous avez dit: Ils deviendront une proie! je les y ferai entrer, et ils connaîtront le pays que vous avez dédaigné.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን በድኖቻችሁ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ይወድቃሉ።

verses.en: But as for you, your carcases, they shall fall in this wilderness.
verses.fr: Vos cadavres, à vous, tomberont dans le désert;
verses.am: ልጆቻችሁም በምድረ በዳ አርባ ዓመት ይቅበዘበዛሉ፥ በድኖቻችሁም በምድረ በዳ እስኪጠፉ ድረስ ግልሙትናችሁን ይሸከማሉ።

verses.en: And your children shall wander in the wilderness forty years, and bear your whoredoms, until your carcases be wasted in the wilderness.
verses.fr: et vos enfants paîtront quarante années dans le désert, et porteront la peine de vos infidélités, jusqu''à ce que vos cadavres soient tous tombés dans le désert.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን በሰላለችሁባት ቀን ቍጥር፥ አርባ ቀን፥ ስለ አንድ ቀንም አንድ ዓመት፥ ኃጢአታችሁን አርባ ዓመት ትሸከማላችሁ፥ ቍጣዬንም ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: After the number of the days in which ye searched the land, even forty days, each day for a year, shall ye bear your iniquities, even forty years, and ye shall know my breach of promise.
verses.fr: De même que vous avez mis quarante jours à explorer le pays, vous porterez la peine de vos iniquités quarante années, une année pour chaque jour; et vous saurez ce que c''est que d''être privé de ma présence.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር። በእኔ ላይ በተሰበሰበ በዚህ ክፉ ማኅበር ሁሉ ላይ እንዲህ አደርጋለሁ ብዬ ተናገርሁ፤ በዚህ ምድረ በዳ ያልቃሉ፥ በዚያም ይሞታሉ።

verses.en: I the Lord have said, I will surely do it unto all this evil congregation, that are gathered together against me: in this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.
verses.fr: Moi, l''Eternel, j''ai parlé! et c''est ainsi que je traiterai cette méchante assemblée qui s''est réunie contre moi; ils seront consumés dans ce désert, ils y mourront.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ሊሰልሉ ሙሴ ልኮአቸው የተመለሱት ሰዎች ክፉ ወሬም ስለ ምድሪቱ እያወሩ በእርሱ ላይ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ እንዲያጕረመርሙ ያደረጉ፥

verses.en: And the men, which Moses sent to search the land, who returned, and made all the congregation to murmur against him, by bringing up a slander upon the land,
verses.fr: Les hommes que Moïse avait envoyés pour explorer le pays, et qui, à leur retour, avaient fait murmurer contre lui toute l''assemblée, en décriant le pays;
verses.am: ክፉ ወሬ ያወሩ እነዚያ ሰዎች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመቅሠፍት ሞቱ።

verses.en: Even those men that did bring up the evil report upon the land, died by the plague before the Lord.
verses.fr: ces hommes, qui avaient décrié le pays, moururent frappés d''une plaie devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ምድሪቱን ሊሰልሉ ከሄዱ ሰዎች የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱና የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ በሕይወት ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: But Joshua the son of Nun, and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, which were of the men that went to search the land, lived still.
verses.fr: Josué, fils de Nun, et Caleb, fils de Jephunné, restèrent seuls vivants parmi ces hommes qui étaient allés pour explorer le pays.
verses.am: ሙሴም ይህን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ነገረ፥ ሕዝቡም እጅግ አዘኑ።

verses.en: And Moses told these sayings unto all the children of Israel: and the people mourned greatly.
verses.fr: Moïse rapporta ces choses à tous les enfants d''Israël, et le peuple fut dans une grande désolation.
verses.am: በነጋውም ማልደው ተነሡ፥ ወደ ተራራውም ራስ መጥተው። እነሆ፥ መጣን፤ እኛ በድለናልና እግዚአብሔር ወዳለው ስፍራ እንወጣለን አሉ።

verses.en: And they rose up early in the morning, and gat them up into the top of the mountain, saying, Lo, we be here, and will go up unto the place which the Lord hath promised: for we have sinned.
verses.fr: Ils se levèrent de bon matin, et montèrent au sommet de la montagne, en disant: Nous voici! nous monterons au lieu dont a parlé l''Eternel, car nous avons péché.
verses.am: ሙሴም አለ። የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ለምን ትተላለፋላችሁ? አይጠቅማችሁም።

verses.en: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the Lord? but it shall not prosper.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Pourquoi transgressez-vous l''ordre de l''Eternel? Cela ne réussira point.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእናንተ መካከል አይደለምና በጠላቶቻችሁ ፊት እንዳትወድቁ አትውጡ።

verses.en: Go not up, for the Lord is not among you; that ye be not smitten before your enemies.
verses.fr: Ne montez pas! car l''Eternel n''est pas au milieu de vous. Ne vous faites pas battre par vos ennemis.
verses.am: አማሌቃዊና ከነዓናዊ በፊታችሁ ናቸውና በሰይፍ ትወድቃላችሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርን ከመከተል ተመልሳችኋልና እግዚአብሔር ከእናንተ ጋር አይሆንም።

verses.en: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there before you, and ye shall fall by the sword: because ye are turned away from the Lord, therefore the Lord will not be with you.
verses.fr: Car les Amalécites et les Cananéens sont là devant vous, et vous tomberiez par l''épée. Parce que vous vous êtes détournés de l''Eternel, l''Eternel ne sera point avec vous.
verses.am: እነርሱ ግን ወደ ተራራው ራስ ሊወጡ ደፈሩ፤ ነገር ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቃል ኪዳን ታቦትና ሙሴ ከሰፈሩ አልተነሡም።

verses.en: But they presumed to go up unto the hill top: nevertheless the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and Moses, departed not out of the camp.
verses.fr: Ils s''obstinèrent à monter au sommet de la montagne; mais l''arche de l''alliance et Moïse ne sortirent point du milieu du camp.
verses.am: በዚያም ተራራ ላይ የተቀመጡ አማሌቃዊና ከነዓናዊ ወረዱ፥ መትተዋቸውም እስከ ሔርማ ድረስ አሳደዱአቸው።

verses.en: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites which dwelt in that hill, and smote them, and discomfited them, even unto Hormah.
verses.fr: Alors descendirent les Amalécites et les Cananéens qui habitaient cette montagne; ils les battirent, et les taillèrent en pièces jusqu''à Horma.
verses.am: ፤ በዚያም ተራራ ላይ የተቀመጡ አማሌቃዊና ከነዓናዊ ወረዱ፥ መትተዋቸውም እስከ ሔርማ ድረስ አሳደዱአቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come into the land of your habitations, which I give unto you,
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Quand vous serez entrés dans le pays que je vous donne pour y établir vos demeures,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደምሰጣችሁ ወደ መኖሪያችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And will make an offering by fire unto the Lord, a burnt offering, or a sacrifice in performing a vow, or in a freewill offering, or in your solemn feasts, to make a sweet savour unto the Lord, of the herd or of the flock:
verses.fr: et que vous offrirez à l''Eternel un sacrifice consumé par le feu, soit un holocauste, soit un sacrifice en accomplissement d''un voeu ou en offrande volontaire, ou bien dans vos fêtes, pour produire avec votre gros ou votre menu bétail une agréable odeur à l''Eternel, -
verses.am: ስእለታችሁን ልትፈጽሙ፥ ወይም በፈቃዳችሁ፥ ወይም በበዓላችሁ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ ታደርጉ ዘንድ ከበሬ ወይም ከበግ መንጋ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም መሥዋዕት የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታቀርቡ፥

verses.en: Then shall he that offereth his offering unto the Lord bring a meat offering of a tenth deal of flour mingled with the fourth part of an hin of oil.
verses.fr: celui qui fera son offrande à l''Eternel présentera en offrande un dixième de fleur de farine pétrie dans un quart de hin d''huile,
verses.am: ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርብ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ከሌላ መሥዋዕት ጋር ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ አንድ እጅ የሆነ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.en: And the fourth part of an hin of wine for a drink offering shalt thou prepare with the burnt offering or sacrifice, for one lamb.
verses.fr: et tu feras une libation d''un quart de hin de vin, avec l''holocauste ou le sacrifice, pour chaque agneau.
verses.am: ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርብ ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ከሌላ መሥዋዕት ጋር ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ አንድ እጅ የሆነ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ያዘጋጃል።

verses.en: Or for a ram, thou shalt prepare for a meat offering two tenth deals of flour mingled with the third part of an hin of oil.
verses.fr: Pour un bélier, tu présenteras en offrande deux dixièmes de fleur de farine pétrie dans un tiers de hin d''huile,
verses.am: ለአንዱም አውራ በግ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታዘጋጃለህ፤ የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And for a drink offering thou shalt offer the third part of an hin of wine, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: et tu feras une libation d''un tiers de hin de vin, comme offrande d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለአንዱም አውራ በግ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታዘጋጃለህ፤ የኢን መስፈሪያ ሢሶም የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And when thou preparest a bullock for a burnt offering, or for a sacrifice in performing a vow, or peace offerings unto the Lord:
verses.fr: Si tu offres un veau, soit comme holocauste, soit comme sacrifice en accomplissement d''un voeu, ou comme sacrifice d''actions de grâces à l''Eternel,
verses.am: ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ወይም ለሌላ መሥዋዕት ወይም ስእለትን ለመፈጸም ወይም ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ወይፈንን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታዘጋጅ፥

verses.en: Then shall he bring with a bullock a meat offering of three tenth deals of flour mingled with half an hin of oil.
verses.fr: on présentera en offrande, avec le veau, trois dixièmes de fleur de farine pétrie dans un demi-hin d''huile,
verses.am: ከወይፈኑ ጋር የኢን መስፈሪያ ግማሽ በሆነ ዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt bring for a drink offering half an hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: et tu feras une libation d''un demi-hin de vin: c''est un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት ለተደረገ ቍርባን፥ የኢን መስፈሪያ ግማሽ የወይን ጠጅ ለመጠጥ ቍርባን ታቀርባለ።

verses.en: Thus shall it be done for one bullock, or for one ram, or for a lamb, or a kid.
verses.fr: On fera ainsi pour chaque boeuf, pour chaque bélier, pour chaque petit des brebis ou des chèvres.
verses.am: እንዲሁ ለእያንዳንዱ ወይፈን ወይም ለእያንዳንዱ አውራ በግ ወይም ለእያንዳንዱ ተባት የበግ ወይም የፍየል ጠቦት ይደረጋል።

verses.en: According to the number that ye shall prepare, so shall ye do to every one according to their number.
verses.fr: Suivant le nombre des victimes, vous ferez ainsi pour chacune, d''après leur nombre.
verses.am: እንዳዘጋጃችሁት ቍጥር፥ እንዲሁ እንደ ቍጥራቸው ለእያንዳንዱ ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tout indigène fera ces choses ainsi, lorsqu''il offrira un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአገር ልጅ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ቍርባን በእሳት ባቀረበ ጊዜ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And if a stranger sojourn with you, or whosoever be among you in your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; as ye do, so he shall do.
verses.fr: Si un étranger séjournant chez vous, ou se trouvant à l''avenir au milieu de vous, offre un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel, il l''offrira de la même manière que vous.
verses.am: መጻተኛም ከእናንተ ጋር ቢቀመጥ፥ ወይም በትውልዳችሁ መካከል ማንም ሰው ቢኖር፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ቍርባን በእሳት ቢያቀርብ፥ እናንተ የምታደርጉትን እርሱ እንዲሁ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: One ordinance shall be both for you of the congregation, and also for the stranger that sojourneth with you, an ordinance for ever in your generations: as ye are, so shall the stranger be before the Lord.
verses.fr: Il y aura une seule loi pour toute l''assemblée, pour vous et pour l''étranger en séjour au milieu de vous; ce sera une loi perpétuelle parmi vos descendants: il en sera de l''étranger comme de vous, devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለእናንተ በጉባኤው ላላችሁ በእናንተም መካከል ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ አንድ ሥርዓት ይሆናል፥ ለልጅ ልጃችሁም የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤ እናንተ እንደ ሆናችሁ እንዲሁ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መጻተኛ ይሆናል።

verses.en: One law and one manner shall be for you, and for the stranger that sojourneth with you.
verses.fr: Il y aura une seule loi et une seule ordonnance pour vous et pour l''étranger en séjour parmi vous.
verses.am: ለእናንተና ከእናንተ ጋር ለሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ አንድ ሕግና አንድ ፍርድ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land whither I bring you,
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Quand vous serez arrivés dans le pays où je vous ferai entrer,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደማመጣችሁ ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then it shall be, that, when ye eat of the bread of the land, ye shall offer up an heave offering unto the Lord.
verses.fr: et que vous mangerez du pain de ce pays, vous prélèverez une offrande pour l''Eternel.
verses.am: እናንተ የምድሪቱን እንጀራ በበላችሁ ጊዜ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን ታደርጋላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall offer up a cake of the first of your dough for an heave offering: as ye do the heave offering of the threshingfloor, so shall ye heave it.
verses.fr: Vous présenterez par élévation un gâteau, les prémices de votre pâte; vous le présenterez comme l''offrande qu''on prélève de l''aire.
verses.am: መጀመሪያ ከምታደርጉት ሊጥ አንድ እንጐቻ ለማንሣት ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ከአውድማም እንደምታነሡት ቍርባን እንዲሁ ታነሣላችሁ።

verses.en: Of the first of your dough ye shall give unto the Lord an heave offering in your generations.
verses.fr: Vous prélèverez pour l''Eternel une offrande des prémices de votre pâte, dans les temps à venir.
verses.am: መጀመሪያ ከምታደርጉት ሊጥ የማንሣት ቍርባን እስከ ልጅ ልጃችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: And if ye have erred, and not observed all these commandments, which the Lord hath spoken unto Moses,
verses.fr: Si vous péchez involontairement, en n''observant pas tous ces commandements que l''Eternel a fait connaître à Moïse,
verses.am: ብትስቱም፥ እግዚአብሔርም ለሙሴ ያዘዛቸውን እነዚህን ትእዛዛት ሁሉ ባታደርጉ፥

verses.en: Even all that the Lord hath commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day that the Lord commanded Moses, and henceforward among your generations;
verses.fr: tout ce que l''Eternel vous a ordonné par Moïse, depuis le jour où l''Eternel a donné des commandements et plus tard dans les temps à venir;
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ካዘዘበት ከፊተኛው ቀን ጀምሮ ወደ ፊትም እስከ ልጅ ልጃችሁ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ያዘዛችሁን ሁሉ ባታደርጉ፥

verses.en: Then it shall be, if ought be committed by ignorance without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bullock for a burnt offering, for a sweet savour unto the Lord, with his meat offering, and his drink offering, according to the manner, and one kid of the goats for a sin offering.
verses.fr: si l''on a péché involontairement, sans que l''assemblée s''en soit aperçue, toute l''assemblée offrira un jeune taureau en holocauste d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel, avec l''offrande et la libation, d''après les règles établies; elle offrira encore un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: ማኅበሩ ሳያውቁ በስሕተት ቢደረግ፥ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከእህሉ ቍርባንና ከመጠጡ ቍርባን ጋር እንደ ሕጉ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን አንድ ወይፈን፥ ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ያቀርባሉ።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them; for it is ignorance: and they shall bring their offering, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord, and their sin offering before the Lord, for their ignorance:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur fera l''expiation pour toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, et il leur sera pardonné; car ils ont péché involontairement, et ils ont apporté leur offrande, un sacrifice consumé par le feu en l''honneur de l''Eternel et une victime expiatoire devant l''Eternel, à cause du péché qu''ils ont involontairement commis.
verses.am: ካህኑም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ያስተሰርይላቸዋል፥ ስሕተትም ነበረና ይሰረይላቸዋል፤ ስለ ስሕተታቸውም ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባናቸውን በእሳት አቅርበዋል፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም የኃጢአታቸውን መሥዋዕት አቅርበዋል።

verses.en: And it shall be forgiven all the congregation of the children of Israel, and the stranger that sojourneth among them; seeing all the people were in ignorance.
verses.fr: Il sera pardonné à toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël et à l''étranger en séjour au milieu d''eux, car c''est involontairement que tout le peuple a péché.
verses.am: በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ዘንድ ያለ እውቀት ተደርጎአልና ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በመካከላቸውም ለሚኖሩት መጻተኞች ስርየት ይደረግላቸዋል።

verses.en: And if any soul sin through ignorance, then he shall bring a she goat of the first year for a sin offering.
verses.fr: Si c''est une seule personne qui a péché involontairement, elle offrira une chèvre d''un an en sacrifice pour le péché.
verses.am: አንድ ሰው ሳያውቅ ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አንዲት የአንድ ዓመት እንስት ፍየል ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for the soul that sinneth ignorantly, when he sinneth by ignorance before the Lord, to make an atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur fera l''expiation pour la personne qui a péché involontairement devant l''Eternel: quand il aura fait l''expiation pour elle, il lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: ኃጢአት ሠርቶ ሳያውቅ፥ ለሳተ ለዚያ ሰው ካህኑ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ይሰረይለትማል።

verses.en: Ye shall have one law for him that sinneth through ignorance, both for him that is born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger that sojourneth among them.
verses.fr: Pour l''indigène parmi les enfants d''Israël et pour l''étranger en séjour au milieu d''eux, il y aura pour vous une même loi, quand on péchera involontairement.
verses.am: ትውልዱ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ቢሆን፥ ወይም በመካከላቸው የሚቀመጥ መጻተኛ ቢሆን፥ ሳያውቅ ኃጢአትን ለሚሠራ ሁሉ ሕጉ አንድ ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: But the soul that doeth ought presumptuously, whether he be born in the land, or a stranger, the same reproacheth the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.fr: Mais si quelqu''un, indigène ou étranger, agit la main levée, il outrage l''Eternel; celui-là sera retranché du milieu de son peuple.
verses.am: የአገር ልጅ ቢሆን ወይም መጻተኛ ቢሆን፥ አንዳች በትዕቢት የሚያደርግ ሰው እግዚአብሔርን ሰድቦአል፤ ያም ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋል።

verses.en: Because he hath despised the word of the Lord, and hath broken his commandment, that soul shall utterly be cut off; his iniquity shall be upon him.
verses.fr: Il a méprisé la parole de l''Eternel, et il a violé son commandement: celui-là sera retranché, il portera la peine de son iniquité.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስለ ናቀ፥ ትእዛዙንም ስለ ሰበረ፥ ያ ሰው ፈጽሞ ይጥፋ፤ ኃጢአቱ በራሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man that gathered sticks upon the sabbath day.
verses.fr: Comme les enfants d''Israël étaient dans le désert, on trouva un homme qui ramassait du bois le jour du sabbat.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች በምድረ በዳ ሳሉ አንድ ሰው በሰንበት ቀን እንጨት ሲለቅም አገኙ።

verses.en: And they that found him gathering sticks brought him unto Moses and Aaron, and unto all the congregation.
verses.fr: Ceux qui l''avaient trouvé ramassant du bois l''amenèrent à Moïse, à Aaron, et à toute l''assemblée.
verses.am: እንጨትም ሲለቅም ያገኙት ሰዎች ወደ ሙሴና ወደ አሮን ወደ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ አመጡት።

verses.en: And they put him in ward, because it was not declared what should be done to him.
verses.fr: On le mit en prison, car ce qu''on devait lui faire n''avait pas été déclaré.
verses.am: ያደርጉበትም ዘንድ የሚገባው አልተገለጠምና በግዞት አስቀመጡት።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, The man shall be surely put to death: all the congregation shall stone him with stones without the camp.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Cet homme sera puni de mort, toute l''assemblée le lapidera hors du camp.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። ሰውየው ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ በድንጋይ ይውገሩት አለው።

verses.en: And all the congregation brought him without the camp, and stoned him with stones, and he died; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée le fit sortir du camp et le lapida, et il mourut, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አወጡት፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እስኪሞት ድረስ በድንጋይ ወገሩት።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and bid them that they make them fringes in the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put upon the fringe of the borders a ribband of blue:
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur qu''ils se fassent, de génération en génération, une frange au bord de leurs vêtements, et qu''ils mettent un cordon bleu sur cette frange du bord de leurs vêtements.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በላቸው። እነርሱም ትውልዶቻቸውም በልብሳቸው ጫፍ ዘርፍ ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ በዘርፉም ሁሉ ላይ ሰማያዊ ፈትል ያደርጉ ዘንድ እዘዛቸው።

verses.en: And it shall be unto you for a fringe, that ye may look upon it, and remember all the commandments of the Lord, and do them ; and that ye seek not after your own heart and your own eyes, after which ye use to go a whoring:
verses.fr: Quand vous aurez cette frange, vous la regarderez, et vous vous souviendrez de tous les commandements de l''Eternel pour les mettre en pratique, et vous ne suivrez pas les désirs de vos coeurs et de vos yeux pour vous laisser entraîner à l''infidélité.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርንም ትእዛዝ ሁሉ ታስቡና ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ እርስዋን በመከተል ያመነዘራችሁባትን የልባችሁንና የዓይኖቻችሁን ፈቃድ እንዳትከተሉ፥

verses.en: That ye may remember, and do all my commandments, and be holy unto your God.
verses.fr: Vous vous souviendrez ainsi de mes commandements, vous les mettrez en pratique, et vous serez saints pour votre Dieu.
verses.am: ትእዛዜን ሁሉ ታስቡና ታደርጉ ዘንድ፥ ለአምላካችሁም ቅዱሳን ትሆኑ ዘንድ ዘርፉ በልብሳችሁ ላይ እንዲታይ ይሁን።

verses.en: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu, qui vous ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte, pour être votre Dieu. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ፤ አምላክ እሆናችሁ ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
verses.fr: Koré, fils de Jitsehar, fils de Kehath, fils de Lévi, se révolta avec Dathan et Abiram, fils d''Eliab, et On, fils de Péleth, tous trois fils de Ruben.
verses.am: የሌዊም ልጅ የቀዓት ልጅ የይስዓር ልጅ ቆሬ ከሮቤልም ልጆች የኤልያብ ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮን የፋሌትም ልጅ ኦን በሙሴ ላይ ተነሡ። ች የኤልያብ ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮን የፋሌትም ልጅ ኦን በሙሴ

verses.en: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.fr: Ils se soulevèrent contre Moïse, avec deux cent cinquante hommes des enfants d''Israël, des principaux de l''assemblée, de ceux que l''on convoquait à l''assemblée, et qui étaient des gens de renom.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች ከእነርሱ ጋር ወሰዱ፤ ከጉባኤው የተመረጡ ዝናቸውም የተሰማ የማኅበሩ አለቆች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the Lord is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the Lord?
verses.fr: Ils s''assemblèrent contre Moïse et Aaron, et leur dirent: C''en est assez! car toute l''assemblée, tous sont saints, et l''Eternel est au milieu d''eux. Pourquoi vous élevez-vous au-dessus de l''assemblée de l''Eternel?
verses.am: በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ ተሰብስበው። ማኅበሩ ሁሉ እያንዳንዳቸው ቅዱሳን ናቸውና፥ እግዚአብሔርም በመካከላቸው ነውና እናንተ እጅግ አብዝታችኋል፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ጉባኤ ላይ ለምን ትታበያላችሁ? አሉ።

verses.en: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.fr: Quand Moïse eut entendu cela, il tomba sur son visage.
verses.am: ሙሴም በሰማ ጊዜ በግምባሩ ወደቀ፤

verses.en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the Lord will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.fr: Il parla à Koré et à toute sa troupe, en disant: Demain, l''Eternel fera connaître qui est à lui et qui est saint, et il le fera approcher de lui; il fera approcher de lui celui qu''il choisira.
verses.am: ለቆሬም ለወገኑም ሁሉ። ነገ እግዚአብሔር ለእርሱ የሚሆነውን፥ ቅዱስም የሚሆነውን ያስታውቃል፤ የመረጠውንም ሰው ወደ እርሱ ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.fr: Faites ceci. Prenez des brasiers, Koré et toute sa troupe.
verses.am: እንዲሁ አድርጉ፤ ቆሬና ወገንህ ሁሉ፥ ጥናዎቹን ውሰዱ፤

verses.en: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the Lord to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the Lord doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.fr: Demain, mettez-y du feu, et posez-y du parfum devant l''Eternel; celui que l''Eternel choisira, c''est celui-là qui sera saint. C''en est assez, enfants de Lévi!
verses.am: ነገም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እሳት አድርጉባቸው፥ ዕጣንም ጨምሩባቸው፤ እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ እግዚአብሔር የሚመርጠው እርሱ ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ እናንተ የሌዊ ልጆች ሆይ እጅግ አብዝታችኋል ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Koré: Ecoutez donc, enfants de Lévi:
verses.am: ሙሴም ቆሬን አለው። እናንተ የሌዊ ልጆች፥ ስሙ፤

verses.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the Lord, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.fr: Est-ce trop peu pour vous que le Dieu d''Israël vous ait choisis dans l''assemblée d''Israël, en vous faisant approcher de lui, afin que vous soyez employés au service du tabernacle de l''Eternel, et que vous vous présentiez devant l''assemblée pour la servir?
verses.am: የእስራኤል አምላክ ከእስራኤል ማኅበር የለያችሁ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ትሠሩ ዘንድ፥ እንድታገለግሉአቸውም በማኅበሩ ፊት ትቆሙ ዘንድ ወደ እርሱ ያቀረባችሁ አይበቃችሁምን?

verses.en: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.fr: Il vous a fait approcher de lui, toi, et tous tes frères, les enfants de Lévi, et vous voulez encore le sacerdoce!
verses.am: አንተን ከአንተም ጋር የሌዊን ልጆች ወንድሞችህን ሁሉ ወደ እርሱ አቅርቦአል፤ ክህነትንም ደግሞ ትፈልጋላችሁን?

verses.en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the Lord: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.fr: C''est à cause de cela que toi et toute ta troupe, vous vous assemblez contre l''Eternel! car qui est Aaron, pour que vous murmuriez contre lui?
verses.am: ስለዚህም አንተና ወገንህ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ተሰብስባችኋል፤ በእርሱም ላይ ታጕረመርሙ ዘንድ አሮን ማን ነው?

verses.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.fr: Moïse envoya appeler Dathan et Abiram, fils d''Eliab. Mais ils dirent: Nous ne monterons pas.
verses.am: ሙሴም የኤልያብን ልጆች ዳታንና አቤሮንን እንዲጠሩአቸው ላከ፤ እነርሱም። አንመጣም፤

verses.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.fr: N''est-ce pas assez que tu nous aies fait sortir d''un pays où coulent le lait et le miel pour nous faire mourir au désert, sans que tu continues à dominer sur nous?
verses.am: በምድረ በዳ ትገድለን ዘንድ ወተትና ማር ከምታፈስሰው ምድር ያወጣኸን አይበቃህምን? ደግመህ በእኛ ላይ ራስህን አለቃ ታደርጋለህን?

verses.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.fr: Et ce n''est pas dans un pays où coulent le lait et le miel que tu nous as menés, ce ne sont pas des champs et des vignes que tu nous as donnés en possession. Penses-tu crever les yeux de ces gens? Nous ne monterons pas.
verses.am: ደግሞ ወተትና ማር ወደምታፈስስ ምድር አላገባኸንም፥ እርሻና ወይንም አላወረስኸንም፤ የእነዚህንስ ሰዎች ዓይኖቻቸውን ታወጣለህን? አንመጣም አሉ።

verses.en: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the Lord, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.fr: Moïse fut très irrité, et il dit à l''Eternel: N''aie point égard à leur offrande. Je ne leur ai pas même pris un âne, et je n''ai fait de mal à aucun d''eux.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም። ወደ ቍርባናቸው አትመልከት፤ እኔ ከእነርሱ አንድ አህያ ስንኳ አልወሰድሁም፥ ከእነርሱም አንድ ሰው አልበደልሁም አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the Lord, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Koré: Toi et toute ta troupe, trouvez-vous demain devant l''Eternel, toi et eux, avec Aaron.
verses.am: ሙሴም ቆሬን። ነገ አንተ፥ ወገንህም ሁሉ፥ አሮንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሁኑ፤

verses.en: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the Lord every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.fr: Prenez chacun votre brasier, mettez-y du parfum, et présentez devant l''Eternel chacun votre brasier: il y aura deux cent cinquante brasiers; toi et Aaron, vous prendrez aussi chacun votre brasier.
verses.am: ሁላችሁም ጥናዎቻችሁን ውሰዱ፥ ዕጣንም አድርጉባቸው፥ እያንዳንዳችሁም ጥናዎቻችሁን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት አምጡ፥ ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ጥናዎች፤ አንተ ደግሞ አሮንም ጥናዎቻችሁን አምጡ አለው።

verses.en: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.fr: Ils prirent chacun leur brasier, y mirent du feu et y posèrent du parfum, et ils se tinrent à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, avec Moïse et Aaron.
verses.am: እያንዳንዱም ጥናውን ወሰደ፥ እሳትም አደረገበት፥ ዕጣንም ጨመረበት፥ ከሙሴና ከአሮንም ጋር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ቆመ።

verses.en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.fr: Et Koré convoqua toute l''assemblée contre Moïse et Aaron, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation. Alors la gloire de l''Eternel apparut à toute l''assemblée.
verses.am: ቆሬም ማኅበሩን ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእነርሱ ላይ ሰበሰበ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለማኅበሩ ሁሉ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.fr: Séparez-vous du milieu de cette assemblée, et je les consumerai en un seul instant.
verses.am: ሁሉን በቅጽበት አጠፋቸው ዘንድ ከዚህ ማኅበር መካከል ፈቀቅ በሉ።

verses.en: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.fr: Ils tombèrent sur leur visage, et dirent: O Dieu, Dieu des esprits de toute chair! un seul homme a péché, et tu t''irriterais contre toute l''assemblée?
verses.am: እነርሱም በግምባራቸው ወድቀው። አምላክ ሆይ፥ አንተ የሰው ሁሉ ነፍስ አምላክ፥ አንድ ሰው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ አንተ በማኅበሩ ሁሉ ላይ ትቈጣለህን? አሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.fr: Parle à l''assemblée, et dis: Retirez-vous de toutes parts loin de la demeure de Koré, de Dathan et d''Abiram.
verses.am: ለማኅበሩ። ከቆሬና ከዳታን ከአቤሮንም ማደሪያ ዙሪያ ፈቀቅ በሉ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.fr: Moïse se leva, et alla vers Dathan et Abiram; et les anciens d''Israël le suivirent.
verses.am: ሙሴም ተነሥቶ ወደ ዳታንና ወደ አቤሮን ሄደ፤ የእስራኤልም ሽማግሌዎች ተከተሉት።

verses.en: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of their's, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.fr: Il parla à l''assemblée, et dit: Eloignez-vous des tentes de ces méchants hommes, et ne touchez à rien de ce qui leur appartient, de peur que vous ne périssiez en même temps qu''ils seront punis pour tous leurs péchés.
verses.am: ማኅበሩንም። እባካችሁ፥ ከእነዚህ ክፉዎች ድንኳን ፈቀቅ በሉ፤ በኃጢአታቸውም ሁሉ እንዳትጠፉ ለእነርሱ የሆነውን ሁሉ አትንኩ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.fr: Ils se retirèrent de toutes parts loin de la demeure de Koré, de Dathan et d''Abiram. Dathan et Abiram sortirent, et se tinrent à l''entrée de leurs tentes, avec leurs femmes, leurs fils et leurs petits-enfants.
verses.am: ከቆሬና ከዳታን ከአቤሮንም ማደሪያ ከዙሪያውም ሁሉ ፈቀቅ አሉ፤ ዳታንና አቤሮንም ሴቶቻቸውም ልጆቻቸውም ሕፃናቶቻቸውም ወጥተው በድንኳኖቻቸው ደጃፍ ቆሙ።

verses.en: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the Lord hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: A ceci vous connaîtrez que l''Eternel m''a envoyé pour faire toutes ces choses, et que je n''agis pas de moi-même.
verses.am: ሙሴም አለ። ይህን ሥራ ሁሉ አደርግ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ላከኝ እንጂ ከልቤ እንዳይደለ በዚህ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the Lord hath not sent me.
verses.fr: Si ces gens meurent comme tous les hommes meurent, s''ils subissent le sort commun à tous les hommes, ce n''est pas l''Eternel qui m''a envoyé;
verses.am: እነዚህ ሰዎች ሰው እንደሚሞት ቢሞቱ፥ ወይም እንደ ሰው ሁሉ ቢቀሠፉ እግዚአብሔር አልላከኝም።

verses.en: But if the Lord make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the Lord.
verses.fr: mais si l''Eternel fait une chose inouïe, si la terre ouvre sa bouche pour les engloutir avec tout ce qui leur appartient, et qu''ils descendent vivants dans le séjour des morts, vous saurez alors que ces gens ont méprisé l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ግን አዲስ ነገር ቢፈጥር፥ ምድርም አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱን ለእነርሱም ያለውን ሁሉ ብትውጣቸው፥ በሕይወታቸውም ወደ ሲኦል ቢወርዱ፥ ያን ጊዜ እነዚህ ሰዎች እግዚአብሔርን እንደ ናቁ ታውቃላችሁ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
verses.fr: Comme il achevait de prononcer toutes ces paroles, la terre qui était sous eux se fendit.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ይህን ቃል ሁሉ መናገር በፈጸመ ጊዜ ከበታቻቸው ያለው መሬት ተሰነጠቀ፤

verses.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.fr: La terre ouvrit sa bouche, et les engloutit, eux et leurs maisons, avec tous les gens de Koré et tous leurs biens.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም አፍዋን ከፍታ እነርሱን ቤተ ሰቦቻቸውንም፥ ለቆሬም የነበሩትን ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ ዕቃዎቻቸውንም ሁሉ ዋጠቻቸው።

verses.en: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.fr: Ils descendirent vivants dans le séjour des morts, eux et tout ce qui leur appartenait; la terre les recouvrit, et ils disparurent au milieu de l''assemblée.
verses.am: እነርሱም ለእነርሱም የነበሩ ሁሉ በሕይወታቸው ወደ ሲኦል ወረዱ፤ ምድሪቱም ተዘጋችባቸው፥ ከጉባኤውም መካከል ጠፉ።

verses.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.fr: Tout Israël, qui était autour d''eux, s''enfuit à leur cri; car ils disaient: Fuyons, de peur que la terre ne nous engloutisse!
verses.am: በዙሪያቸው የነበሩ የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ከጩኸታቸው የተነሣ። ምድሪቱ እንዳትውጠን ብለው በረሩ።

verses.en: And there came out a fire from the Lord, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.fr: Un feu sortit d''auprès de l''Eternel, et consuma les deux cent cinquante hommes qui offraient le parfum.
verses.am: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጥታ ያጥኑ የነበሩትን ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ሰዎች በላች።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.fr: Dis à Eléazar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron, de retirer de l''incendie les brasiers et d''en répandre au loin le feu, car ils sont sanctifiés.
verses.am: ለካህኑ ለአሮን ልጅ ለአልዓዛር እንዲህ ብለህ ንገረው። ተቀድሰዋልና ጥናዎቹን ከተቃጠሉት ዘንድ ውሰድ፥ እሳቱንም ወደ ውጭ ጣለው፤

verses.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the Lord, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Avec les brasiers de ces gens qui ont péché au péril de leur vie, que l''on fasse des lames étendues dont on couvrira l''autel. Puisqu''ils ont été présentés devant l''Eternel et qu''ils sont sanctifiés, ils serviront de souvenir aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በኃጢአታቸው ሰውነታቸውን ያጠፉትን የእነዚያን ሰዎች ጥናዎች ጠፍጥፈህ ለመሠዊያ መለበጫ አድርጋቸው፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርበዋቸዋልና የተቀደሱ ናቸው፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ምልክት ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Eléazar prit les brasiers d''airain qu''avaient présentés les victimes de l''incendie, et il en fit des lames pour couvrir l''autel.
verses.am: ካህኑም አልዓዛር የተቃጠሉት ሰዎች ያቀረቡአቸውን የናስ ጥናዎች ወስዶ ጠፍጥፎም ለመሠዊያው መለበጫ አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the Lord; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the Lord said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: C''est un souvenir pour les enfants d''Israël, afin qu''aucun étranger à la race d''Aaron ne s''approche pour offrir du parfum devant l''Eternel et ne soit comme Koré et comme sa troupe, selon ce que l''Eternel avait déclaré par Moïse.
verses.am: በቆሬና በወገኑ የደረሰው እንዳይደርስበት፥ ከአሮን ልጆች ያልሆነ ሌላ ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዕጣን ያጥን ዘንድ እንዳይቀርብ፥ እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እንደ ተናገረው፥ ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ አደረጋቸው።

verses.en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the Lord.
verses.fr: Dès le lendemain, toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël murmura contre Moïse et Aaron, en disant: Vous avez fait mourir le peuple de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በነጋውም የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ። እናንተ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕዝብ ገድላችኋል ብለው በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ አጕረመረሙ።

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the Lord appeared.
verses.fr: Comme l''assemblée se formait contre Moïse et Aaron, et comme ils tournaient les regards vers la tente d''assignation, voici, la nuée la couvrit, et la gloire de l''Eternel apparut.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ማኅበሩ በሙሴና በአሮን ላይ በተሰበሰቡ ጊዜ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አዩ፤ እነሆም፥ ደመናው ሸፈነው፥ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron arrivèrent devant la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት መጡ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.fr: Retirez-vous du milieu de cette assemblée, et je les consumerai en un instant. Ils tombèrent sur leur visage;
verses.am: ከዚህ ማኅበር መካከል ፈቀቅ በሉ፥ እኔም በቅጽበት አጠፋቸዋለሁ። በግምባራቸውም ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the Lord; the plague is begun.
verses.fr: et Moïse dit à Aaron: Prends le brasier, mets-y du feu de dessus l''autel, poses-y du parfum, va promptement vers l''assemblée, et fais pour eux l''expiation; car la colère de l''Eternel a éclaté, la plaie a commencé.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። ጥናህን ውሰድ፥ ከመሠዊያውም ላይ እሳት አድርግበት፥ ዕጣንም ጨምርበት፥ ወደ ማኅበሩም ፈጥነህ ውሰደው አስተስርይላቸውም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቍጣ ወጥቶአልና መቅሠፍት ጀምሮአል አለው።

verses.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.fr: Aaron prit le brasier, comme Moïse avait dit, et courut au milieu de l''assemblée; et voici, la plaie avait commencé parmi le peuple. Il offrit le parfum, et il fit l''expiation pour le peuple.
verses.am: አሮንም ሙሴ እንደ ተናገረው ጥናውን ወስዶ ወደ ጉባኤው መካከል ሮጠ፤ እነሆም፥ መቅሠፍቱ በሕዝቡ መካከል ጀምሮ ነበር፤ ዕጣንም ጨመረ፥ ለሕዝቡም አስተሰረየላቸው።

verses.en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.fr: Il se plaça entre les morts et les vivants, et la plaie fut arrêtée.
verses.am: በሙታንና በሕያዋን መካከል ቆመ፤ መቅሠፍቱም ተከለከለ።

verses.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.fr: Il y eut quatorze mille sept cents personnes qui moururent de cette plaie, outre ceux qui étaient morts à cause de Koré.
verses.am: በቆሬም ምክንያት ከሞቱት ሌላ በመቅሠፍቱ የሞቱት አሥራ አራት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.fr: Aaron retourna auprès de Moïse, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation. La plaie était arrêtée.
verses.am: አሮንም ወደ ሙሴ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ተመለሰ፤ መቅሠፍቱም ተከለከለ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and take of every one of them a rod according to the house of their fathers, of all their princes according to the house of their fathers twelve rods: write thou every man's name upon his rod.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et prends d''eux une verge selon les maisons de leurs pères, soit douze verges de la part de tous leurs princes selon les maisons de leurs pères. Tu écriras le nom de chacun sur sa verge,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው፥ ከእነርሱም ከእያንዳንዱ ከየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አንድ አንድ በትር፥ ከአለቆቻቸው ከየአባቶቻቸው ቤት አሥራ ሁለት በትሮች፥ ውሰድ፤ የእያንዳንዱንም ስም በየበትሩ ላይ ጻፍ።

verses.en: And thou shalt write Aaron's name upon the rod of Levi: for one rod shall be for the head of the house of their fathers.
verses.fr: et tu écriras le nom d''Aaron sur la verge de Lévi; car il y aura une verge pour chaque chef des maisons de leurs pères.
verses.am: አንድ በትርም ለአባቶቻቸው ቤት አለቃ ይሆናልና በሌዊ በትር ላይ የአሮንን ስም ጻፍ።

verses.en: And thou shalt lay them up in the tabernacle of the congregation before the testimony, where I will meet with you.
verses.fr: Tu les déposeras dans la tente d''assignation, devant le témoignage, où je me rencontre avec vous.
verses.am: እኔ ከእናንተ ጋር በምገናኝበት በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በምስክሩ ፊት አኑራቸው።

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that the man's rod, whom I shall choose, shall blossom: and I will make to cease from me the murmurings of the children of Israel, whereby they murmur against you.
verses.fr: L''homme que je choisirai sera celui dont la verge fleurira, et je ferai cesser de devant moi les murmures que profèrent contre vous les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እንዲህም ይሆናል፤ የመረጥሁት ሰው በትር ታቈጠቁጣለች፤ በእናንተም ላይ የሚያጕረመርሙባችሁን የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማጕረምረም ከእኔ ዘንድ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, even twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron was among their rods.
verses.fr: Moïse parla aux enfants d''Israël; et tous leurs princes lui donnèrent une verge, chaque prince une verge, selon les maisons de leurs pères, soit douze verges; la verge d''Aaron était au milieu des leurs.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ተናገራቸው፤ አለቆቻቸው ሁሉ አሥራ ሁለት በትሮች፥ እያንዳንዱም አለቃ በየአባቱ ቤት አንድ አንድ በትር፥ ሰጡት፤ የአሮንም በትር በበትሮቻቸው መካከል ነበረች።

verses.en: And Moses laid up the rods before the Lord in the tabernacle of witness.
verses.fr: Moïse déposa les verges devant l''Eternel, dans la tente du témoignage.
verses.am: ሙሴም በትሮቹን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.
verses.fr: Le lendemain, lorsque Moïse entra dans la tente du témoignage, voici, la verge d''Aaron, pour la maison de Lévi, avait fleuri, elle avait poussé des boutons, produit des fleurs, et mûri des amandes.
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ በነጋው ሙሴ ወደ ምስክሩ ድንኳን ውስጥ ገባ፤ እነሆም፥ ለሌዊ ቤት የሆነች የአሮን በትር አቈጠቈጠች፥ ለመለመችም፥ አበባም አወጣች፥ የበሰለ ለውዝም አፈራች።

verses.en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the Lord unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.
verses.fr: Moïse ôta de devant l''Eternel toutes les verges, et les porta à tous les enfants d''Israël, afin qu''ils les vissent et qu''ils prissent chacun leur verge.
verses.am: ሙሴም በትሮችን ሁሉ ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ እስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ አወጣቸው፤ እነርሱም አዩ፥ እያንዳንዱም በትሩን ወሰደ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Reporte la verge d''Aaron devant le témoignage, pour être conservée comme un signe pour les enfants de rébellion, afin que tu fasses cesser de devant moi leurs murmures et qu''ils ne meurent point.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የአሮንን በትር ወደ ምስክሩ ፊት መልስ፤ ማጕረምረማቸው ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲጠፋ እነርሱም እንዳይሞቱ ለሚያምፁብኝ ልጆች ምልክት ሆና ትጠበቅ አለው።

verses.en: And Moses did so: as the Lord commanded him, so did he.
verses.fr: Moïse fit ainsi; il se conforma à l''ordre que l''Eternel lui avait donné.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንዲሁ አደረገ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel spake unto Moses, saying, Behold, we die, we perish, we all perish.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël dirent à Moïse: Voici, nous expirons, nous périssons, nous périssons tous!
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሙሴን።እነሆ፥ እንሞታለን፥ እንጠፋለን፥ ሁላችንም እንጠፋለን።

verses.en: Whosoever cometh any thing near unto the tabernacle of the Lord shall die: shall we be consumed with dying?
verses.fr: Quiconque s''approche du tabernacle de l''Eternel, meurt. Nous faudra-t-il tous expirer?
verses.am: የሚቀርብ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ የሚቀርብ፥ ይሞታል፤ በውኑ ሁላችን እንሞታለንን? ብለው ተናገሩት።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Aaron: Toi et tes fils, et la maison de ton père avec toi, vous porterez la peine des iniquités commises dans le sanctuaire; toi et tes fils avec toi, vous porterez la peine des iniquités commises dans l''exercice de votre sacerdoce.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን አለው። አንተ ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህና የአባቶችህ ቤት የመቅደስን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ፤ አንተም ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ የክህነታችሁን ኃጢአት ትሸከማላችሁ።

verses.en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee shall minister before the tabernacle of witness.
verses.fr: Fais aussi approcher de toi tes frères, la tribu de Lévi, la tribu de ton père, afin qu''ils te soient attachés et qu''ils te servent, lorsque toi, et tes fils avec toi, vous serez devant la tente du témoignage.
verses.am: ደግሞም የአባትህን የሌዊን ነገድ ወንድሞችህን ከአንተ ጋር አቅርብ፤ ከአንተም ጋር በአንድነት ይሁኑ፥ ያገልግሉህም፤ አንተ ግን ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ በምስክሩ ድንኳን ፊት ትሆናላችሁ።

verses.en: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.
verses.fr: Ils observeront ce que tu leur ordonneras et ce qui concerne toute la tente; mais ils ne s''approcheront ni des ustensiles du sanctuaire, ni de l''autel, de peur que vous ne mouriez, eux et vous.
verses.am: እነርሱም ትእዛዝህን የድንኳኑንም ሁሉ አገግሎት ይጠብቁ፤ ነገር ግን እንዳይሞቱ፥ እናንተም ደግሞ ከእነርሱ ጋር እንዳትሞቱ፥ እነርሱ ወደ መቅደሱ ዕቃና ወደ መሠዊያው አይቅረቡ።

verses.en: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.
verses.fr: Ils te seront attachés, et ils observeront ce qui concerne la tente d''assignation pour tout le service de la tente. Aucun étranger n''approchera de vous.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከእናንተ ጋር በአንድነት ይሁኑ፥ ለድንኳኑም አገልግሎት ሁሉ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን ይጠብቁ፤ ሌላም ሰው ወደ እናንተ አይቅረብ።

verses.en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Vous observerez ce qui concerne le sanctuaire et l''autel, afin qu''il n''y ait plus de colère contre les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እንደ ገና በእስራኤል ልጆች ላይ ቍጣ እንዳይሆንባቸው እናንተ መቅደሱንና መሠዊያውን ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you they are given as a gift for the Lord, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Voici, j''ai pris vos frères les Lévites du milieu des enfants d''Israël: donnés à l''Eternel, ils vous sont remis en don pour faire le service de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: እኔም፥ እነሆ፥ ሌዋውያንን ወንድሞቻችሁን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ወስጄአለሁ፤ የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ያደርጉ ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር የተሰጡ ለእናንተ ስጦታ ናቸው።

verses.en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for everything of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office unto you as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
verses.fr: Toi, et tes fils avec toi, vous observerez les fonctions de votre sacerdoce pour tout ce qui concerne l''autel et pour ce qui est en dedans du voile: c''est le service que vous ferez. Je vous accorde en pur don l''exercice du sacerdoce. L''étranger qui approchera sera mis à mort.
verses.am: አንተም ከአንተም ጋር ልጆችህ ለመሠዊያው ሥራ የሚሆነውን ሁሉ፥ በመጋረጃውም ውስጥ የሚሆነውን ታደርጉ ዘንድ ክህነታችሁን ጠብቁ፥ አገልግሉም፤ ክህነቱን ለስጦታ አገልግሎት ሰጥቼአችኋለሁ፤ ሌላም ሰው ቢቀርብ ይገደል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Aaron: Voici, de toutes les choses que consacrent les enfants d''Israël, je te donne celles qui me sont offertes par élévation; je te les donne, à toi et à tes fils, comme droit d''onction, par une loi perpétuelle.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን ተናገረው እንዲህም አለው። እነሆ፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለእኔ የቀደሱትን የማንሣት ቍርባኔን ሁሉ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ ስለ መቀባትህ ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: This shall be thine of the most holy things, reserved from the fire: every oblation of their's, every meat offering of their's, and every sin offering of their's, and every trespass offering of their's which they shall render unto me, shall be most holy for thee and for thy sons.
verses.fr: Voici ce qui t''appartiendra parmi les choses très saintes qui ne sont pas consumées par le feu: toutes leurs offrandes, tous leurs dons, tous leurs sacrifices d''expiation, et tous les sacrifices de culpabilité qu''ils m''offriront; ces choses très saintes seront pour toi et pour tes fils.
verses.am: በእሳት ከሚቀርበው ከተቀደሰው ይህ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ለእኔ የሚያመጡት መባቸው ሁሉ፥ የእህሉ ቍርባናቸው ሁሉ፥ የኃጢአታቸውም መስዋዕት ሁሉ፥ የበደላቸውም መሥዋዕት ሁሉ፥ ለአንተ ለልጆችህም የተቀደሰ ይሆናል።

verses.en: In the most holy place shalt thou eat it; every male shall eat it: it shall be holy unto thee.
verses.fr: Vous les mangerez dans un lieu très saint; tout mâle en mangera; vous les regarderez comme saintes.
verses.am: በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ብላው፤ ወንዶች ሁሉ ይብሉት፤ የተቀደሰ ይሆንልሃል።

verses.en: And this is thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.
verses.fr: Voici encore ce qui t''appartiendra: tous les dons que les enfants d''Israël présenteront par élévation et en les agitant de côté et d''autre, je te les donne à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles avec toi, par une loi perpétuelle. Quiconque sera pur dans ta maison en mangera.
verses.am: ይህም ለአንተ ነው፤ የእስራኤል ልጆች ለስጦታ ያቀረቡትን የማንሣትና የመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ሁሉ ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው።

verses.en: All the best of the oil, and all the best of the wine, and of the wheat, the firstfruits of them which they shall offer unto the Lord, them have I given thee.
verses.fr: Je te donne les prémices qu''ils offriront à l''Eternel: tout ce qu''il y aura de meilleur en huile, tout ce qu''il y aura de meilleur en moût et en blé.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚሰጡት የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ከዘይትና ከወይን ከእህልም የተመረጠውን ሁሉ ለአንተ ሰጥቼሃለሁ።

verses.en: And whatsoever is first ripe in the land, which they shall bring unto the Lord, shall be thine; every one that is clean in thine house shall eat of it.
verses.fr: Les premiers produits de leur terre, qu''ils apporteront à l''Eternel, seront pour toi. Quiconque sera pur dans ta maison en mangera.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔር የሚያመጡት በምድራቸው ያለው ሁሉ የፍሬ መጀመሪያ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ በቤትህ ውስጥ ንጹሕ የሆነ ሁሉ ይብላው።

verses.en: Every thing devoted in Israel shall be thine.
verses.fr: Tout ce qui sera dévoué par interdit en Israël sera pour toi.
verses.am: በእስራኤል ዘንድ እርም የሆነው ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Every thing that openeth the matrix in all flesh, which they bring unto the Lord, whether it be of men or beasts, shall be thine: nevertheless the firstborn of man shalt thou surely redeem, and the firstling of unclean beasts shalt thou redeem.
verses.fr: Tout premier-né de toute chair, qu''ils offriront à l''Eternel, tant des hommes que des animaux, sera pour toi. Seulement, tu feras racheter le premier-né de l''homme, et tu feras racheter le premier-né d''un animal impur.
verses.am: ከሰው ወይም ከእንስሳ ቢሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ከሚያቀርቡት ሥጋ ሁሉ ማኅፀን የሚከፍት ሁሉ ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን የሰውን በኵራት ፈጽሞ ትቤዠዋለህ፥ ያልነጻውንም እንስሳ በኵራት ትቤዠዋለህ።

verses.en: And those that are to be redeemed from a month old shalt thou redeem, according to thine estimation, for the money of five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary, which is twenty gerahs.
verses.fr: Tu les feras racheter dès l''âge d''un mois, d''après ton estimation, au prix de cinq sicles d''argent, selon le sicle du sanctuaire, qui est de vingt guéras.
verses.am: ከአንድ ወር ጀምሮ የምትቤዠውን እንደ ግምትህ ትቤዠዋለህ፤ ግምቱም እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን አምስት ሰቅል ይሆናል፤ እርሱም ሀያ አቦሊ ነው።

verses.en: But the firstling of a cow, or the firstling of a sheep, or the firstling of a goat, thou shalt not redeem; they are holy: thou shalt sprinkle their blood upon the altar, and shalt burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Mais tu ne feras point racheter le premier-né du boeuf, ni le premier-né de la brebis, ni le premier-né de la chèvre: ce sont des choses saintes. Tu répandras leur sang sur l''autel, et tu brûleras leur graisse: ce sera un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የላም በኵራት ወይም የበግ በኵራት ወይም የፍየል በኵራት አትቤዥም፤ የተቀደሱ ናቸው፤ ደማቸውን በመሠዊያው ላይ ትረጨዋለህ፥ ስባቸውንም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለእሳት ቍርባን ታቃጥለዋለህ።

verses.en: And the flesh of them shall be thine, as the wave breast and as the right shoulder are thine.
verses.fr: Leur chair sera pour toi, comme la poitrine qu''on agite de côté et d''autre et comme l''épaule droite.
verses.am: ሥጋቸውም ለአንተ ይሆናል፤ እንደ መወዝወዝ ፍርምባ እንደ ቀኙም ወርች ለአንተ ይሆናል።

verses.en: All the heave offerings of the holy things, which the children of Israel offer unto the Lord, have I given thee, and thy sons and thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: it is a covenant of salt for ever before the Lord unto thee and to thy seed with thee.
verses.fr: Je te donne, à toi, à tes fils et à tes filles avec toi, par une loi perpétuelle, toutes les offrandes saintes que les enfants d''Israël présenteront à l''Eternel par élévation. C''est une alliance inviolable et à perpétuité devant l''Eternel, pour toi et pour ta postérité avec toi.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ከተቀደሰው ነገር ሁሉ አንሥተው ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀረቡትን ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለወንዶችና ለሴቶች ልጆችህ ድርሻ እንዲሆን ለዘላለም ሰጥቼሃለሁ፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለአንተ ከአንተም ጋር ለዘርህ የጨው ቃል ኪዳን ለዘላለም ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, Thou shalt have no inheritance in their land, neither shalt thou have any part among them: I am thy part and thine inheritance among the children of Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Aaron: Tu ne posséderas rien dans leur pays, et il n''y aura point de part pour toi au milieu d''eux; c''est moi qui suis ta part et ta possession, au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን አለው። በምድራቸው ርስት በመካከላቸውም ድርሻ አይሆንልህም፤ በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ድርሻህና ርስትህ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: And, behold, I have given the children of Levi all the tenth in Israel for an inheritance, for their service which they serve, even the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Je donne comme possession aux fils de Lévi toute dîme en Israël, pour le service qu''ils font, le service de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ለሌዊም ልጆች፥ እነሆ፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን አገልግሎት ስለሚያገለግሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሥራት ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአለሁ።

verses.en: Neither must the children of Israel henceforth come nigh the tabernacle of the congregation, lest they bear sin, and die.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël n''approcheront plus de la tente d''assignation, de peur qu''ils ne se chargent d''un péché et qu''ils ne meurent.
verses.am: ከዚህም በኋላ ኃጢአትን እንዳይሸከሙ እንዳይሞቱም፥ የእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አይቅረቡ።

verses.en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.
verses.fr: Les Lévites feront le service de la tente d''assignation, et ils resteront chargés de leurs iniquités. Ils n''auront point de possession au milieu des enfants d''Israël: ce sera une loi perpétuelle parmi vos descendants.
verses.am: ሌዋውያን ግን የመገናኛውን ድንኳን አገልግሎት ይሥሩ፥ እነርሱም ኃጢአታቸውን ይሸከማሉ፤ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤ በእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል ርስት አይወርሱም።

verses.en: But the tithes of the children of Israel, which they offer as an heave offering unto the Lord, I have given to the Levites to inherit: therefore I have said unto them, Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.
verses.fr: Je donne comme possession aux Lévites les dîmes que les enfants d''Israël présenteront à l''Eternel par élévation; c''est pourquoi je dis à leur égard: Ils n''auront point de possession au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን የሚያቀርቡትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች አሥራት ለሌዋውያን ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአለሁ፤ ስለዚህ። በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል ርስት አይወርሱም አልኋቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the Lord, even a tenth part of the tithe.
verses.fr: Tu parleras aux Lévites, et tu leur diras: Lorsque vous recevrez des enfants d''Israël la dîme que je vous donne de leur part comme votre possession, vous en prélèverez une offrande pour l''Eternel, une dîme de la dîme;
verses.am: ለሌዋውያን እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ከእስራኤል ልጆች ለእናንተ ርስት አድርጌ የሰጠኋችሁን አሥራት በተቀበላችሁ ጊዜ፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን የአሥራት አሥራት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And this your heave offering shall be reckoned unto you, as though it were the corn of the threshingfloor, and as the fulness of the winepress.
verses.fr: et votre offrande vous sera comptée comme le blé qu''on prélève de l''aire et comme le moût qu''on prélève de la cuve.
verses.am: የማንሣት ቍርባናችሁም እንደ አውድማው እህልና እንደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ፍሬ ይቈጠርላችኋል።

verses.en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the Lord of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the Lord'S heave offering to Aaron the priest.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que vous prélèverez une offrande pour l''Eternel sur toutes les dîmes que vous recevrez des enfants d''Israël, et vous donnerez au sacrificateur Aaron l''offrande que vous en aurez prélevée pour l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንዲሁ እናንተ ደግሞ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከምትቀበሉት አሥራት ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም የማንሣት ቍርባን ለካህኑ ለአሮን ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: Out of all your gifts ye shall offer every heave offering of the Lord, of all the best thereof, even the hallowed part thereof out of it.
