verses.fr: Sur tous les dons qui vous seront faits, vous prélèverez toutes les offrandes pour l''Eternel; sur tout ce qu''il y aura de meilleur, vous prélèverez la portion consacrée.
verses.am: ከምትቀበሉት ስጦታ ሁሉ፥ ከተመረጠው ከተቀደሰውም ድርሻ ሁሉ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን የማንሣት ቍርባን ሁሉ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt say unto them, When ye have heaved the best thereof from it, then it shall be counted unto the Levites as the increase of the threshingfloor, and as the increase of the winepress.
verses.fr: Tu leur diras: Quand vous en aurez prélevé le meilleur, la dîme sera comptée aux Lévites comme le revenu de l''aire et comme le revenu de la cuve.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ትላቸዋለህ። ከእርሱ የተመረጠውን ባነሣችሁ ጊዜ እንደ አውድማው እህልና እንደ ወይን መጭመቂያው ፍሬ ለሌዋውያን ይቈጠራል።

verses.en: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it is your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Vous la mangerez en un lieu quelconque, vous et votre maison; car c''est votre salaire pour le service que vous faites dans la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: እናንተም ቤተ ሰቦቻችሁም፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ የማገልገላችሁ ዋጋ ነውና በሁሉ ስፍራ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.
verses.fr: Vous ne serez chargés pour cela d''aucun péché, quand vous en aurez prélevé le meilleur, vous ne profanerez point les offrandes saintes des enfants d''Israël, et vous ne mourrez point.
verses.am: የተመረጠውንም ከእርሱ ባነሣችሁ ጊዜ ስለ እርሱ ኃጢአትን አትሸከሙም፤ እንዳትሞቱም የእስራኤል ልጆች የቀደሱትን አታረክሱም።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein is no blemish, and upon which never came yoke:
verses.fr: Voici ce qui est ordonné par la loi que l''Eternel a prescrite, en disant: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et qu''ils t''amènent une vache rousse, sans tache, sans défaut corporel, et qui n''ait point porté le joug.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው የሕጉ ትእዛዝ ይህ ነው፤ መልካሚቱን፥ ነውርም የሌለባትን፥ ቀንበርም ያልተጫነባትን ቀይ ጊደር ያመጡልህ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ንገራቸው።

verses.en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and one shall slay her before his face:
verses.fr: Vous la remettrez au sacrificateur Eléazar, qui la fera sortir du camp, et on l''égorgera devant lui.
verses.am: እርስዋንም ለካህኑ ለአልዓዛር ትሰጣላችሁ፥ እርስዋንም ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ይወስዳታል፥ አንድ ሰውም በፊቱ ያርዳታል።

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Eléazar prendra du sang de la vache avec le doigt, et il en fera sept fois l''aspersion sur le devant de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ካህኑም አልዓዛር ከደምዋ በጣቱ ይወስዳል፥ ከደምዋም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጫል።

verses.en: And one shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
verses.fr: On brûlera la vache sous ses yeux; on brûlera sa peau, sa chair et son sang, avec ses excréments.
verses.am: ጊደሪቱም በፊቱ ትቃጠላለች፤ ቁርበትዋም ሥጋዋም ደምዋም ፈርስዋም ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the midst of the burning of the heifer.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra du bois de cèdre, de l''hysope et du cramoisi, et il les jettera au milieu des flammes qui consumeront la vache.
verses.am: ካህኑም የዝግባ እንጨት ሂሶጵም ቀይ ግምጃም ወስዶ ጊደሪቱ በምትቃጠልበት እሳት መካከል ይጥለዋል።

verses.en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur lavera ses vêtements, et lavera son corps dans l''eau; puis il rentrera dans le camp, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ካህኑም ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ይገባል፤ ካህኑም እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Celui qui aura brûlé la vache lavera ses vêtements dans l''eau, et lavera son corps dans l''eau; et il sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ያቃጠላትም ሰው ልብሱን በውኃ ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And a man that is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it is a purification for sin.
verses.fr: Un homme pur recueillera la cendre de la vache, et la déposera hors du camp, dans un lieu pur; on la conservera pour l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, afin d''en faire l''eau de purification. C''est une eau expiatoire.
verses.am: ንጹሕም ሰው የጊደሪቱን አመድ ያከማቻል ከሰፈሩም ውጭ በንጹሕ ስፍራ ያኖረዋል፤ ርኵሰትም ለሚያነጻ ውኃ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ይጠበቃል፤ ከኃጢአት ለማንጻት የሚሆን ነው።

verses.en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
verses.fr: Celui qui aura recueilli la cendre de la vache lavera ses vêtements, et sera impur jusqu''au soir. Ce sera une loi perpétuelle pour les enfants d''Israël et pour l''étranger en séjour au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: የጊደሪቱንም አመድ ያከማቸ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእስራኤል ልጆች በመካከላቸውም ለሚኖር መጻተኛ ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
verses.fr: Celui qui touchera un mort, un corps humain quelconque, sera impur pendant sept jours.
verses.am: የሞተውን ሰው በድን የሚነካ ሰባት ቀን ርኵስ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
verses.fr: Il se purifiera avec cette eau le troisième jour et le septième jour, et il sera pur; mais, s''il ne se purifie pas le troisième jour et le septième jour, il ne sera pas pur.
verses.am: በዚህም ውኃ በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሁለመናውን ያጠራል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሁለመናውን ባያጠራ ንጹሕ አይሆንም።

verses.en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the Lord; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is yet upon him.
verses.fr: Celui qui touchera un mort, le corps d''un homme qui sera mort, et qui ne se purifiera pas, souille le tabernacle de l''Eternel; celui-là sera retranché d''Israël. Comme l''eau de purification n''a pas été répandue sur lui, il est impur, et son impureté est encore sur lui.
verses.am: የሞተውን ሰው በድን የነካ ሁለመናውን ባያጠራ የእግዚአብሔርን ማደሪያ ያረክሳል፤ ያ ሰው ከእስራኤል ዘንድ ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ በእርሱም ላይ የሚያነጻ ውኃ አልተረጨምና ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ርኵሰቱ ገና በእርሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: This is the law, when a man dieth in a tent: all that come into the tent, and all that is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.fr: Voici la loi. Lorsqu''un homme mourra dans une tente, quiconque entrera dans la tente, et quiconque se trouvera dans la tente, sera impur pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ሰው በድንኳን ውስጥ ቢሞት ሕጉ ይህ ነው፤ ወደ ድንኳኑ የሚገባ ሁሉ በድንኳኑም ውስጥ ያለው ሁሉ ሰባት ቀን ርኵስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And every open vessel, which hath no covering bound upon it, is unclean.
verses.fr: Tout vase découvert, sur lequel il n''y aura point de couvercle attaché, sera impur.
verses.am: መክደኛው ያልታሰረ የተከፈተ ዕቃ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.fr: Quiconque touchera, dans les champs, un homme tué par l''épée, ou un mort, ou des ossements humains, ou un sépulcre, sera impur pendant sept jours.
verses.am: በሜዳም በሰይፍ የተገደለውን ወይም የሞተውን በድን ወይም የሰውን አጥንት ወይም መቃብር የሚነካ ሰባት ቀን ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And for an unclean person they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:
verses.fr: On prendra, pour celui qui est impur, de la cendre de la victime expiatoire qui a été brûlée, et on mettra dessus de l''eau vive dans un vase.
verses.am: ከኃጢአት ለማንጻት እንድትሆን ከተቃጠለችው ጊደር አመድ ለርኩሱ ይወስዱለታል፥ በዕቃውም ውስጥ የምንጭ ውኃ ይቀላቀልበታል።

verses.en: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:
verses.fr: Un homme pur prendra de l''hysope, et la trempera dans l''eau; puis il en fera l''aspersion sur la tente, sur tous les ustensiles, sur les personnes qui sont là, sur celui qui a touché des ossements, ou un homme tué, ou un mort, ou un sépulcre.
verses.am: ንጹሕም ሰው ሂሶጱን ወስዶ በውኃው ውስጥ ያጠልቀዋል፤ በድንኳኑም፥ በዕቃውም ሁሉ፥ በዚያም ባሉ ሰዎች ላይ፥ አጥንቱንም ወይም የተገደለውን ወይም የሞተውን ወይም መቃብሩን በነካው ላይ ይረጨዋል፤

verses.en: And the clean person shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.
verses.fr: Celui qui est pur fera l''aspersion sur celui qui est impur, le troisième jour et le septième jour, et il le purifiera le septième jour. Il lavera ses vêtements, et se lavera dans l''eau; et le soir, il sera pur.
verses.am: ንጹሑም በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን በርኩሱ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤ ባሰባተኛውም ቀን ያጠራዋል፤ እርሱም ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ በማታም ጊዜ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the Lord: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he is unclean.
verses.fr: Un homme qui sera impur, et qui ne se purifiera pas, sera retranché du milieu de l''assemblée, car il a souillé le sanctuaire de l''Eternel; comme l''eau de purification n''a pas été répandue sur lui, il est impur.
verses.am: ሰውም ርኩስ ቢሆን ሁለመናውንም ባያጠራ፥ ያ ሰው የእግዚአብሔርን መቅደስ አርክሶአልና ከጉባኤው መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋል፤ በሚያነጻ ውኃ አልተረጨም፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.
verses.fr: Ce sera pour eux une loi perpétuelle. Celui qui fera l''aspersion de l''eau de purification lavera ses vêtements, et celui qui touchera l''eau de purification sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ይህም የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆንላችኋል፤ የሚያነጻውን ውኃ የሚረጭ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፤ የሚያነጻውንም ውኃ የሚነካ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And whatsoever the unclean person toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth it shall be unclean until even.
verses.fr: Tout ce que touchera celui qui est impur sera souillé, et la personne qui le touchera sera impure jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ርኩሱም የሚነካው ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ የሚነካውም ሰው እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: Then came the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël arriva dans le désert de Tsin le premier mois, et le peuple s''arrêta à Kadès. C''est là que mourut Marie, et qu''elle fut enterrée.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በመጀመሪያው ወር ወደ ጺን ምድረ በዳ መጡ፤ ሕዝቡም በቃዴስ ተቀመጡ፤ ማርያምም በዚያ ሞተች፥ በዚያም ተቀበረች።

verses.en: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.fr: Il n''y avait point d''eau pour l''assemblée; et l''on se souleva contre Moïse et Aaron.
verses.am: ለማኅበሩም ውኃ አልነበረም፤ በሙሴና በአሮንም ላይ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the Lord!
verses.fr: Le peuple chercha querelle à Moïse. Ils dirent: Que n''avons-nous expiré, quand nos frères expirèrent devant l''Eternel?
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ሙሴን ተጣሉት፥ እንዲህም ብለው ተናገሩት። ወንድሞቻችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በሞቱ ጊዜ እኛም ምነው በሞትን ኖሮ!

verses.en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the Lord into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
verses.fr: Pourquoi avez-vous fait venir l''assemblée de l''Eternel dans ce désert, pour que nous y mourions, nous et notre bétail?
verses.am: እኛ ከብቶቻችንም በዚያ እንሞት ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ጉባኤ ወደዚህ ምድረ በዳ ለምን አመጣችሁ?

verses.en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.
verses.fr: Pourquoi nous avez-vous fait monter hors d''Egypte, pour nous amener dans ce méchant lieu? Ce n''est pas un lieu où l''on puisse semer, et il n''y a ni figuier, ni vigne, ni grenadier, ni d''eau à boire.
verses.am: ወደዚህ ክፉ ስፍራ ታመጡን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ለምን አወጣችሁን? ዘርና በለስ ወይንም ሮማንም የሌለበት ስፍራ ነው፤ የሚጠጣም ውኃ የለበትም።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto them.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron s''éloignèrent de l''assemblée pour aller à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation. Ils tombèrent sur leur visage; et la gloire de l''Eternel leur apparut.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ከጉባኤው ፊት ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሂደው በግምባራቸው ወደቁ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ተገለጠላቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take the rod, and gather thou the assembly together, thou, and Aaron thy brother, and speak ye unto the rock before their eyes; and it shall give forth his water, and thou shalt bring forth to them water out of the rock: so thou shalt give the congregation and their beasts drink.
verses.fr: Prends la verge, et convoque l''assemblée, toi et ton frère Aaron. Vous parlerez en leur présence au rocher, et il donnera ses eaux; tu feras sortir pour eux de l''eau du rocher, et tu abreuveras l''assemblée et leur bétail.
verses.am: በትርህን ውሰድ፤ አንተና ወንድምህ አሮን ማኅበሩን ሰብስቡ፥ ድንጋዩም ውኃን እንዲሰጥ እነርሱ ሲያዩ ተናገሩት፤ ከድንጋዩም ውኃ ታወጣላቸዋለህ፤ እንዲሁም ማኅበሩን ከብቶቻቸውንም ታጠጣላቸዋለህ።

verses.en: And Moses took the rod from before the Lord, as he commanded him.
verses.fr: Moïse prit la verge qui était devant l''Eternel, comme l''Eternel le lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: ሙሴም እንደ ታዘዘ በትሩን ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወሰደ።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron gathered the congregation together before the rock, and he said unto them, Hear now, ye rebels; must we fetch you water out of this rock?
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron convoquèrent l''assemblée en face du rocher. Et Moïse leur dit: Ecoutez donc, rebelles! Est-ce de ce rocher que nous vous ferons sortir de l''eau?
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ጉባኤውን በድንጋዩ ፊት ሰብስበው። እናንተ ዓመፀኞች፥ እንግዲህ ስሙ፤ በውኑ ከዚህ ድንጋይ ውኃን እናወጣላችኋለን? አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses lifted up his hand, and with his rod he smote the rock twice: and the water came out abundantly, and the congregation drank, and their beasts also.
verses.fr: Puis Moïse leva la main et frappa deux fois le rocher avec sa verge. Il sortit de l''eau en abondance. L''assemblée but, et le bétail aussi.
verses.am: ሙሴም እጁን ዘርግቶ ድንጋዩን ሁለት ጊዜ በበትሩ መታው፤ ብዙም ውኃ ወጣ፥ ማኅበሩም ከብቶቻቸውም ጠጡ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, Because ye believed me not, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore ye shall not bring this congregation into the land which I have given them.
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel dit à Moïse et à Aaron: Parce que vous n''avez pas cru en moi, pour me sanctifier aux yeux des enfants d''Israël, vous ne ferez point entrer cette assemblée dans le pays que je lui donne.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን። በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት ትቀድሱኝ ዘንድ በእኔ አላመናችሁምና ስለዚህ ወደ ሰጠኋቸው ምድር ይህን ጉባኤ ይዛችሁ አትገቡም አላቸው።

verses.en: This is the water of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the Lord, and he was sanctified in them.
verses.fr: Ce sont les eaux de Meriba, où les enfants d''Israël contestèrent avec l''Eternel, qui fut sanctifié en eux.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ጠብ ያደረጉበት፥ እርሱም ቅዱስ መሆኑን የገለጠበት ይህ የመሪባ ውኃ ነው።

verses.en: And Moses sent messengers from Kadesh unto the king of Edom, Thus saith thy brother Israel, Thou knowest all the travail that hath befallen us:
verses.fr: De Kadès, Moïse envoya des messagers au roi d''Edom, pour lui dire: Ainsi parle ton frère Israël: Tu sais toutes les souffrances que nous avons éprouvées.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከቃዴስ ወደ ኤዶምያስ ንጉሥ መልእክተኞችን እንዲህ ብሎ ላከ። ወንድምህ እስራኤል እንዲህ ይላል። ያገኘንን መከራ ሁሉ አንተ ታውቃለህ፤

verses.en: How our fathers went down into Egypt, and we have dwelt in Egypt a long time; and the Egyptians vexed us, and our fathers:
verses.fr: Nos pères descendirent en Egypte, et nous y demeurâmes longtemps. Mais les Egyptiens nous ont maltraités, nous et nos pères.
verses.am: አባቶቻችን ወደ ግብፅ ወረዱ፥ በግብፅም እጅግ ዘመን ተቀመጥን ግብፃውያንም እኛንና አባቶቻችንን በደሉ፤

verses.en: And when we cried unto the Lord, he heard our voice, and sent an angel, and hath brought us forth out of Egypt: and, behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the uttermost of thy border:
verses.fr: Nous avons crié à l''Eternel, et il a entendu notre voix. Il a envoyé un ange, et nous a fait sortir de l''Egypte. Et voici, nous sommes à Kadès, ville à l''extrémité de ton territoire.
verses.am: ወደ እግዚአብሔርም በጮኽን ጊዜ ድምፃችንን ሰማ፥ መልአክንም ሰድዶ ከግብፅ አወጣን፤ እነሆም፥ በምድርህ ዳርቻ ባለችው ከተማ በቃዴስ ተቀምጠናል።

verses.en: Let us pass, I pray thee, through thy country: we will not pass through the fields, or through the vineyards, neither will we drink of the water of the wells: we will go by the king's high way, we will not turn to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed thy borders.
verses.fr: Laisse-nous passer par ton pays; nous ne traverserons ni les champs, ni les vignes, et nous ne boirons pas l''eau des puits; nous suivrons la route royale, sans nous détourner à droite ou à gauche, jusqu''à ce que nous ayons franchi ton territoire.
verses.am: እባክህ፥ በምድርህ ላይ እንለፍ፤ ወደ እርሻም ወደ ወይንም አንገባም፥ ከጕድጓዶችም ውኃን አንጠጣም፤ በንጉሡ ጐዳና እንሄዳለን፥ ዳርቻህንም እስክናልፍ ድረስ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አንልም።

verses.en: And Edom said unto him, Thou shalt not pass by me, lest I come out against thee with the sword.
verses.fr: Edom lui dit: Tu ne passeras point chez moi, sinon je sortirai à ta rencontre avec l''épée.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስም። በሰይፍ እንዳልገጥምህ በምድሬ ላይ አታልፍም አለው።

verses.en: And the children of Israel said unto him, We will go by the high way: and if I and my cattle drink of thy water, then I will pay for it: I will only, without doing anything else, go through on my feet.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël lui dirent: Nous monterons par la grande route; et, si nous buvons de ton eau, moi et mes troupeaux, j''en paierai le prix; je ne ferai que passer avec mes pieds, pas autre chose.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች። በጐዳናው እንሄዳለን፥ እኔም ከብቶቼም ከውኃህ ብንጠጣ ዋጋውን እንከፍላለን፥ ሌላም ምንም አናደርግም፤ ብቻ በእግራችን እንለፍ አሉት።

verses.en: And he said, Thou shalt not go through. And Edom came out against him with much people, and with a strong hand.
verses.fr: Il répondit: Tu ne passeras pas! Et Edom sortit à sa rencontre avec un peuple nombreux et à main forte.
verses.am: እርሱም። አታልፍም አለ። ኤዶምያስም በብዙ ሕዝብና በጽኑ እጅ ሊገጥመው ወጣ።

verses.en: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border: wherefore Israel turned away from him.
verses.fr: Ainsi Edom refusa de donner passage à Israël par son territoire. Et Israël se détourna de lui.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስም እስራኤል በዳርቻው እንዳያልፍ ከለከለ፤ ስለዚህ እስራኤል ከእርሱ ተመለሰ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, journeyed from Kadesh, and came unto mount Hor.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël partit de Kadès, et arriva à la montagne de Hor.
verses.am: ከቃዴስም ተጓዙ፤ የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ወደ ሖር ተራራ መጡ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron in mount Hor, by the coast of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse et à Aaron, vers la montagne de Hor, sur la frontière du pays d''Edom:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን በኤዶምያስ ምድር ዳርቻ ባለው በሖር ተራራ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Aaron shall be gathered unto his people: for he shall not enter into the land which I have given unto the children of Israel, because ye rebelled against my word at the water of Meribah.
verses.fr: Aaron va être recueilli auprès de son peuple; car il n''entrera point dans le pays que je donne aux enfants d''Israël, parce que vous avez été rebelles à mon ordre, aux eaux de Meriba.
verses.am: አሮን ወደ ወገኑ ይከማች፤ በመሪባ ውኃ ዘንድ በቃሌ ላይ ስለ ዐመፃችሁ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ወደ ሰጠኋት ምድር አይገባም።

verses.en: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up unto mount Hor:
verses.fr: Prends Aaron et son fils Eléazar, et fais-les monter sur la montagne de Hor.
verses.am: አሮንና ልጁን አልዓዛርን ይዘህ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ላይ አምጣቸው፤

verses.en: And strip Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son: and Aaron shall be gathered unto his people, and shall die there.
verses.fr: Dépouille Aaron de ses vêtements, et fais-les revêtir à Eléazar, son fils. C''est là qu''Aaron sera recueilli et qu''il mourra.
verses.am: ከአሮንም ልብሱን አውጣ፥ ልጁንም አልዓዛርን አልብሰው፤ አሮንም ወደ ወገኑ ይከማች፥ በዚያም ይሙት።

verses.en: And Moses did as the Lord commanded: and they went up into mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.
verses.fr: Moïse fit ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné. Ils montèrent sur la montagne de Hor, aux yeux de toute l''assemblée.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ አደረገ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ እያዩ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ወጡ።

verses.en: And Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them upon Eleazar his son; and Aaron died there in the top of the mount: and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mount.
verses.fr: Moïse dépouilla Aaron de ses vêtements, et les fit revêtir à Eléazar, son fils. Aaron mourut là, au sommet de la montagne. Moïse et Eléazar descendirent de la montagne.
verses.am: ሙሴም የአሮንን ልብስ አወጣ፥ ልጁንም አልዓዛርን አለበሰው፤ አሮንም በዚያ በተራራው ራስ ላይ ሞተ፤ ሙሴና አልዓዛርም ከተራራው ወረዱ።

verses.en: And when all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they mourned for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.
verses.fr: Toute l''assemblée vit qu''Aaron avait expiré, et toute la maison d''Israël pleura Aaron pendant trente jours.
verses.am: ማኅበሩም ሁሉ አሮን እንደ ሞተ ባዩ ጊዜ፥ የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ለአሮን ሠላሳ ቀን አለቀሱ።

verses.en: And when king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south, heard tell that Israel came by the way of the spies; then he fought against Israel, and took some of them prisoners.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Arad, Cananéen, qui habitait le midi, apprit qu''Israël venait par le chemin d''Atharim. Il combattit Israël, et emmena des prisonniers.
verses.am: በደቡብም በኩል ተቀምጦ የነበረው ከነዓናዊው የዓራድ ንጉሥ በአታሪም መንገድ እስራኤል እንደ መጡ ሰማ፤ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ሰልፍ አደረገ ከእነርሱም ምርኮ ማረከ።

verses.en: And Israel vowed a vow unto the Lord, and said, If thou wilt indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.
verses.fr: Alors Israël fit un voeu à l''Eternel, et dit: Si tu livres ce peuple entre mes mains, je dévouerai ses villes par interdit.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ለእግዚአብሔር። እነዚህን አሳልፈህ በእጄ ብትሰጣቸው ከተሞቻቸውን እርም ብዬ አጠፋለሁ ብሎ ስእለት ተሳለ።

verses.en: And the Lord hearkened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities: and he called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.fr: L''Eternel entendit la voix d''Israël, et livra les Cananéens. On les dévoua par interdit, eux et leurs villes; et l''on nomma ce lieu Horma.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የእስራኤልን ድምፅ ሰማ፥ ከነዓናውያንንም አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ እነርሱንም ከተሞቻቸውንም እርም ብለው አጠፉ፤ የዚያንም ስፍራ ስም ሔርማ ብለው ጠሩት።

verses.en: And they journeyed from mount Hor by the way of the Red sea, to compass the land of Edom: and the soul of the people was much discouraged because of the way.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de la montagne de Hor par le chemin de la mer Rouge, pour contourner le pays d''Edom. Le peuple s''impatienta en route,
verses.am: ከሖርም ተራራ ከኤዶምያስ ምድር ርቀው ሊዞሩ በኤርትራ ባሕር መንገድ ተጓዙ፤ የሕዝቡም ሰውነት ከመንገዱ የተነሣ ደከመ።

verses.en: And the people spake against God, and against Moses, Wherefore have ye brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? for there is no bread, neither is there any water; and our soul loatheth this light bread.
verses.fr: et parla contre Dieu et contre Moïse: Pourquoi nous avez-vous fait monter hors d''Egypte, pour que nous mourions dans le désert? car il n''y a point de pain, et il n''y a point d''eau, et notre âme est dégoûtée de cette misérable nourriture.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም በእግዚአብሔርና በሙሴ ላይ። በምድረ በዳ እንሞት ዘንድ ከግብፅ ለምን አወጣችሁን? እንጀራ የለም፥ ውኃ የለም፤ ሰውነታችንም ይህን ቀላል እንጀራ ተጸየፈ ብለው ተናገሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord sent fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people; and much people of Israel died.
verses.fr: Alors l''Eternel envoya contre le peuple des serpents brûlants; ils mordirent le peuple, et il mourut beaucoup de gens en Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሕዝቡ ላይ እባቦችን ሰደደ፥ ሕዝቡንም ነደፉ፤ ከእስራኤልም ብዙ ሰዎች ሞቱ።

verses.en: Therefore the people came to Moses, and said, We have sinned, for we have spoken against the Lord, and against thee; pray unto the Lord, that he take away the serpents from us. And Moses prayed for the people.
verses.fr: Le peuple vint à Moïse, et dit: Nous avons péché, car nous avons parlé contre l''Eternel et contre toi. Prie l''Eternel, afin qu''il éloigne de nous ces serpents. Moïse pria pour le peuple.
verses.am: ሕዝቡም ወደ ሙሴ መጥተው። በእግዚአብሔርና በአንተ ላይ ስለ ተናገርን በድለናል፤ እባቦችን ከእኛ ያርቅልን ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ጸልይልን አሉት።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Make thee a fiery serpent, and set it upon a pole: and it shall come to pass, that every one that is bitten, when he looketh upon it, shall live.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Fais-toi un serpent brûlant, et place-le sur une perche; quiconque aura été mordu, et le regardera, conservera la vie.
verses.am: ሙሴም ስለ ሕዝቡ ጸለየ። እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እባብን ሠርተህ በዓላማ ላይ ስቀል፤ የተነደፈውም ሁሉ ሲያያት በሕይወት ይኖራል አለው።

verses.en: And Moses made a serpent of brass, and put it upon a pole, and it came to pass, that if a serpent had bitten any man, when he beheld the serpent of brass, he lived.
verses.fr: Moïse fit un serpent d''airain, et le plaça sur une perche; et quiconque avait été mordu par un serpent, et regardait le serpent d''airain, conservait la vie.
verses.am: ሙሴም የናሱን እባብ ሠርቶ በዓላማ ላይ ሰቀለ፤ እባብም የነደፈችው ሰው ሁሉ የናሱን እባብ ባየ ጊዜ ዳነ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël partirent, et ils campèrent à Oboth.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተጓዙ፥ በኦቦትም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they journeyed from Oboth, and pitched at Ijeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrising.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Oboth et ils campèrent à Ijjé-Abarim, dans le désert qui est vis-à-vis de Moab, vers le soleil levant.
verses.am: ከኦቦትም ተጕዘው በሞዓብ ፊት ለፊት ባለችው ምድረ በዳ፥ በፀሐይ መውጫ በኩል፥ በዒዬዓባሪም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: From thence they removed, and pitched in the valley of Zared.
verses.fr: De là ils partirent, et ils campèrent dans la vallée de Zéred.
verses.am: ከዚያም ተጕዘው በዘሬድ ሸለቆ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: From thence they removed, and pitched on the other side of Arnon, which is in the wilderness that cometh out of the coasts of the Amorites: for Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.fr: De là ils partirent, et ils campèrent de l''autre côté de l''Arnon, qui coule dans le désert en sortant du territoire des Amoréens; car l''Arnon est la frontière de Moab, entre Moab et les Amoréens.
verses.am: ከዚያም ተጕዘው ከአሞራውያን ዳርቻ በሚወጣው ምድረ በዳ ውስጥ በአሮኖን ማዶ ሰፈሩ፤ አሮኖን በሞዓብና በአሞራውያን መካከል ያለ የሞዓብ ዳርቻ ነውና።

verses.en: Wherefore it is said in the book of the wars of the Lord, What he did in the Red sea, and in the brooks of Arnon,
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi il est dit dans le livre des Guerres de l''Eternel: ...Vaheb en Supha, et les torrents de l''Arnon,
verses.am: ስለዚህ በእግዚአብሔር የጦርነት መጽሐፍ እንዲህ ተባለ።  ዋሄብ በሱፋ፥  የአርኖንም ሸለቆች፥

verses.en: And at the stream of the brooks that goeth down to the dwelling of Ar, and lieth upon the border of Moab.
verses.fr: et le cours des torrents, qui s''étend du côté d''Ar et touche à la frontière de Moab.
verses.am: ወደ ዔር ማደሪያ የሚወርድ  በሞዓብም ዳርቻ የሚጠጋ  የሸለቆች ፈሳሽ።

verses.en: And from thence they went to Beer: that is the well whereof the Lord spake unto Moses, Gather the people together, and I will give them water.
verses.fr: De là ils allèrent à Beer. C''est ce Beer, où l''Eternel dit à Moïse: Rassemble le peuple, et je leur donnerai de l''eau.
verses.am: ከዚያም ወደ ብኤር ተጓዙ፤ ይኸውም እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን። ሕዝቡን ሰብስብ ውኃንም እሰጣቸዋለሁ ብሎ የተናገረለት ጕድጓድ ነው።

verses.en: Then Israel sang this song, Spring up, O well; sing ye unto it:
verses.fr: Alors Israël chanta ce cantique: Monte, puits! Chantez en son honneur!
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ እስራኤል ይህን መዝሙር ዘመረ።  አንተ ምንጭ ሆይ፥ ፍለቅ፤ እናንተ ዘምሩለት፤

verses.en: The princes digged the well, the nobles of the people digged it, by the direction of the lawgiver, with their staves. And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah:
verses.fr: Puits, que des princes ont creusé, Que les grands du peuple ont creusé, Avec le sceptre, avec leurs bâtons! Du désert ils allèrent à Matthana;
verses.am: በበትረ መንግሥት በበትራቸውም  የሕዝብ አዛውንቶች ያጐደጐዱት፥  አለቆችም የቈፈሩት ጕድጓድ።

verses.en: And from Mattanah to Nahaliel: and from Nahaliel to Bamoth:
verses.fr: de Matthana, à Nahaliel; de Nahaliel, à Bamoth;
verses.am: ከምድረ በዳም ወደ መቴና ተጓዙ፤ ከመቴናም ወደ ነሃሊኤል፥ ከነሃሊኤልም ወደ ባሞት፥

verses.en: And from Bamoth in the valley, that is in the country of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looketh toward Jeshimon.
verses.fr: de Bamoth, à la vallée qui est dans le territoire de Moab, au sommet du Pisga, en regard du désert.
verses.am: ከባሞትም ምድረ በዳውን ከላይ ወደሚመለከተው ወደ ፈስጋ ተራራ ራስ በሞዓብ በረሀ ወዳለው ሸለቆ ተጓዙ።

verses.en: And Israel sent messengers unto Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.fr: Israël envoya des messagers à Sihon, roi des Amoréens, pour lui dire:
verses.am: ሴዎንም እስራኤል በምድሩ ላይ ያልፍ ዘንድ እንቢ አለ፤ ሴዎንም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ እስራኤልንም ለመውጋት ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣ፥ ወደ ያሀጽም መጣ፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.en: Let me pass through thy land: we will not turn into the fields, or into the vineyards; we will not drink of the waters of the well: but we will go along by the king's high way, until we be past thy borders.
verses.fr: Laisse-moi passer par ton pays; nous n''entrerons ni dans les champs, ni dans les vignes, et nous ne boirons pas l''eau des puits; nous suivrons la route royale, jusqu''à ce que nous ayons franchi ton territoire.
verses.am: ሴዎንም እስራኤል በምድሩ ላይ ያልፍ ዘንድ እንቢ አለ፤ ሴዎንም ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፥ እስራኤልንም ለመውጋት ወደ ምድረ በዳ ወጣ፥ ወደ ያሀጽም መጣ፥ ከእስራኤልም ጋር ተዋጋ።

verses.en: And Sihon would not suffer Israel to pass through his border: but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness: and he came to Jahaz, and fought against Israel.
verses.fr: Sihon n''accorda point à Israël le passage sur son territoire; il rassembla tout son peuple, et sortit à la rencontre d''Israël, dans le désert; il vint à Jahats, et combattit Israël.
verses.am: እስራኤልም በሰይፍ መታው፥ ምድሩንም ከአርኖን ጀምሮ እስከ አሞን ልጆች እስከ ያቦቅ ድረስ ወረሰ፤ የአሞንም ልጆች ዳርቻ የጸና ነበረ።

verses.en: And Israel smote him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from Arnon unto Jabbok, even unto the children of Ammon: for the border of the children of Ammon was strong.
verses.fr: Israël le frappa du tranchant de l''épée et s''empara de son pays depuis l''Arnon jusqu''au Jabbok, jusqu''à la frontière des enfants d''Ammon; car la frontière des enfants d''Ammon était fortifiée.
verses.am: እስራኤልም እነዚህን ከተሞች ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ እስራኤልም በአሞራውያን ከተሞች ሁሉ በሐሴቦንና በመንደሮቹ ሁሉ ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Israel took all these cities: and Israel dwelt in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all the villages thereof.
verses.fr: Israël prit toutes les villes, et s''établit dans toutes les villes des Amoréens, à Hesbon et dans toutes les villes de son ressort.
verses.am: ሐሴቦንም የአሞራውያን ንጉሥ የሴዎን ከተማ ነበረ፤ እርሱም የፊተኛውን የሞዓብን ንጉሥ ወግቶ እስከ አርኖን ድረስ ምድሩን ሁሉ ከእጁ ወስዶ ነበር።

verses.en: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even unto Arnon.
verses.fr: Car Hesbon était la ville de Sihon, roi des Amoréens; il avait fait la guerre au précédent roi de Moab, et lui avait enlevé tout son pays jusqu''à l''Arnon.
verses.am: ስለዚህ በምሳሌ እንዲህ ተብሎ ተነገረ።  ወደ ሐሴቦን ኑ፤  የሴዎን ከተማ ይሠራ፥ ይመሥረት፤

verses.en: Wherefore they that speak in proverbs say, Come into Heshbon, let the city of Sihon be built and prepared:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi les poètes disent: Venez à Hesbon! Que la ville de Sihon soit rebâtie et fortifiée!
verses.am: እሳት ከሐሴቦን፥ ነበልባልም ከሴዎን ከተማ ወጣ፤  የሞዓብን ዔር፥ የአርኖንን ተራራ አለቆች በላ፤

verses.en: For there is a fire gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon: it hath consumed ar of Moab, and the lords of the high places of Arnon.
verses.fr: Car il est sorti un feu de Hesbon, Une flamme de la ville de Sihon; Elle a dévoré Ar-Moab, Les habitants des hauteurs de l''Arnon.
verses.am: ሞዓብ ሆይ፥ ወዮልህ!  የከሞስ ሕዝብ ሆይ፥ ጠፋህ፤  ወንዶች ልጆቹን ለሽሽት፥ ሴቶች ልጆቹንም ለምርኮ፥  ለአሞራውያን ንጉሥ ለሴዎን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Woe to thee, Moab! thou art undone, O people of Chemosh: he hath given his sons that escaped, and his daughters, into captivity unto Sihon king of the Amorites.
verses.fr: Malheur à toi, Moab! Tu es perdu, peuple de Kemosch! Il a fait de ses fils des fuyards, Et il a livré ses filles captives A Sihon, roi des Amoréens.
verses.am: ገተርናቸው፤ ከሐሴቦን እስከ ዴቦን ድረስ ጠፉ፤  ኖፋም እስኪደርሱ እስከ ሜድባ አፈረስናቸው።

verses.en: We have shot at them; Heshbon is perished even unto Dibon, and we have laid them waste even unto Nophah, which reacheth unto Medeba.
verses.fr: Nous avons lancé sur eux nos traits: De Hesbon à Dibon tout est détruit; Nous avons étendu nos ravages jusqu''à Nophach, Jusqu''à Médeba.
verses.am: እስራኤልም እንደዚህ በአሞራውያን ምድር ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: Thus Israel dwelt in the land of the Amorites.
verses.fr: Israël s''établit dans le pays des Amoréens.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሰላዮችን ወደ ኢያዜር ሰደደ፤ መንደሮችዋንም ወሰዱ፥ በዚያም የነበሩትን አሞራውያን አባረሩ።

verses.en: And Moses sent to spy out Jaazer, and they took the villages thereof, and drove out the Amorites that were there.
verses.fr: Moïse envoya reconnaître Jaezer; et ils prirent les villes de son ressort, et chassèrent les Amoréens qui y étaient.
verses.am: ተመልሰውም በበሳን መንገድ ወጡ፤ የባሳንም ንጉሥ ዐግ ከሕዝቡ ሁሉ ጋር በኤድራይ ይወጋቸው ዘንድ ወጣ።

verses.en: And they turned and went up by the way of Bashan: and og the king of bashan went out against them, he, and all his people, to the battle at edrei.
verses.fr: Ils changèrent ensuite de direction, et montèrent par le chemin de Basan. Og, roi de Basan, sortit à leur rencontre, avec tout son peuple, pour les combattre à Edréi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። እርሱንና ሕዝቡን ሁሉ ምድሪቱንም አሳልፌ በእጅህ ሰጥቼአለሁና አትፍራው፤ በሐሴቦንም በተቀመጠው በአሞራውያን ንጉሥ በሴዎን እንዳደረግህ እንዲሁ ታደርግበታለህ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Fear him not: for I have delivered him into thy hand, and all his people, and his land; and thou shalt do to him as thou didst unto Sihon king of the Amorites, which dwelt at Heshbon.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Ne le crains point; car je le livre entre tes mains, lui et tout son peuple, et son pays; tu le traiteras comme tu as traité Sihon, roi des Amoréens, qui habitait à Hesbon.
verses.am: እርሱንና ልጆቹን ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ መቱ ሰውም አልቀረለትም፤ ምድሩንም ወረሱ።

verses.en: So they smote him, and his sons, and all his people, until there was none left him alive: and they possessed his land.
verses.fr: Et ils le battirent, lui et ses fils, et tout son peuple, sans en laisser échapper un seul, et ils s''emparèrent de son pays.
verses.am: ፤ እርሱንና ልጆቹን ሕዝቡንም ሁሉ መቱ ሰውም አልቀረለትም፤ ምድሩንም ወረሱ።

verses.en: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan by Jericho.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël partirent, et ils campèrent dans les plaines de Moab, au delà du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ተጓዙ፥ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ባለው በሞዓብ ሜዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.fr: Balak, fils de Tsippor, vit tout ce qu''Israël avait fait aux Amoréens.
verses.am: የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ እስራኤል በአሞራውያን ላይ ያደረገውን ሁሉ አየ።

verses.en: And Moab was sore afraid of the people, because they were many: and Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Et Moab fut très effrayé en face d''un peuple aussi nombreux, il fut saisi de terreur en face des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ብዙም ነበረና ሞዓብ ከሕዝቡ እጅግ ፈራ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች የተነሣ ሞዓብ ደነገጠ።

verses.en: And Moab said unto the elders of Midian, Now shall this company lick up all that are round about us, as the ox licketh up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor was king of the Moabites at that time.
verses.fr: Moab dit aux anciens de Madian: Cette multitude va dévorer tout ce qui nous entoure, comme le boeuf broute la verdure des champs. Balak, fils de Tsippor, était alors roi de Moab.
verses.am: ሞዓብም የምድያምን ሽማግሌዎች። በሬ የለመለመውን ሣር እንደሚጨርስ ይህ ጭፍራ በዙሪያችን ያለውን ሁሉ ይጨርሳል አላቸው። በዚያን ጊዜም የሴፎር ልጅ ባላቅ የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ነበረ።

verses.en: He sent messengers therefore unto Balaam the son of Beor to Pethor, which is by the river of the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, Behold, there is a people come out from Egypt: behold, they cover the face of the earth, and they abide over against me:
verses.fr: Il envoya des messagers auprès de Balaam, fils de Beor, à Pethor sur le fleuve, dans le pays des fils de son peuple, afin de l''appeler et de lui dire: Voici, un peuple est sorti d''Egypte, il couvre la surface de la terre, et il habite vis-à-vis de moi.
verses.am: በወንዙ አጠገብ ባለችው በሕዝቡ ልጆች ምድር በፋቱራ ወደ ተቀመጠው ወደ ቢዖር ልጅ ወደ በለዓም። እነሆ፥ ከግብፅ የወጣ ሕዝብ አለ፤ እነሆም፥ የምድሩን ሁሉ ፊት ሸፈነ፥ በአቅራቢያችንም ተቀምጦአል፤ አሁንም ይህ ሕዝብ ከእኔ ይበልጣልና ልወጋቸውና ከምድሪቱ ላሳድዳቸው እችል እንደ ሆነ፥ እባክህ፥ ና ርገምልኝ፤ አንተ የመረቅኸው ምሩቅ የረገምኸውም ርጉም እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁና ብሎ ይጠሩት ዘንድ መልእክተኞቹን ላከ።

verses.en: Come now therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people; for they are too mighty for me: peradventure I shall prevail, that we may smite them, and that I may drive them out of the land: for I wot that he whom thou blessest is blessed, and he whom thou cursest is cursed.
verses.fr: Viens, je te prie, maudis-moi ce peuple, car il est plus puissant que moi; peut-être ainsi pourrai-je le battre et le chasserai-je du pays, car je sais que celui que tu bénis est béni, et que celui que tu maudis est maudit.
verses.am: በወንዙ አጠገብ ባለችው በሕዝቡ ልጆች ምድር በፋቱራ ወደ ተቀመጠው ወደ ቢዖር ልጅ ወደ በለዓም። እነሆ፥ ከግብፅ የወጣ ሕዝብ አለ፤ እነሆም፥ የምድሩን ሁሉ ፊት ሸፈነ፥ በአቅራቢያችንም ተቀምጦአል፤ አሁንም ይህ ሕዝብ ከእኔ ይበልጣልና ልወጋቸውና ከምድሪቱ ላሳድዳቸው እችል እንደ ሆነ፥ እባክህ፥ ና ርገምልኝ፤ አንተ የመረቅኸው ምሩቅ የረገምኸውም ርጉም እንደ ሆነ አውቃለሁና ብሎ ይጠሩት ዘንድ መልእክተኞቹን ላከ።

verses.en: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand; and they came unto Balaam, and spake unto him the words of Balak.
verses.fr: Les anciens de Moab et les anciens de Madian partirent, ayant avec eux des présents pour le devin. Ils arrivèrent auprès de Balaam, et lui rapportèrent les paroles de Balak.
verses.am: የሞዓብ ሽማግሌዎችና የምድያም ሽማግሌዎችም የምዋርቱን ዋጋ በእጃቸው ይዘው ሄዱ፤ ወደ በለዓምም መጡ፥ የባላቅንም ቃል ነገሩት።

verses.en: And he said unto them, Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the Lord shall speak unto me: and the princes of Moab abode with Balaam.
verses.fr: Balaam leur dit: Passez ici la nuit, et je vous donnerai réponse, d''après ce que l''Eternel me dira. Et les chefs de Moab restèrent chez Balaam.
verses.am: እርሱም። ዛሬ ሌሊት በዚህ እደሩ፥ እግዚአብሔርም እንደሚነግረኝ እመልስላችኋለሁ አላቸው፤ የሞዓብም አለቆች በበለዓም ዘንድ ተቀመጡ።

verses.en: And God came unto Balaam, and said, What men are these with thee?
verses.fr: Dieu vint à Balaam, et dit: Qui sont ces hommes que tu as chez toi?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ በለዓም መጥቶ። እነዚህ በአንተ ዘንድ ያሉ ሰዎች እነማን ናቸው? አለው።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, hath sent unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Balaam répondit à Dieu: Balak, fils de Tsippor, roi de Moab, les a envoyés pour me dire:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በለዓምን። ከእነርሱ ጋር አትሂድ፤ የተባረከ ነውና ሕዝቡን አትረግምም አለው።

verses.en: Behold, there is a people come out of Egypt, which covereth the face of the earth: come now, curse me them; peradventure I shall be able to overcome them, and drive them out.
verses.fr: Voici, un peuple est sorti d''Egypte, et il couvre la surface de la terre; viens donc, maudis-le; peut-être ainsi pourrai-je le combattre, et le chasserai-je.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በለዓምን። ከእነርሱ ጋር አትሂድ፤ የተባረከ ነውና ሕዝቡን አትረግምም አለው።

verses.en: And God said unto Balaam, Thou shalt not go with them; thou shalt not curse the people: for they are blessed.
verses.fr: Dieu dit à Balaam: Tu n''iras point avec eux; tu ne maudiras point ce peuple, car il est béni.
verses.am: በለዓምም ሲነጋ ተነሥቶ የባላቅን አለቆች። ከእናንተ ጋር እሄድ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አልፈቀደምና ወደ ምድራችሁ ሂዱ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and said unto the princes of Balak, Get you into your land: for the Lord refuseth to give me leave to go with you.
verses.fr: Balaam se leva le matin, et il dit aux chefs de Balak: Allez dans votre pays, car l''Eternel refuse de me laisser aller avec vous.
verses.am: የሞዓብ አለቆች ተነሡ፥ ወደ ባላቅም መጥተው። በለዓም ከእኛ ጋር ይመጣ ዘንድ አልፈቀደም አሉት።

verses.en: And the princes of Moab rose up, and they went unto Balak, and said, Balaam refuseth to come with us.
verses.fr: Et les princes de Moab se levèrent, retournèrent auprès de Balak, et dirent: Balaam a refusé de venir avec nous.
verses.am: ባላቅም ደግሞ ከፊተኞች የበዙና የከበሩ ሌሎችን አለቆች ሰደደ።

verses.en: And Balak sent yet again princes, more, and more honourable than they.
verses.fr: Balak envoya de nouveau des chefs en plus grand nombre et plus considérés que les précédents.
verses.am: በለዓምም መልሶ የባላቅን ባሪያዎች። ባላቅ በቤቱ የሞላውን ወርቅና ብር ቢሰጠኝ፥ በትንሹ ወይም በትልቁ ቢሆን የአምላኬን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እተላለፍ ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤

verses.en: And they came to Balaam, and said to him, Thus saith Balak the son of Zippor, Let nothing, I pray thee, hinder thee from coming unto me:
verses.fr: Ils arrivèrent auprès de Balaam, et lui dirent: Ainsi parle Balak, fils de Tsippor: Que l''on ne t''empêche donc pas de venir vers moi;
verses.am: በለዓምም መልሶ የባላቅን ባሪያዎች። ባላቅ በቤቱ የሞላውን ወርቅና ብር ቢሰጠኝ፥ በትንሹ ወይም በትልቁ ቢሆን የአምላኬን የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል እተላለፍ ዘንድ አይቻለኝም፤

verses.en: For I will promote thee unto very great honour, and I will do whatsoever thou sayest unto me: come therefore, I pray thee, curse me this people.
verses.fr: car je te rendrai beaucoup d''honneurs, et je ferai tout ce que tu me diras; viens, je te prie, maudis-moi ce peuple.
verses.am: አሁንም እግዚአብሔር ደግሞ የሚነግረኝን አውቅ ዘንድ፥ እባካችሁ፥ ዛሬ ሌሊት ደግሞ በዚህ እደሩ አላቸው።

verses.en: And Balaam answered and said unto the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the Lord my God, to do less or more.
verses.fr: Balaam répondit et dit aux serviteurs de Balak: Quand Balak me donnerait sa maison pleine d''argent et d''or, je ne pourrais faire aucune chose, ni petite ni grande, contre l''ordre de l''Eternel, mon Dieu.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ወደ በለዓም በሌሊት መጥቶ። ሰዎቹ ይጠሩህ ዘንድ መጥተው እንደ ሆነ፥ ተነሣ ከእነርሱም ጋር ሂድ፤ ነገር ግን የምነግርህን ቃል ብቻ ታደርጋለህ አለው።

verses.en: Now therefore, I pray you, tarry ye also here this night, that I may know what the Lord will say unto me more.
verses.fr: Maintenant, je vous prie, restez ici cette nuit, et je saurai ce que l''Eternel me dira encore.
verses.am: በለዓምም ሲነጋ ተነሣ፥ አህያይቱንም ጭኖ ከሞዓብ አለቆች ጋር ሄደ።

verses.en: And God came unto Balaam at night, and said unto him, If the men come to call thee, rise up, and go with them; but yet the word which I shall say unto thee, that shalt thou do.
verses.fr: Dieu vint à Balaam pendant la nuit, et lui dit: Puisque ces hommes sont venus pour t''appeler, lève-toi, va avec eux; mais tu feras ce que je te dirai.
verses.am: እርሱም ስለ ሄደ እግዚአብሔር ተቈጣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ሊቋቋመው በመንገድ ላይ ቆመ። እርሱም በአህያይቱ ላይ፥ ሁለቱም ሎሌዎቹ ከእርሱ ጋር ነበሩ።

verses.en: And Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his ass, and went with the princes of Moab.
verses.fr: Balaam se leva le matin, sella son ânesse, et partit avec les chefs de Moab.
verses.am: አህያይቱም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ በመንገድ ላይ ቆሞ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ይዞ አየች፤ ከመንገዱም ፈቀቅ ብላ ወደ እርሻው ውስጥ ገባች፤ በለዓምም ወደ መንገድ ይመልሳት ዘንድ አህያይቱን መታት።

verses.en: And God's anger was kindled because he went: and the angel of the Lord stood in the way for an adversary against him. Now he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants were with him.
verses.fr: La colère de Dieu s''enflamma, parce qu''il était parti; et l''ange de l''Eternel se plaça sur le chemin, pour lui résister. Balaam était monté sur son ânesse, et ses deux serviteurs étaient avec lui.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ከወይኑ ቦታዎች መካከል በወዲያና በወዲህ ወገን ግንብ በነበረበት በጠባብ መንገድ ላይ ቆመ።

verses.en: And the ass saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verses.fr: L''ânesse vit l''ange de l''Eternel qui se tenait sur le chemin, son épée nue dans la main; elle se détourna du chemin et alla dans les champs. Balaam frappa l''ânesse pour la ramener dans le chemin.
verses.am: አህያይቱም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ አይታ ወደ ቅጥሩ ተጠጋች፥ የበለዓምንም እግር ከቅጥሩ ጋር አጣበቀች፤ እርሱም ደግሞ መታት።

verses.en: But the angel of the Lord stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel se plaça dans un sentier entre les vignes; il y avait un mur de chaque côté.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ ወደ ፊት ሄደ፥ በቀኝና በግራ መተላለፊያ በሌለበት በጠባብ ስፍራ ቆመ።

verses.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she thrust herself unto the wall, and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall: and he smote her again.
verses.fr: L''ânesse vit l''ange de l''Eternel; elle se serra contre le mur, et pressa le pied de Balaam contre le mur. Balaam la frappa de nouveau.
verses.am: አህያይቱም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ አየች፥ ከበለዓምም በታች ተኛች፤ በለዓምም እጅግ ተቈጣ፥ አህያይቱንም በበትሩ ደበደባት።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord went further, and stood in a narrow place, where was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel passa plus loin, et se plaça dans un lieu où il n''y avait point d''espace pour se détourner à droite ou à gauche.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የአህያይቱን አፍ ከፈተ፥ በለዓምንም። ሦስት ጊዜ የመታኸኝ ምን አድርጌብህ ነው? አለችው።

verses.en: And when the ass saw the angel of the Lord, she fell down under Balaam: and Balaam's anger was kindled, and he smote the ass with a staff.
verses.fr: L''ânesse vit l''ange de l''Eternel, et elle s''abattit sous Balaam. La colère de Balaam s''enflamma, et il frappa l''ânesse avec un bâton.
verses.am: በለዓምም አህያይቱን። ስላላገጥሽብኝ ነው፤ በእጄስ ሰይፍ ቢኖር አሁን በገደልሁሽ ነበር አላት።

verses.en: And the Lord opened the mouth of the ass, and she said unto Balaam, What have I done unto thee, that thou hast smitten me these three times?
verses.fr: L''Eternel ouvrit la bouche de l''ânesse, et elle dit à Balaam: Que t''ai je fait, pour que tu m''aies frappée déjà trois fois?
verses.am: አህያይቱም በለዓምን። ከብዙ ዘመን ጀምሮ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ የምትቀመጥብኝ አህያህ አይደለሁምን? በውኑ እንዲህ አደርግ ዘንድ ልማዴ ነበረን? አለችው። እርሱም። እንዲህ አላደረግሽብኝም አላት።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto the ass, Because thou hast mocked me: I would there were a sword in mine hand, for now would I kill thee.
verses.fr: Balaam répondit à l''ânesse: C''est parce que tu t''es moquée de moi; si j''avais une épée dans la main, je te tuerais à l''instant.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም የበለዓምን ዓይኖች ከፈተ፤ የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ በመንገድ ላይ ቆሞ የተመዘዘም ሰይፍ በእጁ ይዞ አየ፤ ሰገደም፥ በግምባሩም ወደቀ።

verses.en: And the ass said unto Balaam, Am not I thine ass, upon which thou hast ridden ever since I was thine unto this day? was I ever wont to do so unto thee? and he said, Nay.
verses.fr: L''ânesse dit à Balaam: Ne suis-je pas ton ânesse, que tu as de tout temps montée jusqu''à ce jour? Ai-je l''habitude de te faire ainsi? Et il répondit: Non.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ። አህያህን ሦስት ጊዜ ለምን መታህ? እነሆ፥ መንገድህ በፊቴ ጠማማ ነውና እቋቋምህ ዘንድ ወጥቼአለሁ፤

verses.en: Then the Lord opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the angel of the Lord standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and he bowed down his head, and fell flat on his face.
verses.fr: L''Eternel ouvrit les yeux de Balaam, et Balaam vit l''ange de l''Eternel qui se tenait sur le chemin, son épée nue dans la main; et il s''inclina, et se prosterna sur son visage.
verses.am: አህያይቱም አይታኝ ከፊቴ ሦስት ጊዜ ፈቀቅ አለች፤ ከፊቴስ ፈቀቅ ባላለች በእውነት አሁን አንተን በገደልሁህ፥ እርስዋንም ባዳንኋት ነበር አለው።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto him, Wherefore hast thou smitten thine ass these three times? behold, I went out to withstand thee, because thy way is perverse before me:
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel lui dit: Pourquoi as-tu frappé ton ânesse déjà trois fois? Voici, je suis sorti pour te résister, car c''est un chemin de perdition qui est devant moi.
verses.am: በለዓምም የእግዚአብሔርን መልአክ። በድያለሁ፤ አንተ በመንገድ ላይ በፊቴ እንደቆምህብኝ አላወቅሁም፤ እንግዲህም አሁን አትወድድ እንደ ሆነ እመለሳለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And the ass saw me, and turned from me these three times: unless she had turned from me, surely now also I had slain thee, and saved her alive.
verses.fr: L''ânesse m''a vu, et elle s''est détournée devant moi déjà trois fois; si elle ne se fût pas détournée de moi, je t''aurais même tué, et je lui aurais laissé la vie.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም መልአክ በለዓምን። ከሰዎቹ ጋር ሂድ፥ ነገር ግን የምናገርህን ቃል ብቻ ትናገራለህ አለው። በለዓምም ከባላቅ አለቆች ጋር ሄደ።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto the angel of the Lord, I have sinned; for I knew not that thou stoodest in the way against me: now therefore, if it displease thee, I will get me back again.
verses.fr: Balaam dit à l''ange de l''Eternel: J''ai péché, car je ne savais pas que tu te fusses placé au-devant de moi sur le chemin; et maintenant, si tu me désapprouves, je m''en retournerai.
verses.am: ባላቅም በለዓም እንደ መጣ በሰማ ጊዜ በአርኖን ዳር ዳርቻ በመጨረሻ ወዳለችው ወደ ሞዓብ ከተማ ሊገናኘው ወጣ።

verses.en: And the angel of the Lord said unto Balaam, Go with the men: but only the word that I shall speak unto thee, that thou shalt speak. So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.
verses.fr: L''ange de l''Eternel dit à Balaam: Va avec ces hommes; mais tu ne feras que répéter les paroles que je te dirai. Et Balaam alla avec les chefs de Balak.
verses.am: ባላቅም በለዓምን። በውኑ አንተን ለመጥራት አልላክሁብህምን? ለምንስ ወደ እኔ አልመጣህም? በውኑ አንተን ለማክበር እኔ አልችልምን? አለው።

verses.en: And when Balak heard that Balaam was come, he went out to meet him unto a city of Moab, which is in the border of Arnon, which is in the utmost coast.
verses.fr: Balak apprit que Balaam arrivait, et il sortit à sa rencontre jusqu''à la ville de Moab qui est sur la limite de l''Arnon, à l''extrême frontière.
verses.am: በለዓምም ባላቅን። እነሆ፥ ወደ አንተ መጥቼአለሁ፤ በውኑ አሁን አንዳችን ነገር እናገር ዘንድ እችላለሁን? እግዚአብሔር በአፌ የሚያደርገውን ቃል እርሱን እናገራለሁ አለው።

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Did I not earnestly send unto thee to call thee? wherefore camest thou not unto me? am I not able indeed to promote thee to honour?
verses.fr: Balak dit à Balaam: N''ai-je pas envoyé auprès de toi pour t''appeler? Pourquoi n''es-tu pas venu vers moi? Ne puis-je donc pas te traiter avec honneur?
verses.am: በለዓምም ከባላቅ ጋር ሄደ፥ ወደ ቂርያት ሐጾትም መጡ።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Lo, I am come unto thee: have I now any power at all to say any thing? the word that God putteth in my mouth, that shall I speak.
verses.fr: Balaam dit à Balak: Voici, je suis venu vers toi; maintenant, me sera-t-il permis de dire quoi que ce soit? Je dirai les paroles que Dieu mettra dans ma bouche.
verses.am: ባላቅም በሬዎችንና በጎችን አርዶ ወደ በለዓም ከእርሱም ጋር ወዳሉት አለቆች ላከ።

verses.en: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came unto Kirjathhuzoth.
verses.fr: Balaam alla avec Balak, et ils arrivèrent à Kirjath-Hutsoth.
verses.am: በነጋውም ባላቅ በለዓምን ይዞ ወደ በኣል ኮረብታ መስገጃ አወጣው፤ በዚያም ሆኖ የሕዝቡን ዳርቻ አየ።

verses.en: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes that were with him.
verses.fr: Balak sacrifia des boeufs et des brebis, et il en envoya à Balaam et aux chefs qui étaient avec lui.
verses.am: ፤ ባላቅም በሬዎችንና በጎችን አርዶ ወደ በለዓም ከእርሱም ጋር ወዳሉት አለቆች ላከ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, that Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal, that thence he might see the utmost part of the people.
verses.fr: Le matin, Balak prit Balaam, et le fit monter à Bamoth-Baal, d''où Balaam vit une partie du peuple.
verses.am: ፤ በነጋውም ባላቅ በለዓምን ይዞ ወደ በኣል ኮረብታ መስገጃ አወጣው፤ በዚያም ሆኖ የሕዝቡን ዳርቻ አየ።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven oxen and seven rams.
verses.fr: Balaam dit à Balak: Bâtis-moi ici sept autels, et prépare-moi ici sept taureaux et sept béliers.
verses.am: በለዓምም ባላቅን። ሰባት መሠዊያ በዚህ ሥራልኝ፥ ሰባትም ወይፈን ሰባትም አውራ በግ በዚህ አዘጋጅልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.fr: Balak fit ce que Balaam avait dit; et Balak et Balaam offrirent un taureau et un bélier sur chaque autel.
verses.am: ባላቅም በለዓም እንደ ተናገረ አደረገ፤ ባላቅና በለዓምም በየመሠዊያው ላይ አንድ ወይፈንና አንድ አውራ በግ አሳረጉ።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Stand by thy burnt offering, and I will go: peradventure the Lord will come to meet me: and whatsoever he sheweth me I will tell thee. And he went to an high place.
verses.fr: Balaam dit à Balak: Tiens-toi près de ton holocauste, et je m''éloignerai; peut-être que l''Eternel viendra à ma rencontre, et je te dirai ce qu''il me révélera. Et il alla sur un lieu élevé.
verses.am: በለዓምም ባላቅን። በመሥዋዕትህ ዘንድ ቆይ፥ እኔም እሄዳለሁ፤ ምናልባት እግዚአብሔር ሊገናኘኝ ይመጣል፤ እርሱም የሚገልጥልኝን እነግርሃለሁ አለው። ወደ ጉብታም ሄደ።

verses.en: And God met Balaam: and he said unto him, I have prepared seven altars, and I have offered upon every altar a bullock and a ram.
verses.fr: Dieu vint au-devant de Balaam, et Balaam lui dit: J''ai dressé sept autels, et j''ai offert un taureau et un bélier sur chaque autel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከበለዓም ጋር ተገናኘ፤ እርሱም። ሰባት መሠዊያዎች አዘጋጀሁ፥ በየመሠዊያውም ላይ አንድ ወይፈንና አንድ አውራ በግ አሳረግሁ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord put a word in Balaam's mouth, and said, Return unto Balak, and thus thou shalt speak.
verses.fr: L''Eternel mit des paroles dans la bouche de Balaam, et dit: Retourne vers Balak, et tu parleras ainsi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ቃልን በበለዓም አፍ አድርጎ። ወደ ባላቅ ተመለስ፥ እንዲህም በል አለው።

verses.en: And he returned unto him, and, lo, he stood by his burnt sacrifice, he, and all the princes of Moab.
verses.fr: Il retourna vers lui; et voici, Balak se tenait près de son holocauste, lui et tous les chefs de Moab.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም ተመለሰ፥ እነሆም፥ እርሱና የሞዓብ አለቆች ሁሉ በመሥዋዕቱ ዘንድ ቆመው ነበር።

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balak the king of Moab hath brought me from Aram, out of the mountains of the east, saying, Come, curse me Jacob, and come, defy Israel.
verses.fr: Balaam prononça son oracle, et dit: Balak m''a fait descendre d''Aram, Le roi de Moab m''a fait descendre des montagnes de l''Orient. -Viens, maudis-moi Jacob! Viens, sois irrité contre Israël!
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  ባላቅ ከአራም አመጣኝ፥  የሞዓብ ንጉሥ ከምሥራቅ ተራሮች፤  ና፥ ያዕቆብን ርገምልኝ፤  ና፥ እስራኤልን ተጣላልኝ ብሎ።

verses.en: How shall I curse, whom God hath not cursed? or how shall I defy, whom the Lord hath not defied?
verses.fr: Comment maudirais-je celui que Dieu n''a point maudit? Comment serais-je irrité quand l''Eternel n''est point irrité?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ያልረገመውን እንዴት እረግማለሁ?

verses.en: For from the top of the rocks I see him, and from the hills I behold him: lo, the people shall dwell alone, and shall not be reckoned among the nations.
verses.fr: Je le vois du sommet des rochers, Je le contemple du haut des collines: C''est un peuple qui a sa demeure à part, Et qui ne fait point partie des nations.
verses.am: በአምቦች ራስ ላይ ሆኜ አየዋለሁ፥  በኮረብቶችም ላይ ሆኜ እመለከተዋለሁ፤  እነሆ፥ ብቻውን የሚቀመጥ ሕዝብ ነው፥  በአሕዛብም መካከል አይቈጠርም።

verses.en: Who can count the dust of Jacob, and the number of the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous, and let my last end be like his!
verses.fr: Qui peut compter la poussière de Jacob, Et dire le nombre du quart d''Israël? Que je meure de la mort des justes, Et que ma fin soit semblable à la leur!
verses.am: የያዕቆብን ትቢያ ማን ይቈጥራል?  የእስራኤልስ እርቦ ማን ይቈጥራል?  የጻድቃንን ሞት እኔ ልሙት፥  ፍጻሜዬም እንደ እርሱ ፍጻሜ ትሁን።

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, What hast thou done unto me? I took thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast blessed them altogether.
verses.fr: Balak dit à Balaam: Que m''as-tu fait? Je t''ai pris pour maudire mon ennemi, et voici, tu le bénis!
verses.am: ባላቅም በለዓምን። ያደረግህብኝ ምንድር ነው? ጠላቶቼን ትረግምልኝ ዘንድ ጠራሁህ፤ እነሆም፥ ፈጽመህ ባረክሃቸው አለው።

verses.en: And he answered and said, Must I not take heed to speak that which the Lord hath put in my mouth?
verses.fr: Il répondit, et dit: N''aurai-je pas soin de dire ce que l''Eternel met dans ma bouche?
verses.am: እርሱም መልሶ። በውኑ እግዚአብሔር በአፌ ያደረገውን እናገር ዘንድ አልጠነቀቅምን? አለው።

verses.en: And Balak said unto him, Come, I pray thee, with me unto another place, from whence thou mayest see them: thou shalt see but the utmost part of them, and shalt not see them all: and curse me them from thence.
verses.fr: Balak lui dit: Viens donc avec moi dans un autre lieu, d''où tu le verras; tu n''en verras qu''une partie, tu n''en verras pas la totalité. Et de là maudis-le-moi.
verses.am: ባላቅም። በዚያ ሆነህ ታያቸው ዘንድ፥ እባክህ፥ ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ሌላ ቦታ ና ዳርቻቸውንም ብቻ ታያለህ፥ ሁሉን ግን አታይም፤ በዚያም ሆነህ እነርሱን ርገምልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And he brought him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.fr: Il le mena au champ de Tsophim, sur le sommet du Pisga; il bâtit sept autels, et offrit un taureau et un bélier sur chaque autel.
verses.am: ወደ ጾፊምም ሜዳ ወደ ፈስጋ ተራራ ራስ ላይ ወሰደው፤ ሰባትም መሠዊያዎች ሠራ፥ በየመሠዊያውም ላይ አንድ ወይፈን አንድም አውራ በግ አሳረገ።

verses.en: And he said unto Balak, Stand here by thy burnt offering, while I meet the Lord yonder.
verses.fr: Balaam dit à Balak: Tiens-toi ici, près de ton holocauste, et j''irai à la rencontre de Dieu.
verses.am: ባላቅንም። እኔ ወደዚያ ለመገናኘት ስሄድ በዚህ በመሥዋዕትህ ዘንድ ቆይ አለው።

verses.en: And the Lord met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, Go again unto Balak, and say thus.
verses.fr: L''Eternel vint au-devant de Balaam; il mit des paroles dans sa bouche, et dit: Retourne vers Balak, et tu parleras ainsi.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በለዓምን ተገናኘ፥ ቃልንም በአፉ አድርጎ። ወደ ባላቅ ተመለስ፥ እንዲህም በል አለው።

verses.en: And when he came to him, behold, he stood by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. And Balak said unto him, What hath the Lord spoken?
verses.fr: Il retourna vers lui; et voici, Balak se tenait près de son holocauste, avec les chefs de Moab. Balak lui dit: Qu''est-ce que l''Eternel a dit?
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም መጣ፥ እነሆም፥ እርሱ ከእርሱም ጋር የሞዓብ አለቆች በመሥዋዕቱ ዘንድ ቆመው ነበር፤ ባላቅም። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረው ምንድር ነው? አለው።

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Rise up, Balak, and hear; hearken unto me, thou son of Zippor:
verses.fr: Balaam prononça son oracle, et dit: Lève-toi, Balak, écoute! Prête-moi l''oreille, fils de Tsippor!
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  ባላቅ ሆይ፥ ተነሣ፥ ስማ፤  የሴፎር ልጅ ሆይ፥ አድምጠኝ፤

verses.en: God is not a man, that he should lie; neither the son of man, that he should repent: hath he said, and shall he not do it? or hath he spoken, and shall he not make it good?
verses.fr: Dieu n''est point un homme pour mentir, Ni fils d''un homme pour se repentir. Ce qu''il a dit, ne le fera-t-il pas? Ce qu''il a déclaré, ne l''exécutera-t il pas?
verses.am: ሐሰትን ይናገር ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሰው አይደለም፥  ይጸጸትም ዘንድ የሰው ልጅ አይደለም።  እርሱ ያለውን አያደርገውምን?  የተናገረውንስ አይፈጽመውምን?

verses.en: Behold, I have received commandment to bless: and he hath blessed; and I cannot reverse it.
verses.fr: Voici, j''ai reçu l''ordre de bénir: Il a béni, je ne le révoquerai point.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ለመባረክ ትእዛዝን ተቀብያለሁ፤  እርሱ ባርኮአል፥ እመልሰውም ዘንድ አልችልም።

verses.en: He hath not beheld iniquity in Jacob, neither hath he seen perverseness in Israel: the Lord his God is with him, and the shout of a king is among them.
verses.fr: Il n''aperçoit point d''iniquité en Jacob, Il ne voit point d''injustice en Israël; L''Eternel, son Dieu, est avec lui, Il est son roi, l''objet de son allégresse.
verses.am: በያዕቆብ ላይ ክፋትን አልተመለከተም፥  በእስራኤልም ጠማምነትን አላየም፤  አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር ከእርሱ ጋር ነው፥  የንጉሥም እልልታ በመካከላቸው አለ።

verses.en: God brought them out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn.
verses.fr: Dieu les a fait sortir d''Egypte, Il est pour eux comme la vigueur du buffle.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ከግብፅ አውጥቶአቸዋል፤  ጕልበቱ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ነው።

verses.en: Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel: according to this time it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, What hath God wrought!
verses.fr: L''enchantement ne peut rien contre Jacob, Ni la divination contre Israël; Au temps marqué, il sera dit à Jacob et à Israël: Quelle est l''oeuvre de Dieu.
verses.am: በያዕቆብ ላይ አስማት የለም፥  በእስራኤልም ላይ ምዋርት የለም፤  በጊዜው ስለ ያዕቆብና ስለ እስራኤል።  እግዚአብሔር ምን አደረገ! ይባላል።

verses.en: Behold, the people shall rise up as a great lion, and lift up himself as a young lion: he shall not lie down until he eat of the prey, and drink the blood of the slain.
verses.fr: C''est un peuple qui se lève comme une lionne, Et qui se dresse comme un lion; Il ne se couche point jusqu''à ce qu''il ait dévoré la proie, Et qu''il ait bu le sang des blessés.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ ሕዝቡ እንደ እንስት አንበሳ ይቆማል፥  እንደ አንበሳም ይነሣል፤  ያደነውን አስኪበላ፥  የገደለውንም ደሙን እስኪጠጣ አይተኛም።

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.
verses.fr: Balak dit à Balaam: Ne le maudis pas, mais du moins ne le bénis pas.
verses.am: ባላቅም በለዓምን። ከቶ አትርገማቸው፥ ከቶም አትባርካቸው አለው።

verses.en: But Balaam answered and said unto Balak, Told not I thee, saying, All that the Lord speaketh, that I must do?
verses.fr: Balaam répondit, et dit à Balak: Ne t''ai-je pas parlé ainsi: Je ferai tout ce que l''Eternel dira?
verses.am: በለዓምም መልሶ ባላቅን። እግዚአብሔር የተናገረውን ሁሉ አደርጋለሁ ብዬ አልተናገርሁህምን? አለው።

verses.en: And Balak said unto Balaam, Come, I pray thee, I will bring thee unto another place; peradventure it will please God that thou mayest curse me them from thence.
verses.fr: Balak dit à Balaam: Viens donc, je te mènerai dans un autre lieu; peut être Dieu trouvera-t-il bon que de là tu me maudisses ce peuple.
verses.am: ባላቅም በለዓምን። ና፥ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ እወስድሃለሁ፤ ምናልባት በዚህ ሆነህ እነርሱን ትረግምልኝ ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ይወድዳል አለው።

verses.en: And Balak brought Balaam unto the top of Peor, that looketh toward jeshimon.
verses.fr: Balak mena Balaam sur le sommet du Peor, en regard du désert.
verses.am: ባላቅም ምድረ በዳውን ከላይ ወደሚመለከተው ወደ ፌጎር ላይ በለዓምን ወሰደው።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Build me here seven altars, and prepare me here seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.fr: Balaam dit à Balak: Bâtis-moi ici sept autels, et prépare-moi ici sept taureaux et sept béliers.
verses.am: በለዓምም ባላቅን። በዚህ ሰባት መሠዊያዎች ሥራልኝ፥ በዚህም ሰባት ወይፈን ሰባትም አውራ በግ አዘጋጅልኝ አለው።

verses.en: And Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered a bullock and a ram on every altar.
verses.fr: Balak fit ce que Balaam avait dit, et il offrit un taureau et un bélier sur chaque autel.
verses.am: ባላቅም በለዓም እንዳለው አደረገ፥ በየመሠዊያውም ላይ አንድ ወይፈንና አንድ አውራ በግ አሳረገ።

verses.en: And when Balaam saw that it pleased the Lord to bless Israel, he went not, as at other times, to seek for enchantments, but he set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.fr: Balaam vit que l''Eternel trouvait bon de bénir Israël, et il n''alla point comme les autres fois, à la rencontre des enchantements; mais il tourna son visage du côté du désert.
verses.am: በለዓምም እግዚአብሔር እስራኤልን ይባርክ ዘንድ እንዲወድድ ባየ ጊዜ፥ አስቀድሞ ያደርግ የነበረውን አስማት ይሻ ዘንድ አልሄደም፤ ነገር ግን ወደ ምድረ በዳ ፊቱን አቀና።

verses.en: And Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel abiding in his tents according to their tribes; and the spirit of God came upon him.
verses.fr: Balaam leva les yeux, et vit Israël campé selon ses tribus. Alors l''esprit de Dieu fut sur lui.
verses.am: በለዓምም ዓይኑን አንሥቶ እስራኤል በየነገዱ ተቀምጦ አየ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ በላዩ መጣ።

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.fr: Balaam prononça son oracle, et dit: Parole de Balaam, fils de Beor, Parole de l''homme qui a l''oeil ouvert,
verses.am: ምሳሌውን ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  የቢዖር ልጅ በለዓም እንዲህ ይላል፥  ዓይኖቹ የተከፈቱለት ሰው እንዲህ ይላል፤

verses.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.fr: Parole de celui qui entend les paroles de Dieu, De celui qui voit la vision du Tout-Puissant, De celui qui se prosterne et dont les yeux s''ouvrent.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የሚሰማ፥  ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክን ራእይ የሚያይ፥  የወደቀው፥ ዓይኖቹም የተከፈቱለት እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verses.fr: Qu''elles sont belles, tes tentes, ô Jacob! Tes demeures, ô Israël!
verses.am: ያዕቆብ ሆይ፥ ድንኳኖችህ፥  እስራኤል ሆይ ማደሪያዎችህ ምንኛ ያምራሉ!

verses.en: As the valleys are they spread forth, as gardens by the river's side, as the trees of lign aloes which the Lord hath planted, and as cedar trees beside the waters.
verses.fr: Elles s''étendent comme des vallées, Comme des jardins près d''un fleuve, Comme des aloès que l''Eternel a plantés, Comme des cèdres le long des eaux.
verses.am: እንደ ሸለቆች፥  በወንዝ ዳር እንዳሉ አትክልቶች፥  እግዚአብሔር እንደ ተከለው እሬት  በውኃም ዳር እንዳሉ ዝግባዎች ተዘርግተዋል።

verses.en: He shall pour the water out of his buckets, and his seed shall be in many waters, and his king shall be higher than Agag, and his kingdom shall be exalted.
verses.fr: L''eau coule de ses seaux, Et sa semence est fécondée par d''abondantes eaux. Son roi s''élève au-dessus d''Agag, Et son royaume devient puissant.
verses.am: ከማድጋዎቹ ውኃ ይፈስሳል፥  ዘሩም በብዙ ውኆች ይሆናል፥  ንጉሡም ከአጋግ ይልቅ ከፍ ከፍ ይላል፥ መንግሥቱም ይከበራል።

verses.en: God brought him forth out of Egypt; he hath as it were the strength of an unicorn: he shall eat up the nations his enemies, and shall break their bones, and pierce them through with his arrows.
verses.fr: Dieu l''a fait sortir d''Egypte, Il est pour lui comme la vigueur du buffle. Il dévore les nations qui s''élèvent contre lui, Il brise leurs os, et les abat de ses flèches.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከግብፅ አውጥቶታል፤  ጕልበቱ አንድ ቀንድ እንዳለው ነው፤  ጠላቶቹን አሕዛብን ይበላል፥  አጥንቶቻቸውንም ይሰባብራል፥  በፍላጾቹም ይወጋቸዋል።

verses.en: He couched, he lay down as a lion, and as a great lion: who shall stir him up? Blessed is he that blesseth thee, and cursed is he that curseth thee.
verses.fr: Il ploie les genoux, il se couche comme un lion, comme une lionne: Qui le fera lever? Béni soit quiconque te bénira, Et maudit soit quiconque te maudira!
verses.am: እንደ አንበሳ ዐርፎ ተኝቶአል፥  እንደ እንስቲቱም አንበሳ ተጋድሞአል፤  ማን ያስነሣዋል?  የሚመርቅህ ሁሉ የተመረቀ ይሁን፥  የሚረግምህም ሁሉ የተገመ ይሁን።

verses.en: And Balak's anger was kindled against Balaam, and he smote his hands together: and Balak said unto Balaam, I called thee to curse mine enemies, and, behold, thou hast altogether blessed them these three times.
verses.fr: La colère de Balak s''enflamma contre Balaam; il frappa des mains, et dit à Balaam: C''est pour maudire mes ennemis que je t''ai appelé, et voici, tu les as bénis déjà trois fois.
verses.am: የባላቅም ቍጣ በበለዓም ላይ ነደደ፤ እጆቹንም አጨበጨበ፤ ባላቅም በለዓምን። ጠላቶቼን ትረግም ዘንድ ጠራሁህ፥ እነሆም፥ ሦስት ጊዜ ፈጽመህ መረቅሃቸው፤ አሁንም እንግዲህ ወደ ስፍራህ ሽሽ፤

verses.en: Therefore now flee thou to thy place: I thought to promote thee unto great honour; but, lo, the Lord hath kept thee back from honour.
verses.fr: Fuis maintenant, va-t''en chez toi! J''avais dit que je te rendrais des honneurs, mais l''Eternel t''empêche de les recevoir.
verses.am: እኔ አከብርህ ዘንድ ወድጄ ነበር፤ እግዚአብሔር ግን፥ እነሆ፥ ክብርህን ከለከለ አለው።

verses.en: And Balaam said unto Balak, Spake I not also to thy messengers which thou sentest unto me, saying,
verses.fr: Balaam répondit à Balak: Eh! n''ai-je pas dit aux messagers que tu m''as envoyés:
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ወደ ሕዝቤ እሄዳለሁ፤ ና፥ ይህ ሕዝብ በኋለኛው ዘመን በሕዝብህ ላይ የሚያደርገውን እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.en: If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the commandment of the Lord, to do either good or bad of mine own mind; but what the Lord saith, that will I speak?
verses.fr: Quand Balak me donnerait sa maison pleine d''argent et d''or, je ne pourrais faire de moi-même ni bien ni mal contre l''ordre de l''Eternel; je répéterai ce que dira l''Eternel?
verses.am: አሁንም፥ እነሆ፥ ወደ ሕዝቤ እሄዳለሁ፤ ና፥ ይህ ሕዝብ በኋለኛው ዘመን በሕዝብህ ላይ የሚያደርገውን እነግርሃለሁ።

verses.en: And now, behold, I go unto my people: come therefore, and I will advertise thee what this people shall do to thy people in the latter days.
verses.fr: Et maintenant voici, je m''en vais vers mon peuple. Viens, je t''annoncerai ce que ce peuple fera à ton peuple dans la suite des temps.
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  የቢዖር ልጅ በለዓም እንዲህ ይላል፥  ዓይኖቹም የተከፈቱለት ሰው እንዲህ ይላል፤

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Balaam the son of Beor hath said, and the man whose eyes are open hath said:
verses.fr: Balaam prononça son oracle, et dit: Parole de Balaam, fils de Beor, Parole de l''homme qui a l''oeil ouvert,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል የሚሰማ፥  የልዑልንም እውቀት የሚያውቅ፥  ሁሉን የሚችል የአምላክን ራእይ የሚያይ፥  የወደቀው፥ ዓይኖቹም የተከፈቱለት እንዲህ ይላል።

verses.en: He hath said, which heard the words of God, and knew the knowledge of the most High, which saw the vision of the Almighty, falling into a trance, but having his eyes open:
verses.fr: Parole de celui qui entend les paroles de Dieu, De celui qui connaît les desseins du Très-Haut, De celui qui voit la vision du Tout-Puissant, De celui qui se prosterne et dont les yeux s''ouvrent.
verses.am: አየዋለሁ፥ አሁን ግን አይደለም፤  እመለከተዋለሁ፥ በቅርብ ግን አይደለም፤  ከያዕቆብ ኮከብ ይወጣል፥  ከእስራኤል በትር ይነሣል፥  የሞዓብንም ማዕዘኖች ይመታል፥  የሤትንም ልጆች ያጠፋል።

verses.en: I shall see him, but not now: I shall behold him, but not nigh: there shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel, and shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth.
verses.fr: Je le vois, mais non maintenant, Je le contemple, mais non de près. Un astre sort de Jacob, Un sceptre s''élève d''Israël. Il perce les flancs de Moab, Et il abat tous les enfants de Seth.
verses.am: ኤዶምያስም ርስቱ ይሆናል፥  ጠላቱ ሴይር ደግሞ ርስቱ ይሆናል፤  እስራኤልም በኃይል ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And Edom shall be a possession, Seir also shall be a possession for his enemies; and Israel shall do valiantly.
verses.fr: Il se rend maître d''Edom, Il se rend maître de Séir, ses ennemis. Israël manifeste sa force.
verses.am: ከያዕቆብም የሚወጣ ገዥ ይሆናል፥  ከከተማውም የቀሩትን ያጠፋል።

verses.en: Out of Jacob shall come he that shall have dominion, and shall destroy him that remaineth of the city.
verses.fr: Celui qui sort de Jacob règne en souverain, Il fait périr ceux qui s''échappent des villes.
verses.am: አማሌቅንም አይቶ ምሳሌውን ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  አማሌቅ የአሕዛብ አለቃ ነበረ፤  ፍጻሜው ግን ወደ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.en: And when he looked on Amalek, he took up his parable, and said, Amalek was the first of the nations; but his latter end shall be that he perish for ever.
verses.fr: Balaam vit Amalek. Il prononça son oracle, et dit: Amalek est la première des nations, Mais un jour il sera détruit.
verses.am: ቄናውያንንም አይቶ ምሳሌውን ይምስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  ማደሪያህ የጸና ነው፥  ጎጆህም በአምባ ላይ ተሠርቶአል፤

verses.en: And he looked on the Kenites, and took up his parable, and said, Strong is thy dwellingplace, and thou puttest thy nest in a rock.
verses.fr: Balaam vit les Kéniens. Il prononça son oracle, et dit: Ta demeure est solide, Et ton nid posé sur le roc.
verses.am: ነገር ግን አሦር እስኪማርክህ ድረስ ቄናዊው ለጥፋት ይሆናል።

verses.en: Nevertheless the Kenite shall be wasted, until Asshur shall carry thee away captive.
verses.fr: Mais le Kénien sera chassé, Quand l''Assyrien t''emmènera captif.
verses.am: ምሳሌውንም ይመስል ጀመር፥ እንዲህም አለ።  እግዚአብሔር ይህን ሲያደርግ  አወይ! ማን በሕይወት ይኖራል?

verses.en: And he took up his parable, and said, Alas, who shall live when God doeth this!
verses.fr: Balaam prononça son oracle, et dit: Hélas! qui vivra après que Dieu l''aura établi?
verses.am: ከኪቲም ዳርቻ መርከቦች ይመጣሉ፥  አሦርንም ያስጨንቃሉ፥  ዔቦርንም ያስጨንቃሉ፤  እርሱም ደግሞ ወደ ጥፋት ይመጣል።

verses.en: And ships shall come from the coast of Chittim, and shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber, and he also shall perish for ever.
verses.fr: Mais des navires viendront de Kittim, Ils humilieront l''Assyrien, ils humilieront l''Hébreu; Et lui aussi sera détruit.
verses.am: በለዓምም ተነሣ፥ ተመልሶም ወደ ስፍራው ሄደ፤ ባላቅም ደግሞ መንገዱን ሄደ።

verses.en: And Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place: and Balak also went his way.
verses.fr: Balaam se leva, partit, et retourna chez lui. Balak s''en alla aussi de son côté.
verses.am: ፤ በለዓምም ተነሣ፥ ተመልሶም ወደ ስፍራው ሄደ፤ ባላቅም ደግሞ መንገዱን ሄደ።

verses.en: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
verses.fr: Israël demeurait à Sittim; et le peuple commença à se livrer à la débauche avec les filles de Moab.
verses.am: እስራኤልም በሰጢም ተቀመጡ፤ ሕዝቡም ከሞዓብ ልጆች ጋር ያመነዝሩ ጀመር።

verses.en: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
verses.fr: Elles invitèrent le peuple aux sacrifices de leurs dieux; et le peuple mangea, et se prosterna devant leurs dieux.
verses.am: ሕዝቡንም ወደ አምላኮቻቸው መሥዋዕት ጠሩ፤ ሕዝቡም በሉ፥ ወደ አምላኮቻቸውም ሰገዱ።

verses.en: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the Lord was kindled against Israel.
verses.fr: Israël s''attacha à Baal-Peor, et la colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Israël.
verses.am: እስራኤልም ብዔልፌጎርን ተከተለ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ነደደ።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the Lord against the sun, that the fierce anger of the Lord may be turned away from Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Assemble tous les chefs du peuple, et fais pendre les coupables devant l''Eternel en face du soleil, afin que la colère ardente de l''Eternel se détourne d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን። የእግዚአብሔር የቍጣው ጽናት ከእስራኤል እንዲመለስ የሕዝቡን አለቆች ሁሉ ወስደህ በፀሐዩ ፊት ወደ እግዚአብሔር ስቀላቸው አለው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
verses.fr: Moïse dit aux juges d''Israël: Que chacun de vous tue ceux de ses gens qui se sont attachés à Baal-Peor.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ዳኞች። እናንተ ሁሉ ብዔልፌጎርን የተከተሉትን ሰዎቻችሁን ግደሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Et voici, un homme des enfants d''Israël vint et amena vers ses frères une Madianite, sous les yeux de Moïse et sous les yeux de toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, tandis qu''ils pleuraient à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች አንዱ መጥቶ በሙሴና በእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ ፊት ምድያማዊቱን አንዲቱን ሴት ወደ ወንድሞቹ አመጣት፤ እነርሱም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ያለቅሱ ነበር።

verses.en: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
verses.fr: A cette vue, Phinées, fils d''Eléazar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron, se leva du milieu de l''assemblée, et prit une lance, dans sa main.
verses.am: የካህኑም የአሮን ልጅ የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ ባየው ጊዜ ከማኅበሩ መካከል ተነሥቶ በእጁ ጦር አነሣ፤

verses.en: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il suivit l''homme d''Israël dans sa tente, et il les perça tous les deux, l''homme d''Israël, puis la femme, par le bas-ventre. Et la plaie s''arrêta parmi les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ያንንም የእስራኤልን ሰው ተከትሎ ወደ ድንኳኑ ገባ። እስራኤላዊውንም ሰውና ሴቲቱን ሁለቱን ሆዳቸውን ወጋቸው። ከእስራኤልም ልጆች መቅሠፍቱ ተከለከለ።

verses.en: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
verses.fr: Il y en eut vingt-quatre mille qui moururent de la plaie.
verses.am: በመቅሠፍትም የሞተው ሀያ አራት ሺህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
verses.fr: Phinées, fils d''Eléazar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron, a détourné ma fureur de dessus les enfants d''Israël, parce qu''il a été animé de mon zèle au milieu d''eux; et je n''ai point, dans ma colère, consumé les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የካህኑ የአሮን ልጅ የአልዓዛር ልጅ ፊንሐስ በቅንዓቴ በመካከላቸው ቀንቶአልና ቍጣዬን ከእስራኤል ልጆች መለሰ፤ እኔም የእስራኤልን ልጆች በቅንዓቴ አላጠፋሁም።

verses.en: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi tu diras que je traite avec lui une alliance de paix.
verses.am: ስለዚህ፥ እነሆ፥ የሰላሜን ቃል ኪዳን እሰጠዋለሁ።

verses.en: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Ce sera pour lui et pour sa postérité après lui l''alliance d''un sacerdoce perpétuel, parce qu''il a été zélé pour son Dieu, et qu''il a fait l''expiation pour les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ለአምላኩም ቀንቶአልና፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች አስተስርዮአልና ለእርሱ ከእርሱም በኋላ ለዘሩ ለዘላለም ክህነት ቃል ኪዳን ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
verses.fr: L''homme d''Israël, qui fut tué avec la Madianite, s''appelait Zimri, fils de Salu; il était chef d''une maison paternelle des Siméonites.
verses.am: ከምድያማዊቱም ጋር የተገደለው የእስራኤላዊው ሰው ስም ዘንበሪ ነበረ፤ የአባቱ ቤት አለቃ የስምዖናውያን የሆነ የሰሉ ልጅ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
verses.fr: La femme qui fut tuée, la Madianite, s''appelait Cozbi, fille de Tsur, chef des peuplades issues d''une maison paternelle en Madian.
verses.am: የተገደለችውም ምድያማዊት ስምዋ ከስቢ ነበረ፤ እርስዋም የሱር ልጅ ነበረች፤ እርሱም በምድያም ዘንድ የአባቱ ቤት ወገን አለቃ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
verses.fr: Traite les Madianites en ennemis, et tuez-les;
verses.am: በፌጎር በመቅሠፍቱ ቀን ስለተገደለችው ስለ ምድያም አለቃ ልጅ ስለ እኅታቸው ስለ ከስቢ በፌጎር ምክንያት በሸነገሉአችሁ ሽንገላ አስጨንቀዋችኋልና ምድያማውያንን አስጨንቁአቸው ግደሉአቸውም።

verses.en: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor's sake.
verses.fr: car ils se sont montrés vos ennemis, en vous séduisant par leurs ruses, dans l''affaire de Peor, et dans l''affaire de Cozbi, fille d''un chef de Madian, leur soeur, tuée le jour de la plaie qui eut lieu à l''occasion de Peor.
verses.am: በፌጎር በመቅሠፍቱ ቀን ስለተገደለችው ስለ ምድያም አለቃ ልጅ ስለ እኅታቸው ስለ ከስቢ በፌጎር ምክንያት በሸነገሉአችሁ ሽንገላ አስጨንቀዋችኋልና ምድያማውያንን አስጨንቁአቸው ግደሉአቸውም።

verses.en: And it came to pass after the plague, that the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,
verses.fr: A la suite de cette plaie, l''Eternel dit à Moïse et à Eléazar, fils du sacrificateur Aaron:
verses.am: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ መቅሠፍቱ ከሆነ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴንና የካህኑን የአሮን ልጅ አልዓዛርን።

verses.en: Take the sum of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, throughout their fathers' house, all that are able to go to war in Israel.
verses.fr: Faites le dénombrement de toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, selon les maisons de leurs pères, de tous ceux d''Israël en état de porter les armes.
verses.am: ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን፥ በእስራኤል ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጣውን ሁሉ፥ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት ቍጠሩ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest spake with them in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.fr: Moïse et le sacrificateur Eléazar leur parlèrent dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho. Ils dirent:
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛር በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ።
