verses.en: Take the sum of the people, from twenty years old and upward; as the Lord commanded Moses and the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: On fera le dénombrement, depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse et aux enfants d''Israël, quand ils furent sortis du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ከግብፅም ምድር የወጡትን የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዳዘዛቸው፥ ከሀያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያለውን ሕዝቡን ቍጠሩ ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: Reuben, the eldest son of Israel: the children of Reuben; Hanoch, of whom cometh the family of the Hanochites: of Pallu, the family of the Palluites:
verses.fr: Ruben, premier-né d''Israël. Fils de Ruben: Hénoc de qui descend la famille des Hénokites; Pallu, de qui descend la famille des Palluites;
verses.am: የእስራኤል በኵር ሮቤል፤ የሮቤል ልጆች፤ ከሄኖኅ የሄኖኀውያን ወገን፥ ከፈሉስ የፈሉሳውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: Of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.
verses.fr: Hetsron, de qui descend la famille des Hetsronites; Carmi, de qui descend la famille des Carmites.
verses.am: ከአስሮን የአስሮናውያን ወገን፥ ከከርሚ የከርማውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of the Reubenites: and they that were numbered of them were forty and three thousand and seven hundred and thirty.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles des Rubénites: ceux dont on fit le dénombrement furent quarante-trois mille sept cent trente. -
verses.am: እነዚህ የሮቤላውያን ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ ሦስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the sons of Pallu; Eliab.
verses.fr: Fils de Pallu: Eliab.
verses.am: የፈሉስም ልጆች፤ ኤልያብ።

verses.en: And the sons of Eliab; Nemuel, and Dathan, and Abiram. This is that Dathan and Abiram, which were famous in the congregation, who strove against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah, when they strove against the Lord:
verses.fr: Fils d''Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan et Abiram. C''est ce Dathan et cet Abiram, qui étaient de ceux que l''on convoquait à l''assemblée, et qui se soulevèrent contre Moïse et Aaron, dans l''assemblée de Koré, lors de leur révolte contre l''Eternel.
verses.am: የኤልያብም ልጆች፤ ነሙኤል፥ ዳታን፥ አቤሮን፤ እነዚህ ዳታንና አቤሮን ከማኅበሩ የተመረጡ ነበሩ፤ ከቆሬ ወገን ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ላይ ባመፁ ጊዜ ሙሴንና አሮንን ተጣሉ፤

verses.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah, when that company died, what time the fire devoured two hundred and fifty men: and they became a sign.
verses.fr: La terre ouvrit sa bouche, et les engloutit avec Koré, quand moururent ceux qui s''étaient assemblés, et que le feu consuma les deux cent cinquante hommes: ils servirent au peuple d''avertissement.
verses.am: ያም ወገን በሞተ ጊዜ ምድሪቱ አፍዋን ከፍታ ከቆሬ ጋር ዋጠቻቸው፤ በዚያም ጊዜ እሳቲቱ ሁለት መቶ አምሳውን ሰዎች አቃጠለቻቸው፤ እነርሱም ለምልክት ሆኑ።

verses.en: Notwithstanding the children of Korah died not.
verses.fr: Les fils de Koré ne moururent pas.
verses.am: የቆሬ ልጆች ግን አልሞቱም።

verses.en: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites: of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites: of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites:
verses.fr: Fils de Siméon, selon leurs familles: de Nemuel descend la famille des Nemuélites; de Jamin, la famille des Jaminites; de Jakin, la famille des Jakinites;
verses.am: የስምዖን ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከነሙኤል የነሙኤላውያን ወገን፥ ከያሚን የያሚናውያን ወገን፥ ከያኪን የያኪናውያን ወገን፥ ከዛራ የዛራውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: Of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites: of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.
verses.fr: de Zérach, la famille des Zérachites; de Saül, la famille des Saülites.
verses.am: ከሳኡል የሳኡላውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty and two thousand and two hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles des Siméonites; vingt-deux mille deux cents.
verses.am: እነዚህ የስምዖናውያን ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ሀያ ሁለት ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The children of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites: of Haggi, the family of the Haggites: of Shuni, the family of the Shunites:
verses.fr: Fils de Gad, selon leurs familles: de Tsephon descend la famille des Tsephonites; de Haggi, la famille des Haggites; de Schuni, la famille des Schunites;
verses.am: የጋድ ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከጽፎን የጽፎናውያን ወገን፥ ከሐጊ የሐጋውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: Of Ozni, the family of the Oznites: of Eri, the family of the Erites:
verses.fr: d''Ozni, la famille des Oznites; d''Eri, la famille des Erites;
verses.am: ከሹኒ የሹናውያን ወገን፥ ከኤስናን የኤስናናውያን ወገን፥ ከዔሪ የዔራውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: Of Arod, the family of the Arodites: of Areli, the family of the Arelites.
verses.fr: d''Arod, la famille des Arodites; d''Areéli, la famille des Areélites.
verses.am: ከአሮድ የአሮዳውያን ወገን፥ ከአርኤሊ የአርኤላውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of the children of Gad according to those that were numbered of them, forty thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles des fils de Gad, d''après leur dénombrement: quarante mille cinq cents.
verses.am: እነዚህ የጋድ ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Judah were Er and Onan: and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Fils de Juda: Er et Onan; mais Er et Onan moururent au pays de Canaan.
verses.am: የይሁዳ ልጆች ዔርና አውናን፤ ዔርና አውናንም በከነዓን ምድር ሞቱ።

verses.en: And the sons of Judah after their families were; of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites: of Pharez, the family of the Pharzites: of Zerah, the family of the Zarhites.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Juda, selon leurs familles: de Schéla descend la famille des Schélanites; de Pérets, la famille des Péretsites; de Zérach, la famille des Zérachites.
verses.am: የይሁዳም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከሴሎም የሴሎማውያን ወገን፥ ከፋሬስ የፋሬሳውያን ወገን፥ ከዛራ የዛራውያን ወገን።

verses.en: And the sons of Pharez were; of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites: of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.
verses.fr: Les fils de Pérets furent: Hetsron, de qui descend la famille des Hetsronites; Hamul, de qui descend la famille des Hamulites.
verses.am: የፋሬስም ልጆች፤ ከኤስሮም የኤስሮማውያን ወገን፥ ከሐሙል የሐሙላውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles de Juda, d''après leur dénombrement: soixante-seize mille cinq cents.
verses.am: እነዚህ የይሁዳ ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ሰባ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites: of Pua, the family of the Punites:
verses.fr: Fils d''Issacar, selon leurs familles: de Thola descend la famille des Tholaïtes; de Puva, la famille des Puvites;
verses.am: የይሳኮር ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከቶላ የቶላውያን ወገን፥ ከፉዋ የፉዋውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: Of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites: of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.
verses.fr: de Jaschub, la famille des Jaschubites; de Schimron, la famille des Schimronites.
verses.am: ከያሱብ የያሱባውያን ወገን፥ ከሺምሮን የሺምሮናውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of Issachar according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and four thousand and three hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles d''Issacar, d''après leur dénombrement: soixante quatre mille trois cents.
verses.am: እነዚህ የይሳኮር ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ስድሳ አራት ሺህ ሦስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Sardites: of Elon, the family of the Elonites: of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.
verses.fr: Fils de Zabulon, selon leurs familles: de Séred descend la famille des Sardites; d''Elon, la famille des Elonites; de Jahleel, la famille des Jahleélites.
verses.am: የዛብሎን ወገኖች በየወገናቸው፤ ከሴሬድ የሴሬዳውያን ወገን፥ ከኤሎን የኤሎናውያን ወገን፥ ከያሕልኤል የያሕልኤላውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those that were numbered of them, threescore thousand and five hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles des Zabulonites, d''après leur dénombrement: soixante mille cinq cents.
verses.am: እነዚህ የዛብሎናውያን ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ስድሳ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: The sons of Joseph after their families were Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.fr: Fils de Joseph, selon leurs familles: Manassé et Ephraïm.
verses.am: የዮሴፍ ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ምናሴና ኤፍሬም።

verses.en: Of the sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites: and Machir begat Gilead: of Gilead come the family of the Gileadites.
verses.fr: Fils de Manassé: de Makir descend la famille des Makirites. -Makir engendra Galaad. De Galaad descend la famille des Galaadites.
verses.am: የምናሴ ልጆች፤ ከማኪር የማኪራውያን ወገን፤ ማኪርም ገለዓድን ወለደ፤ ከገለዓድ የገልዓዳውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the sons of Gilead: of Jeezer, the family of the Jeezerites: of Helek, the family of the Helekites:
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Galaad: Jézer, de qui descend la famille des Jézerites; Hélek, la famille des Hélekites;
verses.am: የገለዓድ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከኢዔዝር የኢዔዝራውያን ወገን፥ ከኬሌግ የኬሌጋውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: And of Asriel, the family of the Asrielites: and of Shechem, the family of the Shechemites:
verses.fr: Asriel, la famille des Asriélites; Sichem, la famille des Sichémites;
verses.am: ከአሥሪኤል የአሥሪኤላውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: And of Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites: and of Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.
verses.fr: Schemida, la famille des Schemidaïtes; Hépher, la famille des Héphrites.
verses.am: ከሴኬም የሴኬማውያን ወገን፥ ከሸሚዳ የሸሚዳውያን ወገን፥ ከኦፌር የኦፌራውያን ወገን።

verses.en: And Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, and Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.fr: Tselophchad, fils de Hépher, n''eut point de fils, mais il eut des filles. Voici les noms des filles de Tselophchad: Machla, Noa, Hogla, Milca et Thirtsa.
verses.am: የኦፌርም ልጅ ሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች እንጂ ወንዶች ልጆች አልነበሩትም፤ የሰለጰዓድም የሴቶች ልጆቹ ስም ማህለህ፥ ኑዓ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ቲርጻ ነበረ።

verses.en: These are the families of Manasseh, and those that were numbered of them, fifty and two thousand and seven hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles de Manassé, d''après leur dénombrement: cinquante-deux mille sept cents.
verses.am: እነዚህ የምናሴ ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሁለት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthalhites: of Becher, the family of the Bachrites: of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.
verses.fr: Voici les fils d''Ephraïm, selon leurs familles: de Schutélach descend la famille des Schutalchites; de Béker, la famille des Bakrites; de Thachan, la famille des Thachanites. -
verses.am: በየወገናቸው የኤፍሬም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከሱቱላ የሱቱላውያን ወገን፥ ከቤኬር የቤኬራውያን ወገን፥ ከታሐን የታሐናውያን ወገን።

verses.en: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Schutélach: d''Eran est descendue la famille des Eranites.
verses.am: እነዚህ የሱቱላ ልጆች ናቸው፤ ከዔዴን የዔዴናውያን ወገን። ከዔዴን የዔዴናውያና ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those that were numbered of them, thirty and two thousand and five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles des fils d''Ephraïm, d''après leur dénombrement: trente-deux mille cinq cents. Ce sont là les fils de Joseph, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: እነዚህ የኤፍሬም ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ። በየወገናቸው የዮሴፍ ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites: of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites: of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites:
verses.fr: Fils de Benjamin, selon leurs familles: de Béla descend la famille des Balites; d''Aschbel, la famille des Aschbélites; d''Achiram, la famille des Achiramites;
verses.am: የብንያም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከቤላ የቤላውያን ወገን፥ ከአስቤል የአስቤላውያን ወገን፥ ከአኪራን የአኪራናውያን ወገን፥ ከሶፋን የሶፋናውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: Of Shupham, the family of the Shuphamites: of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.
verses.fr: de Schupham, la famille des Schuphamites; de Hupham, la famille des Huphamites. -
verses.am: ከሑፋም የሑፋማውያን ወገን።

verses.en: And the sons of Bela were ard and Naaman: of Ard, the family of the Ardites: and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.
verses.fr: Les fils de Béla furent: Ard et Naaman. D''Ard descend la famille des Ardites; de Naaman, la famille des Naamanites.
verses.am: የቤላም ልጆች፤ አርድና ናዕማን፤ ከአርድ የአርዳውያን ወገን፥ ከናዕማን የናዕማናውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and six hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les fils de Benjamin, selon leurs familles et d''après leur dénombrement; quarante-cinq mille six cents.
verses.am: በየወገናቸው የብንያም ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ አምስት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.
verses.fr: Voici les fils de Dan, selon leurs familles: de Schucham descend la famille des Schuchamites. Ce sont là les familles de Dan, selon leurs familles.
verses.am: በየወገናቸው የዳን ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከሰምዔ የሰምዔያውያን ወገን፤ በየወገናቸው የዳን ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those that were numbered of them, were threescore and four thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: Total pour les familles des Schuchamites, d''après leur dénombrement: soixante-quatre mille quatre cents.
verses.am: የሰምዔያውያን ወገኖች ሁሉ ከእነርሱ እንደ ተቈጠሩ ስድሳ አራት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the children of Asher after their families: of Jimna, the family of the Jimnites: of Jesui, the family of the Jesuites: of Beriah, the family of the Beriites.
verses.fr: Fils d''Aser, selon leurs familles: de Jimna descend la famille des Jimnites; de Jischvi, la famille des Jischvites; de Beria, la famille des Beriites.
verses.am: የአሴር ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከዪምና የዪምናውያን ወገን፥ ከየሱዋ የየሱዋውያን ወገን፥ ከበሪዓ የበሪዓውያን ወገን።

verses.en: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites: of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.
verses.fr: Des fils de Beria descendent: de Héber, la famille des Hébrites; de Malkiel, la famille des Malkiélites.
verses.am: ከበሪዓ ልጆች፤ ከሔቤር የሔቤራውያን ወገን፥ ከመልኪኤል የመልኪኤላውያን ወገን።

verses.en: And the name of the daughter of Asher was Sarah.
verses.fr: Le nom de la fille d''Aser était Sérach.
verses.am: የአሴርም የሴት ልጁ ስም ሤራሕ ነበረ።

verses.en: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those that were numbered of them; who were fifty and three thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles des fils d''Aser, d''après leur dénombrement: cinquante-trois mille quatre cents.
verses.am: እነዚህ የአሴር ልጆች ወገኖች ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አምሳ ሦስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: Of the sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites: of Guni, the family of the Gunites:
verses.fr: Fils de Nephthali, selon leurs familles: de Jahtseel descend la famille des Jahtseélites; de Guni, la famille des Gunites;
verses.am: የንፍታሌም ልጆች በየወገናቸው፤ ከያሕጽኤል የያሕጽኤላውያን ወገን፥ ከጉኒ የጉናውያን ወገን፥

verses.en: Of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites: of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.
verses.fr: de Jetser, la famille des Jitsrites; de Schillem, la famille des Schillémites.
verses.am: ከዬጽር የዬጽራውያን ወገን፥ ከሺሌም የሺሌማውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families: and they that were numbered of them were forty and five thousand and four hundred.
verses.fr: Ce sont là les familles de Nephthali, selon leurs familles et d''après leur dénombrement: quarante-cinq mille quatre cents.
verses.am: በየወገናቸው የንፍታሌም ወገኖች እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከእነርሱም የተቈጠሩት አርባ አምስት ሺህ አራት መቶ ነበሩ።

verses.en: These were the numbered of the children of Israel, six hundred thousand and a thousand seven hundred and thirty.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux des enfants d''Israël dont on fit le dénombrement: six cent un mille sept cent trente.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች የተቈጠሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ስድስት መቶ አንድ ሺህ ሰባት መቶ ሠላሳ ነበሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Unto these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.
verses.fr: Le pays sera partagé entre eux, pour être leur propriété, selon le nombre des noms.
verses.am: ለእነዚህ በየስማቸው ቍጥር ምድሪቱ ርስት ሆና ትከፈላለች።

verses.en: To many thou shalt give the more inheritance, and to few thou shalt give the less inheritance: to every one shall his inheritance be given according to those that were numbered of him.
verses.fr: A ceux qui sont en plus grand nombre tu donneras une portion plus grande, et à ceux qui sont en plus petit nombre tu donneras une portion plus petite; on donnera à chacun sa portion d''après le dénombrement.
verses.am: ለብዙዎቹ እንደ ብዛታቸው፥ ለጥቂቶቹም እንደ ጥቂትነታቸው መጠን ርስትን ትሰጣቸዋለህ። ለሁሉ እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን ርስታቸው ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.en: Notwithstanding the land shall be divided by lot: according to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.
verses.fr: Mais le partage du pays aura lieu par le sort; ils le recevront en propriété selon les noms des tribus de leurs pères.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ምድሪቱ በዕጣ ትከፈላለች፤ እንደ አባቶቻቸው ነገድ ስም ይወርሳሉ።

verses.en: According to the lot shall the possession thereof be divided between many and few.
verses.fr: C''est par le sort que le pays sera partagé entre ceux qui sont en grand nombre et ceux qui sont en petit nombre.
verses.am: በብዙዎችና በጥቂቶች መካከል ርስታቸው በዕጣ ትከፈላለች።

verses.en: And these are they that were numbered of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites: of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites: of Merari, the family of the Merarites.
verses.fr: Voici les Lévites dont on fit le dénombrement, selon leurs familles: de Guerschon descend la famille des Guerschonites; de Kehath, la famille des Kehathites; de Merari, la famille des Merarites.
verses.am: ከሌዋውያንም በየወገናቸው የተቈጠሩት እነዚህ ናቸው፤ ከጌድሶን የጌድሶናውያን ወገን፥ ከቀዓት የቀዓታውያን ወገን፥ ከሜራሪ የሜራራውያን ወገን።

verses.en: These are the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, the family of the Korathites. And Kohath begat Amram.
verses.fr: Voici les familles de Lévi: la famille des Libnites, la famille des Hébronites, la famille des Machlites, la famille des Muschites, la famille des Korites. Kehath engendra Amram.
verses.am: እነዚህ የሌዊ ወገኖች ናቸው፤ የሊብናውያን ወገን፥ የኬብሮናውያን ወገን፥ የሞሖላውያን ወገን፥ የሙሳውያን ወገን፥ የቆሬያውያን ወገን። ቀዓትም እንበረምን ወለደ።

verses.en: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, whom her mother bare to Levi in Egypt: and she bare unto Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.fr: Le nom de la femme d''Amram était Jokébed, fille de Lévi, laquelle naquit à Lévi, en Egypte; elle enfanta à Amram: Aaron, Moïse, et Marie, leur soeur.
verses.am: የእንበረም ሚስት ስም ዮካብድ ነበረ። እርስዋ በግብፅ ከሌዊ የተወለደች የሌዊ ልጅ ነበረች፤ ለእንበረምም አሮንንና ሙሴን እኅታቸውንም ማርያምን ወለደችለት።

verses.en: And unto Aaron was born Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.fr: Il naquit à Aaron: Nadab et Abihu, Eléazar et Ithamar.
verses.am: ለአሮንም ናዳብ፥ አብዩድ፥ አልዓዛር፥ ኢታምር ተወለዱለት።

verses.en: And Nadab and Abihu died, when they offered strange fire before the Lord.
verses.fr: Nadab et Abihu moururent, lorsqu''ils apportèrent devant l''Eternel du feu étranger.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሌላ እሳት ባቀረቡ ጊዜ ናዳብና አብዩድ ሞቱ።

verses.en: And those that were numbered of them were twenty and three thousand, all males from a month old and upward: for they were not numbered among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Ceux dont on fit le dénombrement, tous les mâles depuis l''âge d''un mois et au-dessus, furent vingt-trois mille. Ils ne furent pas compris dans le dénombrement des enfants d''Israël, parce qu''il ne leur fut point donné de possession au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ከአንድ ወርም ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉ ወንዶች ሁሉ ከእነርሱ የተቈጠሩ ሀያ ሦስት ሺህ ነበሩ። ከእስራኤልም ልጆች መካከል ርስት አልተሰጣቸውምና ከእስራኤል ልጆች ጋር አልተቈጠሩም።

verses.en: These are they that were numbered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who numbered the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux des enfants d''Israël dont Moïse et le sacrificateur Eléazar firent le dénombrement dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho.
verses.am: በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት ሲቈጥሩ፥ ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛር የቈጠሩአቸው የእስራኤል ልጆች እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: But among these there was not a man of them whom Moses and Aaron the priest numbered, when they numbered the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.fr: Parmi eux, il n''y avait aucun des enfants d''Israël dont Moïse et le sacrificateur Aaron avaient fait le dénombrement dans le désert de Sinaï.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ሙሴና ካህኑ አሮን በሲና ምድረ በዳ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በቈጠሩአቸው ጊዜ ከነበሩት ከእነዚያ መካከል አንድም ሰው አልነበረም።

verses.en: For the Lord had said of them, They shall surely die in the wilderness. And there was not left a man of them, save Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.fr: Car l''Eternel avait dit: ils mourront dans le désert, et il n''en restera pas un, excepté Caleb, fils de Jephunné, et Josué, fils de Nun.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ እነርሱ። በእውነት በምድረ በዳ ይሞታሉ ብሎ ተናግሮአልና። ከዮፎኒ ልጅ ከካሌብ ከነዌም ልጅ ከኢያሱ በቀር ከእነርሱ አንድ ሰው ስንኳ አልቀረም።

verses.en: Then came the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph: and these are the names of his daughters; Mahlah, Noah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.fr: Les filles de Tselophchad, fils de Hépher, fils de Galaad, fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, des familles de Manassé, fils de Joseph, et dont les noms étaient Machla, Noa, Hogla, Milca et Thirtsa,
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ልጅ ከምናሴ ወገኖች፥ የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጅ የኦፌር ልጅ የሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች ቀረቡ፤ የእነዚህም ሴቶች ልጆች ስም ማህለህ፥ ኑዓ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ቲርጻ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.fr: s''approchèrent et se présentèrent devant Moïse, devant le sacrificateur Eléazar, et devant les princes et toute l''assemblée, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation. Elles dirent:
verses.am: በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በሙሴና በካህኑ በአልዓዛር በአለቆቹም በማኅበሩም ሁሉ ፊት ቆመው።

verses.en: Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the company of them that gathered themselves together against the Lord in the company of Korah; but died in his own sin, and had no sons.
verses.fr: Notre père est mort dans le désert; il n''était pas au milieu de l''assemblée de ceux qui se révoltèrent contre l''Eternel, de l''assemblée de Koré, mais il est mort pour son péché, et il n''avait point de fils.
verses.am: አባታችን በምድረ በዳ ሞተ፤ በራሱ ኃጢአት ሞተ እንጂ ከቆሬ ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ላይ በተሰበሰቡ ወገን መካከል አልነበረም፤ ወንዶችም ልጆች አልነበሩትም።

verses.en: Why should the name of our father be done away from among his family, because he hath no son? Give unto us therefore a possession among the brethren of our father.
verses.fr: Pourquoi le nom de notre père serait-il retranché du milieu de sa famille, parce qu''il n''avait point eu de fils? Donne-nous une possession parmi les frères de notre père.
verses.am: ወንድ ልጅስ ባይኖረው የአባታችን ስም ከወገኑ መካከል ለምን ይጠፋል? በአባታችን ወንድሞች መካከል ርስትን ስጠን አሉ።

verses.en: And Moses brought their cause before the Lord.
verses.fr: Moïse porta la cause devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም ነገራቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረበ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: Et l''Eternel dit à Moïse:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: The daughters of Zelophehad speak right: thou shalt surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father's brethren; and thou shalt cause the inheritance of their father to pass unto them.
verses.fr: Les filles de Tselophchad ont raison. Tu leur donneras en héritage une possession parmi les frères de leur père, et c''est à elles que tu feras passer l''héritage de leur père.
verses.am: የሰለጰዓድ ልጆች እውነት ተናግረዋል፤ በአባታቸው ወንድሞች መካከል የርስት ድርሻ ስጣቸው፤ የአባታቸውን ርስት ለእነርሱ አሳልፈህ ስጥ።

verses.en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.
verses.fr: Tu parleras aux enfants d''Israël, et tu diras: Lorsqu''un homme mourra sans laisser de fils, vous ferez passer son héritage à sa fille.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ሰው ቢሞት ወንድ ልጅም ባይኖረው፥ ርስቱ ለሴት ልጁ ይለፍ፤

verses.en: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.
verses.fr: S''il n''a point de fille, vous donnerez son héritage à ses frères.
verses.am: ሴት ልጅም ባትኖረው ርስቱን ለወንድሞቹ ስጡ፤

verses.en: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.
verses.fr: S''il n''a point de frères, vous donnerez son héritage aux frères de son père.
verses.am: ወንድሞችም ባይኖሩት ርስቱን ለአባቱ ወንድሞች ስጡ፤

verses.en: And if his father have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his kinsman that is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it: and it shall be unto the children of Israel a statute of judgment, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: S''il n''y a point de frères de son père, vous donnerez son héritage au plus proche parent dans sa famille, et c''est lui qui le possédera. Ce sera pour les enfants d''Israël une loi et un droit, comme l''Eternel l''a ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: የአባቱም ወንድሞች ባይኖሩት ከወገኑ ለቀረበ ዘመድ ርስቱን ስጡ እርሱም ይውረሰው፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Get thee up into this mount Abarim, and see the land which I have given unto the children of Israel.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Monte sur cette montagne d''Abarim, et regarde le pays que je donne aux enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። ወደዚህ ወደ ዓባሪም ተራራ ውጣ፥ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች የሰጠኋትን ምድር እይ፤

verses.en: And when thou hast seen it, thou also shalt be gathered unto thy people, as Aaron thy brother was gathered.
verses.fr: Tu le regarderas; mais toi aussi, tu seras recueilli auprès de ton peuple, comme Aaron, ton frère, a été recueilli;
verses.am: ባየሃትም ጊዜ ወንድምህ አሮን እንደ ተከማቸ አንተ ደግሞ ወደ ወገንህ ትከማቻለህ።

verses.en: For ye rebelled against my commandment in the desert of Zin, in the strife of the congregation, to sanctify me at the water before their eyes: that is the water of Meribah in Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.fr: parce que vous avez été rebelles à mon ordre, dans le désert de Tsin, lors de la contestation de l''assemblée, et que vous ne m''avez point sanctifié à leurs yeux à l''occasion des eaux. Ce sont les eaux de contestation, à Kadès, dans le désert de Tsin.
verses.am: እናንተ በጺን ምድረ በዳ በማኅበሩ ጠብ በቃሌ ላይ ዐምፃችኋልና፥ በእነርሱም ፊት በውኃው ዘንድ አልቀደሳችሁኝምና። ይህም በጺን ምድረ በዳ በቃዴስ ያለው የመሪባ ውኃ ነው።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the Lord, saying,
verses.fr: Moïse parla à l''Eternel, et dit:
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔርን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Let the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, set a man over the congregation,
verses.fr: Que l''Eternel, le Dieu des esprits de toute chair, établisse sur l''assemblée un homme
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። መንፈስ ያለበትን ሰው የነዌን ልጅ ኢያሱን ወስደህ እጅህን በላዩ ጫንበት፤

verses.en: Which may go out before them, and which may go in before them, and which may lead them out, and which may bring them in; that the congregation of the Lord be not as sheep which have no shepherd.
verses.fr: qui sorte devant eux et qui entre devant eux, qui les fasse sortir et qui les fasse entrer, afin que l''assemblée de l''Eternel ne soit pas comme des brebis qui n''ont point de berger.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። መንፈስ ያለበትን ሰው የነዌን ልጅ ኢያሱን ወስደህ እጅህን በላዩ ጫንበት፤

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Take thee Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the spirit, and lay thine hand upon him;
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Prends Josué, fils de Nun, homme en qui réside l''esprit; et tu poseras ta main sur lui.
verses.am: በካህኑ በአልዓዛርና በማኅበሩ ሁሉ ፊት አቁመው፥ እነርሱም እያዩ እዘዘው።

verses.en: And set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and give him a charge in their sight.
verses.fr: Tu le placeras devant le sacrificateur Eléazar et devant toute l''assemblée, et tu lui donneras des ordres sous leurs yeux.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲታዘዙት ከክብርህ አኑርበት።

verses.en: And thou shalt put some of thine honour upon him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may be obedient.
verses.fr: Tu le rendras participant de ta dignité, afin que toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël l''écoute.
verses.am: በካህኑም በአልዓዛር ፊት ይቁም፤ እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በኡሪም ፍርድ ይጠይቅለት፤ እርሱ ከእርሱም ጋር የእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ በቃሉ ይውጡ፥ በቃሉም ይግቡ።

verses.en: And he shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall ask counsel for him after the judgment of Urim before the Lord: at his word shall they go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he, and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.
verses.fr: Il se présentera devant le sacrificateur Eléazar, qui consultera pour lui le jugement de l''urim devant l''Eternel; et Josué, tous les enfants d''Israël avec lui, et toute l''assemblée, sortiront sur l''ordre d''Eléazar et entreront sur son ordre.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ኢያሱንም ወስዶ በካህኑ በአልዓዛርና በማኅበሩ ሁሉ ፊት አቆመው፤

verses.en: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him: and he took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation:
verses.fr: Moïse fit ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné. Il prit Josué, et il le plaça devant le sacrificateur Eléazar et devant toute l''assemblée.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ እንደ ተናገረ፥ እጁን በላዩ ጫነበት፥ አዘዘውም።

verses.en: And he laid his hands upon him, and gave him a charge, as the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Il posa ses mains sur lui, et lui donna des ordres, comme l''Eternel l''avait dit par Moïse.
verses.am: ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ እንደ ተናገረ፥ እጁን በላዩ ጫነበት፥ አዘዘውም።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, My offering, and my bread for my sacrifices made by fire, for a sweet savour unto me, shall ye observe to offer unto me in their due season.
verses.fr: Donne cet ordre aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Vous aurez soin de me présenter, au temps fixé, mon offrande, l''aliment de mes sacrifices consumés par le feu, et qui me sont d''une agréable odeur.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። መብሌን፥ ለእኔ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት የተደረገውን ቍርባኔን፥ መባዬን በየጊዜው ታቀርቡልኝ ዘንድ ጠብቁ።

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto them, This is the offering made by fire which ye shall offer unto the Lord; two lambs of the first year without spot day by day, for a continual burnt offering.
verses.fr: Tu leur diras: Voici le sacrifice consumé par le feu que vous offrirez à l''Eternel: chaque jour, deux agneaux d''un an sans défaut, comme holocauste perpétuel.
verses.am: እንዲህም በላቸው። በእሳት ለእግዚአብሔር የምታቀርቡት ቍርባን ይህ ነው፤ ለዘወትር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሁለት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ዕለት ዕለት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: The one lamb shalt thou offer in the morning, and the other lamb shalt thou offer at even;
verses.fr: Tu offriras l''un des agneaux le matin, et l''autre agneau entre les deux soirs,
verses.am: አንዱን ጠቦት በማለዳ፥ ሌላውንም ጠቦት በማታ አቅርብ፤

verses.en: And a tenth part of an ephah of flour for a meat offering, mingled with the fourth part of an hin of beaten oil.
verses.fr: et, pour l''offrande, un dixième d''épha de fleur de farine pétrie dans un quart de hin d''huile d''olives concassées.
verses.am: ለእህልም ቍርባን የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛ እጅ በሆነ ተወቅጦ በተጠለለ ዘይት የተለወሰ የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ እጅ መልካም ዱቄት ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: It is a continual burnt offering, which was ordained in mount Sinai for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est l''holocauste perpétuel, qui a été offert à la montagne de Sinaï; c''est un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእሳት ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የቀረበ በሲና ተራራ የተሠራ ለዘወትር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And the drink offering thereof shall be the fourth part of an hin for the one lamb: in the holy place shalt thou cause the strong wine to be poured unto the Lord for a drink offering.
verses.fr: La libation sera d''un quart de hin pour chaque agneau: c''est dans le lieu saint que tu feras la libation de vin à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የመጠጡ ቍርባን ለአንድ ጠቦት የኢን መስፈሪያ አራተኛው እጅ ነው፤ በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ለእግዚአብሔር ለመጠጥ ቍርባን መጠጥ ታፈስሳለህ።

verses.en: And the other lamb shalt thou offer at even: as the meat offering of the morning, and as the drink offering thereof, thou shalt offer it, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu offriras le second agneau entre les deux soirs, avec une offrande et une libation semblables à celles du matin; c''est un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሌላውንም ጠቦት በማታ ጊዜ ታቀርባለህ፤ የእህሉን ቍርባንና የመጠጡን ቍርባን በማለዳ እንዳቀረብህ በእሳት ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ታቀርበዋለህ።

verses.en: And on the sabbath day two lambs of the first year without spot, and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and the drink offering thereof:
verses.fr: Le jour du sabbat, vous offrirez deux agneaux d''un an sans défaut, et, pour l''offrande, deux dixièmes de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, avec la libation.
verses.am: በሰንበትም ቀን ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሁለት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥ ለእህልም ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥ የመጠጡንም ቍርባን ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: This is the burnt offering of every sabbath, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: C''est l''holocauste du sabbat, pour chaque sabbat, outre l''holocauste perpétuel et la libation.
verses.am: በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ሌላ፥ ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ፥ በየሰንበቱ ሁሉ የምታቀርቡት የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And in the beginnings of your months ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, seven lambs of the first year without spot;
verses.fr: Au commencement de vos mois, vous offrirez en holocauste à l''Eternel deux jeunes taureaux, un bélier, et sept agneaux d''un an sans défaut;
verses.am: በወሩም መባቻ ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ሁለት ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ነውርም የሌለባቸውን ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: And three tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one bullock; and two tenth deals of flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, for one ram;
verses.fr: et, comme offrande pour chaque taureau, trois dixièmes de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile; comme offrande pour le bélier, deux dixièmes de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile;
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱም ወይፈን ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለአውራው በግም ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥

verses.en: And a several tenth deal of flour mingled with oil for a meat offering unto one lamb; for a burnt offering of a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: comme offrande pour chaque agneau, un dixième de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile. C''est un holocauste, un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለእያንዳንዱም ጠቦት ለእህል ቍርባን በዘይት የተለወሰ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And their drink offerings shall be half an hin of wine unto a bullock, and the third part of an hin unto a ram, and a fourth part of an hin unto a lamb: this is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.
verses.fr: Les libations seront d''un demi-hin de vin pour un taureau, d''un tiers de hin pour un bélier, et d''un quart de hin pour un agneau. C''est l''holocauste du commencement du mois, pour chaque mois, pour tous les mois de l''année.
verses.am: የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውም ለአንድ ወይፈን የኢን ግማሽ፥ ለአውራው በግም የኢን ሢሶ፥ ለአንዱም ጠቦት የኢን አራተኛ እጅ የወይን ጠጅ ይሆናል፤ ይህ ለዓመቱ የወር መባቻ ሁሉ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering unto the Lord shall be offered, beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: On offrira à l''Eternel un bouc, en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel et la libation.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከመጠጡ ቍርባን ሌላ ይቀርባል።

verses.en: And in the fourteenth day of the first month is the passover of the Lord.
verses.fr: Le premier mois, le quatorzième jour du mois, ce sera la Pâque de l''Eternel.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አራተኛው ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ፋሲካ ነው።

verses.en: And in the fifteenth day of this month is the feast: seven days shall unleavened bread be eaten.
verses.fr: Le quinzième jour de ce mois sera un jour de fête. On mangera pendant sept jours des pains sans levain.
verses.am: ከዚህም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን በዓል ይሆናል ሰባት ቀን ቂጣ እንጀራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: In the first day shall be an holy convocation; ye shall do no manner of servile work therein:
verses.fr: Le premier jour, il y aura une sainte convocation: vous ne ferez aucune oeuvre servile.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆናል፤ በእርሱም የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.en: But ye shall offer a sacrifice made by fire for a burnt offering unto the Lord; two young bullocks, and one ram, and seven lambs of the first year: they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.fr: Vous offrirez en holocauste à l''Eternel un sacrifice consumé par le feu: deux jeunes taureaux, un bélier, et sept agneaux d''un an sans défaut.
verses.am: በእሳትም የተደረገውን ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፤ ነውር የሌለባቸው ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil: three tenth deals shall ye offer for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram;
verses.fr: Vous y joindrez l''offrande de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, trois dixièmes pour un taureau, deux dixièmes pour un bélier,
verses.am: የእህል ቍርባናቸውንም በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለአንድ ወይፈን ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአውራውም በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.en: A several tenth deal shalt thou offer for every lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.fr: et un dixième pour chacun des sept agneaux.
verses.am: ለሰባቱም ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, afin de faire pour vous l''expiation.
verses.am: ማስተስረያ የሚሆንላችሁን አንድ አውራ ፍየል ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall offer these beside the burnt offering in the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez ces sacrifices, outre l''holocauste du matin, qui est un holocauste perpétuel.
verses.am: ማልዶ ከሚቀርበው በዘወትር ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሌላ እነዚህን ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: After this manner ye shall offer daily, throughout the seven days, the meat of the sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: it shall be offered beside the continual burnt offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: Vous les offrirez chaque jour, pendant sept jours, comme l''aliment d''un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel. On les offrira, outre l''holocauste perpétuel et la libation.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት የሚደረገውን የቍርባኑን መብል ሰባት ቀን በየዕለቱ እንዲሁ ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከመጠጡ ቍርባን ሌላ ይቀርባል።

verses.en: And on the seventh day ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work.
verses.fr: Le septième jour, vous aurez une sainte convocation: vous ne ferez aucune oeuvre servile.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.en: Also in the day of the firstfruits, when ye bring a new meat offering unto the Lord, after your weeks be out, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work:
verses.fr: Le jour des prémices, où vous présenterez à l''Eternel une offrande, à votre fête des semaines, vous aurez une sainte convocation: vous ne ferez aucune oeuvre servile.
verses.am: ደግሞ በበኵራት ቀን ከሰባቱ ሱባዔ በዓላችሁ አዲሱን የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ባቀረባችሁ ጊዜ፥ የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሆንላችኋል፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.en: But ye shall offer the burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; two young bullocks, one ram, seven lambs of the first year;
verses.fr: Vous offrirez en holocauste, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel, deux jeunes taureaux, un bélier, et sept agneaux d''un an.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ሁለት ወይፈኖች፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: And their meat offering of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto one bullock, two tenth deals unto one ram,
verses.fr: Vous y joindrez l''offrande de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, trois dixièmes pour chaque taureau, deux dixièmes pour le bélier,
verses.am: ለእህል ቍርባናቸው በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለእያንዳንዱ ወይፈን ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአንዱም አውራ በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.en: A several tenth deal unto one lamb, throughout the seven lambs;
verses.fr: et un dixième pour chacun des sept agneaux.
verses.am: ለሰባቱም ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ጠቦት ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And one kid of the goats, to make an atonement for you.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc, afin de faire pour vous l''expiation.
verses.am: ማስተስረያ የሚሆንላችሁን አንድ አውራ ፍየል ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall offer them beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, (they shall be unto you without blemish) and their drink offerings.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez ces sacrifices, outre l''holocauste perpétuel et l''offrande. Vous aurez des agneaux sans défaut, et vous joindrez les libations.
verses.am: በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ሌላ እነርሱንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ነውርም የሌለባቸው ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And in the seventh month, on the first day of the month, ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work: it is a day of blowing the trumpets unto you.
verses.fr: Le septième mois, le premier jour du mois, vous aurez une sainte convocation: vous ne ferez aucune oeuvre servile. Ce jour sera publié parmi vous au son des trompettes.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ወር ከወሩ በመጀመሪያ ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት፤ መለከቶች የሚነፉበት ቀን ነው።

verses.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering for a sweet savour unto the Lord; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.fr: Vous offrirez en holocauste, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel, un jeune taureau, un bélier, et sept agneaux d''un an sans défaut.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals for a bullock, and two tenth deals for a ram,
verses.fr: Vous y joindrez l''offrande de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, trois dixièmes pour le taureau, deux dixièmes pour le bélier,
verses.am: ለእህል ቍርባናቸው በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለወይፈኑ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአውራው በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.en: And one tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.fr: et un dixième pour chacun des sept agneaux.
verses.am: ለሰባቱ ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering, to make an atonement for you:
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, afin de faire pour vous l''expiation.
verses.am: ማስተስረያም የሚሆንላችሁን አንድ አውራ ፍየል ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: Beside the burnt offering of the month, and his meat offering, and the daily burnt offering, and his meat offering, and their drink offerings, according unto their manner, for a sweet savour, a sacrifice made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez ces sacrifices, outre l''holocauste et l''offrande de chaque mois, l''holocauste perpétuel et l''offrande, et les libations qui s''y joignent, d''après les règles établies. Ce sont des sacrifices consumés par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: በወሩ መባቻ ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን፥ በዘወትርም ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን፥ ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ፥ እንደ ሕጋቸው ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.en: And ye shall have on the tenth day of this seventh month an holy convocation; and ye shall afflict your souls: ye shall not do any work therein:
verses.fr: Le dixième jour de ce septième mois, vous aurez une sainte convocation, et vous humilierez vos âmes: vous ne ferez aucun ouvrage.
verses.am: ከዚህም ከሰባተኛው ወር በአሥረኛው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ ሰውነታችሁን አስጨንቁት፤ ከሥራ ሁሉ ምንም አታድርጉ።

verses.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering unto the Lord for a sweet savour; one young bullock, one ram, and seven lambs of the first year; they shall be unto you without blemish:
verses.fr: Vous offrirez en holocauste, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel, un jeune taureau, un bélier, et sept agneaux d''un an sans défaut.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ታቀርባላችሁ፤ ነውር የሌለባቸው ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals to a bullock, and two tenth deals to one ram,
verses.fr: Vous y joindrez l''offrande de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, trois dixièmes pour le taureau, deux dixièmes pour le bélier,
verses.am: ለእህል ቍርባናቸውም በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለወይፈኑ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለአውራው በግ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.en: A several tenth deal for one lamb, throughout the seven lambs:
verses.fr: et un dixième pour chacun des sept agneaux.
verses.am: ለሰባቱ ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ፥

verses.en: One kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering of it, and their drink offerings.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre le sacrifice des expiations, l''holocauste perpétuel et l''offrande, et les libations ordinaires.
verses.am: ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል አቅርቡ። ከሚያስተሰርየው ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ በዘወትርም ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን፥ ከመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውም ሌላ አቅርቡት።

verses.en: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month ye shall have an holy convocation; ye shall do no servile work, and ye shall keep a feast unto the Lord seven days:
verses.fr: Le quinzième jour du septième mois, vous aurez une sainte convocation: vous ne ferez aucune oeuvre servile. Vous célébrerez une fête en l''honneur de l''Eternel, pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ከሰባተኛውም ወር በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት፥ ሰባት ቀንም ለእግዚአብሔር በዓል አድርጉ።

verses.en: And ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord; thirteen young bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year; they shall be without blemish:
verses.fr: Vous offrirez en holocauste un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel: treize jeunes taureaux, deux béliers, et quatorze agneaux d''un an sans défaut.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ አሥራ ሦስት ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች አቅርቡ፤ ነውር የሌለባቸውም ይሁኑ።

verses.en: And their meat offering shall be of flour mingled with oil, three tenth deals unto every bullock of the thirteen bullocks, two tenth deals to each ram of the two rams,
verses.fr: Vous y joindrez l''offrande de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, trois dixièmes pour chacun des treize taureaux, deux dixièmes pour chacun des deux béliers,
verses.am: ለእህል ቍርባናቸውም በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ ለአሥራ ሦስት ወይፈኖች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ፥ ለሁለቱ አውራ በጎች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሁለት እጅ፥

verses.en: And a several tenth deal to each lamb of the fourteen lambs:
verses.fr: et un dixième pour chacun des quatorze agneaux.
verses.am: ለአሥራ አራቱ ጠቦቶች ለእያንዳንዱ ከመስፈሪያው አሥረኛ እጅ፥

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation. -
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.en: And on the second day ye shall offer twelve young bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.fr: Le second jour, vous offrirez douze jeunes taureaux, deux béliers, et quatorze agneaux d''un an sans défaut,
verses.am: በሁለተኛውም ቀን አሥራ ሁለት ወይፈኖችን፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎችን፥ ነውር የሌለባቸው አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶችን፥

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.fr: avec l''offrande et les libations pour les taureaux, les béliers et les agneaux, selon leur nombre, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and the meat offering thereof, and their drink offerings.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation. -
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየልን ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባናቸው ሌላ የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.en: And on the third day eleven bullocks, two rams, fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish;
verses.fr: Le troisième jour, vous offrirez onze taureaux, deux béliers, et quatorze agneaux d''un an sans défaut,
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን አሥራ አንድ ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.fr: avec l''offrande et les libations pour les taureaux, les béliers et les agneaux, selon leur nombre, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation. -
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፥ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And on the fourth day ten bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.fr: Le quatrième jour, vous offrirez dix taureaux, deux béliers, et quatorze agneaux d''un an sans défaut,
verses.am: በአራተኛውም ቀን አሥር ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.fr: avec l''offrande et les libations pour les taureaux, les béliers et les agneaux, selon leur nombre, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸውም መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.en: And one kid of the goats for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation. -
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፥ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And on the fifth day nine bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without spot:
verses.fr: Le cinquième jour, vous offrirez neuf taureaux, deux béliers, et quatorze agneaux d''un an sans défaut,
verses.am: በአምስተኛውም ቀን ዘጠኝ ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.fr: avec l''offrande et les libations pour les taureaux, les béliers et les agneaux selon leur nombre, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation. -
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፥ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And on the sixth day eight bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.fr: Le sixième jour, vous offrirez huit taureaux, deux béliers et quatorze agneaux d''un an sans défaut,
verses.am: በስድስተኛውም ቀን ስምንት ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.fr: avec l''offrande et les libations pour les taureaux, les béliers et les agneaux, selon leur nombre, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation. -

verses.en: And on the seventh day seven bullocks, two rams, and fourteen lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.fr: Le septième jour, vous offrirez sept taureaux, deux béliers, et quatorze agneaux d''un an sans défaut,
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ሰባት ወይፈኖች፥ ሁለት አውራ በጎች፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን አሥራ አራት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች፥

verses.en: And their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullocks, for the rams, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.fr: avec l''offrande et les libations pour les taureaux, les béliers et les agneaux, selon leur nombre, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: ለወይፈኖቹና ለአውራ በጎቹ ለጠቦቶቹም የእህል ቍርባናቸውንና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸውን እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ፥

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation. -
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል፥ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: On the eighth day ye shall have a solemn assembly: ye shall do no servile work therein:
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, vous aurez une assemblée solennelle: vous ne ferez aucune oeuvre servile.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን የተቀደሰ ጉባኤ ይሁንላችሁ፤ የተግባርን ሥራ ሁሉ አትሥሩበት።

verses.en: But ye shall offer a burnt offering, a sacrifice made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord: one bullock, one ram, seven lambs of the first year without blemish:
verses.fr: Vous offrirez en holocauste un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel: un taureau, un bélier, et sept agneaux d''un an sans défaut,
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በእሳት የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት፥ አንድ ወይፈን፥ አንድ አውራ በግ፥ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሰባት የአንድ ዓመት ተባት የበግ ጠቦቶች ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: Their meat offering and their drink offerings for the bullock, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the manner:
verses.fr: avec l''offrande et les libations pour le taureau, le bélier et les agneaux, selon leur nombre, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: የእህል ቍርባናቸውና የመጠጥ ቍርባናቸው ለወይፈኑ ለአውራውም በግ ለጠቦቶቹም እንደ ቍጥራቸው መጠን እንደ ሕጉ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And one goat for a sin offering; beside the continual burnt offering, and his meat offering, and his drink offering.
verses.fr: Vous offrirez un bouc en sacrifice d''expiation, outre l''holocauste perpétuel, l''offrande et la libation.
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ ፍየል ታቀርባላችሁ፤ በዘወትር ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕትና ከእህሉ ቍርባን ከመጠጡም ቍርባን ሌላ የሚቀርቡ ናቸው።

verses.en: These things ye shall do unto the Lord in your set feasts, beside your vows, and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, and for your meat offerings, and for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.
verses.fr: Tels sont les sacrifices que vous offrirez à l''Eternel dans vos fêtes, outre vos holocaustes, vos offrandes et vos libations, et vos sacrifices de prospérité, en accomplissement d''un voeu ou en offrandes volontaires.
verses.am: እነዚህንም፥ ከስእለታችሁና በፈቃዳችሁ ከምታመጡት ሌላ፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ለእህልም ለመጠጥም ቍርባን፥ ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕታችሁ በበዓላችሁ ጊዜ ለእግዚአብሔር አቅርቡ።

verses.en: And Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Moïse dit aux enfants d''Israël tout ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ያዘዘውን ሁሉ ነገራቸው።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded.
verses.fr: Moïse parla aux chefs des tribus des enfants d''Israël, et dit: Voici ce que l''Eternel ordonne.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለእስራኤል ልጆች ነገዶች አለቆች እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው።

verses.en: If a man vow a vow unto the Lord, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme fera un voeu à l''Eternel, ou un serment pour se lier par un engagement, il ne violera point sa parole, il agira selon tout ce qui est sorti de sa bouche.
verses.am: ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ቢሳል፥ ወይም ራሱ በመሐላ ቢያስር፥ ቃሉን አይስበር፤ ከአፉ እንደ ወጣው ሁሉ ያድርግ።

verses.en: If a woman also vow a vow unto the Lord, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father's house in her youth;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''une femme, dans sa jeunesse et à la maison de son père, fera un voeu à l''Eternel et se liera par un engagement,
verses.am: ሴትም ደግሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ስእለት ብትሳል፥ እርስዋም በአባትዋ ቤት ሳለች በብላቴንነትዋ ጊዜ ራስዋን በመሐላ ብታስር፥

verses.en: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
verses.fr: et que son père aura connaissance du voeu qu''elle a fait et de l''engagement par lequel elle s''est liée, -si son père garde le silence envers elle, tout voeu qu''elle aura fait sera valable, et tout engagement par lequel elle se sera liée sera valable;
verses.am: አባትዋም ራስዋን ያሰረችበትን መሐላ ስእለትዋንም ቢሰማ፥ አባትዋም ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለትዋ ሁሉ ይጸናል፥ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ሁሉ ይጸናል።

verses.en: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the Lord shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
verses.fr: mais si son père la désapprouve le jour où il en a connaissance, tous ses voeux et tous les engagements par lesquels elle se sera liée n''auront aucune valeur; et l''Eternel lui pardonnera, parce qu''elle a été désapprouvée de son père.
verses.am: አባትዋ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ቢከለክላት፥ ስእለትዋ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላዋ አይጸኑም፤ አባትዋ ከልክሎአታልና እግዚአብሔር ይቅር ይላታል።

verses.en: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''elle sera mariée, après avoir fait des voeux, ou s''être liée par une parole échappée de ses lèvres,
verses.am: በተሳለችም ጊዜ ራስዋንም በመሐላ ያሰረችበት ነገር ከአፍዋ በወጣ ጊዜ ባል ያገባች ብትሆን፥

verses.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.fr: et que son mari en aura connaissance, -s''il garde le silence envers elle le jour où il en a connaissance, ses voeux seront valables, et les engagements par lesquels elle se sera liée seront valables;
verses.am: ባልዋም ቢሰማ፥ በሰማበትም ቀን ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለትዋ ይጸናል፥ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ይጸናል።

verses.en: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.fr: mais si son mari la désapprouve le jour où il en a connaissance, il annulera le voeu qu''elle a fait et la parole échappée de ses lèvres, par laquelle elle s''est liée; et l''Eternel lui pardonnera.
verses.am: ባልዋ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ቢከለክላት፥ በእርስዋ ላይ ያለውን ስእለትዋን ራስዋንም በመሐላ ያሰረችበትን የአፍዋን ነገር ከንቱ ያደርገዋል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይቅር ይላታል።

verses.en: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
verses.fr: Le voeu d''une femme veuve ou répudiée, l''engagement quelconque par lequel elle se sera liée, sera valable pour elle.
verses.am: ባልዋ የሞተባት ወይም የተፋታች ግን ስእለትዋ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ይጸኑባታል።

verses.en: And if she vowed in her husband's house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''une femme, dans la maison de son mari, fera des voeux ou se liera par un serment,
verses.am: ሴትም በባልዋ ቤት ሳለች ብትሳል፥ ወይም ራስዋን በመሐላ ብታስር፥

verses.en: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
verses.fr: et que son mari en aura connaissance, -s''il garde le silence envers elle et ne la désapprouve pas, tous ses voeux seront valables, et tous les engagements par lesquels elle se sera liée seront valables;
verses.am: ባልዋም ሰምቶ ዝም ቢላት ባይከለክላትም፥ ስእለትዋ ሁሉ ራስዋንም ያሰረችበት መሐላ ሁሉ ይጸናል።

verses.en: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the Lord shall forgive her.
verses.fr: mais si son mari les annule le jour où il en a connaissance, tout voeu et tout engagement sortis de ses lèvres n''auront aucune valeur, son mari les a annulés; et l''Eternel lui pardonnera.
verses.am: ባልዋ ግን በሰማበት ቀን ከንቱ ቢያደርገው፥ ስለ ስእለትዋ ወይም ራስዋን ስላሰረችበት መሐላ ከአፍዋ የወጣው ነገር አይጸናም፤ ባልዋ ከንቱ አድርጎታል፤ እግዚአብሔርም ይቅር ይላታል።

verses.en: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
verses.fr: Son mari peut ratifier et son mari peut annuler tout voeu, tout serment par lequel elle s''engage à mortifier sa personne.
verses.am: ስእለትዋን ሁሉ ነፍስዋንም የሚያዋርደውን መሐላ ሁሉ ባልዋ ያጸናዋል፥ ባልዋም ከንቱ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
verses.fr: S''il garde de jour en jour le silence envers elle, il ratifie ainsi tous les voeux ou tous les engagements par lesquels elle s''est liée; il les ratifie, parce qu''il a gardé le silence envers elle le jour où il en a eu connaissance.
verses.am: ባልዋ ግን በየዕለቱ ዝም ቢላት፥ ስእለትዋን ሁሉ በእርስዋም ላይ ያለውን መሐላ ሁሉ አጽንቶታል፤ በሰማበት ቀን ዝም ብሎአታልና አጽንቶታል።

verses.en: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
verses.fr: Mais s''il les annule après le jour où il en a eu connaissance, il sera coupable du péché de sa femme.
verses.am: ከሰማው በኋላ ግን ከንቱ ቢያደርገው ኃጢአትዋን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: These are the statutes, which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father's house.
verses.fr: Telles sont les lois que l''Eternel prescrivit à Moïse, entre un mari et sa femme, entre un père et sa fille, lorsqu''elle est dans sa jeunesse et à la maison de son père.
verses.am: እርስዋ በብላቴንነትዋ ጊዜ በአባትዋ ቤት ሳለች በአባትና በልጂቱ መካከል፥ ወይም በባልና በሚስት መካከል ይሆን ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ያዘዘው ሥርዓት ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
verses.fr: Venge les enfants d''Israël sur les Madianites; tu seras ensuite recueilli auprès de ton peuple.
verses.am: ስለ እስራኤል ልጆች በቀል ምድያማውያንን ተበቀል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ወገኖችህ ትከማቻለህ።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the Lord of Midian.
verses.fr: Moïse parla au peuple, et dit: Equipez d''entre vous des hommes pour l''armée, et qu''ils marchent contre Madian, afin d''exécuter la vengeance de l''Eternel sur Madian.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሕዝቡን። ከእናንተ መካከል ሰዎች ለጦርነት ይሰለፉ፤ ስለ እግዚአብሔር በቀል ምድያምን ይበቀሉ ዘንድ በምድያም ላይ ይሂዱ፤

verses.en: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
verses.fr: Vous enverrez à l''armée mille hommes par tribu, de toutes les tribus d''Israël.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ነገዶች ሁሉ ከየነገዱ አንድ ሺህ ሰው ወደ ጦርነት ስደዱ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
verses.fr: On leva d''entre les milliers d''Israël mille hommes par tribu, soit douze mille hommes équipés pour l''armée.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም አእላፋት አሥራ ሁለት ሺህ፥ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሺህ፥ ለጦርነት የተሰለፉ ሰዎች ተሰጡ።

verses.en: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of every tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
verses.fr: Moïse envoya à l''armée ces mille hommes par tribu, et avec eux le fils du sacrificateur Eléazar, Phinées, qui portait les instruments sacrés et les trompettes retentissantes.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ ሺህ ወደ ጦርነት ሰደደ፤ እነርሱንና የካህኑን የአልዓዛርን ልጅ ፊንሐስን ወደ ጦርነት ሰደዳቸው፤ የመቅደሱንም ዕቃ የሚነፋውንም መለከት በእጁ ሰጠው።

verses.en: And they warred against the Midianites, as the Lord commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
verses.fr: Ils s''avancèrent contre Madian, selon l''ordre que l''Eternel avait donné à Moïse; et ils tuèrent tous les mâles.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘ ከምድያም ጋር ተዋጉ፥ ወንዶችንም ሁሉ ገደሉ።

verses.en: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
verses.fr: Ils tuèrent les rois de Madian avec tous les autres, Evi, Rékem, Tsur, Hur et Réba, cinq rois de Madian; ils tuèrent aussi par l''épée Balaam, fils de Beor.
verses.am: ከተገደሉትም ጋር የምድያምን ነገሥታት ገደሉአቸው፤ አምስቱም የምድያም ነገሥታት ኤዊ፥ ሮቆም፥ ሱር፥ ሑር፥ ሪባ ነበሩ፤ የቢዖርንም ልጅ በለዓምን ደግሞ በሰይፍ ገደሉት።

verses.en: And the children of Israel took all the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël firent prisonnières les femmes des Madianites avec leurs petits enfants, et ils pillèrent tout leur bétail, tous leurs troupeaux et toutes leurs richesses.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች የምድያምን ሴቶችና ልጆቻቸውን ማረኩ፤ እንስሶቻቸውንና መንጎቻቸውንም ዕቃቸውንም ሁሉ በዘበዙ።

verses.en: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
verses.fr: Ils incendièrent toutes les villes qu''ils habitaient et tous leurs enclos.
verses.am: የተቀመጡባቸውን ከተሞቻቸውን ሁሉ ሰፈሮቻቸውንም ሁሉ በእሳት አቃጠሉ።

verses.en: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, both of men and of beasts.
verses.fr: Ils prirent toutes les dépouilles et tout le butin, personnes et bestiaux;
verses.am: የሰውንና የእንስሳን ምርኮና ብዝበዛ ሁሉ ወሰዱ።

verses.en: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.fr: et ils amenèrent les captifs, le butin et les dépouilles, à Moïse, au sacrificateur Eléazar, et à l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, campés dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho.
verses.am: የማረኩአቸውንም ሰዎች ምርኮውንና ብዝበዛውን ወደ ሙሴና ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አልዓዛር ወደ እስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር፥ በዮርዳኖስም አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ሜዳ ወዳለው ሰፈር አመጡ።

verses.en: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
verses.fr: Moïse, le sacrificateur Eléazar, et tous les princes de l''assemblée, sortirent au-devant d''eux, hors du camp.
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም የማኅበሩም አለቆች ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ ሊገናኙአቸው ወጡ።

verses.en: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, with the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
verses.fr: Et Moïse s''irrita contre les commandants de l''armée, les chefs de milliers et les chefs de centaines, qui revenaient de l''expédition.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከዘመቻ በተመለሱት በጭፍራ አለቆች፥ በሻለቆችና በመቶ አለቆች ላይ ተቈጣ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Avez-vous laissé la vie à toutes les femmes?
verses.am: ሙሴም አላቸው። በውኑ ሴቶችን ሁሉ አዳናችኋቸውን?

verses.en: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici, ce sont elles qui, sur la parole de Balaam, ont entraîné les enfants d''Israël à l''infidélité envers l''Eternel, dans l''affaire de Peor; et alors éclata la plaie dans l''assemblée de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆ፥ እነዚህ በፌጎር ምክንያት በበለዓም ምክር እግዚአብሔርን ይበድሉ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ዕንቅፋት ሆኑ፤ ስለዚህም በእግዚአብሔር ማኅበር ላይ መቅሠፍት ሆነ።

verses.en: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
verses.fr: Maintenant, tuez tout mâle parmi les petits enfants, et tuez toute femme qui a connu un homme en couchant avec lui;
verses.am: አሁን እንግዲህ ከልጆቹ ወንዱን ሁሉ ግደሉ፥ ወንድንም በመኝታ የሚያውቁትን ሴቶች ሁሉ ግደሉ።

verses.en: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.fr: mais laissez en vie pour vous toutes les filles qui n''ont point connu la couche d''un homme.
verses.am: ወንድን የማያውቁትን ሴቶች ልጆችን ሁሉ ግን ለራሳችሁ አድኑአቸው።

verses.en: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify both yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
verses.fr: Et vous, campez pendant sept jours hors du camp; tous ceux d''entre vous qui ont tué quelqu''un, et tous ceux qui ont touché un mort, se purifieront le troisième et le septième jour, eux et vos prisonniers.
verses.am: ከሰፈሩም ውጭ ሰባት ቀን ስፈሩ፤ ሰውን የገደለ ሁሉ የተገደለውንም የዳሰሰ ሁሉ፥ እናንተ የማረካችኋቸውም በሦስተኛውና በሰባተኛው ቀን ሰውነታችሁን ንጹሕ አድርጉ።

verses.en: And purify all your raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' hair, and all things made of wood.
verses.fr: Vous purifierez aussi tout vêtement, tout objet de peau, tout ouvrage de poil de chèvre et tout ustensile de bois.
verses.am: ልብስንም፥ ከቁርበትም የተዘጋጀውን ሁሉ፥ ከፍየልም ጠጕር ከእንጨትም የተሠራውን ሁሉ ንጹሕ አድርጉ።

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This is the ordinance of the law which the Lord commanded Moses;
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Eléazar dit aux soldats qui étaient allés à la guerre: Voici ce qui est ordonné par la loi que l''Eternel a prescrite à Moïse.
verses.am: ካህኑም አልዓዛር ከሰልፍ የመጡትን ሰዎች አላቸው። እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ያዘዘው የሕጉ ሥርዓት ይህ ነው፤

verses.en: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
verses.fr: L''or, l''argent, l''airain, le fer, l''étain et le plomb,
verses.am: ወርቁንና ብሩን፥ ናሱንም፥ ብረቱንም፥ ቆርቆሮውንም፥

verses.en: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make it go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
verses.fr: tout objet qui peut aller au feu, vous le ferez passer par le feu pour le rendre pur. Mais c''est par l''eau de purification que sera purifié tout ce qui ne peut aller au feu; vous le ferez passer dans l''eau.
verses.am: አረሩንም፥ በእሳት ለማለፍ የሚችለውን ሁሉ በእሳት ታሳልፉታላችሁ፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል፤ ነገር ግን በማንጻት ውኃ ደግሞ ይጠራል። በእሳትም ለማለፍ የማይችለውን በውኃ ታሳልፉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
verses.fr: Vous laverez vos vêtements le septième jour, et vous serez purs; ensuite, vous pourrez entrer dans le camp.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ልብሳችሁን እጠቡ፥ ንጹሕም ትሆናላችሁ፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ትቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, both of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
verses.fr: Fais, avec le sacrificateur Eléazar et les chefs de maison de l''assemblée, le compte du butin, de ce qui a été pris, personnes et bestiaux.
verses.am: አንተና ካህኑ አልዓዛር የማኅበሩም አባቶች አለቆች የተማረኩትን ሰውና እንስሳ ቍጠሩ።

verses.en: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
verses.fr: Partage le butin entre les combattants qui sont allés à l''armée et toute l''assemblée.
verses.am: ምርኮውንም በተዋጉትና ወደ ሰፍል በወጡት፥ በማኅበሩም ሁሉ መካከል አስተካክለህ ክፈል።

verses.en: And levy a tribute unto the Lord of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, both of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
verses.fr: Tu prélèveras sur la portion des soldats qui sont allés à l''armée un tribut pour l''Eternel, savoir: un sur cinq cents, tant des personnes que des boeufs, des ânes et des brebis.
verses.am: ከእነዚያም ከተዋጉት ወደ ሰልፍም ከወጡት ሰልፈኞች ዘንድ፥ ከሰዎችም ከበሬዎችም ከአህዮችም ከመንጎችም ከአምስት መቶ አንድ ለእግዚአብሔር ግብር አውጣ።

verses.en: Take it of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, for an heave offering of the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous le prendrez sur leur moitié, et tu le donneras au sacrificateur Eléazar comme une offrande à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከድርሻቸው ወስደህ ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን ለካህኑ ለአልዓዛር ስጠው።

verses.en: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord.
verses.fr: Et sur la moitié qui revient aux enfants d''Israël tu prendras un sur cinquante, tant des personnes que des boeufs, des ânes et des brebis, de tout animal; et tu le donneras aux Lévites, qui ont la garde du tabernacle de l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ድርሻ ከሰዎች ከበሬዎችም ከአህዮችም ከመንጎችም ከከብቶችም ሁሉ ከአምሳ አንድ ትወስዳለህ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ለሚጠብቁ ለሌዋውያን ትሰጣለህ።

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Moïse et le sacrificateur Eléazar firent ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the booty, being the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
verses.fr: Le butin, reste du pillage de ceux qui avaient fait partie de l''armée, était de six cent soixante-quinze mille brebis,
verses.am: ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡ ሰዎችም ከወሰዱት ብዝበዛ ያስቀሩት ምርኮ እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ስድስት መቶ ሰባ አምስት ሺህ በጎች፥

verses.en: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
verses.fr: soixante-douze mille boeufs,
verses.am: ወንድ ከማያውቁ ሴቶችም ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ ነፍስ።

verses.en: And threescore and one thousand asses,
verses.fr: soixante et un mille ânes,
verses.am: ወንድ ከማያውቁ ሴቶችም ሠላሳ ሁለት ሺህ ነፍስ።

verses.en: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
verses.fr: et trente-deux mille personnes ou femmes qui n''avaient point connu la couche d''un homme. -
verses.am: በዘመቻም ለነበሩ ሰዎች ድርሻ የሆነ እኵሌታ ከበግ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ በጎች ነበረ፥

verses.en: And the half, which was the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
verses.fr: La moitié, formant la part de ceux qui étaient allés à l''armée, fut de trois cent trente-sept mille cinq cents brebis,
verses.am: ከበጎችም የእግዚአብሔር ግብር ስድስት መቶ ሰባ አምስት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the Lord'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
verses.fr: dont six cent soixante-quinze pour le tribut à l''Eternel;
verses.am: በሬዎችም ሠላሳ ስድስት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ግብር ሰባ ሁለት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the beeves were thirty and six thousand; of which the Lord'S tribute was threescore and twelve.
verses.fr: trente-six mille boeufs, dont soixante-douze pour le tribut à l''Eternel;
verses.am: አህዮቹም ሠላሳ ሺህ አምስት መቶ ነበሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ግብር ስድሳ አንድ ነበረ።

verses.en: And the asses were thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the Lord'S tribute was threescore and one.
verses.fr: trente mille cinq cents ânes, dont soixante et un pour le tribut à l''Eternel;
verses.am: ሰዎቹም አሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ነበሩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ግብር ሠላሳ ሁለት ነበረ።

verses.en: And the persons were sixteen thousand; of which the Lord'S tribute was thirty and two persons.
verses.fr: et seize mille personnes, dont trente-deux pour le tribut à l''Eternel.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሙሴ ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን የሆነውን ግብር ለካህኑ ለአልዓዛር ሰጠው።

verses.en: And Moses gave the tribute, which was the Lord'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Moïse donna au sacrificateur Eléazar le tribut réservé comme offrande à l''Eternel, selon ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné. -
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች እኩሌታም፥ ወደ ሰልፍ ከወጡት ወንዶች ላይ ሙሴ የለየው፥

verses.en: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
verses.fr: La moitié qui revenait aux enfants d''Israël, séparée par Moïse de celle des hommes de l''armée,
verses.am: የማኅበሩ ድርሻ ሦስት መቶ ሠላሳ ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ በጎች፥

verses.en: (Now the half that pertained unto the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand and seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
verses.fr: et formant la part de l''assemblée, fut de trois cent trente-sept mille cinq cents brebis,
verses.am: ሠላሳ ስድስት ሺህ በሬዎች፥

verses.en: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
verses.fr: trente-six mille boeufs,
verses.am: ሠላሳ ሺህ አምስት መቶ አህዮች፥

verses.en: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
verses.fr: trente mille cinq cents ânes,
verses.am: አሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ሰዎች ነበሩ።

verses.en: And sixteen thousand persons;)
verses.fr: et seize mille personnes.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች ድርሻ ሙሴ ከሰውና ከእንስሳ ከአምሳ አንድ ወሰደ፥ እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው የእግዚአብሔርን ማደሪያ አገልግሎት ለሚጠብቁ ሌዋውያን ሰጠ።

verses.en: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, both of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Sur cette moitié qui revenait aux enfants d''Israël, Moïse prit un sur cinquante, tant des personnes que des animaux; et il le donna aux Lévites, qui ont la garde du tabernacle de l''Eternel, selon ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné.
verses.am: በሠራዊት አእላፋት ላይ የተሾሙት አለቆች፥ ሻለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች፥ ወደ ሙሴ ቀረቡ፥

verses.en: And the officers which were over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
verses.fr: Les commandants des milliers de l''armée, les chefs de milliers et les chefs de centaines, s''approchèrent de Moïse,
verses.am: ሙሴንም። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡትን ከእጃችን በታች ያሉትን ቈጠርን፥ ከእኛም አንድ አልጐደለም።

verses.en: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which are under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
verses.fr: et lui dirent: Tes serviteurs ont fait le compte des soldats qui étaient sous nos ordres, et il ne manque pas un homme d''entre nous.
verses.am: ሰውም ሁሉ ካገኘው ከወርቅ ዕቃ፥ ከእግር አልቦም፥ ከአምባርም፥ ከቀለበትም፥ ከጕትቻም፥ ከድሪውም ለነፍሳችን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይልን ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር መባ አምጥተናል አሉት።

verses.en: We have therefore brought an oblation for the Lord, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the Lord.
verses.fr: Nous apportons, comme offrande à l''Eternel, chacun les objets d''or que nous avons trouvés, chaînettes, bracelets, anneaux, pendants d''oreilles, et colliers, afin de faire pour nos personnes l''expiation devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም ወርቁንና በልዩ ልዩ የተሠራውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ከእጃቸው ተቀበሉ።

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, even all wrought jewels.
verses.fr: Moïse et le sacrificateur Eléazar reçurent d''eux tous ces objets travaillés en or.
verses.am: ሻለቆችም የመቶ አለቆችም ለእግዚአብሔር ለማንሣት ቍርባን ያቀረቡት ወርቅ ሁሉ አሥራ ስድስት ሺህ ሰባት መቶ አምሳ ሰቅል ነበረ።

verses.en: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the Lord, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
verses.fr: Tout l''or, que les chefs de milliers et les chefs de centaines présentèrent à l''Eternel en offrande par élévation, pesait seize mille sept cent cinquante sicles.
verses.am: ወደ ሰልፍ የወጡ ሰዎች ሁሉ ከምርኮአቸው ለራሳቸው ወሰዱ።

verses.en: (For the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
verses.fr: Les hommes de l''armée gardèrent chacun le butin qu''ils avaient fait.
