verses.am: ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም ወርቁን ከሻለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች ወስደው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አገቡት።

verses.en: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, for a memorial for the children of Israel before the Lord.
verses.fr: Moïse et le sacrificateur Eléazar prirent l''or des chefs de milliers et des chefs de centaines, et l''apportèrent à la tente d''assignation, comme souvenir pour les enfants d''Israël devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ፤ ሙሴና ካህኑ አልዓዛርም ወርቁን ከሻለቆችና ከመቶ አለቆች ወስደው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለእስራኤል ልጆች መታሰቢያ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን አገቡት።

verses.en: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place was a place for cattle;
verses.fr: Les fils de Ruben et les fils de Gad avaient une quantité considérable de troupeaux, et ils virent que le pays de Jaezer et le pays de Galaad étaient un lieu propre pour des troupeaux.
verses.am: የሮቤልና የጋድ ልጆችም እጅግ ብዙ እንስሶች ነበሩአቸው፤ እነሆም፥ የኢያዜር ምድርና የገለዓድ ምድር ለእንስሶች የተመቸ ስፍራ እንደ ነበረ ባዩ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
verses.fr: Alors les fils de Gad et les fils de Ruben vinrent auprès de Moïse, du sacrificateur Eléazar et des princes de l''assemblée, et ils leur dirent:
verses.am: የጋድና የሮቤል ልጆች መጥተው ሙሴንና ካህኑን አልዓዛርን የማኅበሩንም አለቆች እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩአቸው።

verses.en: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
verses.fr: Atharoth, Dibon, Jaezer, Nimra, Hesbon, Elealé, Sebam, Nebo et Beon,
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ማኅበር ፊት የመታው ምድር፥ አጣሮት፥ ዲቦን፥ ኢያዜር፥ ነምራ፥ ሐሴቦን፥ ኤልያሊ፥ ሴባማ፥ ናባው፥ ባያን፥ ለእንስሶች የተመቸ ምድር ነው፤ ለእኛም ለባሪያዎችህ እንስሶች አሉን።

verses.en: Even the country which the Lord smote before the congregation of Israel, is a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
verses.fr: ce pays que l''Eternel a frappé devant l''assemblée d''Israël, est un lieu propre pour des troupeaux, et tes serviteurs ont des troupeaux.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ማኅበር ፊት የመታው ምድር፥ አጣሮት፥ ዲቦን፥ ኢያዜር፥ ነምራ፥ ሐሴቦን፥ ኤልያሊ፥ ሴባማ፥ ናባው፥ ባያን፥ ለእንስሶች የተመቸ ምድር ነው፤ ለእኛም ለባሪያዎችህ እንስሶች አሉን።

verses.en: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, and bring us not over Jordan.
verses.fr: Ils ajoutèrent: Si nous avons trouvé grâce à tes yeux, que la possession de ce pays soit accordée à tes serviteurs, et ne nous fais point passer le Jourdain.
verses.am: እኛስ በአንተ ዘንድ ሞገስን አግኝተን እንደ ሆነ ይህን ምድር ለባሪያዎችህ ርስት አድርገህ ስጠን፤ ወደ ዮርዳኖስም ማዶ አታሻግረን።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
verses.fr: Moïse répondit aux fils de Gad et aux fils de Ruben: Vos frères iront-ils à la guerre, et vous, resterez-vous ici?
verses.am: ሙሴም ለጋድና ለሮቤል ልጆች አላቸው። ወንድሞቻችሁ ወደ ጦርነት ሲሄዱ እናንተ በዚህ ትቀመጣላችሁን?

verses.en: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the Lord hath given them?
verses.fr: Pourquoi voulez-vous décourager les enfants d''Israël de passer dans le pays que l''Eternel leur donne?
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ወደሚሰጣቸው ምድር እንዳይሻገሩ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልብ ለምን ታደክማላችሁ?

verses.en: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadeshbarnea to see the land.
verses.fr: Ainsi firent vos pères, quand je les envoyai de Kadès-Barnéa pour examiner le pays.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን ይሰልሉ ዘንድ ከቃዴስ በርኔ በሰደድኋቸው ጊዜ አባቶቻችሁ እንዲህ አደረጉ።

verses.en: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the Lord had given them.
verses.fr: Ils montèrent jusqu''à la vallée d''Eschcol, et, après avoir examiné le pays, ils découragèrent les enfants d''Israël d''aller dans le pays que l''Eternel leur donnait.
verses.am: ወደ ኤሽኮልም ሸለቆ በሄዱ ጊዜ፥ ምድሪቱንም ባዩ ጊዜ፥ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ሰጣቸው ምድር እንዳይገቡ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ልብ አደከሙ።

verses.en: And the Lord'S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma ce jour-là, et il jura en disant:
verses.am: በዚያም ቀን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ ነደደ፥

verses.en: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
verses.fr: Ces hommes qui sont montés d''Egypte, depuis l''âge de vingt ans et au-dessus, ne verront point le pays que j''ai juré de donner à Abraham, à Isaac et à Jacob, car ils n''ont pas suivi pleinement ma voie,
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ጸና፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ያደረገ ትውልድ ሁሉ እስኪጠፋ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ አቅበዘበዛቸው።

verses.en: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the Lord.
verses.fr: excepté Caleb, fils de Jephunné, le Kenizien, et Josué, fils de Nun, qui ont pleinement suivi la voie de l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔርም ቍጣ በእስራኤል ላይ ጸና፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ ያደረገ ትውልድ ሁሉ እስኪጠፋ ድረስ አርባ ዓመት በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ አቅበዘበዛቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the Lord, was consumed.
verses.fr: La colère de l''Eternel s''enflamma contre Israël, et il les fit errer dans le désert pendant quarante années, jusqu''à l''anéantissement de toute la génération qui avait fait le mal aux yeux de l''Eternel.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ የእግዚአብሔርን መዓት በእስራኤል ላይ አብዝታችሁ ትጨምሩ ዘንድ እናንተ የኃጢአተኞች ትውልድ በአባቶቻችሁ ፋንታ ቆማችኋል።

verses.en: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the Lord toward Israel.
verses.fr: Et voici, vous prenez la place de vos pères comme des rejetons d''hommes pécheurs, pour rendre la colère de l''Eternel encore plus ardente contre Israël.
verses.am: እርሱን ከመከተል ብትመለሱ እርሱ ሕዝቡን በምድረ በዳ ደግሞ ይተዋል፤ ይህንንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ታጠፋላችሁ።

verses.en: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
verses.fr: Car, si vous vous détournez de lui, il continuera de laisser Israël au désert, et vous causerez la perte de tout ce peuple.
verses.am: ወደ እርሱም ቀርበው አሉት። በዚህ ለእንስሶቻችን በረቶች ለልጆቻችንም ከተሞች እንሠራለን፤

verses.en: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
verses.fr: Ils s''approchèrent de Moïse, et ils dirent: Nous construirons ici des parcs pour nos troupeaux et des villes pour nos petits enfants;
verses.am: እኛ ግን ለጦርነት ተዘጋጅተን ወደ ስፍራቸው እስክናገባቸው ድረስ በእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንሄዳለን፤ በዚህም ምድር ስላሉ ሰዎች ልጆቻችን በተመሸጉ ከተሞች ይቀመጣሉ።

verses.en: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.fr: puis nous nous équiperons en hâte pour marcher devant les enfants d''Israël, jusqu''à ce que nous les ayons introduits dans le lieu qui leur est destiné; et nos petits enfants demeureront dans les villes fortes, à cause des habitants du pays.
verses.am: የእስራኤል ልጆች ሁሉ ርስታቸውን እስኪወርሱ ድረስ ወደ ቤቶቻችን አንመለስም፤

verses.en: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
verses.fr: Nous ne retournerons point dans nos maisons avant que les enfants d''Israël aient pris possession chacun de son héritage;
verses.am: ከዮርዳኖስ ወዲህ ወደ ምሥራቅ ርስታችን ደርሶናልና እኛ ከዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ወደዚያ ከእነርሱ ጋር ርስት አንወርስም።

verses.en: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
verses.fr: et nous ne posséderons rien avec eux de l''autre côté du Jourdain, ni plus loin, puisque nous aurons notre héritage de ce côté-ci du Jourdain, à l''orient.
verses.am: ሙሴም አላቸው። ይህንስ ነገር ብታደርጉ፥ ተዘጋጅታችሁም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ሰልፍ ብትሄዱ፥

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the Lord to war,
verses.fr: Moïse leur dit: Si vous faites cela, si vous vous armez pour combattre devant l''Eternel,
verses.am: እርሱም ጠላቶቹን ከፊቱ እስኪያሳድድ ድረስ ምድሪቱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ድል እስክትሆን ድረስ ከእናንተ ሰው ሁሉ ጋሻ ጦሩን ይዞ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዮርዳኖስን ቢሻገር፥

verses.en: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the Lord, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
verses.fr: si tous ceux de vous qui s''armeront passent le Jourdain devant l''Eternel jusqu''à ce qu''il ait chassé ses ennemis loin de sa face,
verses.am: ከዚያ በኋላ ትመለሳላችሁ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት በእስራኤል ዘንድ ንጹሐን ትሆናላችሁ፤ ይህች ምድርም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ርስት ትሆንላችኋለች።

verses.en: And the land be subdued before the Lord: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the Lord, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the Lord.
verses.fr: et si vous revenez seulement après que le pays aura été soumis devant l''Eternel, -vous serez alors sans reproche vis-à-vis de l''Eternel et vis-à-vis d''Israël, et cette contrée-ci sera votre propriété devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: እናንተ ግን እንዲህ ባታደርጉ፥ እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔርን ትበድላላችሁ፤ ኃጢአታችሁም እንዲያገኛችሁ እወቁ።

verses.en: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the Lord: and be sure your sin will find you out.
verses.fr: Mais si vous ne faites pas ainsi, vous péchez contre l''Eternel; sachez que votre péché vous atteindra.
verses.am: ለልጆቻችሁ ከተሞች፥ ለበጎቻችሁም በረቶች ሥሩ፤ ከአፋችሁም የወጣውን ነገር አድርጉ።

verses.en: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
verses.fr: Construisez des villes pour vos petits enfants et des parcs pour vos troupeaux, et faites ce que votre bouche a déclaré.
verses.am: የጋድና የሮቤልም ልጆች ሙሴን እንዲህ ብለው ተናገሩት። እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ጌታችን እንዳዘዘ እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
verses.fr: Les fils de Gad et les fils de Ruben dirent à Moïse: Tes serviteurs feront ce que mon seigneur ordonne.
verses.am: ልጆቻችን፥ ሚስቶቻችንም፥ መንጎቻችንም፥ እንስሶቻችንም ሁሉ በዚያ በገለዓድ ከተሞች ይሆናሉ፤

verses.en: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
verses.fr: Nos petits enfants, nos femmes, nos troupeaux et tout notre bétail, resteront dans les villes de Galaad;
verses.am: እኛ ባሪያዎችህ ግን ሁላችን ጋሻ ጦራችንን ይዘን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ጌታችን እንደ ተናገረ ወደ ጦርነት እንሄዳለን።

verses.en: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the Lord to battle, as my lord saith.
verses.fr: et tes serviteurs, tous armés pour la guerre, iront combattre devant l''Eternel, comme dit mon seigneur.
verses.am: ሙሴም ካህኑን አልዓዛርን የነዌንም ልጅ ኢያሱን የእስራኤልንም ልጆች ነገድ አለቆች ስለ እነርሱ አዘዘ።

verses.en: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
verses.fr: Moïse donna des ordres à leur sujet au sacrificateur Eléazar, à Josué, fils de Nun, et aux chefs de famille dans les tribus des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ሙሴም። የጋድና የሮቤል ልጆች ሁላቸው ጋሻ ጦራቸውን ይዘው ከእናንተ ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዮርዳኖስን ቢሻገሩ፥ ምድሪቱንም ድል ብትነሡ፥ የገለዓድን ምድር ርስት አድርጋችሁ ትሰጡአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the Lord, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
verses.fr: Il leur dit: Si les fils de Gad et les fils de Ruben passent avec vous le Jourdain, tous armés pour combattre devant l''Eternel, et que le pays soit soumis devant vous, vous leur donnerez en propriété la contrée de Galaad.
verses.am: ጋሻ ጦራቸውን ይዘው ከእናንተ ጋር ባይሻገሩ ግን በከነዓን ምድር በእናንተ መካከል ርስታቸውን ይወርሳሉ አላቸው።

verses.en: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Mais s''ils ne marchent point en armes avec vous, qu''ils s''établissent au milieu de vous dans le pays de Canaan.
verses.am: የጋድና የሮቤልም ልጆች መልሰው። እግዚአብሔር ለእኛ ለባሪያዎችህ እንደ ተናገረ እንዲሁ እናደርጋለን።

verses.en: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the Lord hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
verses.fr: Les fils de Gad et les fils de Ruben répondirent: Nous ferons ce que l''Eternel a dit à tes serviteurs.
verses.am: ጋሻ ጦራችንን ይዘን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደ ከነዓን ምድር እንሻገራለን፥ ከዮርዳኖስም ማዶ ከወዲሁ የወረስነው ርስት ይሆንልናል አሉት።

verses.en: We will pass over armed before the Lord into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan may be our's.
verses.fr: Nous passerons en armes devant l''Eternel au pays de Canaan; mais que nous possédions notre héritage de ce côté-ci du Jourdain.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለጋድና ለሮቤል ልጆች ለዮሴፍም ልጅ ለምናሴ ነገድ እኩሌታ፥ የአሞራውያንን ንጉሥ የሴዎንን ግዛት የባሳንንም ንጉሥ የዐግን ግዛት፥ ምድሪቱንና በዙሪያዋ ያሉትን ከተሞች ሰጣቸው።

verses.en: And Moses gave unto them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, even the cities of the country round about.
verses.fr: Moïse donna aux fils de Gad et aux fils de Ruben, et à la moitié de la tribu de Manassé, fils de Joseph, le royaume de Sihon, roi des Amoréens, et le royaume d''Og, roi de Basan, le pays avec ses villes, avec les territoires des villes du pays tout alentour.
verses.am: የጋድም ልጆች ዲቦንን፥ አጣሮትን፥ አሮዔርን፥

verses.en: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
verses.fr: Les fils de Gad bâtirent Dibon, Atharoth, Aroër,
verses.am: ዓጥሮትሽፋንን፥ ኢያዜርን፥ ዮግብሃን፥

verses.en: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
verses.fr: Athroth-Schophan, Jaezer, Jogbeha,
verses.am: ቤትነምራን፥ ቤትሃራንን የተመሸጉ ከተሞች አድርገው ሠሩ፤ የበጎች በረቶችንም ሠሩ።

verses.en: And Bethnimrah, and Bethharan, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
verses.fr: Beth-Nimra et Beth-Haran, villes fortes, et ils firent des parcs pour les troupeaux.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች ሐሴቦንን፥ ኤልያሊን፥

verses.en: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
verses.fr: Les fils de Ruben bâtirent Hesbon, Elealé et Kirjathaïm,
verses.am: ቂርያታይምን፥ ስማቸውም የተለወጠውን ናባውን፥ በኣልሜዎንን፥ ሴባማን ሠሩ፤ እነዚህንም የሠሩአቸውን ከተሞች በሌላ ስም ጠሩአቸው።

verses.en: And Nebo, and Baalmeon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
verses.fr: Nebo et Baal-Meon, dont les noms furent changés, et Sibma, et ils donnèrent des noms aux villes qu''ils bâtirent.
verses.am: የምናሴም ልጅ የማኪር ልጆች ወደ ገለዓድ ሄዱ፥ ወሰዱአትም፥ በእርስዋም የነበሩትን አሞራውያንን አሳደዱ።

verses.en: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which was in it.
verses.fr: Les fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, marchèrent contre Galaad, et s''en emparèrent; ils chassèrent les Amoréens qui y étaient.
verses.am: ሙሴም ለምናሴ ልጅ ለማኪር ገለዓድን ሰጠ፤ በእርስዋም ተቀመጠ።

verses.en: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
verses.fr: Moïse donna Galaad à Makir, fils de Manassé, qui s''y établit.
verses.am: የምናሴም ልጅ ኢያዕር ሄዶ መንደሮችዋን ወሰደ፥ የኢያዕርም መንደሮች ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havothjair.
verses.fr: Jaïr, fils de Manassé, se mit en marche, prit les bourgs, et les appela bourgs de Jaïr.
verses.am: ኖባህም ሄደ ቄናትንም መንደሮችዋንም ወሰደ፥ በስሙም ኖባህ ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.en: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
verses.fr: Nobach se mit en marche, prit Kenath avec les villes de son ressort, et l''appela Nobach, d''après son nom.
verses.am: ፤ ኖባህም ሄደ ቄናትንም መንደሮችዋንም ወሰደ፥ በስሙም ኖባህ ብሎ ጠራቸው።

verses.en: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.fr: Voici les stations des enfants d''Israël qui sortirent du pays d''Egypte, selon leurs corps d''armée, sous la conduite de Moïse et d''Aaron.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ጕዞ ከሙሴና ከአሮን እጅ በታች በጭፍሮቻቸው ከግብፅ በወጡ ጊዜ እንዲህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the Lord: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
verses.fr: Moïse écrivit leurs marches de station en station, d''après l''ordre de l''Eternel. Et voici leurs stations, selon leurs marches.
verses.am: ሙሴም በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ እንደ ጕዞአቸው አወጣጣቸውን ጻፈ፤ እንደ አወጣጣቸውም ጕዞአቸው እንዲህ ነበረ።

verses.en: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Ramsès le premier mois, le quinzième jour du premier mois. Le lendemain de la Pâque, les enfants d''Israël sortirent la main levée, à la vue de tous les Egyptiens.
verses.am: በመጀመሪያው ወር ከወሩም በአሥራ አምስተኛው ቀን ከራምሴ ተጓዙ፤ ከፋሲካ በኋላ በነጋው የእስራኤል ልጆች ግብፃውያን ሁሉ እያዩ ከፍ ባለች እጅ ወጡ።

verses.en: For the Egyptians buried all their firstborn, which the Lord had smitten among them: upon their gods also the Lord executed judgments.
verses.fr: Et les Egyptiens enterraient ceux que l''Eternel avait frappés parmi eux, tous les premiers-nés; l''Eternel exerçait aussi des jugements contre leurs dieux.
verses.am: በዚያም ጊዜ ግብፃውያን እግዚአብሔር የገደላቸውን በኵሮቻቸውን ይቀብሩ ነበር፤ በአማልክቶቻቸውም ደግሞ እግዚአብሔር ፈረደባቸው።

verses.en: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
verses.fr: Les enfants d''Israël partirent de Ramsès, et campèrent à Succoth.
verses.am: የእስራኤልም ልጆች ከራምሴ ተጕዘው በሱኮት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Succoth, et campèrent à Etham, qui est à l''extrémité du désert.
verses.am: ከሱኮትም ተጕዘው በምድረ በዳ ዳርቻ ባለች በኤታም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pihahiroth, which is before Baalzephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Etham, se détournèrent vers Pi-Hahiroth, vis-à-vis de Baal-Tsephon, et campèrent devant Migdol.
verses.am: ከኤታምም ተጕዘው በበኣልዛፎን ፊት ወደ ነበረች ወደ ፊሀሒሮት ተመለሱ፤ በሚግዶልም ፊት ለፊት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from before Pihahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days'journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de devant Pi-Hahiroth, et passèrent au milieu de la mer dans la direction du désert; ils firent trois journées de marche dans le désert d''Etham, et campèrent à Mara.
verses.am: ከፊሀሒሮትም ተጕዘው በባሕሩ ውስጥ ወደ ምድረ በዳ አለፉ፤ በኤታምም በረሀ የሦስት ቀን መንገድ ሄደው በማራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim were twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Mara, et arrivèrent à Elim; il y avait à Elim douze sources d''eau et soixante-dix palmiers: ce fut là qu''ils campèrent.
verses.am: ከማራም ተጕዘው ወደ ኤሊም መጡ፤ በኤሊምም አሥራ ሁለት የውኃ ምንጮች ሰባ ዘንባቦችም ነበሩ፤ በዚያም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Elim, et campèrent près de la mer Rouge.
verses.am: ከኤሊምም ተጕዘው በኤርትራ ባሕር ዳር ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de la mer Rouge, et campèrent dans le désert de Sin.
verses.am: ከኤርትራም ባሕር ተጕዘው በሲን ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent du désert de Sin, et campèrent à Dophka.
verses.am: ከሲን ምድረ በዳም ተጕዘው በራፋቃ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Dophka, et campèrent à Alusch.
verses.am: ከራፋቃም ተጕዘው በኤሉስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Alusch, et campèrent à Rephidim, où le peuple ne trouva point d''eau à boire.
verses.am: ከኤሉስም ተጕዘው በራፊዲም ሰፈሩ፤ በዚያም ሕዝቡ የሚጠጡት ውኃ አልነበረም።

verses.en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Rephidim, et campèrent dans le désert de Sinaï.
verses.am: ከራፊዲምም ተጕዘው በሲና ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent du désert du Sinaï, et campèrent à Kibroth-Hattaava.
verses.am: ከሲናም ምድረ በዳ ተጕዘው በምኞት መቃብር ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Kibroth-Hattaava, et campèrent à Hatséroth.
verses.am: ከምኞት መቃብርም ተጕዘው በሐጼሮት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Hatséroth, et campèrent à Rithma.
verses.am: ከሐጼሮትም ተጕዘው በሪትማ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Rithma, et campèrent à Rimmon-Pérets.
verses.am: ከሪትማም ተጕዘው በሬሞን ዘፋሬስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Rimmon-Pérets, et campèrent à Libna.
verses.am: ከሬሞን ዘፋሬስም ተጕዘው በልብና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Libna, et campèrent à Rissa.
verses.am: ከልብናም ተጕዘው በሪሳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Rissa, et campèrent à Kehélatha.
verses.am: ከሪሳም ተጕዘው በቀሄላታ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Kehélatha, et campèrent à la montagne de Schapher.
verses.am: ከቀሄላታም ተጕዘው በሻፍር ተራራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de la montagne de Schapher, et campèrent à Harada.
verses.am: ከሻፍር ተራራም ተጕዘው በሐራዳ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Harada, et campèrent à Makhéloth.
verses.am: ከሐራዳም ተጕዘው በመቅሄሎት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Makhéloth, et campèrent à Tahath.
verses.am: ከመቅሄሎትም ተጕዘው በታሐት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Tahath, et campèrent à Tarach.
verses.am: ከታሐትም ተጕዘው በታራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Tarach, et campèrent à Mithka.
verses.am: ከታራም ተጕዘው በሚትቃ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Mithka, et campèrent à Haschmona.
verses.am: ከሚትቃም ተጕዘው በሐሽሞና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Haschmona, et campèrent à Moséroth.
verses.am: ከሐሽሞናም ተጕዘው በሞሴሮት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Moséroth, et campèrent à Bené-Jaakan.
verses.am: ከሞሴሮትም ተጕዘው በብኔያዕቃን ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Bené-Jaakan, et campèrent à Hor-Guidgad.
verses.am: ከብኔያዕቃንም ተጕዘው በሖርሃጊድጋድ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Hor-Guidgad, et campèrent à Jothbatha.
verses.am: ከሖርሃጊድጋድም ተጕዘው በዮጥባታ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Jothbatha, et campèrent à Abrona.
verses.am: ከዮጥባታም ተጕዘው በዔብሮና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Abrona, et campèrent à Etsjon-Guéber.
verses.am: ከዔብሮናም ተጕዘው በዔጽዮንጋብር ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which is Kadesh.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Etsjon-Guéber, et campèrent dans le désert de Tsin: c''est Kadès.
verses.am: ከዔጽዮንጋብርም ተጕዘው በጺን ምድረ በዳ ሰፈሩ፤ ይህችም ቃዴስ ናት።

verses.en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Kadès, et campèrent à la montagne de Hor, à l''extrémité du pays d''Edom.
verses.am: ከቃዴስም ተጕዘው በኤዶምያስ ምድር ዳርቻ ባለው በሖር ተራራ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the Lord, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first day of the fifth month.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur Aaron monta sur la montagne de Hor, suivant l''ordre de l''Eternel; et il y mourut, la quarantième année après la sortie des enfants d''Israël du pays d''Egypte, le cinquième mois, le premier jour du mois.
verses.am: ካህኑም አሮን በእግዚአብሔር ትእዛዝ ወደ ሖር ተራራ ላይ ወጣ፥ በዚያም የእስራኤል ልጆች ከግብፅ ምድር ከወጡ በኋላ በአርባኛው ዓመት በአምስተኛው ወር ከወሩም በመጀመሪያው ቀን ሞተ።

verses.en: And Aaron was an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
verses.fr: Aaron était âgé de cent vingt-trois ans lorsqu''il mourut sur la montagne de Hor.
verses.am: አሮንም በሖር ተራራ በሞተ ጊዜ ዕድሜው መቶ ሀያ ሦስት ዓመት ነበር።

verses.en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Le roi d''Arad, Cananéen, qui habitait le midi du pays de Canaan, apprit l''arrivée des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: በከነዓን ምድርም በደቡብ በኩል ተቀምጦ የነበረው ከነዓናዊው የዓራድ ንጉሥ የእስራኤል ልጆች እንደ መጡ ሰማ።

verses.en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de la montagne de Hor, et campèrent à Tsalmona.
verses.am: እነርሱም ከሖር ተራራ ተጕዘው በሴልሞና ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Tsalmona, et campèrent à Punon.
verses.am: ከሴልሞናም ተጕዘው በፉኖን ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Punon, et campèrent à Oboth.
verses.am: ከፉኖንም ተጕዘው በኦቦት ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Oboth, et campèrent à Ijjé-Abarim, sur la frontière de Moab.
verses.am: ከኦቦትም ተጕዘው በሞዓብ ዳርቻ ባለው በጋይ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Ijjé-Abarim, et campèrent à Dibon-Gad.
verses.am: ከጋይም ተጕዘው በዲቦንጋድ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
verses.fr: Ils partirent de Dibon-Gad, et campèrent à Almon-Diblathaïm.
verses.am: ከዲቦንጋድም ተጕዘው በዓልሞንዲብላታይም ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
verses.fr: Ils partirent d''Almon-Diblathaïm, et campèrent aux montagnes d''Abarim, devant Nebo.
verses.am: ከዓልሞንዲብላታይምም ተጕዘው በናባው ፊት ባሉ በዓብሪም ተራሮች ላይ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.fr: Ils partirent des montagnes d''Abarim, et campèrent dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho.
verses.am: ከዓብሪምም ተራሮች ተጕዘው በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ባለው በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth even unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
verses.fr: Ils campèrent près du Jourdain, depuis Beth-Jeschimoth jusqu''à Abel-Sittim, dans les plaines de Moab.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስም አጠገብ በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ ከቤትየሺሞት እስከ አቤልሰጢም ድረስ ሰፈሩ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho. Il dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ ፊት ለፊት በሞዓብ ሜዳ ላይ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Lorsque vous aurez passé le Jourdain et que vous serez entrés dans le pays de Canaan,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደከነዓን ምድር ዮርዳኖስን በተሻገራችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
verses.fr: vous chasserez devant vous tous les habitants du pays, vous détruirez toutes leurs idoles de pierre, vous détruirez toutes leurs images de fonte, et vous détruirez tous leurs hauts lieux.
verses.am: የአገሩን ሰዎች ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ ታሳድዳላችሁ፥ የተቀረጹትንም ድንጋዮቻቸውን ሁሉ ታጠፋላችሁ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም ምስሎቻቸውን ሁሉ ታጠፋላችሁ፥ በኮረብታ ላይ ያሉትን መስገጃዎቻቸውንም ታፈርሳላችሁ፤

verses.en: And ye shall dispossess the inhabitants of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
verses.fr: Vous prendrez possession du pays, et vous vous y établirez; car je vous ai donné le pays, pour qu''il soit votre propriété.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ለእናንተ ርስት አድርጌ ሰጥቼአችኋለሁና ምድሪቱን ትወርሱአታላችሁ ትቀመጡባታላችሁም።

verses.en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: and to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's inheritance shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
verses.fr: Vous partagerez le pays par le sort, selon vos familles. A ceux qui sont en plus grand nombre vous donnerez une portion plus grande, et à ceux qui sont en plus petit nombre vous donnerez une portion plus petite. Chacun possédera ce qui lui sera échu par le sort: vous le recevrez en propriété, selon les tribus de vos pères.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም በየወገኖቻችሁ በዕጣ ትወርሳላችሁ፤ ለብዙዎች እንደ ብዛታቸው ለጥቂቶቹም እንደ ጥቂትነታቸው መጠን ርስትን ትሰጣላችሁ፤ እያዳንዱ ሁሉ ዕጣ እንደ ወደቀለት በዚያ ርስቱ ይሆናል፤ በየአባቶቻችሁ ነገዶች ትወርሳላችሁ።

verses.en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them shall be pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
verses.fr: Mais si vous ne chassez pas devant vous les habitants du pays, ceux d''entre eux que vous laisserez seront comme des épines dans vos yeux et des aiguillons dans vos côtés, ils seront vos ennemis dans le pays où vous allez vous établir.
verses.am: የአገሩንም ሰዎች ከፊታችሁ ባታሳድዱ፥ ያስቀራችኋቸው ለዓይናችሁ እንደ እሾህ ለጎናችሁም እንደሚወጋ ነገር ይሆኑባችኋል፥ በምትቀመጡባትም ምድር ያስጨንቁአችኋል።

verses.en: Moreover it shall come to pass, that I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
verses.fr: Et il arrivera que je vous traiterai comme j''avais résolu de les traiter.
verses.am: እኔም በእነርሱ አደርገው ዘንድ ያሰብሁትን በእናንተ አደርግባችኋለሁ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this is the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
verses.fr: Donne cet ordre aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Quand vous serez entrés dans le pays de Canaan, ce pays deviendra votre héritage, le pays de Canaan, dont voici les limites.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። ወደ ከነዓን ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥ ርስት ትሆናችሁ ዘንድ በዕጣ የምትደርሳችሁ ምድር፥ በዳርቻዋ ያለች የከነዓን ምድር፥

verses.en: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
verses.fr: Le côté du midi commencera au désert de Tsin près d''Edom. Ainsi, votre limite méridionale partira de l''extrémité de la mer Salée, vers l''orient;
verses.am: ይህች ናት፤ የደቡቡ ወገን ከጺን ምድረ በዳ በኤዶምያስ በኩል ይሆናል፤ የደቡቡም ዳርቻ ከጨው ባሕር ዳር በምሥራቅ በኩል ይጀምራል፤

verses.en: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
verses.fr: elle tournera au sud de la montée d''Akrabbim, passera par Tsin, et s''étendra jusqu''au midi de Kadès-Barnéa; elle continuera par Hatsar-Addar, et passera vers Atsmon;
verses.am: ዳርቻችሁም በአቅረቢም ዐቀበት በደቡብ በኩል ይዞራል ወደ ጺንም ያልፋል፤ መውጫውም በቃዴስ በርኔ በደቡብ በኩል ይሆናል፤ ወደ ሐጸርአዳር ይሄዳል ወደ ዓጽሞንም ያልፋል፤

verses.en: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
verses.fr: depuis Atsmon, elle tournera jusqu''au torrent d''Egypte, pour aboutir à la mer.
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ከዓጽሞን ወደ ግብፅ ወንዝ ይዞራል፥ መውጫውም በባሕሩ በኩል ይሆናል።

verses.en: And as for the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
verses.fr: Votre limite occidentale sera la grande mer: ce sera votre limite à l''occident.
verses.am: ለምዕራብም ዳርቻ ታላቁ ባሕር ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል፤ ይህ የምዕራብ ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
verses.fr: Voici quelle sera votre limite septentrionale: à partir de la grande mer, vous la tracerez jusqu''à la montagne de Hor;
verses.am: የሰሜንም ዳርቻችሁ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ከታላቁ ባሕር ወደ ሖር ተራራ ምልክት ታመለክታላችሁ፤

verses.en: From mount Hor ye shall point out your border unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
verses.fr: depuis la montagne de Hor, vous la ferez passer par Hamath, et arriver à Tsedad;
verses.am: ከሖርም ተራራ ወደ ሐማት መግቢያ ምልክት ታመለክታላችሁ የዳርቻውም መውጫ በጽዳድ ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
verses.fr: elle continuera par Ziphron, pour aboutir à Hatsar-Enan: ce sera votre limite au septentrion.
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ወደ ዚፍሮን ያልፋል እስከ ሐጸርዔናንም ድረስ ይወጣል፤ ይህ የሰሜን ዳርቻችሁ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
verses.fr: Vous tracerez votre limite orientale de Hatsar-Enan à Schepham;
verses.am: የምሥራቁንም ዳርቻችሁን ከሐጸርዔናን ወደ ሴፋማ ምልክት ታመለክታላችሁ፤

verses.en: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
verses.fr: elle descendra de Schepham vers Ribla, à l''orient d''Aïn; elle descendra, et s''étendra le long de la mer de Kinnéreth, à l''orient;
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ከሴፋማ በዓይን ምሥራቅ ወዳለው ወደ ሪብላ ይወርዳል፤ እስከ ኪኔሬት የባሕር ወሽመጥ በምሥራቅ በኩል ይደርሳል፤

verses.en: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
verses.fr: elle descendra encore vers le Jourdain, pour aboutir à la mer Salée. Tel sera votre pays avec ses limites tout autour.
verses.am: ዳርቻውም ወደ ዮርዳኖስ ይወርዳል፥ መውጫውም በጨው ባሕር ይሆናል። ምድራችሁ እንደ ዳርቻዋ በዙሪያዋ ይህች ናት።

verses.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the Lord commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
verses.fr: Moïse transmit cet ordre aux enfants d''Israël, et dit: C''est là le pays que vous partagerez par le sort, et que l''Eternel a résolu de donner aux neuf tribus et à la demi-tribu.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው። እግዚአብሔር ለዘጠኝ ነገድ ተኩል ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ ያዘዘ በዕጣ የምትወርሱአት ምድር ይህች ናት፤

verses.en: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received their inheritance; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
verses.fr: Car la tribu des fils de Ruben et la tribu des fils de Gad ont pris leur héritage, selon les maisons de leurs pères; la demi-tribu de Manassé a aussi pris son héritage.
verses.am: የሮቤልም ልጆች ነገድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፥ የጋድም ልጆች ነገድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤት፥ የምናሴም ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስታቸውን ወርሰዋል።

verses.en: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan near Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
verses.fr: Ces deux tribus et la demi-tribu ont pris leur héritage en deçà du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho, du côté de l''orient.
verses.am: እነዚህ ሁለቱ ነገድና የአንዱ ነገድ እኩሌታ ርስታቸውን በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በምሥራቅ በኩል ወረሱ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: These are the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
verses.fr: Voici les noms des hommes qui partageront entre vous le pays: le sacrificateur Eléazar, et Josué, fils de Nun.
verses.am: ምድሪቱን ርስት አድርገው የሚከፍሉላችሁ ሰዎች ስማቸው ይህ ነው፤ ካህኑ አልዓዛርና የነዌ ልጅ ኢያሱ።

verses.en: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
verses.fr: Vous prendrez encore un prince de chaque tribu, pour faire le partage du pays.
verses.am: ምድሪቱንም ርስት አድርገው ይከፍሉ ዘንድ ከየነገዱ አንድ አንድ አለቃ ትወስዳላችሁ።

verses.en: And the names of the men are these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.fr: Voici les noms de ces hommes. Pour la tribu de Juda: Caleb, fils de Jephunné;
verses.am: የሰዎቹም ስም ይህ ነው፤ ከይሁዳ ነገድ የዮፎኒ ልጅ ካሌብ፥

verses.en: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
verses.fr: pour la tribu des fils de Siméon: Samuel, fils d''Ammihud;
verses.am: ከስምዖን ልጆች ነገድ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ሰላሚኤል፥

verses.en: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
verses.fr: pour la tribu de Benjamin: Elidad, fils de Kislon;
verses.am: ከብንያም ነገድ የኪስሎን ልጅ ኤልዳድ፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
verses.fr: pour la tribu des fils de Dan: le prince Buki, fils de Jogli;
verses.am: ከዳን ልጆች ንገድ አንድ አለቃ የዮግሊ ልጅ ቡቂ፥

verses.en: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
verses.fr: pour les fils de Joseph, -pour la tribu des fils de Manassé: le prince Hanniel, fils d''Ephod; -
verses.am: ከዮሴፍም ልጆች ከምናሴ ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሱፊድ ልጅ አኒኤል፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
verses.fr: et pour la tribu des fils d''Ephraïm: le prince Kemuel, fils de Schiphtan;
verses.am: ከኤፍሬም ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሺፍጣን ልጅ ቀሙኤል፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
verses.fr: pour la tribu des fils de Zabulon: le prince Elitsaphan, fils de Parnac;
verses.am: ከዛብሎን ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የፈርናክ ልጅ ኤሊሳፈን፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
verses.fr: pour la tribu des fils d''Issacar: le prince Paltiel, fils d''Azzan;
verses.am: ከይሳኮር ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሖዛ ልጅ ፈልጢኤል፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
verses.fr: pour la tribu des fils d''Aser: le prince Ahihud, fils de Schelomi;
verses.am: ከአሴር ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የሴሌሚ ልጅ አሒሁድ፥

verses.en: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
verses.fr: pour la tribu des fils de Nephthali: le prince Pedahel, fils d''Ammihud.
verses.am: ከንፍታሌም ልጆች ነገድ አንድ አለቃ የዓሚሁድ ልጅ ፈዳሄል።

verses.en: These are they whom the Lord commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
verses.fr: Tels sont ceux à qui l''Eternel ordonna de partager le pays de Canaan entre les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በከነዓን ምድር ለእስራኤል ልጆች ርስታቸውን ይከፍሉ ዘንድ ያዘዛቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho. Il dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በሞዓብ ሜዳ እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give also unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
verses.fr: Ordonne aux enfants d''Israël d''accorder aux Lévites, sur l''héritage qu''ils posséderont, des villes où ils puissent habiter. Vous donnerez aussi aux Lévites une banlieue autour de ces villes.
verses.am: ሌዋውያን የሚቀመጡባቸውን ከተሞች ከርስታቸው ይሰጡ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እዘዛቸው፤ በከተሞቹም ዙሪያ ያለውን መሰምርያ ለሌዋውያን ስጡ።

verses.en: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
verses.fr: Ils auront les villes pour y habiter; et les banlieues seront pour leur bétail, pour leurs biens et pour tous leurs animaux.
verses.am: እነርሱም በከተሞቹ ውስጥ ይቀመጣሉ፤ መሰምርያቸውም ለከብቶቻቸው ለእንስሶቻቸውም ለእነርሱም ላለው ሁሉ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, shall reach from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
verses.fr: Les banlieues des villes que vous donnerez aux Lévites auront, à partir du mur de la ville et au dehors, mille coudées tout autour.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያንም የምትሰጡት የከተማ መሰምርያ በከተማው ዙሪያ ከቅጥሩ ወደ ውጭ አንድ ሺህ ክንድ ይሁን።

verses.en: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city shall be in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
verses.fr: Vous mesurerez, en dehors de la ville, deux mille coudées pour le côté oriental, deux mille coudées pour le côté méridional, deux mille coudées pour le côté occidental, et deux mille coudées pour le côté septentrional. La ville sera au milieu. Telles seront les banlieues de leurs villes.
verses.am: ከከተማው ውጭ በምሥራቅ በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ፥ በደቡብ በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ፥ በምዕራብ በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ፥ በሰሜንም በኩል ሁለት ሺህ ክንድ ትከነዳላችሁ፥ ከተማውም በመካከል ይሆናል፤ ይህም የከተሞቹ መሰምርያ ይሆንላቸዋል።

verses.en: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites there shall be six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
verses.fr: Parmi les villes que vous donnerez aux Lévites, il y aura six villes de refuge où pourra s''enfuir le meurtrier, et quarante-deux autres villes.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያንም የምትሰጡአቸው ስድስቱ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ናቸው፤ እነርሱም ነፍሰ ገዳይ ይሸሽባቸው ዘንድ የምትሰጡአቸው ናቸው፤ ከእነዚህም ሌላ አርባ ሁለት ከተሞች ትሰጣላችሁ።

verses.en: So all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites shall be forty and eight cities: them shall ye give with their suburbs.
verses.fr: Total des villes que vous donnerez aux Lévites: quarante-huit villes, avec leurs banlieues.
verses.am: ለሌዋውያን የምትሰጡአቸው ከተሞች ሁሉ አርባ ስምንት ከተሞች ይሆናሉ፤ ከመሰምርያቸው ጋር ትሰጡአቸዋላችሁ።

verses.en: And the cities which ye shall give shall be of the possession of the children of Israel: from them that have many ye shall give many; but from them that have few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
verses.fr: Les villes que vous donnerez sur les propriétés des enfants d''Israël seront livrées en plus grand nombre par ceux qui en ont le plus, et en plus petit nombre par ceux qui en ont moins; chacun donnera de ses villes aux Lévites à proportion de l''héritage qu''il possédera.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት ለሌዋውያን የምትሰጡአቸውን ከተሞች እንዲሁ ስጡ፤ ከብዙዎቹ ብዙ፥ ከጥቂቶቹ ጥቂት ትወስዳላችሁ፤ እያንዳንዱ እንደ ወረሱት እንደ ርስታቸው መጠን ከከተሞቻቸው ለሌዋውያን ይሰጣሉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Lorsque vous aurez passé le Jourdain et que vous serez entrés dans le pays de Canaan,
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ወደ ከነዓን ምድር ዮርዳኖስን በተሻገራችሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
verses.fr: vous vous établirez des villes qui soient pour vous des villes de refuge, où pourra s''enfuir le meurtrier qui aura tué quelqu''un involontairement.
verses.am: በስሕተት ነፍስ የገደለ ወደዚያ ይሸሽ ዘንድ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች እንዲሆኑላችሁ ከተሞችን ለእናንት ለዩ።

verses.en: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
verses.fr: Ces villes vous serviront de refuge contre le vengeur du sang, afin que le meurtrier ne soit point mis à mort avant d''avoir comparu devant l''assemblée pour être jugé.
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳዩ በማኅበሩ ፊት ለፍርድ እስኪቆም ድረስ እንዳይሞት፥ ከተሞቹም ከደም ተበቃይ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
verses.fr: Des villes que vous donnerez, six seront pour vous des villes de refuge.
verses.am: የምትሰጡአቸውም ስድስቱ ከተሞች የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, which shall be cities of refuge.
verses.fr: Vous donnerez trois villes au delà du Jourdain, et vous donnerez trois villes dans le pays de Canaan: ce seront des villes de refuge.
verses.am: በዮርዳኖስ ማዶ ሦስት ከተሞች ትሰጣላችሁ፥ በከነዓንም ምድር ሦስት ከተሞች ትሰጣላችሁ፤ የመማፀኛ ከተሞች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: These six cities shall be a refuge, both for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
verses.fr: Ces six villes serviront de refuge aux enfants d''Israël, à l''étranger et à celui qui demeure au milieu de vous: là pourra s''enfuir tout homme qui aura tué quelqu''un involontairement.
verses.am: በስሕተት ነፍስ የገደለ ይሸሽበት ዘንድ እነዚህ ስድስት ከተሞች ለእስራኤል ልጆች በመካከላቸው ለሚቀመጡ እንግዶችና መጻተኞች መማፀኛ ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: Si un homme frappe son prochain avec un instrument de fer, et que la mort en soit la suite, c''est un meurtrier: le meurtrier sera puni de mort.
verses.am: በብረት መሣርያ እስኪሞት ድረስ ቢመታው ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: S''il le frappe, tenant à la main une pierre qui puisse causer la mort, et que la mort en soit la suite, c''est un meurtrier: le meurtrier sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ሰውም በሚሞትበት በእጁ ባለው ድንጋይ ቢመታው የተመታውም ቢሞት፥ እርሱ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: Or if he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he is a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: S''il le frappe, tenant à la main un instrument de bois qui puisse causer la mort, et que la mort en soit la suite, c''est un meurtrier: le meurtrier sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ሰውም በሚሞትበት በእጁ ባለው በእንጨት መሣርያ ቢመታው የተመታውም ቢሞት፥ እርሱ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ነፍሰ ገዳዩም ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
verses.fr: Le vengeur du sang fera mourir le meurtrier; quand il le rencontrera, il le tuera.
verses.am: ደም ተበቃዩ ራሱ ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ይግደል፤ ባገኘው ጊዜ ይግደለው።

verses.en: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
verses.fr: Si un homme pousse son prochain par un mouvement de haine, ou s''il jette quelque chose sur lui avec préméditation, et que la mort en soit la suite,
verses.am: እስኪሞት ድረስ በጥላቻ ቢደፋው፥ ወይም ሸምቆ አንዳች ነገር ቢጥልበት፥

verses.en: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote him shall surely be put to death; for he is a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
verses.fr: ou s''il le frappe de sa main par inimitié, et que la mort en soit la suite, celui qui a frappé sera puni de mort, c''est un meurtrier: le vengeur du sang tuera le meurtrier, quand il le rencontrera.
verses.am: ወይም በጥላቻ እስኪሞት ድረስ በእጁ ቢመታው፥ የመታው ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ ነፍሰ ገዳይ ነው፤ ደም ተበቃዩ ባገኘው ጊዜ ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ይግደለው።

verses.en: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
verses.fr: Mais si un homme pousse son prochain subitement et non par inimitié, ou s''il jette quelque chose sur lui sans préméditation,
verses.am: ነገር ግን ያለ ጥላቻ ድንገት ቢደፋው፥ ሳይሸምቅም አንዳች ነገር ቢጥልበት፥

verses.en: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing him not, and cast it upon him, that he die, and was not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
verses.fr: ou s''il fait tomber sur lui par mégarde une pierre qui puisse causer la mort, et que la mort en soit la suite, sans qu''il ait de la haine contre lui et qu''il lui cherche du mal,
verses.am: ወይም ሳያየው እስኪሞት ድረስ ሰው የሚሞትበትን ድንጋይ ቢጥልበት፥ ጠላቱም ባይሆን፥ ክፉም ያደርግበት ዘንድ ባይሻ፥

verses.en: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
verses.fr: voici les lois d''après lesquelles l''assemblée jugera entre celui qui a frappé et le vengeur du sang.
verses.am: ማኅበሩ በመቺውና በደም ተባቃዩ መካከል ፍርድን እንደዚሁ ይፍረድ፤

verses.en: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
verses.fr: L''assemblée délivrera le meurtrier de la main du vengeur du sang, et le fera retourner dans la ville de refuge où il s''était enfui. Il y demeurera jusqu''à la mort du souverain sacrificateur qu''on a oint de l''huile sainte.
verses.am: ማኅበሩም ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ከደም ተበቃዩ እጅ ያድነዋል፥ ማኅበሩም ወደ ሸሸበት ወደ መማፀኛ ከተማ ይመልሰዋል፤ በቅዱስ ዘይትም የተቀባው ዋነኛው ካህን እስኪሞት ድረስ በዚያ ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
verses.fr: Si le meurtrier sort du territoire de la ville de refuge où il s''est enfui,
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ግን ከሸሸበት ከመማፀኛው ከተማ ዳርቻ ቢወጣ፥

verses.en: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
verses.fr: et si le vengeur du sang le rencontre hors du territoire de la ville de refuge et qu''il tue le meurtrier, il ne sera point coupable de meurtre.
verses.am: ደም ተበቃዩም ከመማፀኛው ከተማ ዳርቻ ውጭ ቢያገኘው፥ ደም ተበቃዩም ነፍሰ ገዳዩን ቢገድለው፥ የደም ዕዳ አይሆንበትም፤

verses.en: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
verses.fr: Car le meurtrier doit demeurer dans sa ville de refuge jusqu''à la mort du souverain sacrificateur; et après la mort du souverain sacrificateur, il pourra retourner dans sa propriété.
verses.am: ዋነኛው ካህን እስኪሞት ድረሰ በመማፀኛው ከተማ ውስጥ መቀመጥ ይገባው ነበርና። ዋነኛው ካህን ከሞተ በኋላ ግን ነፍሰ ገዳዩ ወደ ርስቱ ምድር ይመለሳል።

verses.en: So these things shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
verses.fr: Voici des ordonnances de droit pour vous et pour vos descendants, dans tous les lieux où vous habiterez.
verses.am: እነዚህም ነገሮች ለልጅ ልጃችሁ በማደሪያችሁ ሁሉ ሥርዓትና ፍርድ ይሁኑላችሁ።

verses.en: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person to cause him to die.
verses.fr: Si un homme tue quelqu''un, on ôtera la vie au meurtrier, sur la déposition de témoins. Un seul témoin ne suffira pas pour faire condamner une personne à mort.
verses.am: ነፍሰ ገዳይ ሁሉ በምስክሮች አፍ ይገደላል፤ በአንድ ምስክር ግን ማናቸውንም ሰው መግደል አይገባም።

verses.en: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which is guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
verses.fr: Vous n''accepterez point de rançon pour la vie d''un meurtrier qui mérite la mort, car il sera puni de mort.
verses.am: ሞት የተፈረደበትን ነፍሰ ገዳዩንም ለማዳን የነፍስ ዋጋ አትቀበሉ፤ እርሱ ፈጽሞ ይገደል።

verses.en: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
verses.fr: Vous n''accepterez point de rançon, qui lui permette de s''enfuir dans sa ville de refuge, et de retourner habiter dans le pays après la mort du sacrificateur.
verses.am: ዋነኛው ካህን ሳይሞት ወደ ምድሩ ይመለስ ዘንድ ወደ መማፀኛው ከተማ ከሸሸው የነፍስ ዋጋ አትቀበሉ።

verses.en: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye are: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
verses.fr: Vous ne souillerez point le pays où vous serez, car le sang souille le pays; et il ne sera fait pour le pays aucune expiation du sang qui y sera répandu que par le sang de celui qui l''aura répandu.
verses.am: ደም ምድሪቱን ያረክሳታልና የምትኖሩባትን ምድር አታርክሱአት፤ በደም አፍሳሹ ደም ካልሆነ በቀር ምድሪቱ ከፈሰሰባት ደም አትነጻም።

verses.en: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the Lord dwell among the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Vous ne souillerez point le pays où vous allez demeurer, et au milieu duquel j''habiterai; car je suis l''Eternel, qui habite au milieu des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር በእስራኤል ልጆች መካከል አድራለሁና የምትኖሩባትን በመካከልዋም የማድርባትን ምድር አታርክሱአት።

verses.en: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
verses.fr: Les chefs de la famille de Galaad, fils de Makir, fils de Manassé, d''entre les familles des fils de Joseph, s''approchèrent et parlèrent devant Moïse et devant les princes, chefs de famille des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ልጆች ወገኖች የምናሴ ልጅ የማኪር ልጅ የገለዓድ ልጆች ወገን አለቆች ቀረቡ፥ በሙሴና በእስራኤልም ልጆች አባቶች አለቆች ፊት ተናገሩ፤

verses.en: And they said, The Lord commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the Lord to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
verses.fr: Ils dirent: L''Eternel a ordonné à mon seigneur de donner le pays en héritage par le sort aux enfants d''Israël. Mon seigneur a aussi reçu de l''Eternel l''ordre de donner l''héritage de Tselophchad, notre frère, à ses filles.
verses.am: አሉም። ምድሪቱን ለእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት አድርገህ በዕጣ ከፍለህ ትሰጣቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር አንተን ጌታችንን አዘዘህ፤ እግዚአብሔርም የወንድማችንን የሰለጰዓድን ርስት ለሴቶች ልጆቹ ትሰጥ ዘንድ አንተን ጌታችንን አዘዘ።

verses.en: And if they be married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
verses.fr: Si elles se marient à l''un des fils d''une autre tribu des enfants d''Israël, leur héritage sera retranché de l''héritage de nos pères et ajouté à celui de la tribu à laquelle elles appartiendront; ainsi sera diminué l''héritage qui nous est échu par le sort.
verses.am: ከሌላም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ነገድ ባል ቢያገቡ፥ ርስታቸው ከአባቶቻችን ርስት ይነቀላል፥ እነርሱም ለሚሆኑበት ለሌላው ነገድ ርስት ይጨመራል፤ እንደዚህም የርስታችን ዕጣ ይጐድላል።

verses.en: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
verses.fr: Et quand viendra le jubilé pour les enfants d''Israël, leur héritage sera ajouté à celui de la tribu à laquelle elles appartiendront, et il sera retranché de celui de la tribu de nos pères.
verses.am: ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ኢዮቤልዩ በመጣ ጊዜ ርስታቸው ለሚሆኑበት ነገድ ርስት ይጨመራል፤ እንደዚህም ርስታቸው ከአባቶቻችን ነገድ ርስት ይጐድላል።

verses.en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the Lord, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
verses.fr: Moïse transmit aux enfants d''Israël les ordres de l''Eternel. Il dit: La tribu des fils de Joseph a raison.
verses.am: ሙሴም የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንደ እግዚአብሔር ቃል እንዲህ ብሎ አዘዛቸው። የዮሴፍ ልጆች ነገድ በእውነት ተናገሩ።

verses.en: This is the thing which the Lord doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
verses.fr: Voici ce que l''Eternel ordonne au sujet des filles de Tselophchad: elles se marieront à qui elles voudront, pourvu qu''elles se marient dans une famille de la tribu de leurs pères.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር ስለ ሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው፤ የወደዱትን ያግቡ፤ ነገር ግን ከአባታቸው ነገድ ብቻ ያግቡ።

verses.en: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
verses.fr: Aucun héritage parmi les enfants d''Israël ne passera d''une tribu à une autre tribu, mais les enfants d''Israël s''attacheront chacun à l''héritage de la tribu de ses pères.
verses.am: እንደዚህም የእስራኤል ልጆች ርስት ከነገድ ወደ ነገድ ምንም አይተላለፍ፤ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች እያንዳንዱ ወደ አባቶቹ ነገድ ርስት ይጠጋ።

verses.en: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
verses.fr: Et toute fille, possédant un héritage dans les tribus des enfants d''Israël, se mariera à quelqu''un d''une famille de la tribu de son père, afin que les enfants d''Israël possèdent chacun l''héritage de leurs pères.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች እያንዳንዱ ሰው የአባቶቹን ርስት ይወርስ ዘንድ፥ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ነገድ ሁሉ ርስት ያላት ሴት ልጅ ሁሉ ከአባትዋ ነገድ ባል ታግባ።

verses.en: Neither shall the inheritance remove from one tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
verses.fr: Aucun héritage ne passera d''une tribu à une autre tribu, mais les tribus des enfants d''Israël s''attacheront chacune à son héritage.
verses.am: እንደዚህም ከአንድ ነገድ ወደ ሌላ ነገድ ምንም ርስት አይተላለፍ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ነገድ እያንዳንዱ ወደ ርስቱ ይጠጋ።

verses.en: Even as the Lord commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
verses.fr: Les filles de Tselophchad se conformèrent à l''ordre que l''Eternel avait donné à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ የሰለጰዓድ ሴቶች ልጆች አደረጉ።

verses.en: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their fathers brothers' sons:
verses.fr: Machla, Thirtsa, Hogla, Milca et Noa, filles de Tselophchad, se marièrent aux fils de leurs oncles;
verses.am: የሰለጰዓድ ልጆች ማህለህ፥ ቲርጻ፥ ዔግላ፥ ሚልካ፥ ኑዓ ከአባታቸው ወንድሞች ልጆች ጋር ተጋቡ።

verses.en: And they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
verses.fr: elles se marièrent dans les familles des fils de Manassé, fils de Joseph, et leur héritage resta dans la tribu de la famille de leur père.
verses.am: ከዮሴፍ ልጅ ከምናሴ ልጆች ወገኖች ባሎቻቸውን አገቡ፥ ርስታቸውም በአባታቸው ነገድ ጸና።

verses.en: These are the commandments and the judgments, which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan near Jericho.
verses.fr: Tels sont les commandements et les lois que l''Eternel donna par Moïse aux enfants d''Israël, dans les plaines de Moab, près du Jourdain, vis-à-vis de Jéricho.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ የእስራኤልን ልጆች በዮርዳኖስ አጠገብ በኢያሪኮ አንጻር በሞዓብ ሜዳ ያዘዛቸው ትእዛዝና ፍርድ እነዚህ ናቸው።
